title: Servicemedarbejder til rengøring hver anden lørdag i Hobro
description:
Coor søger en dedikeret servicemedarbejder til rengøring, hvor du er med til at sikre rene omgivelser.

Arbejdssted og arbejdstider:

  • Sted: Hobro

  • Antal timer: 3,75

  • Arbejdstid: hver anden lørdag i lige uger

VIGTIGT AT VIDE: For at blive ansat skal du kunne PET-godkendes. Det betyder, at Politiets Efterretningstjeneste foretager en sikkerhedsundersøgelse, der bl.a. vurderer, om du kan arbejde i miljøer, hvor sikkerhed er afgørende. Dette kræver blandt andet, at du har boet i Danmark i mindst 7 år. Coor får ikke adgang til oplysningerne, men den er nødvendigt for at sikre vores kunders sikkerhed. Alle over 18 år som har adresse på husstanden, vil også blive tjekket.

Hos Coor får du:

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn i henhold til Serviceoverenskomsten (DI og 3F). Ved at arbejde på Serviceoverenskomsten er du sikret, at arbejde under lovlige og ordnede forhold. Vi stræber efter at arbejde efter de nyeste arbejdsprincipper, så vi sikrer, at du ikke slider unødigt på din krop når du arbejder hos Coor.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring: Du er sikret pension fra første arbejdsdag, og hvis du får brug for hurtig behandling hos fx fysioterapeut, kan du benytte sundhedsforsikringen.

  • En aktiv personaleforening som tilbyder særlige rabatter til Coor ansatte fx til hverdagsbutikker, sommerland billetter og forskellige kulturoplevelser. Du får også mulighed for at booke feriehuse i Danmark og i Spanien.

title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer - Efficiency Engineering
description:
About ClickHouse

Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

About the Team

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineering team builds and manages the foundational blocks of ClickHouse Cloud data plane end-to-end. This includes compute, networking, security, and a multi-cloud, multi-region architecture that provides a reliable and scalable managed ClickHouse experience for ClickHouse Cloud customers. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced cloud infrastructure software engineers to join our team, who will be responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining our infrastructure.

What will you do?

  • Architect and build a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.
  • Build a cutting-edge cloud-native platform on top of the public cloud, and automate our cloud resource management.
  • Execute high-impact infrastructure optimization initiatives across compute, storage, and networking.
  • Collaborate with the ClickHouse engineering teams to develop high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective solutions for our SaaS platform.
  • Optimize cost efficiency systematically through the implementation of distributed systems and industry best practices.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to design and construct tooling for cost efficiency insights.

About you:

  • 5+ years of relevant software development industry experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems.
  • Software development experience in Go, C/C++, Java, or another OOP language.
  • Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience developing cloud infrastructure services, preferably with Kubernetes.
  • Experience developing cloud native edge or service mesh services, preferably with envoy and Istio.
  • Experience leading and shipping large scope technical projects in collaboration with multiple experienced engineers.
  • Understanding of network topologies, protocols, and security principles, such as VPNs, firewalls, and load balancers.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including encryption, access controls, and compliance standards like SOC2 and GDPR.
  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a global team.
  • You are a strong problem-solver and have solid production debugging skills.
  • You are passionate about efficiency, availability, scalability and data governance.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward.
  • You have a high level of responsibility, ownership, and accountability

#LI-Remote

The typical starting salary for this role in the US is
$133,450—$197,200 USD
The typical starting salary for this role in US Premium Markets is
$157,000—$232,000 USD

Compensation

For roles based in the United States, the typical starting salary range for this position is listed above. In certain locations, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City Metro Area, a premium market range may apply, as listed.

These salary ranges reflect what we reasonably and in good faith believe to be the minimum and maximum pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amounts listed, and the ranges may be subject to future adjustments.

An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization.

If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at paytransparency@clickhouse.com.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 20 countries.
  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
  • A $500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Are you looking for a place where meaningful moments are made together?

At Marriott Vacations Worldwide (MVW), we make vacation dreams come true for travelers around the world in a supportive, friendly, and beautiful work environment. As a Safety & Security Officer at MVW, you will assist in providing our Owners/guests with experiences and events to make memorable vacation memories, where meaningful moments are made together.

Where great benefits lead to a life fulfilled.

  • Free daily associate meal

  • Monthly & quarterly team celebrations and awards

  • Company branded attire for outdoor associates

  • Discounts to onsite food outlets and spa

  • Discounted bus pass

  • Community service opportunities

As a Safety & Security Officer, a typical day will include:

  • Patrols all areas of the property by foot or vehicle using specified equipment (e.g., flashlight, high visibility jacket).

  • Administers first aid/CPR to Owner/guests or associates as required.

  • Ensure Owner/guest and meeting rooms are secure and assist Owner/guests with room access.

  • Monitors Closed Circuit Televisions (CCTV), perimeter alarm systems, duress alarms, and fire life safety systems.

  • Responds to the scene of Owner/guest or associate accidents and determine if emergency aid is required.

  • Defuses Owner/guest or associate disturbances/altercations following company policies and procedures.

  • Handles lost and found, logging and returning items.

  • Utilizes computer systems, prepares and reviews written documents accurately and completely; and answers the phone using proper telephone etiquette.

  • Oversee OSHA & FLS violations to mitigate risks throughout the property.

Guest Experience and Company Standards

  • Welcome and greet guests and anticipate and address their needs.

  • Interact with colleagues and guests professionally and promptly.

  • Contribute to team goals.

  • Always follow company policies and safety procedures.

To Become a Safety & Security Officer at MVW:

  • Available to work various shifts, holidays, and both weekend days.

  • Reach overhead and below the knees, perform bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping, and be able to stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.

  • Lift/Carry/Push/Pull Items that Weigh up to 50lbs without assistance.

  • Position may require background and drug screening contingent on company policy in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

  • Specific job duties may differ by property, size of team, or facility.

Marriott Vacations Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture.

title: Strategic Advisor, QA Vision Care & Pharma
description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's Project Management function, a team that ensures all regular and one-off projects are planned, organized, and executed effectively to help our people and the world see brilliantly.

The Strategic Advisor, QA Vision Care and Pharma is primarily responsible for leading strategic project management within the Alcon business unit to ensure cost-effective, high-quality execution in compliance with global standards at our Facility in Fort Worth, TX. Specifics include:

  • Lead and coordinate strategic Quality programs across the Vision Care & Pharma Franchises, ensuring alignment of priorities, timelines, risks, resources, and deliverables across global functions and regions.
  • Standardize and continuously improve Quality governance, project management tools, reporting processes, and best practices to enhance efficiency, consistency, and organizational effectiveness across both franchises.
  • Support Franchise Quality Leadership in annual objective setting, strategic planning, prioritization, and execution tracking to ensure delivery of business, compliance, and quality objectives.
  • Own governance and project management processes for key Quality initiatives, including remediation programs, monthly quality reviews with franchise and regional teams, quality system improvements, compliance projects, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Plan, coordinate, and host quarterly Franchise Quality Management Reviews (QMRs), including agenda development, metric compilation, executive briefing materials, meeting facilitation, action item management, and leadership follow-up.
  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and status reports that provide visibility to Quality performance, program progress, emerging risks, key decisions, and organizational priorities.
  • Support governance of Franchise-level Quality metrics and performance indicators, including complaint trends, CAPA performance, deviation/nonconformance trends, audit observations, inspection readiness, product quality trends, field actions, and other relevant Quality signals.
  • Facilitate collaboration among Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, Commercial, and regional stakeholders to ensure effective execution of franchise and enterprise Quality objectives.
  • Support identification, prioritization, and escalation of emerging Quality risks across the franchises, including potential patient/customer impact, compliance exposure, supply continuity concerns, or reputational risk.
  • Facilitate cross-franchise alignment on shared Quality priorities, lessons learned, systemic risks, best practices, and opportunities for standardization or continuous improvement.
  • Support preparation of executive-level Quality updates, including concise summaries for Quality Leadership Team, Franchise Leadership Team, and other senior governance forums.
  • Provide thought partnership to Franchise Quality leadership by identifying opportunities to strengthen governance, improve meeting effectiveness, enhance metric visibility, and increase proactive Quality risk management.
  • Liaison with regional quality teams on top issues impacting markets and regions.
  • Support of technology/product transfer projects.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +18 yrs; Assoc.+14 yrs; M.S.+7 yrs; PhD+6 yrs)
  • The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English
  • 10 years of relevant experience
  • Work Location: Onsite
  • Travel Requirements: Up to 10%
  • Relocation Assistance: Yes
  • Sponsorship Available: NO

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:

  • Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and learnings as work evolves!
  • Join Alcon’s mission to provide top-tier, innovative products and solutions to enhance sight & enhance lives.
  • Grow your career in a highly collaborative and diverse environment.
  • Alcon provides robust benefits package including health, life, retirement, flexible time off for salaried associates, paid time off for hourly associates and much more!

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
Overview

GitHub is seeking a passionate, driven, and collaborative Senior TPM to drive the GitHub Enterprise Servier (GHES) release process. This includes OS and container builds across the platform, infrastructure, and application layers; package generation and certification; integration test environments; and distribution of release artifacts through Azure and other clouds. In this role, you will define operational priorities for the team, coordinate execution across a complex release surface, and partner across engineering organizations to ensure GHES ships as a high-quality, secure, and dependable appliance for enterprise customers.

You will partner with stakeholders to deliver solutions that strengthen our security posture and elevate service resiliency and quality. Additionally, you will coordinate with engineers across the organization to monitor progress, resolve blockers, and provide status updates to the leadership team.

Our team is small, efficient, and engineering-focused, thriving in a fast-paced environment. We are looking for a Senior TPM who embraces new challenges and adapts quickly to evolving programs. To support multiple initiatives simultaneously, you will leverage AI to boost productivity and continuously seek opportunities to enhance engineering efficiency through agentic AI-based solutions.

To be successful in the role, the ideal candidate will require strong interpersonal skills, influencing without authority, drive for results, and collaboration in addition to a proven track record in technical program management and operational excellence.



Responsibilities

The Technical Program Manager Role encompasses a broad scope including:

  • Drive execution across build, package generation, validation, certification, and customer delivery workflows for GHES releases.

  • Establish and drive standards for release reliability, observability, compliance, and operational excellence across build, release, and certification workflows.

  • Set investment priorities for the GHES Release team, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term improvements in reliability, efficiency, and engineering velocity.

  • Ensure strong operational ownership of release infrastructure, including clear accountability, effective incident response, and continuous improvement following critical issues.

  • Drive and deliver security and compliance requirements.

  • Negotiate requirements with the central teams (SMEs).

  • Understand best practices and available tooling to improve service resiliency and quality.

  • Influence and drive adoption of quality best practices and standards.

  • Drive onboarding to central infra services and, tooling.

  • Track various metrics across broad set of services.

  • Drive tooling and infra feature design and implementation.

  • Identify new opportunities and work with the central teams to supplement existing quality standards.

  • Deliver technical and high-level presentations in various forums.

  • Drive multiple projects at any given time.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager or in a technical role with systems experience.

  • 3+ years of experience working in the Cloud domain.

  • 3+ year of experience in management of complex cross-group, cross-business, cross-disciplinary projects.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong technical problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Good understanding of cloud services best practices.

  • Good understanding of cloud architecture, telemetry, and monitoring systems.

  • Experience with high-availability systems and services resiliency.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and drive results across teams.

  • Negotiation skills to drive repair items/investments with engineering managers. Knows trade-offs.

  • 4-years degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/EE or equivalent experience.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Scholarships Team Leader (Postgraduate)
description:
Shape the future of postgraduate scholarships to support student and research success.

  • Lead an innovative postgraduate scholarships programme
  • Promote student success through financial support
  • Use data to drive new initiatives and scholarship growth

Ngā kōrero mō te tūranga – About the role

Are you ready to lead a service that directly changes students’ lives?

At the University of Waikato, scholarships are more than funding—they are a pathway to academic achievement, research excellence, and future opportunity. As Scholarships Team Leader (Postgraduate), you will lead the team responsible for managing postgraduate scholarships, bursaries, and prizes across both taught and research postgraduate programmes.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine people leadership, strategic thinking, analytical insight, and operational excellence. You will guide and support our Scholarship Advisors, ensure efficient and student-focused scholarship services, and help shape the future of postgraduate funding through data-informed initiatives, improved processes, and stronger internal and external partnerships.

Working closely with the Dean of the School of Graduate Research, scholarship committees, academic leaders, and external stakeholders, you will play a key role in shaping scholarship opportunities and ensuring funding is delivered fairly, effectively, and in ways that maximise student and research success.

If you are passionate about supporting postgraduate students and want to make a meaningful impact across the University, this is a role where your leadership will be highly visible and genuinely valued.

Salary will be in the range of $102,611 to $113,428 per year, based on the skills, knowledge, and experience you bring to the position. This is a full-time role (37.5 hours per week) based at our Hillcrest Campus.

For more information on the role, please see the position description. For a confidential conversation, contact Prof Emma Nicholson, Dean of Graduate Research, at emma.nicholson@waikato.ac.nz.

All applications must be submitted through the online portal; emailed applications will not be accepted.

Ko wai koe? – Who are you?

You are a strategic, organised, and highly motivated leader who enjoys balancing big-picture thinking with operational delivery. You bring experience leading teams and managing complex scholarship, funding, or administrative programmes, and you are committed to delivering excellent service to students and stakeholders.

You will also bring:

  • Proven leadership and team management experience
  • Strong financial, analytical, and project management skills
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities
  • Confidence working with complex regulations, policies, and processes
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work across diverse stakeholder groups
  • A commitment to continuous improvement and professional growth
  • Respect for and commitment to the principles of Te Tiriti o Waitangi

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Research shows that some people are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At the University of Waikato, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and genuine workplace. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every requirement

Ko wai mātou? – Who are we?

Te Mata Kairangi School of Graduate Research sits within the Office of the Deputy Vice-Chancellor Research and provides strategic leadership and administrative support for postgraduate higher research degree programmes, scholarships, awards, and prizes across the University.

Our work helps create an environment where postgraduate students can thrive, contribute to world-class research, and achieve meaningful outcomes for their communities and disciplines.

He aha ngā take me tono mai ai koe? – Why should you apply for this position?

We want you to be part of our success! Our University stands proudly on the world stage as a provider of future-focused, international education and an active player in global research. Our rankings reflect these strengths. Working with us means you’ll enjoy a satisfying work environment with many benefits.

The University of Waikato is distinctive for the diversity of its staff and students and encourages applicants with the relevant capabilities from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants must have the legal right to live and work in NZ in accordance with the NZ Immigration regulations which can be found here.

title: Supervisor
description:
Primary Location

NSW - Rockdale

Job Description Summary

ConnectSydney are on the hunt for an experienced Supervisor to join our team at our Rockdale office!

About the Role

ConnectSydney, a joint venture of ServiceStream, Boral, and Johnson Controls, in partnership with Transport for NSW, is entrusted with the management of the Harbour Zone. Our responsibilities encompass routine maintenance, strategic enhancements, and specialised projects aimed at bolstering Sydney's transport infrastructure.

The Civil Supervisor will oversee all Civil Maintenance and Minor Project activities through the management of sub-contractor and internal teams, providing leadership by safely managing performance of people, work programs, and/or processes.

They will coordinate road asset maintenance activities to ensure the safe, efficient, and high-quality delivery of works in line with TfNSW. This role offers a diverse mix of day and night shift operations, supporting the delivery of maintenance and project activities across the network.

The successful candidate will play a key role in assisting with coordinating work schedules, creating job packs, and supporting the planning and delivery of works. There is genuine opportunity for the role to expand into broader project coordination and operational leadership for candidates looking to further develop their career.

Please note that this role will consist of mostly onsite night work (7pm-3am) and day work within the Rockdale office. The successful candidate will be provided a company vehicle to travel to various sites across the Sydny Harbour Zone Region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Participate in formal and contractual meetings with the client and other relevant parties
  • Develop and maintain professional relationships with key stakeholders
  • Coordinate all activities across the contract, including scheduling and programming of works as required
  • Assist in scheduling day and night shift activities to ensure the efficient delivery of maintenance and project works
  • Preparation and coordination of project job packs, ensuring all documentation, permits, drawings and supporting information are complete prior to mobilisation
  • Oversee crews conducting road maintenance and minor civil construction and ensure all works are executed safely and efficiently
  • Lead daily pre-starts, toolbox talks, and ensure crew compliance with SWMS & ASECS
  • Ensure implementation of approved Traffic Guidance Schemes and ROLs
  • Organise and manage materials, plant, and labour on-site to meet daily productivity and quality targets
  • Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and traffic control providers to ensure timely delivery and support
  • Perform checks on workmanship, materials, and clean-up to confirm quality and conformance before handover
  • Record daily site activities, including crew hours, quantities, delays, weather conditions, and photos in the asset management system & close out defects
  • Communicate with residents, motorists, or local businesses where required to explain work impacts, duration, and access arrangements
  • Ensure everyone that undertakes work on the contract has the correct training and valid licences
  • Support the contract management system to ensure all maintenance or project activities are completed
  • Ensure all KPIs and contract performance requirements are met
  • Assist in the management of maintenance and construction projects in accordance with standards and the Risk Management Process
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the ongoing development of planning, scheduling, and project delivery processes across the contract.

About You:

  • Preference for a recognised tertiary qualification (Engineering or Construction), or a high level of demonstrated relevant experience
  • Current driver's licence
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in a roads infrastructure environment
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience managing people and/or multiple stakeholders
  • Demonstrated significant experience in the construction or services industry and safety management in a major subcontractor management role
  • Strong organisational, planning and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple work fronts and competing priorities.

About the position


Do you want to manage global upgrade projects for spray drying plants - and see your solutions boost efficiency for customers in dairy, food, pharma and chemical industries?

Join GEA and be part of a team developing tomorrow’s service solutions. Here, you will influence how industries adopt sustainable technologies, while managing both long-term upgrade projects and quick-turn service tasks.



Your responsibilities and tasks



At our office in Søborg, you will join a specialized service team of six project managers who act as a competence center for drying technologies. Together, you support local GEA offices around the world by sharing expertise, delivering second-level service and ensuring that upgrade projects are successfully implemented.

As a team, you collaborate closely, exchange knowledge and contribute to developing new service products that strengthen GEA’s global service business.
 

As Project Manager, your core mission is to make sure customers’ drying plants perform at their best. You are the one who picks up a customer enquiry, translates it into a concrete upgrade project and ensures that the solution is delivered - from the very first scope to final implementation.

Some days, you handle urgent support requests through our global CRM system; other days, you are deep into planning and driving long-term upgrades that stretch over several months. Your role is both technical and commercial, and you work closely with local GEA offices, vendors and customers to make sure every project creates real value.

You will for example:

handle enquiries for upgrade solutions through our global CRM system

manage tenders and ensure a smooth conversion into successful projects

deliver upgrade projects in close collaboration with local GEA offices

provide technical support to colleagues worldwide.



Your profile and qualifications



On a personal level, you are structured and detail-oriented, while still keeping the bigger picture in mind. You enjoy working in an international environment where communication and cultural curiosity are essential. With a proactive mindset, you take ownership of projects and find motivation in delivering value to both colleagues and customers.

Finally, we imagine that you:

bring project management skills combined with a technical background

speak and write English fluently (Danish is an advantage)

have experience working with service and support, ideally in an international setting

are flexible to travel globally up to 30-60 days per year

want to contribute actively to improving and developing the service business.



Would you like to know more?

If you would like to find out more about this position before submitting your application, please do not hesitate to contact Theis Lund, Senior Manager, Service, phone no. +45 2277 4379.



We will process the applications as we receive them, so please submit your application as soon as possible.



Please apply via the indicated link. Please note that GEA exclusively uses electronic recruiting, and only applications received through our application system will be considered.

  Juleassistance til aften og weekend hos BR 
 Vil du være med på et stærkt team, der hver eneste dag giver gode oplevelser og god vejledning? Er du energisk og entusiastisk, og kan du være med til at skabe en stemning, hvor vores kunder i alle aldre kan finde begejstring og inspiration blandt de kendte klassikere og de nyeste skud på legetøjsstammen? 

 Så har vi en spændende mulighed til dig. 

 Hos BR skaber vi oplevelser, og du er en vigtig del af et team præget af samarbejde og fleksibilitet, hvor kunden og den gode vejledning og service er i centrum. Du bliver del af et hold af medarbejdere med en fælles begejstring for legetøj og ikke mindst for legebørn. At skabe den gode kundeoplevelse hos BR er meget mere end at sørge for fyldte hylder og en god bundlinje. Det er at evne at skabe den rette stemning, og det er at give kunderne en oplevelse, der får dem til at komme igen og igen. 

 Med andre ord, du får et job, hvor du og resten af teamet får en umiddelbar belønning for jeres arbejde, når I giver kunderne den gode indkøbsoplevelse med smil og kvalitet, og når I skaber den helt særlige forbindelse til en lille kunde, der får et ønske opfyldt. 

 Din opgave er først og fremmest at sikre, at kunderne får et fantastisk besøg hos os gennem god vejledning, smilende og imødekommende betjening, en indbydende og lækker butik, og du har overskud til leg, nysgerrighed og små pilfingre. 

 Skab den rette stemning 
  Din arbejdsdag foregår hos kunderne i butikken, hvor du vejleder, hjælper og sørger for, at butikken altid er indbydende. Du er en ægte teamplayer, der tager ansvar og giver en kollega en hånd med, så I sammen når i mål. 

 Hvem er vores nye kollega? 
  Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring eller en uddannelse fra detailbranchen. Hvis du har produkterfaring vil det være en stor fordel, hvis ikke, klæder vi dig godt på til jobbet. 
 
 Du er serviceminded, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket, når situationen kræver det. 

 Du har fokus på kunderne og en fantastisk service, og du bidrager til det gode sammenhold i teamet. 

 Du kan lide, at der er travlt og drives af den energi, en fyldt butik giver. 
 
 Vi kan tilbyde dig 
  et spændende job med masser af udfordringer for et af Danmarks mest kendte brands af både børn, deres forældre og bedsteforældre. 

 Er det dig? 
  Så send os din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

   

 Det skal være en oplevelse at besøge BR. Hver gang. Uanset om vores kunder kommer for at købe eller for at ønske. Vi har det brede udvalg, den personlige betjening og plads til legebørn i alle aldre.

title: Team Leader.Retail Banking Ops - QC MIS
description:
Mashreq Bank

Job Description

1

Job Title:

Team Leader, Quality Assurance & MI

Department

Retail Banking Operations- Quality Assurance & MI

Direct Supervisor

Manager, Quality Assurance & MI

Pay Band

J

2

Job Purpose

  • Conduct quality review of various Retail Operation’s Units – Credit Ops, Card Ops, CCAM Ops, Neo Ops wealth Ops and Insurance Ops with a view to ensure existing stipulated standards are being adhered in accordance to the SOP, PPG, APPM, OPMs.

  • Lead the QA Governance function across Retail Operations by driving risk-based quality reviews, control validation, KRI monitoring, governance reporting and corrective action tracking to ensure process adherence, risk mitigation, audit readiness and continuous improvement across all supported business units

  • Reporting review outcome with the units and Delivery managers for timely review and feedback.

  • Recommend and ensure implementation of corrective action plans to continuously improve and enhance the standard processes.

  • Perform and manage MI/Reports of the unit or as directed by the Manager

3

Dimensions

Operating Budget

Number of Staff

Capital Exp. Budget

N/A

Other

4

Key Result Areas

1. Risk-Based QA Governance & Assurance

  • Lead the execution of a risk-based QA Governance Framework across Retail Operations units, ensuring coverage of operational, compliance, audit, fraud, and reputational risks.

  • Facilitate risk identification, assessment, and validation activities through QA reviews, thematic assessments, and governance oversight.

  • Maintain and periodically review risk registers, risk-control mappings, and control effectiveness assessments across supported business units.

2. Control Framework & Quality Validation

  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of preventive, detective, and corrective controls to ensure adequate risk mitigation.

  • Conduct governance-based quality reviews to validate adherence to SOPs, PPGs, APPMs, OPMs, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.

  • Drive enhancement of control frameworks through identification of control gaps, process weaknesses, and recurring exceptions.

3. KRI Monitoring, Escalation & Reporting

  • Develop, monitor, and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and quality metrics across Retail Operations units.

  • Monitor KRI thresholds and initiate timely escalation of Amber and Red risk events in accordance with governance protocols.

  • Prepare governance dashboards, management reports, risk heat maps, and trend analysis for senior management and governance forums.

4. Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement

  • Recommend and track corrective and preventive action plans arising from QA reviews, audit observations, incidents, complaints, and regulatory findings.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and thematic reviews to address recurring control failures and process deficiencies.

  • Ensure sustainable closure of governance actions through periodic validation and effectiveness testing.

5. RCSA & Governance Oversight

  • Review and challenge Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across business units to ensure completeness, accuracy, and alignment with enterprise risk management standards.

  • Validate risk ratings, residual risk assessments, and control ownership to ensure appropriate governance and accountability.

  • Support periodic governance reviews and risk refresh exercises across Retail Operations.

6. Audit, Regulatory & Compliance Governance

  • Act as the central coordination point for audits, regulatory reviews, compliance assessments, and governance inspections.

  • Ensure readiness and availability of governance documentation, risk registers, control inventories, action trackers, and supporting evidence.

  • Monitor closure of audit and regulatory findings and validate implementation of sustainable remediation measures.

7. Governance Forums & Stakeholder Management

  • Facilitate governance forums, calibration sessions, risk review meetings, and management discussions across Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders.

  • Promote a strong risk and control culture through transparent communication of governance insights, emerging risks, and quality trends.

  • Ensure effective collaboration with business units to drive ownership and timely resolution of identified risks and control gaps.

8. MIS, Analytics & Governance Reporting

  • Oversee the development and publication of governance MIS, KRI packs, risk dashboards, action trackers, and executive reports.

  • Analyze defect trends, risk themes, control effectiveness, action closure rates, and governance performance indicators to support informed decision-making.

  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of all governance and management reporting requirements.

5

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

  • Retail Operations processing is carried out as per the Process Frame work, in conjunction with the Bank – Operating documents vide SOP, PPF, APPM, OPM etc.,

  • The scope of work encompasses quality review of Retail units i.e. policies, processes / procedures, MIS, and system covering all Retail Operation’s Units.

  • Regular and frequent interaction with Retail Ops Process owners, their direct reports and the respective delivery managers

6

Problem Solving

  • To ensure that risks associated with Retail processes and compliance to the stipulated standards, system and procedures are appropriately recognized and reported.

  • All highlighted risks and issues are to be mitigated / alleviated through appropriate recommendation of suitable controls, which should not add unnecessary layers, costs, turnaround time but yet yield desired results.

  • To provide adequate solutions to erroneous processes highlighted during the review process.

  • To review standard operating procedures and system manuals periodically. This will ensure process risks are under control.

  • To identify key risks in process during reviews and highlight to Senior Management to drive enhancements and mitigate the risks identified

7

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

  • Conduct and approve quality audits and evaluations.

  • Identify quality gaps and recommend corrective actions.

  • Validate and publish MI reports and dashboards.

  • Allocate tasks and manage team workload.

  • Escalate critical quality, compliance, or operational risks.

  • Recommend process and reporting improvements.

  • Monitor operational quality and compliance with policies and standards.

  • Ensure timely, accurate, and insightful management reporting (MI).

  • Analyze performance trends and provide actionable recommendations.

  • Coach and develop QA & MI team members.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and root cause analysis.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to improve service quality and operational performance.

  • Accuracy of quality assessments and MI reports.

  • Achievement of team KPIs and service standards.

  • Timely identification and escalation of risks and issues.

  • Continuous improvement in quality, productivity, and reporting effectiveness.

8

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Comprehensive knowledge of all host systems & other operating systems in the Bank.

  • In Depth knowledge in one or more of Retail processes such CCAM Ops (CASA account opening & Servicing), Card Ops (Issuing and Chargeback streams), Credit Ops (secured and unsecured loan onboarding and servicing), Insurance Ops and Neo/Digital banking.

  • Sound understanding of Enterprise Risk Management principles, Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), risk registers, control effectiveness assessments, and governance frameworks

  • At least 5 to 7 years of experience in any Retail Operations process and core operations experience would be preferable.

  • Being proactive, effective floor management and taking ownership of all given activities.

  • MIS and systems and related processes understanding.

  • Good Verbal / written communication & computer skills.

  • Team Lead is expected to manage floor, rostering & effective back-up for Manager.

  • Alignment with Bank’s core values and embed right culture for seamless delivery.

title: Program Manager, Partner Launches & Delivery
description:
Glance AI is an AI commerce platform shaping the next wave of e-commerce with inspiration-led shopping, less about searching for what you want and more about discovering who you could be. Operating in 140 countries, Glance AI transforms every screen into a stage for instant, personal, and joyful discovery, where inspiration becomes something you can explore, feel, and shop in the moment.

Its proprietary models, seamlessly integrated with Google’s most advanced AI platforms, Gemini and Imagen on Vertex AI, deliver hyper-realistic, deeply personal shopping experiences across categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and more. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI reimagines the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping.

With an open architecture built for effortless adoption across hardware and software ecosystems, Glance AI is creating a platform that can become a staple in everyday consumer technology. It partners with the world’s leading smartphone makers, connected TV manufacturers, telecom providers, and global brands — meeting people where they are: on mobile, smart TVs, and brand websites.

Through Glance AI’s rich first-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high-impact, performance-driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide. Part of the InMobi Group, a global technology and advertising leader reaching over 2 billion devices and serving more than 30,000 enterprise brands worldwide, Glance AI is backed by Google, Jio Platforms, and Mithril Capital.

Overview of the role:

The Americas is Glance's largest and fastest-growing region, and it is expanding quickly across new partners, surfaces, and markets. Getting our products onto devices is only half the job; delivering reliably enough that partners want to expand with us is the other half. This role owns that second half.

As Program Manager, Partner Launches & Delivery, you will be the single accountable owner for taking our partner launches from kickoff to go-live — on the committed date, at the committed scope. You will turn a fast-moving roadmap and a room full of stakeholders into one plan, one tracker, and one clear story of what is happening and when. And you will make each launch faster than the last by building the playbook the whole team runs on.

The impact you'll make:

  • Run the launches. Be the single accountable owner for each partner launch, end to end: one plan, one tracker, one status
  • Hold the scope line. Define and defend what ships at launch versus what follows. Push back — with data and alternatives — when scope grows late.
  • Coordinate across functions. Bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Revenue Operations, Legal and Privacy, Marketing and PR, and the account team. Turn dependencies into named owners and dates.
  • Partner with our customers. Work alongside the Account Manager as the delivery counterpart to the partner's program and technical teams, driving integration milestones through to launch readiness.
  • Surface risk early. Produce weekly status a senior leader can read in two minutes: what's on track, what's at risk, and what decision is needed by when. No surprises in the final weeks.
  • Own the transition to steady state. Track post-launch health with the account team — adoption, delivery quality, and open partner commitments — through to a clean handover.
  • Build the playbook. Turn each launch into a repeatable operating model — checklist, integration sequence, decision gates — so the second and third launches move faster than the first.

The experience we need:

  • 6+ years in technical program or launch management, ideally in mobile, adtech, consumer applications, or platform software.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping with large external partners — carriers, OEMs, platforms, or enterprise customers — where the partner's dates and standards were non-negotiable.
  • A track record of holding scope and dates with senior stakeholders. You can say “that comes later” and make it stick, diplomatically.
  • Excellent written communication — status updates concise enough that executives actually read them.
  • High tolerance for ambiguity and a fast-moving roadmap. You build the process that's missing rather than waiting for one.
  • Comfort operating across United States and India (Bangalore) time zones, where much of Product and Engineering sits.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience with mobile carriers, OEMs, or their launch and certification processes.
  • Familiarity with mobile device software, pre-load and firmware integrations, or on-device experiences such as lock screen.
  • Exposure to ad-supported or subscription billing mechanics.
  • Experience standing up a launch or program function from scratch, not only operating inside an established one.


Why Glance

  • Category creation, not incremental work. Agentic commerce is being defined right now, and our partner launches are how it reaches millions of consumers. You'll own the delivery engine behind that.
  • The role that makes growth real. Great strategy dies in delivery. You are the person who makes sure what we promise partners actually ships — the difference between winning an account and keeping it.
  • Structural backing without big-company friction. The scale and infrastructure of the InMobi Group, with the latitude and pace of a team still writing its own playbook.
  • Visible, high-stakes work. Our launches are revenue events and often joint public moments with the partner. Your work is seen — inside the company and across the industry.
  • Competitive salary and benefits. Market-benchmarked base, meaningful equity, and a performance bonus tied to launch outcomes, plus full health and retirement benefits.

What we build…

At Glance, we're building products that are redefining industries. Our ecosystem spans:

  • InMobi Advertising – Powering data-driven mobile marketing for the world’s leading brands
  • Glance – A revolutionary Gen AI-powered lockscreen & TV content platform transforming how millions discover and engage with content.
  • 1Weather – One of the world’s leading weather platforms, delivering precise, reliable, and real-time weather forecasts

With deep expertise in AI, mobile, consumer technology, and digital innovation, we are home to some of the brightest minds in the industry.

What sets us apart? Not just what we build. How we build it. At Glance, we balance our hunger for cutting-edge tech with a deep focus on our people - their growth, well-being, and potential.

At Glance, you’ll be surrounded by people who…

  • Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

The base salary (fixed) pay range for this role would range from $107,500 to $128,000 USD (min to max of base salary pay). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*.

*Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, a Glancer can receive equity in the form of a stock grant known as Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we believe that our employees should have the ability to own a part of the organization. Furthermore, as you contribute to the growth of the company, additional stock may be issued in recognition of your contribution over time.

A quick snapshot of our benefits:

  • Competitive salary and RSU grant (where applicable)
  • High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)
  • 401(k) company match
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and compassionate work environment
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!
  • Free lunch provided in our offices daily
  • Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals!
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!

Glance is an equal opportunity employer

Glance is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.

InMobi Glance provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.   Position description  
	Job title
 
 Gym Staff - Greve 
 
	Become a part of the team behind the largest Fitness community in Denmark
 
 
	
  

 Er du er på udkig efter et deltidsjob eller studiejob med mening, eller drømmer du om at starte din karriere indenfor fitness og sundhed, så glæder vi os til at få dig med på teamet i Håndværkerbyen i Greve. 

   

   

 Hvorfor blive en del af PureGym? 

 Hos PureGym ved vi, at vores medarbejdere er vores største styrke. Vi værdsætter din unikke personlighed, dine ideer og din vilje til at skabe og være en del af noget større. Vi arbejder for at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor du føler dig værdsat, udfordret og inspireret til at vokse - både personligt og professionelt. 

 Hvis dine fremtidige karriereønsker er indenfor ledelse og fitness har vi karriereveje med interne uddannelser - både via digital læringsplatform og i kurser som holdinstruktør. 

   

 Om rollen 

 Som Gym Staff vil du være PureGyms ansigt udadtil, og være den, der sikrer den gode medlemsoplevelse og det motiverende træningsmiljø. Du vil arbejde både selvstændigt, og tæt sammen med dine kolleger, og din Gym Manager. Dine opgaver vil spænde bredt - fra daglig rengøring af centeret til vedligeholdelse af maskiner. Derudover vil du og dit team være centrets repræsentanter på vores lokale SoMe-kanal og viser stolt PureGyms teal-farve frem i lokalområdet. 

 Til denne Gym Staff rolle søger vi én til vores team i 15 timer om ugen. De vagter, som kan blive dine, vil som udgangspunkt være fordelt på 2 aftenvagter i hverdagen fra kl. 15.00-20.00, samt hver anden weekend kl. 8.00-13.00. 

    

 Dine opgaver: 
 
 Være serviceminded og skabe den gode stemning sammen med vores medlemmer 

 Hjælpe medlemmer med at navigere i selvbetjeningsløsninger (appen, hjemmeside) 

 Oprydning, rengøring og vedligeholdelse af udstyr - så centeret altid står skarpt og indbydende 

 Give vores medlemmer en god start og guide dem i centret i brugen af vores udstyr 

 Sørge for, at vores salgsautomater er fyldte og klar til medlemskøb 

 Hjælpe med lagerstyring og lageroptælling 

 Lave SoMe opslag - Vi elsker at vise vores medlemmer hvad vi laver! 

 Oplære dine nye kollegaer og samarbejde med instruktører og trænere 

 Andre ad hoc-opgaver, der sikrer en optimal drift 
 
  

 
 
	Your qualifications
 
 
	
  

 Hvem er du? 
 
 Energisk, serviceminded og nysgerrig på at opsøge relationer 

 Trives med praktiske opgaver såsom rengøring, organisering og vedligeholdelse 

 Komfortabel med at guide vores medlemmer på digitale platforme (app og hjemmeside) 

 Kan bidrage til en positiv, inkluderende kultur og være en rollemodel for vores værdier 

 Kan skabe et både sjovt og trygt miljø 

 Har gå på mod, er problemløsende og ivrig efter at lære nyt 
 
   

 Vi tilbyder: 
 
 En meningsfuld rolle, hvor du gør en forskel for vores medlemmer og bliver en del til Danmarks største fitnessfællesskab, der sikrer et sundere Danmark 

 Faste arbejdstider der kan ligge både i hverdag og weekend, samt morgen, eftermiddag og aften 

 Mulighed for personlig udvikling og læring gennem vores trænings- og udviklingsprogrammer, samt holduddannelser - samt en karrievej mod ledelse 

 En inkluderende kultur, hvor mangfoldighed og kreativitet værdsættes 

 Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor forandring og feedback er i centrum 

 Gratis personalemedlemskab så du frit kan træne og deltage på hold i alle PureGym centre i Danmark. 
 
   

  Bliv en del af noget større  

 Som medarbejder i PureGym bliver du en del af Danmarks største fitnesskæde med over 130 centre fordelt i hele landet. PureGym DK er en del af en af Europas største fitnesskæder, med hovedkontor i London, UK, med centre i Danmark, England, Schweiz, UAE og New York, US. 

 Vores mission er at inspirere til et sundere liv med ’Fitness for alle’ som omdrejningspunkt. Vi ser os selv som mere end bare en fitnesskæde. Vi hjælper vores medlemmer med at passe på deres fysiske og mentale sundhed i de bedste rammer med professionel support fra vores passionerede medarbejdere. 

   

 Ansøgningsfrist 

 Er du klar til at blive en del af vores team? Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag eller snarest muligt.  

 Har du nogle spørgsmål er du velkommen til at komme forbi centeret. 

   

 Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning! 

   

   

 Er vi endt i spam? 

 Du vil altid modtage en bekræftelsesmail, når du har sendt din ansøgning. Hvis ikke du modtager denne, så tjek dit spamfilter og sørg for at fjerne os derfra, så fremtidig kommunikation lander i din almindelige indbakke.

title: Gør karriere inden for salg og kunderådgivning i vores butik i Frederikshavn - fuldtid Joboplysninger | job-karriere
description:
Gør karriere inden for salg og kunderådgivning i vores butik i Frederikshavn - fuldtid
     
                         
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
                 
   



   


 

 

  Er du klar til et job, hvor vi lærer dig at rådgive - og møder dig som menneske? Og vil du mærke opbakningen fra vores stærke fællesskab hver eneste dag?     

 


 

   

 


 

  Så bliv kunderådgiver og få:     

 


 
 

 

  Salgsværktøjer, du kan bruge videre i din karriere     

 

 
 


 
 

 

  Gode kolleger, der gør, at du kan føle dig hjemme på din arbejdsplads     

 

 
 


 
 

 

  Check-ins med din leder, hvor I vender resultater, læringsmål - og bare hvordan du har det.     

 

 
 


 

     

 


 

  Man får masser af opbakning og støtte til at udvikle sig her - det er ikke bare tomme ord. Jeg kan selv mærke, at jeg er blevet meget bedre til at skabe tillid hos kunderne og afdække deres behov, så jeg kan give dem ansvarlig rådgivning     

 


 

  - Sarah, din nye kollega     

 


 

     

 


 

  Lær at give en serviceoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige     

 


 

  Vi lærer dig det, du har brug for at vide om alt fra mobiltelefoner, abonnementer og gadgets til internet og ladestandere.     

 


 

  Så når kunderne kommer til dig, ved du lige, hvordan du bedst kan hjælpe dem - og måske sender du dem endda hjem med mere, end de kom efter.     

 


 

     

 


 

  Du følger butikkens puls, når du:     

 


 
 

 

  Rådgiver kunderne til at finde de løsninger, der passer bedst til dem.     

 

 
 


 
 

 

  Sender varer retur og sørger for, at butikken står snorlige.     

 

 
 


 
 

 

  Logger på vores chat eller tager imod kundeservicekald i stille perioder.     

 

 
 


 

     

 

 


 

 

  Her passer vi ikke bare vores egen butik     

 


 

  Selvom vi har individuelle salgsmål, er vi fælles om at løfte hverdagen. Vi står nemlig klar til at være der for hinanden - uanset om situationen kalder på et godt råd eller et endnu bedre grin. Hver morgen tjekker vi ind i vores fælles chat for butikkerne i hele distriktet, hvor vi både besvarer tekniske spørgsmål og fejrer hinandens succeser. Så her kan du glæde dig til at blive en del af noget større.     

 


 

     

 


 

  Du møder kunderne med nærvær og nysgerrighed     

 


 
 

 

  Du har måske erfaring med kundekontakt fra butiksverdenen, et callcenter eller et helt tredje sted.     

 

 
 


 
 

 

  Du opsøger gerne selv kunderne og er nysgerrig på rejsen fra rådgivning til mersalg.     

 

 
 


 
 

 

  Du trives med klare salgsmål og kan arbejde om aftenen og i weekender.      

 

 
 


 

        

 


 

  Det er det bedste job, jeg har haft. For jeg lærer noget nyt hver dag - om både salg, kundeservice og ikke mindst rent personligt. Og karrieremulighederne er gode, så jeg kan sagtens se mig selv blive her i mange år     

 


 

  - Laith, din nye kollega     

 


 

     

 


 

  Har du fået Norlys i øjnene?     

 


 

  Så send os dit CV og et par ord om dig selv. Vi indkalder relevante kandidater til samtale løbende, så hold dig endelig ikke tilbage.     

 


 

  Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Butikschef Julie Kyk Larsen på julkyk@norlys.dk. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger via linket nedenfor, og ikke på mail.     

 


 

     

 


 

  Ansættelsestype: Fastansættelse  
  Ugentlig arbejdstid: Fuldtid (37 timer)     

 


 

  
  Diversitet og inklusion er en del af Norlys’ DNA og vores værdier: fællesskab, nytænkning og ansvarlighed. Vi mener, at et ægte fællesskab er rummeligt, trygt og inspirerende, at det er ansvarligt at skabe plads til forskellighed, og at vi bedst kan tænke nyt, når vi bringer alle kompetencer i spil. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset baggrund til at søge jobbet.        

 

 

                 
     
                 

             

         

     

    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
    
 
        
  
 Norlys er Danmarks største integrerede energi- og telekoncern med ca. 800.000 andelshavere, 3,5 millioner kunderelationer, 4.600 medarbejdere og over 100 år på bagen. Som andelsejet selskab ligger det dybt i vores DNA at tage ansvar for mere end os selv. Derfor leverer vi ikke bare fremtidssikrede løsninger til danske hjem og virksomheder. Vi arbejder målrettet for grøn og digital omstilling af hele vores samfund. Og brænder for at skabe fremskridt for både mennesker, lokalmiljø og klima. Vi håber, at du vil være med. For vi tror på, at fremtiden er så god, som vi gør den til. Sammen.

title: Senior Product Manager (BAD Product)
description:
Are you looking to own the customer-facing experience for JetBrains products, from how individuals and organizations buy and manage software to how licensing and entitlements work behind the scenes?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll lead the strategy for BAD (Business Application Development) Product. You’ll tackle the complex web of purchases, subscriptions, organization administration, and usage-based services, making sure our customers have a smooth, coherent experience every step of the way.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, QA, and BAD Platform, as well as Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams. You’ll have the autonomy to drive product discovery, validate hypotheses through data and experimentation, and define the long-term vision for our licensing and administration ecosystem.

Day to day, you will:

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAD Product systems.
  • Uncover user friction through customer research, support data, telemetry, and feedback from internal teams.
  • Map and improve end-to-end customer journeys covering purchasing, subscriptions, licensing, and administration.
  • Identify gaps, overlaps, and inconsistencies across sub-systems to build a clear, unified user experience.
  • Partner with engineering, design, analytics, and QA from early discovery through launch and continuous iteration.
  • Define and track key product metrics for adoption, conversion, and support demand.
  • Communicate product direction, trade-offs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

  • An ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes, not just task completion.
  • A clear focus on underlying problems and desired outcomes rather than immediate feature requests.
  • Comfort with technical complexity, trade-offs, and systems thinking.
  • A preference for quality, long-term sustainability, and user trust over short-term fixes.
  • The ability to make grounded decisions using customer research, analytics, and experimentation.
  • Strong collaboration skills across multi-disciplinary teams and distinct business areas.

What you’ll need

  • A proven track record of managing technically complex SaaS, enterprise, or B2B product areas end to end.
  • Hands-on experience driving product discovery, user research, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Experience navigating complex customer journeys, multi-team dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience making data-informed decisions using telemetry, product metrics, and experimentation.
  • The ability to work comfortably alongside engineering teams on technical details, APIs, data models, and system integrations.
  • Fluency in English.

What success looks like

In practice, success means building a licensing and administration experience that feels seamless to the user and resilient under the hood. You'll bring clarity to ambiguous systems, simplify fragmented customer flows, and establish reliable product metrics. Ultimately, you succeed by removing friction for millions of developers and admins, allowing them to focus on their actual work.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
  • Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
  • Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to read your application.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

• Good attention to detail and analytical skills.

• Potential for future full-time opportunities based on performance.

description:
우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

저희는 누적매출 5,000억 이상 달성한 모바일 게임을 운영해 온 숙련된 팀입니다. 지금은 크래프톤의 룬샷게임즈에서 새로운 게임을 만들기 위해 소중한 동료를 찾고 있습니다.

  • 아름다운 판타지 세계와 매력적인 캐릭터 서사를 중심으로 한 모바일 RPG
  • 도트 기반 캐릭터와 입체적인 배경 연출을 결합한 개성 있는 2.5D 비주얼의 게임
  • 동료를 만나고 공간을 성장시키며, 자신만의 모험을 확장해 나가는 수집·성장형 게임
  • 쉬운 진입성과 전략적 전투, 감성적인 내러티브를 함께 갖춘 게임

※ 본 포지션의 채용이 진행되는 Loonshot Games는 2/23자로 크래프톤의 자회사로 분사 완료되었습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 판타지 세계관과 주요 캐릭터의 서사 방향성 수립
  • 메인 스토리, 캐릭터 에피소드, 퀘스트 대사 등 인게임 스토리 콘텐츠 작성
  • 캐릭터의 성격, 관계, 성장 과정을 플레이 경험과 연결

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 신규 IP 또는 프로젝트 초기 단계에서 스토리 방향성을 수립하고, 게임/콘텐츠의 세계관과 캐릭터 스토리를 구체화해 본 분
  • 캐릭터의 매력과 관계성을 대사, 상황, 에피소드로 풀어낼 수 있는 분
  • 판타지 장르와 캐릭터 중심 RPG 내러티브에 대한 이해가 높은 분
  • 다양한 직군과 협업하며 스토리 방향성을 구체화할 수 있는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 소설, 웹소설, 웹툰, 게임, 영상 등 개인 또는 팀 기반 스토리 프로젝트를 대중에게 공개하고, 실제 반응을 바탕으로 개선해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 애니메이션, JRPG, 수집형 RPG, 캐릭터 RPG의 스토리텔링에 관심과 이해가 높은 분

룬샷게임즈의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in United States.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and evolve high-impact healthcare applications across the full technology stack.
You will take ownership of projects from initial design through delivery, iteration, and long-term improvement.
The role combines frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI/ML technologies in a highly collaborative environment.
You will work alongside software engineers, machine learning researchers, physicians, product managers, and UX researchers to solve complex problems.
You will also influence architectural decisions, establish strong engineering practices, and help elevate the technical capabilities of the broader team.
This is an opportunity to contribute directly to technology designed to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and effective.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who enjoys autonomy, technical ownership, and solving meaningful problems at scale.

Accountabilities

  • Drive high-impact software projects across the full stack, taking ownership from technical design and implementation through delivery, iteration, and continued improvement.
  • Develop new user-facing features and enhance existing applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Build and maintain React applications, including components, hooks, state management, performance optimization, and reusable patterns.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using Python and asynchronous frameworks such as FastAPI or Starlette.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to establish consistent APIs and effective patterns for frontend-to-backend interactions.
  • Lead and guide cross-team architectural decisions, helping define scalable application and system designs.
  • Produce detailed technical specifications, architectural documentation, and implementation plans for new features.
  • Design and work with both relational and NoSQL databases, selecting appropriate technologies and data models based on application access patterns.
  • Develop reliable asynchronous workflows involving background jobs, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
  • Build comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategies, including automated and visual regression testing where appropriate.
  • Contribute to continuous delivery practices and CI pipelines that enable teams to release frequently and confidently.
  • Collaborate with product owners, AI/ML researchers, physicians, UX researchers, and other stakeholders to define, estimate, prioritize, and deliver features using Agile practices.
  • Share technical expertise with colleagues and help strengthen engineering practices across areas such as API design, system architecture, cloud infrastructure, healthcare data, and application development.

    • Requirements

    • 5–7 years of professional experience as a full-stack software engineer with ownership of features from design through delivery and continued iteration.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
    • Strong professional experience with React, including components, hooks, state management, and performance optimization.
    • Professional Python backend development experience, ideally using asynchronous frameworks such as FastAPI or Starlette.
    • Experience working with both relational and NoSQL databases, with the ability to select and model technologies according to application access patterns.
    • Strong understanding of asynchronous workflows, including background processing, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
    • Demonstrated ability to use automated testing to improve product quality, including end-to-end coverage, visual regression testing, and CI-based validation.
    • Understanding of modern cloud and application infrastructure, including AWS, Docker, Terraform, Git, RESTful services, and AI/ML technologies.
    • Strong architectural thinking and the ability to make effective technical decisions across teams and systems.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Comfortable working autonomously while contributing to a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment.
    • Experience with React Native, Expo, or other cross-platform mobile technologies is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Storybook, visual or snapshot regression testing, harness engineering, or design systems is advantageous.
    • Knowledge of accessibility standards such as WCAG and experience with screen readers is a plus.
    • Experience developing LLM-powered applications, including streaming, tool calling, and evaluation-driven iteration, is beneficial.
    • Familiarity with Temporal or other durable execution systems is helpful.
    • Experience working with healthcare data standards such as CDA, CCD, or FHIR is a strong advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive annual salary of $170,000–$210,000, with actual compensation determined by qualifications and relevant experience.
      • 100% remote work-from-home environment.
      • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
      • Flexible spending plans.
      • Responsible Vacation Policy.
      • 401(k) plan with employer matching.
      • Opportunity to work on a mission-driven product focused on improving access, affordability, and effectiveness in healthcare.
      • Collaborative environment with experienced colleagues across software engineering, AI/ML, medicine, product, and UX.
      • Opportunities to take ownership of architecture, technical initiatives, and high-impact projects while continuously developing your skills.

Eftermarkedselev søges til Terminalen Aarhus 
 Har du interesse for biler og trives du i en hverdag med fart over feltet og godt humør? Vil du kickstarte din karriere i autobranchen og lære af de bedste? 

 Så er der her en spændende mulighed for dig! 


 Hos Terminalen, Aarhus søger vi en eftermarkedselev, som skal være med til at sikre en professionel og serviceminded kundebetjening på vores værksted. 

 Opbygning af faglige kompetencer 

 Hos Terminalen, Aarhus er målet, at vores kunder altid får en god oplevelse, både personligt i butikken, men også via mail og telefon. Som eftermarkedselev vil du få en bred vifte af opgaver og du vil blandt andet lære at: 

 

 Foretage effektiv booking og planlægning af arbejdet på værkstedet 


 Bestilling af reservedele samt optimering af lagret 


 Sikre den gode kundedialog 


 Styre lageret og logistikken 


 Udvise professionel kundeservice og support 


 Håndtere reklamationer og garantisager 


 Koordinere serviceaftaler 

 
 Engageret holdspiller 

 Du er klar på at blive eftermarkedselev og er ivrig efter at udvikle dine kompetencer. 


 Som person er du: 

 

 Imødekommende og udadvendt 


 Har lysten til læring og udvikling 


 God til at samarbejde 


 Ansvarsbevidst 

 
 Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig 

 Vi tilbyder en elevplads i et professionelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor du vil få opbygget dine faglige kompetencer og ligeledes få grundlagt en god praktisk forståelse for mærkerne Hyundai, Ford og Jaguar & LandRover 


 Uddannelsen som eftermarkedselev tager to år og spænder vidt. Du vil i løbet af perioden få et indgående kendskab til bilbranchen - lige fra indkøb og salg af reservedele, lageroptimering, kundemodtagelse, fakturering, samt deltagelse i den daglige værkstedsplanlægning. 


 Uddannelsen har tre ophold af 14 dages varighed hos Business College Syd - læs mere om uddannelsen og adgangskrav her: Business College Syd: Handelsassistent Auto i Mommark (bcsyd.dk) 


 Sammen med dine cirka 1.600 kolleger i Danmark og Tyskland, får du blandt andet adgang til: 

 

 Gode medarbejdervilkår med pension, sundhedsforsikring, flere årlige udviklingssamtaler og et arbejdsmiljø i topklasse 


 Uddannelse og træning - Vi investerer i vores medarbejderes fremtid med træningsprogrammer og mulighed for efteruddannelse 


 Teamkultur - Vi har en stærk teamånd, hvor samarbejde og kollegial støtte er i fokus og hvor vores værdier ordentlighed, ambition, sammenhold og passion skinner igennem, både i vores nærvær med kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere 


 Firmature og sociale arrangementer - Deltag i vores mange arrangementer, der styrker fællesskabet 


 Attraktive medarbejderrabatter hos koncernens samarbejdspartnere. 

 
 Er du interesseret? 

 Vi vurderer og behandler indkomne ansøgninger løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Du ansøger via linket. Samtaler forventes gennemført løbende og tiltrædelse efter nærmere aftale. Har du spørgsmål til ovenstående, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Eftermarkedschef Jeppe Bækgaard Pedersen telefon  5232 8702  

 Din nye arbejdsplads 

 Vores forhandlerkæde Terminalen A/S er en multibrand kæde med 6 forretninger i Danmark, hvor målsætningen er at give vores kunder den bedste service til den rigtige pris. Hos Terminalen Aarhus er vi autoriseret forhandler af Hyundai, Ford og Jaguar & LandRover, vi går meget op i, at vores medarbejdere altid bliver opdateret og uddannet, så de besidder den korrekte viden inden for vores bilmærker. 


 Du vil desuden blive en del af Nic. Christiansen Gruppen, som er en ledende figur i den nordiske autobranche med mere end 1600 medarbejdere i norden, Tyskland og Baltikum. Vores værdier ordentlighed, ambition, sammenhold og passion er i live lokalt og udleves hver dag. Dette kommer blandt andet til udtryk i vores nærvær med kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere, og vores medarbejdere er drivkraften for vores succes. 


 Vil du lære endnu mere om vores kollegaer og hvad du kan blive en del af? Følg os på  Instagram - NCG People  og  LinkedIn  


 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

 Terminalen A/S 

 Som medarbejder hos Terminalen A/S bliver du en del af Nic. Christiansen Gruppen, der siden 1967 har samlet på stærke brands og dygtige folk. Drevet af ordentlighed, integritet, sammenhold, passion og ambitioner er vi i dag en af Nordens største koncerner i bilbranchen: Vi arbejder hver dag på at gøre gode ting bedre - og på at levere mobilitetsløsninger, der både flytter mennesker og fremtiden med.
