title: QA Engineer (IJ Platform / Remote Development)
description:
At JetBrains, we are passionate about building the strongest, most effective developer tools in the world. Our tools are designed to give developers the freedom to grow, discover, and create. Over 15 million users rely on our tools, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies are our customers. Our products help our users stay focused on code design and the big picture, allowing them to deliver more creative and effective results.

The remote development functionality in JetBrains products redirects IDE-heavy processing from a local machine to a powerful remote server, reimagining how teams work. With hardware performance no longer a limitation, developers can work from anywhere while benefiting from improved security, stability, and reliability.

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join the Remote Development team and take ownership of quality within their areas of responsibility, navigate ambiguity, and proactively improve product quality.

What you'll do

Quality assurance

  • Perform functional, exploratory, regression, and acceptance testing.
  • Ensure product stability and release readiness.
  • Investigate, document, and report defects, ensuring they are prioritized, resolved, verified, and successfully delivered to users.
  • Expand manual test case scenarios and keep existing ones up to date.
  • Take ownership of complex testing areas and drive quality improvements through proactive initiatives.
  • Monitor automated test execution results and troubleshoot test failures.
  • Contribute to UI test automation by maintaining and extending automated tests using our established framework.

Team collaboration

  • Work closely with developers and product stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify risks when feature documentation is incomplete or evolving.
  • Update the internal knowledge base and share expertise with team members.
  • Cooperate with the support team to reproduce issues reported by our valued users.

What we're looking for

Required skills

  • Extensive hands-on QA experience.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.
  • The ability to read and understand Java or Kotlin code.
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams.
  • The ability to grasp new concepts quickly and to work both in a team and independently.
  • Strong prioritization skills and the ability to manage your own workload based on team goals.

Nice to have

  • Experience testing developer tools, IDEs, and desktop applications.
  • Programming skills in Kotlin or Java sufficient to extend and maintain existing UI tests written using internal testing frameworks.
  • Experience working with Linux environments and an understanding of operating system fundamentals.
  • An understanding of networking fundamentals and their impact on distributed systems.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

VI HENVISER TIL TANDPINEVAGTEN PÅ TELEFON 29 60 01 11



Akut tandlæge Nakskov - Vi tilbyder alle former for tandbehandlinger

Akutte tandsmerter er blandt de mest generende smerter vi mennesker kan udsættes for.
Af denne grund er det betydningsfuldt for dig at vide, at vi som erfaren tandlægeklinik tilbyder akut hjælp, når du har allermest brug for det.


Det kan være enormt forstyrrende for resten af din dag at gå rundt med tandpine.
Selvom du har en sund forebyggende tandpleje og børster dine tænder to gange om dagen, så kan det stadig ske, at noget akut opstår.


Det kan i nogen tilfælde lykkes at holde de akutte tandsmerter nede med smertestillende medicin i en rum tid, men det er af stor vigtighed at huske, at selve årsagen ikke fjernes.
Derfor vil du med garanti opleve, at smerterne kommer igen, hvis den rette behandling ikke finder sted i tide. Uanset hvilken årsag som ligger bag smerterne, bør du kontakte os, hvis uheldet er ude.
Jo før du bliver tilset, desto hurtigere vil de akutte smerter også aftage og forsvinde helt.

Hvorfor gå og vente på at blive behandlet, når du kan få en tid hos din vagttandlæge nær Nakskov?
Tandlægeklinik med akut hjælp

Der er flere tandlægeklinikker som tilbyder akut tandlægehjælp.
Dette er dog ikke uden et forholdsvis højt ekstra tillæg i prisen.
De fleste tandlæger tillægger nemlig et højt akut-gebyr i forbindelse med en akut tandbehandling.


Dette skyldes ofte, at de akutte tandproblemer opstår i ydertimerne eller i weekenden.
På den måde kan det hurtigt gå hen og blive en dyr fornøjelse at blive akut behandlet.


Men selvom du har brug for en akut tandlæge om lørdagen eller i de sene ydertimer, kan du sagtens finde en akut tandlæge, som ikke tager det dobbelte blot fordi der er tale om et akut behov.
Det synes vi kun er fair for dig som patient!


Undgå derved et tårnhøjt gebyr, når du vælger os som din foretrukne tandlægevagt i Nakskov.

Som patient er du i centrum hos os

Som patient hos os er du i centrum.
Som erfaren tandlægeklinik ved vi hvor vigtigt det er, at der bliver taget sig god tid til en.


Det er tit når tingene går for hurtigt, at det bliver ubehageligt som patient at ligge i tandlægestolen.
Det har ingen betydning om du er patient hos os i forvejen. Om du er eksisterende patient eller ny har ingen betydning.


Det er i vores største interesse at hjælpe dig med dine akutte tandproblemer.
Vores lange erfaring som tandlægeklinik gør os i stand til at behandle dig uanset problem.
Hvis du blot har brug for råd og vejledning til din specifikke tandsituation, kan vi også være dig behjælpelig. Vi deler meget gerne ud af vores ekspertise inden for tandskade, så du kan blive smertefri hurtigst muligt.


Det er vigtigt for os, at du altid føler dig tryg og velinformeret omkring, hvad der skal til for at få styr på din akutte situation.
Herunder ikke mindst, hvad det vil komme til at koste dig. Du får altså altid oplyst både pris og procedure på forhånd.
På den måde er vi altid fælles om at tage en beslutning om din tandsundhed på et oplyst grundlag.


Vi ser frem til på den ene eller anden måde at hjælpe dig på vores tandlægeklinik nær Nakskov.

Behandlinger vi tilbyder akut

Når du står overfor en tandlægekrise, er det vigtigt at vide, at der er hjælp at hente.
Hos vores klinik i Nakskov er vi specialiserede i akutbehandling og håndtering af akutte tandproblemer med omhu og professionalisme.

Akut smertelindring

Smerter i tænderne kan være overvældende og forstyrrende.
Vi tilbyder hurtig smertelindring, så du kan få ro og komfort tilbage i din hverdag.
Vores team vurderer din situation og finder den bedste løsning for at lindre dine smerter effektivt.

Behandling af tandbylder

Tandbylder kan være meget smertefulde og kræver ofte øjeblikkelig opmærksomhed.
Vi kan hjælpe med at dræne bylden og behandle infektionen, så du undgår yderligere komplikationer.

Reparation af knækkede eller mistede tænder

Uheld kan ske, og tænder kan blive knækket eller mistet.
Vi tilbyder hurtig reparation eller midlertidige løsninger, indtil en permanent behandling kan udføres.

Akut rodbehandling

Hvis du oplever intens smerte eller hævelse, kan det være nødvendigt med en akut rodbehandling.
Vores erfarne tandlæger kan udføre denne procedure for at redde din tand og lindre dine symptomer.

Behandling af tandkødsproblemer

Akutte tandkødsproblemer, såsom blødning eller hævelse, kan være tegn på en infektion eller anden alvorlig tilstand.
Vi tilbyder hurtig vurdering og behandling for at beskytte dit tandkøds sundhed.

Fjernelse af visdomstænder

Visdomstænder kan forårsage pludselige smerter eller infektioner.
Hvis du har brug for akut fjernelse af en visdomstand, er vi her for at hjælpe med en sikker og effektiv procedure.


Vi forstår, hvor stressende tandproblemer kan være, og vi er her for at give dig den nødvendige støtte og behandling.


Kontakt os straks, hvis du har brug for en akut tandlæge i Nakskov.
Vi hjælper dig med at få dit smil tilbage på rette spor.

Hvad kan man gøre ved tandsmerter

At opleve tandsmerter kan være frustrerende og smertefuldt, men der er flere ting, du kan gøre for at lindre ubehaget, indtil du kan få professionel hjælp.
Her er nogle praktiske råd til, hvordan du kan håndtere tandsmerter indtil du kommer ind til en tandlæge:



Skyl med saltvand eller klorhexidin: En enkel måde at reducere smerte og hævelse på er at skylle munden med varmt saltvand eller klorhexidin.
Denne metode kan hjælpe med at rense området og mindske irritation.


Brug smertestillende medicin: Over-the-counter smertestillende som ibuprofen eller paracetamol kan give midlertidig lindring.
Sørg for at følge doseringsanvisningerne nøje.


Påfør en kold kompres: En kold kompres på ydersiden af kinden kan reducere hævelse og lindre smerter.
Hold kompressen mod kinden i 15-20 minutter ad gangen.


Undgå visse fødevarer: Prøv at undgå meget kolde, varme, søde eller hårde fødevarer, da disse kan forværre smerten.
Tyg på den modsatte side af munden for at undgå yderligere irritation.


Hold hovedet højt: Når du ligger ned, kan blodtrykket i hovedet øge smerten.
Prøv at holde hovedet højt ved at bruge ekstra puder, når du hviler.


Kontakt en akut tandlæge: Hvis smerten er vedvarende eller bliver værre, er det vigtigt at kontakte en akut tandlæge i Nakskov.



Det er vigtigt at tage tandsmerter alvorligt, da de kan være et tegn på en underliggende tandproblematik, der kræver behandling.
Vi er her for at støtte dig og sikre, at du får den nødvendige pleje for at genoprette din mundsundhed.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Platforms & AI
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Security Engineer, Platforms & AI based in Canada.

This is a hands-on security engineering role focused on protecting cloud infrastructure, applications, APIs, internal systems, and AI-driven workflows.
You will own key elements of the technical security posture, from infrastructure hardening and vulnerability remediation to monitoring and incident response.
The role combines offensive security, DevSecOps, cloud security, and emerging AI security challenges in a rapidly scaling environment.
You will work closely with Engineering to embed practical security controls directly into production and development workflows.
A major focus will be securing AI systems against prompt injection, adversarial inputs, unsafe actions, and data leakage.
You will have significant autonomy to identify weaknesses, design solutions, and drive improvements across the security architecture.
This is an opportunity to provide technical leadership and help build resilient, secure systems within a high-ownership engineering culture.

Accountabilities

  • Secure and harden cloud infrastructure, applications, APIs, internal systems, and operational workflows across production environments.
  • Implement and maintain security controls covering CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, internal tooling, encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and access controls.
  • Partner directly with engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, coordinate remediation, validate fixes, and strengthen secure development practices.
  • Design and continuously improve security architecture for cloud-native and distributed systems while building scalable security processes into engineering workflows.
  • Lead vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation, and validation across infrastructure, applications, APIs, and operational systems.
  • Proactively identify weaknesses through vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, adversarial testing, threat modeling, and manual security reviews.
  • Secure AI-driven systems and automated agents against prompt injection, adversarial inputs, unauthorized actions, unsafe outputs, and data leakage.
  • Design guardrails and validation layers for AI-generated actions and ensure systems can safely process untrusted inputs from IVRs, web applications, APIs, and human interactions.
  • Monitor AI behavior for anomalies, abuse attempts, and unsafe decision-making while ensuring systems remain observable, auditable, appropriately bounded, and capable of failing safely.
  • Improve security monitoring, alerting, logging, detection, and incident response capabilities across the environment.
  • Investigate suspicious activity and security incidents, lead or support root-cause analysis, and implement preventative measures following incidents or security discoveries.
  • Help establish a culture of continuous security improvement, operational accountability, and resilient engineering practices.

    • Requirements

    • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, application security, DevSecOps, offensive security, or a closely related discipline.
    • Exceptional knowledge of the AWS ecosystem and experience securing cloud-based production environments.
    • Demonstrated experience identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities in live production systems.
    • Strong understanding of security architecture, cloud infrastructure, applications, APIs, access controls, secrets management, monitoring, and secure development practices.
    • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, threat modeling, adversarial testing, or manual security assessments.
    • Strong ability to investigate security events, analyze root causes, and implement effective remediation and prevention measures.
    • Ability to work directly with engineering teams and translate complex security risks into practical technical solutions.
    • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical security issues and recommendations to engineering and other stakeholders.
    • Highly autonomous and proactive, with the ability to drive projects, make sound decisions, and prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment.
    • Experience securing AI/LLM-powered systems, automated agents, or other AI-driven applications is preferred.
    • Familiarity with prompt injection, adversarial AI techniques, AI guardrails, behavioral anomaly detection, and responsible AI security practices is a plus.
    • Experience with cloud security tooling, SIEM and observability platforms, penetration testing tools, endpoint security platforms, or infrastructure-as-code security is advantageous.
    • Experience in a high-growth startup, fintech, banking, payments, or similarly regulated technology environment is preferred.
    • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent are a plus.
    • Ability to work remotely from the United States; the original role also permits candidates based in Canada.

      • Benefits

      • 100% remote-first work culture.
      • Competitive salary and equity opportunities.
      • Unlimited paid time off.
      • Flexible working schedule and paid holidays.
      • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
      • High-ownership culture emphasizing transparency, autonomy, and technical craftsmanship.
      • Opportunities to own security architecture and take on significant technical leadership responsibilities.
      • Opportunity to work on emerging AI security challenges and help shape security practices as the organization scales.

The role combines technical expertise, instructional leadership, and the ability to make complex AI concepts practical and accessible. You will help learners understand how data labeling influences machine learning systems, generative AI, multimodal models, and applied AI workflows. Sessions may range from smaller groups to audiences of thousands of learners in a highly interactive online environment. You will also contribute to curriculum refinement and continuous course improvement. This is a part-time contract position with a remote setup and scheduled sessions aligned with the EST/CEST time zones.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and facilitate live virtual classes for diverse learner groups, potentially ranging from 100 to more than 8,000 participants, while maintaining strong engagement and an effective learning environment.
  • Deliver technical instruction in German on machine learning data workflows, generative AI, foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG, multimodal AI, responsible AI, and related concepts.
  • Explain how data collection, annotation, labeling decisions, model training, evaluation, and deployment are connected, helping learners understand the downstream impact of their work.
  • Manage virtual classroom dynamics, including Q&A, chat activity, pacing, learner engagement, and timely delivery of planned content.
  • Adapt instructional approaches, explanations, and lesson pacing to accommodate learners with different backgrounds and levels of technical understanding.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each lecture and ensure that technical content is delivered accurately, clearly, and in an accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with program and operations teams in English to support smooth delivery, communicate updates, escalate issues, and maintain alignment on schedules and learner needs.
  • Contribute to curriculum design and continuous improvement, including suggesting edits, refining lessons, and supporting the development of hands-on learning activities.
  • Provide constructive feedback before and after sessions to strengthen course quality and learner outcomes.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful, responsive, and empathetic presence when interacting with learners, colleagues, contractors, and guest speakers.

    • Requirements:

    • Fluency in German sufficient to deliver all instruction and learner support professionally, combined with strong English proficiency for written communication, meetings, alignment, and issue escalation.
    • Strong practical understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, model training, evaluation, and deployment, with the ability to explain how labeling decisions affect model behavior and downstream outputs.
    • Solid knowledge of generative AI and foundation models, including concepts such as pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and human feedback for model alignment.
    • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot prompting, and the ability to teach learners how to interpret requirements, identify task constraints, and evaluate output quality.
    • Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and production AI workflows, including the ability to explain how to assess outputs for relevance, faithfulness, and groundedness.
    • Understanding of multimodal and cross-modal AI, including how models process and generate text, images, audio, and video, and how these capabilities influence annotation and evaluation tasks.
    • Knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, confidentiality, security, bias awareness, and transparency principles relevant to data labeling and AI workflows.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality live virtual instruction, ideally to large and diverse audiences.
    • Experience supporting technical curriculum development, lesson refinement, skills labs, or similar instructional content.
    • Strong communication, presentation, empathy, adaptability, and classroom-management skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts easy to understand.
    • A positive and collaborative mindset, with strong attention to preparation, professionalism, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
    • Preferred: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) certification or equivalent expertise, particularly experience aligning training content with certification domains and supporting exam readiness.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work: Work remotely from Romania or another location compatible with the required time zone.
      • Part-time contract: Flexible engagement structured around scheduled instructional sessions and program needs.
      • Virtual-first environment: Deliver impactful learning experiences entirely online using modern virtual classroom tools.
      • High-impact teaching: Reach diverse learner populations and contribute to workforce development in AI and data.
      • Professional collaboration: Work alongside program, operations, and instructional teams in an international environment.
      • Curriculum involvement: Contribute ideas and expertise to the development and continuous improvement of technical training content.
      • Potential schedule flexibility: Program dates and lecture times may be adjusted depending on program requirements and instructor availability.
      • Inclusive environment: Participate in a learning culture focused on respect, accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity.

title: Risk & Compliance Administrator
description:
About Sand

Sand is a global Physical AI company using data and AI to make critical industries work better. We partner with governments, cities and enterprises to improve how essential systems operate across healthcare, water, energy, telecommunications and infrastructure.

Our work delivers proven real-world impact. We have built AI systems that help manage London’s water supply, supported telecom network planning across hundreds of cities, and developed digital healthcare platforms serving tens of millions of people. From intelligent command centers to AI-powered infrastructure platforms, we help organizations sense, analyze and act in complex environments.

Our people are ambitious, curious and relentlessly practical. Our teams work alongside clients in the field, solving hard problems and deploying solutions that last. With colleagues across Africa, Europe, the UK and the US, we operate across the full stack - from research and engineering to deployment and capability building.

Our mission is simple: to harness AI to solve humanity’s most pressing challenges.

About the Role

SAND is seeking an organized, detail-driven Risk & Compliance Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of the Risk & Compliance function, helping ensure our organization continuously meets regulatory obligations, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks.

Working closely with the Risk & Compliance Director, you will assist in tracking risk mitigation efforts, maintaining audit readiness across key frameworks (such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and Cyber Essentials), and fostering a strong culture of compliance across all departments. This is an ideal position for a proactive administrative professional looking to build a career in enterprise risk and governance within a fast-paced environment.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Compliance & Audit Coordination

    • Framework Support: Assist in monitoring ongoing compliance with core industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials).
    • Audit Readiness: Coordinate audit preparation by collecting documentation, organizing evidence repositories, and tracking audit action items.
    • Compliance Calendar: Maintain a centralized compliance calendar to track recurring filings, policy review cycles, and regulatory deadlines.

    Risk Governance & Incident Tracking

    • Risk Register Maintenance: Assist in updating the central Risk Register, tracking risk owners, and monitoring remediation progress across departments.
    • Incident Logging: Log compliance incidents, policy breaches, and near-misses; track follow-up corrective actions to ensure timely resolution.
    • Risk Reporting: Help gather data and draft routine risk and compliance dashboards for management review.

    Policy & Training Administration

    • Policy Management: Support the drafting, version control, and distribution of updated internal policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
    • Awareness & Training: Assist in building and deploying compliance training materials; track employee completion rates and assist with onboarding security training.

    Operational Support

    • Provide administrative support to the Risk & Compliance team, including meeting coordination, agenda preparation, and tracking department action items.
    • Serve as an accessible first point of contact for internal inquiries regarding compliance documentation and procedures.

Skill Requirements - Essential

  • Required:

    • Experience: 1–2 years of experience in an administrative, compliance support, operational risk, or audit-adjacent role.
    • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Law, Information Technology, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.
    • Technical Proficiency: High familiarity with modern workspace tools (e.g., Google Workspace / Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira/Confluence, or Notion).
    • Key Competencies:
      • High attention to detail and rigorous organizational skills.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
      • Discretion and integrity when handling confidential or sensitive organizational data.

    Preferred:

    • Basic familiarity with information security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2) or data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, POPIA).
    • Prior experience working in a fully remote team environment.
    • Exposure to Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) software or ticketing tools.

Work Environment

Due to the considerable amount of virtual working and interaction with colleagues and customers in different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but in larger efforts virtually. Self-drive to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential. As an employee, you will be encouraged to continually develop your capability & attain certifications to reflect your growth as an individual.

The business’s comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services. The Company’s transformers have been deployed across power generation, transmission, and distribution to metals and mining, oil and gas, commercial and infrastructure projects, and mobility. As the grid becomes more complex, the transformers play an increasingly vital role in improving power quality and network management. The Company is proud to introduce its TXpert™ Ecosystem, the next level in transformer digitalization, further advancing its commitment to innovation and sustainability.

The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. The candidate will have excellent communications skills.

Support the unit in achieving the set production targets by adhering to the systems and processes. Correctly use machinery and equipment on the shop floor. Read and interpret the technical diagrams/instructions for assembly of products/systems/panels. Operate process equipment or machinery to convert raw materials or semi-finished parts into components or finished parts for a final product at the right time and with the required quality.

  • Operates within standard operating procedures and maintains a clean work area.

  • Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

  • 2-3 years of working experience as Shop Engineering preferably in Transformer Industry

Headquartered in Switzerland, the business serves utility, industry and infrastructure customers across the value chain, and emerging areas like sustainable mobility, smart cities, energy storage and data centres. title: Software Engineer II
description:
Overview

We are hiring a Software Engineer II to help build threat-resistant platform capabilities for Windows Server across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-connected deployments. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will turn security architecture and threat models into shipping code, implement secure-by-design features, close systemic classes of vulnerabilities, and strengthen the platform's trust boundaries from firmware and boot through the kernel, virtualization, identity, and management surfaces.

You will work on the platform's threat-resistant capabilities and bring secure-by-design and secure-by-default ideas to reality. You will translate evolving threats, security requirements, and customer needs into working software while owning the design and implementation of well-scoped components. Experience or demonstrated interest in operating system fundamentals and/or software and system security is a plus; experience with confidential computing or secure use of cryptography is valued.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Design and implement the validation framework to test and maintain secure-by-design features with automated test coverage, and fuzzing to catch defects early, and balancing security, reliability, performance, compatibility, and secure servicing. Apply secure defaults, hardening baselines, cryptographic standards, key management, auditability and logging in the components you own.
  • Build observability pipelines through telemetry insights, security metrics, and health signals needed to measure how well those controls work in production.
  • Contribute to threat modeling and security reviews and build mitigations for high-severity threats and systemic classes of vulnerabilities, validating each mitigation with targeted test cases and regression coverage so fixes hold over time.
  • Support security incidents and partner with product, support, field, AI, and security-adjacent teams to assess impact, deliver containment and remediation fixes, use observability and telemetry to detect and diagnose issues, incorporate real-world attack patterns and operational constraints, and land post-incident hardening improvements
  • Turn reference architectures, threat models, and security design patterns into production features, implementing and validating secure-by-design, secure-by-default, and cryptographic controls across the components you own with thorough testing, observability, and metrics.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, and with 5+ years of technical engineering experience. Familiarity with virtualization concepts (vTPM, Measured Boot, Confidential Virtual Machines), on-premises management tooling, and PowerShell scripting. Experience with programming languages such as C, C++, and C#.
  • Understanding of confidential computing technologies, hardware-rooted trust mechanisms (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP), attestation, and secure key management concepts.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing automated tests, validation frameworks, and production-quality software systems.
  • Experience or demonstrated interest in OS fundamentals and/or software and system security is an important qualification for this role. Demonstrated work in confidential computing or the secure use of cryptography is valued.
  • Demonstrated experience using cryptography in a secure way, including sound selection and application of cryptographic primitives, careful key management, and secure protocol design.
  • Familiarity with platform security controls such as Secure Boot and TPM, virtualization-based security (VBS), code integrity, Credential Guard, WDAC/App Control, BitLocker, and Secured-core.
  • Understanding of modern attacker techniques (credential theft, lateral movement, privilege escalation, persistence, and supply-chain or build attacks), the corresponding defenses, and how to detect them through security telemetry and observability.

#W+DJOBS


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Salgskonsulent til Andersen Biler















Har du lysten og begejstringen til at give kunderne hos Andersen Biler de bedste oplevelser både før, under og efter et salg? Tror du også på de vedvarende relationer til selv samme kunder? Alle tiders! Andersen Biler søger nemlig en som dig. Til gengæld lover vi dig et fantastisk fællesskab, hvor vi tager fælles ansvar, tilbyder masser af ansvar og har et fokus på de nære relationer…

 

Sagen kort:

Rent konkret søger vi en salgskonsulent til vores afdeling i Holbæk, der både har viljen og kompetencerne til at sikre og udbygge de gode kunderelationer. Er du med så langt, så har du sikkert også en indforstået holdning og konkret erfaring med at være vedholdende, empatisk, ambitiøs og begejstret, men også stærk og tydelig i din kommunikation med kunderne… Når det så er sagt og skrevet, vil vi gerne fortælle, at vi allerede glæder os til at høre fra dig!



 

Hos Andersen Biler - Holbæk er vi autoriseret forhandler af Citroën, Nissan, LeapMotor, Opel og Peugeot Erhverv,  samt serviceværksted for Citroën, Nissan, LeapMotor, Opel, Peugeot & Hyundai, og du bliver en del af et dedikeret team på omtrent 30 kollegaer, som hver dag brænder for at give vores kunder de bedste oplevelser, når det kommer til salg, service og rådgivning.





Og så handler det ikke kun om arbejde, men også om at have det sjovt sammen. Derfor har vi flere årlige festlige sammenkomster, som blandt andet inkluderer en julefrokost og vores kickoff. Men festen slutter ikke her - vi har også, biografture og meget mere.

 



Du er i høj kurs hos Andersen Biler, når du: 



	
har minimum 3 års indgående salgserfaring fra bilbranchen og gerne med kendskab til vores mærker

	
har kendskab til lokalområdet

	
har kendskab til Autodesktop, Dracar og Autoproff

	
er en god købmand, der forstår vigtigheden af effektiv omsætning af vores brugte biler

	
arbejder selvstændigt, effektivt og resultatorienteret 

	
er udadvendt, opsøgende og brænder for at skabe vedvarende kunderelationer

	
er nysgerrig, søger ny viden og er forandringsvillig, når det kræves

	
er struktureret, vedholdende og har fokus på høj kvalitet i dit arbejde

	
bidrager til fællesskabet - både med glimt i øjet og som teamplayer med fokus på det nære, relationsbaserede og det målbare




 

Det kan du forvente som salgskonsulent hos Andersen Biler:



	
Et job i en vækstorienteret virksomhed med en positiv vinderkultur og et højt kompetenceniveau 

	
At blive en del af en filial, hvor fællesskabet er stærkt 

	
Et udviklende og selvstændigt job

	
Et godt arbejdsmiljø med passionerede, tillidsfulde kollegaer og en ledelse, som fokuserer på medarbejdernes trivsel

	
Rig mulighed for karriereudvikling - både fagligt og personligt

	
En attraktiv lønpakke med bl.a. firmabil, bonusordning, pension og sundhedsforsikring




 



Vil du vide mere om stillingen, så kontakt gerne filialchef Ulrik Lydeking Olesen på 81773400.





Tiltrædelse:

Snarest muligt. Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende, hvorfor stillingen kan blive besat inden fristens udløb.



Vil du være en del af Andersen Biler? 

Det håber vi! Tryk på knappen "Ansøg", og udfyld dernæst formularen, som kommer frem. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!



 
















Rundt om Andersen Biler



Andersen Biler har været en markant bilforretning på Sjælland i mere end 50 år. I dag tæller organisationen cirka 400 ansatte, der er fordelt over 13 afdelinger. Vi er en innovativ, dynamisk virksomhed, hvor værdier som medarbejdersyn, kundefokus, holdning, udvikling og begejstring gør os i stand til at efterleve vores vision:



Vi vil være Sjællands mest anbefalede bilforhandler, drevet af branchens bedste medarbejdere. Og det er her du kommer ind i billedet - og forhåbentlig ind på kontoret.

Assistant Commercial Project Manager, LTSA Sales





Ready to build an international career where commercial success and project execution go hand in hand?



Do you enjoy coordinating activities, engaging with customers, and driving projects forward? Are you looking for a role that combines commercial insight, global collaboration, and real responsibility from day one?



At Everllence, we're looking for an Assistant Commercial Project Manager to join our growing LTSA Sales team. You will support commercial initiatives and customer projects across global markets, working closely with regional sales teams, customers, and technical specialists to deliver solutions that create long-term value.



This is a unique opportunity to develop your commercial and project management skills in an international environment while contributing directly to the success of one of our strategic growth areas.



You will play an important role in:



	
Supporting the preparation of commercial offers, proposals, and customer presentations.

	
Coordinating activities between customers, regional sales teams, technical experts, and International Group Companies.

	
Participating in customer meetings and ensuring timely follow-up on actions and deliverables.

	
Driving project coordination activities and supporting the execution of agreed action plans.

	
Monitoring project milestones, risks, and commercial opportunities throughout the sales process.

	
Supporting the development and implementation of Reliability Package solutions for new-build projects.

	
Contributing to process improvements and helping shape new ways of working within the department.




 



We imagine that you: 



Are motivated by working at the intersection of sales, customer relationships, and project execution.



You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating with people from different backgrounds, and turning plans into results. You are curious, eager to learn, and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.



To succeed in this role, you:



	
Communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

	
Have experience from a commercial, project, engineering, or customer-facing environment.

	
Enjoy coordinating multiple activities while maintaining structure and attention to detail.

	
Build strong relationships with customers and colleagues across cultures and functions.

	
Take initiative and proactively drive tasks to completion.
	
		
Experience from the marine industry, two-stroke engines, SAP, Teamcenter, or CRM systems is an advantage, but not a requirement.

	
	




 



Welcome to LTSA Denmark



You will join a young, ambitious, and fast-growing team responsible for developing and delivering reliability-focused service solutions to customers around the world.



We work closely with regional sales organizations, customers, and technical specialists across Europe, APAC, MEA, and the Americas. Together, we develop solutions that improve operational reliability, optimize performance, and create long-term value for our customers.



Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. We challenge traditional ways of working, support one another, and encourage everyone to contribute ideas that help us grow and succeed.



 



What can you expect from us:



At Everllence, we are committed to helping our people grow both professionally and personally.



We offer:



	
A structured onboarding program and support from experienced colleagues.

	
Mentorship and coaching to accelerate your development.

	
Professional training, courses, and certifications tailored to your career ambitions.

	
Opportunities to work with customers and colleagues across the globe.

	
Exposure to both commercial and project management disciplines.

	
A culture of learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.

	
Employee clubs, social activities, and a strong team spirit.

	
Flexibility that supports a healthy work-life balance.




Join us and become part of a global team where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contribution truly matters.



We look forward to hearing from you.



 



Unleash your potential at Everllence



Join us on our journey toward a carbon neutral future. At Everllence, you will help shape innovative energy solutions while growing your skills and advancing your career.



We prioritize work-life balance, flexible working hours and remote work options.

We value creativity, diversity, well being, and have a wide range of social clubs -from yoga and fishing to creative activities.



In 2027, we will unite our Copenhagen and Holeby locations at a new and modern site in Trekroner, Roskilde.



 



Build your future with us 



Please apply before Tuesday, 18th of august, 2026. Interviews will be held during the application period.



Questions? You are welcome to contact Christoffer Munch-Jensen, Head of LTSA Sales, Denmark at +34 638 971 508.



Relocating to Denmark? We support you with a mobility package, including help with CPR registration, tax, and work permits.



We aim for a fair and inclusive recruitment process. Regardless of gender, age, religion, disability, or ethnic background, we encourage you to apply. title: Strategic Advisor, QA Surgical Franchise
description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's Project Management function, a team that ensures all regular and one-off projects are planned, organized, and executed effectively to help our people and the world see brilliantly.

The Strategic Advisor, QA Surgical Franchise is primarily responsible for leading strategic project management within the Alcon business unit to ensure cost-effective, high-quality execution in compliance with global standards at our Facility in Fort Worth, TX. Specifics include:

  • Lead and coordinate strategic Quality programs across the Surgical Franchise, ensuring alignment of priorities, timelines, risks, resources, and deliverables across global functions and regions.
  • Standardize and continuously improve Quality governance, project management tools, reporting processes, and best practices to enhance efficiency, consistency, and organizational effectiveness across both franchises.
  • Support Franchise Quality Leadership in annual objective setting, strategic planning, prioritization, and execution tracking to ensure delivery of business, compliance, and quality objectives.
  • Own governance and project management processes for key Quality initiatives, including remediation programs, monthly quality reviews with franchise and regional teams, quality system improvements, compliance projects, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Plan, coordinate, and host quarterly Franchise Quality Management Reviews (QMRs), including agenda development, metric compilation, executive briefing materials, meeting facilitation, action item management, and leadership follow-up.
  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, and status reports that provide visibility to Quality performance, program progress, emerging risks, key decisions, and organizational priorities.
  • Support governance of Franchise-level Quality metrics and performance indicators, including complaint trends, CAPA performance, deviation/nonconformance trends, audit observations, inspection readiness, product quality trends, field actions, and other relevant Quality signals.
  • Facilitate collaboration among Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, Commercial, and regional stakeholders to ensure effective execution of franchise and enterprise Quality objectives.
  • Support identification, prioritization, and escalation of emerging Quality risks across the franchises, including potential patient/customer impact, compliance exposure, supply continuity concerns, or reputational risk.
  • Facilitate cross-franchise alignment on shared Quality priorities, lessons learned, systemic risks, best practices, and opportunities for standardization or continuous improvement.
  • Support preparation of executive-level Quality updates, including concise summaries for Quality Leadership Team, Franchise Leadership Team, and other senior governance forums.
  • Provide thought partnership to Franchise Quality leadership by identifying opportunities to strengthen governance, improve meeting effectiveness, enhance metric visibility, and increase proactive Quality risk management.
  • Liaison with regional quality teams on top issues impacting markets and regions
  • Support of technology/product transfer projects

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +18 yrs; Assoc.+14 yrs; M.S.+7 yrs; PhD+6 yrs)
  • The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English
  • 10 years of relevant experience
  • Location: Onsite
  • Travel Requirements: Up to 10%
  • Relocation Assistance: Yes
  • Sponsorship Available: NO

HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:

  • Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and learnings as work evolves!
  • Join Alcon’s mission to provide top-tier, innovative products and solutions to enhance sight & enhance lives.
  • Grow your career in a highly collaborative and diverse environment.
  • Alcon provides robust benefits package including health, life, retirement, flexible time off for salaried associates, paid time off for hourly associates and much more!

title: Infection Preventionist
description:
Location Address:

1100 Central Ave SE
Albuquerque, NM 87106-4930


Compensation Pay Range:

Minimum Offer $70,449.60
Maximum Offer $119,974.40
Now Hiring: Infection Preventionist

Summary:

Presbyterian Healthcare Services is seeking a knowledgeable and proactive Infection Preventionist to join our Quality and Patient Safety team.

The Infection Preventionist provides for a safe environment where risks for infection are identified and minimized for patients, employees and visitors. This position acts as a liaison and resource person for Infection Prevention and Control and is accountable for management of all Infection Prevention and Control activities by providing environmental and case surveillance, data reporting, data analysis, practice consult and developing interventions aimed at reduction of healthcare-associated infections in patients, members, and workforce. Is responsible for surveillance, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of infections including healthcare associated infections (HAIs); investigation and response to outbreaks of infection amongst patients and/or healthcare workers; consultation to all PCNM delivery sites on Infection Prevention and Control practices; development of resources and education related to Infection Prevention and Control practices; and serving as a liaison with other entities within the Presbyterian Healthcare System and also the county and state health departments. This position will work with multidisciplinary departments to ensure prevention measures are in place and facilitates adherence with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and other recommended or evidence-based practices aimed at prevention of infections including HAIs and other communicable infectious diseases encountered in the healthcare setting. Will ensure adherence to departmental policies and procedures and assists with the analysis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of Infection Prevention and Control clinical quality initiatives that promote Presbyterian Healthcare System clinical strategies and priorities.

Type of Opportunity: Full time
Job Exempt: Yes
Job is based: Presbyterian Hospital
Work Shift: Days (United States of America)


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct surveillance, investigation, and reporting of healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) and communicable diseases.

  • Analyze infection prevention data and identify trends, opportunities, and corrective actions.

  • Collaborate with clinical leaders, physicians, nursing teams, and support departments to implement evidence-based infection prevention practices.

  • Lead outbreak investigations and coordinate response activities when necessary.

  • Develop, implement, and monitor infection prevention policies, procedures, and educational programs.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards, including CDC, CMS, Joint Commission, OSHA, and state requirements.

  • Provide consultation on isolation precautions, infection prevention practices, construction/renovation projects, and emerging infectious disease concerns.

  • Participate in multidisciplinary committees focused on patient safety, quality improvement, and infection prevention.

  • Educate staff, providers, and leadership on infection prevention best practices and performance improvement initiatives.

  • Prepare and present reports, metrics, and recommendations to leadership teams and committees.

Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in health-related field. Masters degree preferred.
2 years of experience in acute health care required. Previous experience in acute care Infection Prevention and Control and/or quality improvement work preferred.
Certificate in Infection Control (CIC) is within 3 years from hire preferred.
Must have a valid drivers license, clean driving record, and able to travel locally.
Must share 24-hour responsibility for availability to respond to infection prevention and control concerns through scheduled on-call activities.
Computer software application skills
such as Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Visio, and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of epidemiological principles and infectious disease.
Knowledge of current patient care practice.

All benefits-eligible Presbyterian employees receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, group term life insurance and other optional voluntary benefits.


Wellness
Presbyterian's Employee Wellness rewards program is designed to provide you with engaging opportunities to enhance your health and activate your well-being. Earn gift cards and more by taking an active role in our personal well-being by participating in wellness activities like wellness challenges, webinar, preventive screening and more.


Why work at Presbyterian?
As an organization, we are committed to improving the health of our communities. From hosting growers' markets to partnering with local communities, Presbyterian is taking active steps to improve the health of New Mexicans.


About Presbyterian Healthcare Services
Presbyterian exists to improve the health of patients, members, and the communities we serve. We are locally owned, not-for-profit healthcare system of nine hospitals, a statewide health plan and a growing multi-specialty medical group. Founded in New Mexico in 1908, we are the state's largest private employer with nearly 14,000 employees - including more than 1600 providers and nearly 4,700 nurses.

Our health plan serves more than 580,000 members statewide and offers Medicare Advantage, Medicaid (Centennial Care) and Commercial health plans.

AA/EOE/VET/DISABLED. PHS is a drug-free and tobacco-free employer with smoke free campuses.

We're Determined to Support New Mexico's Well-Being | Presbyterian Healthcare Services

Job Description:

Business Information:

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for a Shop Engineer for the Transformers Business to join their team in Savli, Gujarat, India. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual.

Transformers BU team leverages innovative and diverse technology to transform energy, delivering social, environmental, and economic value and enabling a sustainable energy future for current and future generations. The business’s comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services. The Company’s transformers have been deployed across power generation, transmission, and distribution to metals and mining, oil and gas, commercial and infrastructure projects, and mobility. As the grid becomes more complex, the transformers play an increasingly vital role in improving power quality and network management. The Company is proud to introduce its TXpert™ Ecosystem, the next level in transformer digitalization, further advancing its commitment to innovation and sustainability.

The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible to accommodate business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & delivers within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills.

Mission Statement

Support the unit in achieving the set production targets by adhering to the systems and processes. Correctly use machinery and equipment on the shop floor. Read and interpret the technical diagrams/instructions for assembly of products/systems/panels. Operate process equipment or machinery to convert raw materials or semi-finished parts into components or finished parts for a final product at the right time and with the required quality.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Executes the assigned work according to agreed work flows and in accordance and safety guidelines.

  • Operates machines in accordance with operating manual/work schedule/production order instructions.

  • Carries out routine set-up and adjustments as well as simple repairs and fits simple replacement parts.

  • The job may include regular standard maintenance of the equipment, set up of tools and programming.

  • Conducts shop floor operations in compliance with health & safety guidelines and reports any non-compliance.

  • The job may include regular quality testing as part of a defined production process. Skill set required depends on type of products and level of complexity.

  • Operates within standard operating procedures and maintains a clean work area.

  • Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your Background

  • Diploma Degree with Electrical/Mechanical Engineering

  • 2-3 years of working experience as Shop Engineering preferably in Transformer Industry

  • Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

More about us

Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader with a combined heritage of almost 250 years, employing around 42,000 people in 92+ countries. Headquartered in Switzerland, the business serves utility, industry and infrastructure customers across the value chain, and emerging areas like sustainable mobility, smart cities, energy storage and data centres. With a proven track record, global footprint and unparalleled installed base, Hitachi Energy balances social, environmental, and economic values, and is committed to powering good for a sustainable energy future, with pioneering and digital technologies, as the partner of choice for enabling a stronger, smarter, and greener grid.

Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity.

+ Collaboration = Innovation.

title: The Hub | Full Stack Cloud Engineer | Factbird
description:
Full Stack Cloud Engineer  
 Arbejdsgiver Factbird Copenhagen Full-time 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
          Salary
           Competitive  
   
  
 
   
 
  
 
   
 
 
 
   
 Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple. 

 
  

 We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all. 

 
  
 About the Role 
 We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end. 

 
  

 We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.  

 
  

 You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering. 

 
  

 What you'll do 

 Building & shipping 
 
 
 Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts 
 

 
 Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software 
 

 
 Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team) 
 

 
 Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build 
 
 
 Team & growth 
 
 
 Take part in code reviews — giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better 
 

 
 Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos 
 

 
 Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team 
 
 
 
  
 About you 
 We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan. 

 
  

 The ideal background 
 
 
 At least three years experience since graduating from a relevant Masters program 
 

 
 Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side 
 

 
 Comfort working with AWS or another major cloud provider 
 

 
 A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design 
 

 
 Good communication — you can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer or someone outside engineering. And you can do all this with strong English fluency. 
 

 
 Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring other engineers, or driving architecture decisions through to a decision 

 
  
 
 
 We welcome applicants from people eager to move to Denmark so long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can contribute to relocation costs for the right candidate.  

 
  
 Why Factbird? 
 People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it. 

 
  

 Here's what you can look forward to: 
 
 
 Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work. 
 

 
 Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact. 
 

 
 Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from. 
 

 
 Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one. 
 

 
 A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions. 
 

 
 Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next. 
 

 
 A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate. 

 
  
 
 
 We'd love to hear from you 

 If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird. 

 
  

 And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them. 

 
  

 
  

 At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. 

 All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws. 

 We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird. 
   
 
   For more information or questions please contact us at   khma@factbird.com    
            or phone number
             +45 24 61 52 1

title: Benefits & Retirement Administrator
description:
Title: Benefits & Retirement Administrator
Location: Washington, DC
Schedule: Full-time, onsite Monday–Friday
Salary: $71,000 – $80,000 per year

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Benefits & Retirement Administrator to join our team and provide HR operational support to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Human Capital Management Office (HCMO) in Washington, DC.

In this role, you will help support the FTC’s day-to-day HR operations, primarily focusing on employee benefits and retirement services while also assisting with HR processing and staffing needs.

This position is a strong fit for a federal HR professional who is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable handling sensitive information, and able to support both benefits and HR processing needs.

Applicants are reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Benefits & Retirement Administration
  • Promote and support wellness and work-life programs
  • Triage incoming benefits inquiries and direct complex matters to FTC Benefits Specialists
  • Support Open Season activities, seminars, and workforce engagement events
  • Provide basic benefits counseling to employees; in-depth counseling is performed by FTC Benefits Specialists
  • Review and process FEHB, FEGLI, TSP, and related benefits forms
  • Communicate with OPM, DFAS, insurance carriers, payroll providers, and other agencies as necessary
  • Request military service documentation and provide deposit and redeposit guidance using FTC calculation tools
  • Calculate redeposit service, FICA, and military deposits
  • Compile and verify employee service histories for retirement purposes
  • Independently prepare retirement packages with oversight from the Benefits Officer
  • Deliver benefits-related briefings during new-hire orientation
  • Maintain and update benefits-related systems, including e-Comp, FHR Navigator, and FPPS
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely records of benefits activities
HR Processing & Staffing
  • Code and process personnel and payroll actions in FPPS within required timeframes
  • Prepare pre-appointment packages and assist with new-hire in-processing
  • Extend tentative and official job offers as directed
  • Review personnel and payroll forms for accuracy and completeness
  • Request, upload, and maintain eOPF records and convert paper files to electronic records
  • Audit personnel records to ensure accuracy and policy compliance
  • Process leave transfers for incoming and current employees
  • Provide customer service regarding HR systems, processes, and procedures
  • Identify and correct HR processing errors
  • Track commemorative awards and maintain award-related files and logs
  • Coordinate and conduct new employee orientation
  • Respond promptly to employee and management inquiries
  • Maintain complete documentation of HR processing activities
Documentation, Quality & Customer Support
  • Deliver high-quality, accurate, and timely support across assigned duties
  • Adhere to applicable federal regulations, agency policies, and privacy and PII requirements
  • Provide courteous, professional customer service to employees, managers, and stakeholders
  • Maintain organized, complete, and audit-ready documentation for assigned activities
  • Collaborate with HCMO personnel and escalate complex issues appropriately
  • Remain flexible in shifting between benefits and HR processing work based on workload demand
  • Use Government systems, tools, and templates in accordance with provided guidance
  • Incorporate Government comments into draft and final work products within 5 business days of receipt
  • Support weekly/bi-weekly activity updates and updated SOPs or workflows as requested

REQUIRED BACKGROUND
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in federal HR processing or benefits
  • Ability to process forms, maintain records, calculate retirement service, and use FPPS and benefits systems
  • Experience with federal benefits and retirement administration or federal HR processing
  • Ability to review and process personnel, payroll, and benefits forms accurately and within required timeframes
  • Ability to maintain complete and accurate HR, benefits, and personnel records
  • Hands-on FPPS experience is preferred; comparable federal payroll or personnel system experience will be considered
  • Ability to provide professional customer service and respond to employee and management inquiries
  • Ability to protect personally identifiable information and other sensitive FTC information

EDUCATION
  • High school diploma required

LOCATION
  • FTC Headquarters, 600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20580

WORK HOURS
  • Full-time, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week

TELEWORK
  • Limited telework may be available with prior approval

SECURITY
  • Must meet FTC background investigation, fingerprinting, and suitability requirements
  • Must complete required pre-employment security screening and forms
  • Must complete FTC Security and Privacy Awareness Training when using agency systems

EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION
  • Employment Classification Eligibility—Exempt

Du er en dygtig håndværker og begejstret fagnørd med oprigtig interesse for detaljen og smagen.

Er du klar til at stå i spidsen for din helt egen Lidl-butik? Kan du lede og motivere et helt butiksteam og sørge for, at butikken altid står snorlige, så vores kunder får den bedste indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye butikschef!

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 170+ butikker i Danmark. Vi arbejder hårdt for at skabe resultater og fortsætte vores vækst. Sammen er vi nemlig drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg. På #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - og på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles.

Som butikschef leder, inspirerer og udvikler du dine medarbejdere til at give kunderne den bedste indkøbsoplevelse. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.

Om jobbet


Som butikschef er det dig, der sørger for, at alt går op i en højere enhed. Du går forrest og motiverer dine medarbejdere til at skabe rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse. Du sørger for, at alle opgaver bliver fulgt til dørs, og at butikken altid er salgsklar. Samtidig sørger du for, at dine medarbejdere trives, og du bakker dem op i deres udvikling.
Du bliver også ansvarlig for at:

Lede og fordele den daglige butiksdrift 

Tage del i den daglige drift af butikken, f.eks. varebestilling og -opfyldning

Oplære, uddanne og motivere dine medarbejdere i butikken

Planlægge aktiviteter og arbejdsplaner 

Implementere, analysere og optimere Lidls butikskoncepter 

Analysere og følge op på nøgletal og bruge dem aktivt til at nå butikkens mål - herunder omsætte KPI’er til håndgribelige mål og fokusområder

Rekruttere nye medarbejdere




Om dig


Du har muligvis en lederuddannelse og har med succes motiveret og ledet et hold af medarbejdere til at skabe gode resultater. Måske er du allerede en dygtig og resultatorienteret butikschef eller afdelingsleder hos en af vores kolleger i branchen, eller også har du en tilsvarende baggrund og lyst til at investere dig selv og din karriere i en velfungerende arbejdsplads med store ambitioner og højt til loftet. Udover at du tager aktivt del i den daglige drift og har det overordnede overblik, forventer vi, at du: 

Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

Er empatisk, motiverende og har en anerkendende ledelsesstil 

Handler ansvarsbevidst og kan uddelegere og følge opgaverne til dørs 

Er resultatorienteret og har forretningssans

Er serviceminded og kan skabe rammerne for gode indkøbsoplevelser

Vi er åbne overfor ansøgere til denne stilling der ikke taler dansk, men du skal i så fald kunne tale og forstå engelsk i det daglige. Vi lægger mest vægt på din erfaring, motivation og om du passer godt ind i vores værdier og måden vi samarbejder på.
