title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
  • Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
  • Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
  • Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
  • Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

  • A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
  • A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
  • A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
  • A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
  • An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
  • Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
  • A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

What’s in it for you:

  • A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
  • Competitive compensation package + bonus
  • 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment
  • Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
  • Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
  • Pension and life insurance
  • Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan
  • Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
  • Paid parental leave
  • Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme
  • Central office location complete with pop up events organised by our own community team as well as the building’s community team
  • Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
  • Access to over 4,000 deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness, cinema discounts, and more.

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Vil du være med på holdet på Madklubbens nye restaurant i Pilestræde?





Med kræfter fra holdet bag Jade åbner vi snart en ny restaurant i hjertet af Pilestræde, og vi søger et stærkt team, der vil være med til at skabe og forme en ny og spændende restaurantoplevelse fra bunden.

Konceptet forener moderne sushi, dumplings og små deleretter i et stilfuldt og luksuriøst univers, hvor stemningen er levende, servicen nærværende og kvaliteten er i højsædet. Her er der fokus på smag, håndværk og en oplevelse, der får gæsterne til at vende tilbage igen og igen.





Hvem er du?


Som køkkenchef er du overordnet ansvarlig for hele køkkenets drift og personale. Det betyder, at du skal kunne være i stand til, og synes det er sjovt, at have flere bolde i luften og samme tid holde det kølige overblik.  



Der vil være opgaver ved siden af, at du selvfølgelig kører service med dit team.

Jobbet indebærer bl.a. ledelse af dine kokke og køkkenassistenter. Derudover vil din hverdag blandt andet, men ikke udelukkende, bestå af vagtplanlægning, udvikling af nye retter og menuer i samspil med den gastronomiske chef, økonomistyring, varebestilling, rengøring, opfølgning, hygiejne og egenkontrol.  



Du bruger størstedelen af din tid i service side om side med dit hold og du er ansvarlig for - og tager aktiv del i, udviklingen og træningen af alle på holdet.

Succesen er at køre en aften med fantastisk mad, serveret til tiden i godt humør og med glade kollegaer, som føler sig motiveret, inspireret og anerkendt i dit selskab. 






Vi tilbyder

Som en del af Madklubben-familien med +40 restauranter, bliver du en del af et socialt fællesskab, hvor du finder et stærkt bagland til at hjælpe dig med at blive dygtigere og endnu mere succesfuld.  
Derudover tilbyder vi følgende:  


Gode uddannelses- og udviklingsmuligheder såsom f.eks. økonomi og lederkurser. 


Sociale arrangementer og personalefester. 

Personalerabat til at besøge vores andre restauranter.  

Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Pensionsordning og helbredssikring.





Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt.
Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, hvis den rigtige dukker op, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning allerede i dag.  
 
Opstart:  Midt september-start oktober.
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Kontakt Gastronomisk chef Asger Klausen på asger@madklubben.dk.








Om Madklubben
Madklubben er én stor familie af restauranter i fordelt over hele landet.





Lige siden vi åbnede vores første restaurant i 2007, har vi haft en målsætning om at gøre restaurantbesøget tilgængeligt for flere i Danmark. Med langt over en million besøgende om året er vi godt på vej. Vi beskæftiger flere tusinde mennesker fordelt på 40+ restauranter, og vi har ambitioner om endnu flere. Derfor er vi altid på udkig efter talentfulde personligheder, der har lyst til at blive en del af Klubben.

title: External Communications Executive
description:
About the Client

Our client is an established, fast-moving business with a strong external presence across email, social media, events, digital content, podcasts, and promotional campaigns.

They are looking for an experienced External Communications Executive to take ownership of day-to-day email marketing, CRM communications, social media scheduling, and digital content coordination.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how a business communicates effectively with its audience across multiple channels. The successful candidate will work closely with the client’s senior team, videographer, media manager, AI manager, events team, and advertising team.

The client also has a highly developed suite of AI agents that has been trained on its brands, communications, content style, and previous projects over a period of approximately two years. This means the successful candidate will not be starting from scratch. They will be expected to use these tools extensively to support content creation, campaign delivery, imagery, and communications.

Requirements

Key Areas of Responsibility

Email Marketing & CRM Management

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting and managing the client’s external email communications using KEAP and GoHighLevel (GHL).

Previous practical experience using these systems is essential.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Manage outgoing email campaigns, broadcasts, delivery emails, announcements, event communications, and promotional emails through KEAP and GoHighLevel.
  • Maintain and update the monthly email marketing and communications calendar.
  • Prepare, build, format, schedule, and distribute email campaigns.
  • Upload and format copy, imagery, links, calls to action, and other campaign assets.
  • Build, test, and maintain basic email automations relating to events, registrations, campaigns, product delivery, and audience journeys.
  • Manage CRM contacts, tags, lists, segments, opt-ins, and opt-outs.
  • Use tagging and segmentation effectively to reduce unnecessary email volume and improve audience engagement.
  • Understand the difference between engaged and unengaged contacts and manage communications accordingly.
  • Monitor email campaign performance, including open rates, click-through rates, engagement levels, deliverability, and other relevant metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve open rates, click-through rates, audience engagement, and campaign performance.
  • Schedule sponsor and partner emails according to agreed timelines.
  • Conduct thorough quality checks before emails are distributed, including links, formatting, spelling, branding, imagery, and accuracy.
  • Maintain organised email templates, automations, contact segments, campaigns, and supporting assets.
  • Identify campaign, CRM, deliverability, or audience issues and escalate these to the relevant team member when required.

Social Media Management

The successful candidate will help manage and coordinate the client’s external social media presence across all relevant channels.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Learn and understand the client’s brands, tone of voice, audience, messaging, positioning, and preferred content style.
  • Maintain a consistent social media content calendar.
  • Schedule social media content across all relevant platforms using appropriate scheduling tools.
  • Actively manage external social media campaigns across the client’s channels.
  • Research relevant trends, topics, hashtags, conversations, and content opportunities within the client’s market.
  • Repurpose existing long-form and short-form content into social posts, stories, reels, clips, and other suitable formats.
  • Create simple branded graphics and campaign assets using tools such as Canva or Adobe Photoshop.
  • Capture appropriate behind-the-scenes content in the office, at events, or during relevant business activities when required.
  • Coordinate video and podcast assets, including organising files, preparing thumbnails, uploading content, and scheduling posts.
  • Monitor routine comments, messages, and audience engagement.
  • Respond to straightforward engagement in accordance with brand guidelines.
  • Escalate important enquiries, complaints, opportunities, or sensitive conversations to the appropriate member of the senior team.
  • Monitor basic social media performance and contribute insights to monthly reporting.
  • Keep content calendars, campaign assets, imagery, video files, and social media resources organised and up to date.

Content Creation

The role will also involve supporting the creation and coordination of digital content for campaigns and ongoing brand communications.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Create occasional digital guides and supporting resources for social media and promotional campaigns.
  • Produce short-form reels and social media video content.
  • Support and oversee content relating to the client’s podcast channels.
  • Coordinate content required for active external marketing and social campaigns.
  • Repurpose existing material into suitable digital formats for different platforms and audiences.
  • Create promotional imagery and social media campaign assets using the client’s trained AI image creation tools.
  • Work with the client’s established AI systems to develop content while ensuring all outputs remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with the brand.
  • Liaise closely with the events and advertising teams to ensure current content supports upcoming promotions, campaigns, launches, and events.
  • Ensure communications across email, social media, paid advertising, events, and other channels remain aligned.

What the Client Is Looking For

This role would suit someone who understands the wider role of external communications within a business, rather than someone who has only posted occasionally on social media.

The successful candidate should understand how email marketing, CRM management, audience segmentation, social media, campaign content, and customer engagement work together.

They should have:

  • Previous hands-on experience managing email marketing or CRM platforms.
  • Practical experience with KEAP and GoHighLevel is essential.
  • A good understanding of CRM tagging, segmentation, lists, opt-ins, opt-outs, and contact management.
  • An understanding of open rates, click-through rates, email engagement, and deliverability.
  • Experience identifying engaged versus unengaged contacts.
  • An understanding of how segmentation and tagging can reduce unnecessary email volume and improve campaign performance.
  • Experience scheduling and coordinating social media content across multiple platforms.
  • A good understanding of what makes strong versus weak digital content.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Confidence checking content for spelling, formatting, branding, links, and accuracy.
  • Basic content creation and graphic design capabilities.
  • Experience with Canva and/or Adobe Photoshop would be beneficial.
  • Confidence working with AI-assisted content and image creation tools.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
  • The ability to work collaboratively with different teams while taking ownership of their own responsibilities.
  • A proactive approach to identifying ways to improve communication performance and audience engagement.

 You can expect a broad variety of tasks, including preparing and coordinating events (communication, analysis, practical setup for online and in-person events, and ad-hoc execution), mapping relevant stakeholders, and helping with investment activities (hosting investor events, pitch events etc.). You will also assist with strategic initiatives and delegations to/from Denmark, such as working with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, embassies, hospitals, insurance companies, municipalities and investors.  

   

 The successful candidate is expected to work with the following:  

   

 Responsibilities:  
 
 
 Support the planning, communication and execution of our various events, including in-person and online breakout rooms.  
 
  
 
 Assist in mapping and scouting relevant stakeholders and organisations for strategic partnerships in international markets, including healthcare providers, regulatory bodies, investors and industry associations.  
 
  
 
 Help us manage our communications workflow.  
 
  
 
 Maintain the member catalogue and keep member information up to date, with specific portfolio segments per stakeholder.  
 
  
 
 Help plan our yearly activities and ensure member engagement.  
 
  
 
 Help set up and prepare investor events.   
 
 
   

 About you:  

   
 
 
 Ideally, you are probably between your 4th semester of your bachelor’s or master’s programme, with 1-2 years remaining until graduation.   
 
  
 
 Structured and meticulous.  
 
  
 
 Strong analytical and research skills, with a keen interest in health market trends, market access, and investments.  
 
  
 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Additional languages are considered a plus, yet we work in English.  
 
  
 
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.  
 
  
 
 Strong stakeholder management skills.  
 
 
   

 A plus:  
 
 
 Familiarity with the health tech industry.  
 
  
 
 Familiarity with CRM.  
 
  
 
 Flair for design.  
 
 
   

 What you'll gain: 
 
 
 Exposure to the vibrant digital health ecosystem in Copenhagen.  
 
  
 
 Networking opportunities with industry experts, startups, and investors.  
 
  
 
 Hands-on experience in business development work.  
 
  
 
 Flexible work hours to accommodate academic commitments.  

 
  
 
 
 The practical bits: 
 
 
 15-20 hours a week, with flexibility during exams 
 

 
 Start as soon as possible, for a minimum of one year 
 

 
 Based in Copenhagen, with flexibility to work remotely when needed 
 

 
 A fun, informal work environment with perks like healthy lunches, team days, free coffee, and more 
 
 
 
  

 Health Tech Hub Copenhagen is an equal opportunity employer and encourages candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply. We appreciate all applications, but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:
JobMatchProfile

















    



        








Brugtvogns AnsvarligViby, Terminalen A/S












Brugtvogns Ansvarlig
Indtast din mailadresse, og tryk Fortsæt.


Din mailadresse


Indtast en gyldig mailadresse








Jeg giver hermed mit samtykke til, at Terminalen A/S, hvor jeg søger ansættelse, og Garuda AS, som fungerer som databehandler, kan indsamle og registrere de personoplysninger, jeg afgiver. Du kan læse samtykkeerklæringen ved at klikke her.
Dine personoplysninger bliver behandlet som beskrevet i Nic. Christiansen Gruppens privatlivspolitik.

Dette felt er påkrævet.

Hvis du allerede er oprettet som ansøger til stillingen, kan du logge direkte ind her.



Annuller

FortsætSender








Samtykkeerklæring



Dataansvarlig

Terminalen A/S





 Oplysning om indsamling af dine personoplysninger:

Ved udfyldelse af spørgeskemaet indhentes oplysninger om dit navn, e-mail, køn, CV og ansøgning.


Vi behandler de personoplysninger, du har afgivet i dette spørgeskema. Derefter indhenter og behandler vi eventuelt yderligere oplysninger om dine arbejdsevner fra referencer og sociale medier med henblik på en vurdering af dine kompetencer og erfaringer i relation til den pågældende stilling. På grundlag af alle disse oplysninger udarbejder vi en profil, som vi registrerer og opbevarer i en periode på 6 måneder.


Formålet med ovennævnte behandling af dine personoplysninger er en vurdering af dine kompetencer i forhold til det konkrete opslag hos virksomheden/organisationen, du har søgt ansættelse hos, samt i forhold til fremtidige stillinger.


Dine oplysninger i dette spørgeskema kan blive omfattet af en automatisk afgørelse, herunder profilering. Logikken bag denne afgørelse er brug af saglige kriterier, som gør det muligt at finde frem til de registrerede, som har de kompetencer, som søges til den pågældende stilling.


Som led i vurderingen kan dine dokumenter (fx CV og ansøgning) blive analyseret ved hjælp af kunstig intelligens (AI) med det formål at generere indsigter til brug for vurderingen. AI-analysen anvendes som støtte og træffer ikke selvstændige afgørelser - den endelige vurdering foretages altid med menneskelig involvering. Behandlingen kan indebære overførsel af dine oplysninger til tredjelande uden for EU/EØS, som sker på grundlag af EU-Kommissionens standardkontraktsbestemmelser (SCC) og/eller EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Du kan få oplyst det nærmere overførselsgrundlag ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Behandlingen af dine personoplysninger er baseret på dit samtykke.


Dit samtykke til de ovennævnte behandlinger af dine oplysninger kan til enhver tid tilbagekaldes med det resultat, at registreringen af oplysningerne slettes. Tilbagekaldelse kan ske ved henvendelse til den dataansvarlige.


Dine personoplysninger vil blive opbevaret i en periode på 6 måneder og derefter slettet.


Det er frivilligt at besvare de stillede spørgsmål, men undlader du at besvare spørgsmålene, bevirker det, at den dataansvarlige ikke vil være i stand til at vurdere din kompetence på den forudsatte måde.

Ansøg

HAR DU FLAIR FOR SALG AF BRUGTE BILER OG KUNDERÅDGVING I TOPKLASSE? 

Hos Terminalen Viby får du nu muligheden for at blive en del af en ambitiøs forretning, hvor brugtvognssalg er et strategisk fokusområde, og hvor faglighed, samarbejde og gode kundeoplevelser går hånd i hånd.  

 

VÆR MED TIL AT UDVIKLE VORES BRUGTVOGNSFORRETNING 

Vi søger en engageret og resultatorienteret salgskonsulent til Used Cars, som vil være med til at sikre og videreudvikle vores succes inden for brugtvognssalg. Du får en central rolle i afdelingen og bliver en vigtig del af et stærkt team, hvor du er med til at skabe både solide resultater og langvarige relationer i den daglige kontakt med vores kunder og dine komne kolleger. 

 

DIN ROLLE 

Som salgskonsulent bliver du, sammen med en kollega, nøgleperson i vores brugtvognsafdeling, hvor du hjælper kunderne med at finde deres næste bil blandt et bredt og attraktivt udvalg af mærker og modeller. 

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kollegerne i Used Cars-teamet i NCG. Da indkøb, klargøring og mange af de bagvedliggende processer håndteres centralt, kan du fokusere på det, der skaber værdi i hverdagen: salg, rådgivning og den gode kundeoplevelse. 

Din hverdag er varieret, og du får mulighed for aktivt at præge udviklingen af Used Cars-forretningen lokalt. Dine ansvarsområder vil blandt andet omfatte: 



Lageroptimering 

Opnåelse af personlige salgsmål 

Salg af serviceaftaler, finansiering og forsikringer 

Sikring af høj kundetilfredshed gennem hele salgsprocessen 



 

HVEM ER DU? 



Du har erfaring med bilsalg og en stor interesse for brugte biler. Du motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og trives i en rolle med højt aktivitetsniveau.

Du er serviceminded, relations skabende og struktureret - og du formår at bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag.  

Du ved, hvad der skal til for at skabe tryghed hos kunden, og du følger naturligt dine sager helt til dørs. 

Samtidig har du lyst til at blive en del af et strategisk vigtigt område i Nic. Christiansen Gruppen, hvor vi sammen arbejder på at sætte nye standarder for brugtvognssalg. 






DIN NYE ARBEJDSPLADS 

Terminalen er en multibrand-forhandlerkæde med 5 forretninger i Danmark og en klar ambition om at give kunderne den bedste service til den rigtige pris. 

Hos Terminalen Viby er vi autoriseret forhandler af Hyundai og Ford og vi har samtidig en stærk og voksende brugtvognsforretning med et bredt udvalg af kvalitetsbiler. 

Du bliver en del af Nic. Christiansen Gruppen, en førende aktør i den nordiske autobranche med mere end 1.600 medarbejdere i Norden og Tyskland. Vores værdier - ordentlighed, ambition, sammenhold og passion - er en naturlig del af hverdagen og præger samarbejdet med både kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere. 

 

VI TILBYDER  

Som medarbejder hos Terminalen får du:  



Gode medarbejdervilkår - inkl. pension, sundhedsforsikring, flere årlige udviklingssamtaler og et arbejdsmiljø i topklasse  

Uddannelse og træning - vi investerer i din faglige udvikling gennem træningsprogrammer og mulighed for efteruddannelse  

En stærk teamkultur - hvor vi bakker hinanden op og arbejder mod fælles mål  

Sociale arrangementer - der styrker fællesskabet og skaber gode oplevelser sammen  

Attraktive medarbejderrabatter - hos vores samarbejdspartnere  



   

VIL DU MED PÅ HOLDET?  

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi vurderer og behandler indkomne ansøgninger løbende - så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.  

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Salgschef Torben Sejr på tlf. +45 5189 9770

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!  




AnsøgTip en venAndre stillinger 






































 









Terminalen A/S


Som medarbejder hos Terminalen A/S bliver du en del af , der siden 1967 har samlet på stærke brands og dygtige folk. Drevet af ordentlighed, integritet, sammenhold, passion og ambitioner er vi i dag en af Nordens største koncerner i bilbranchen: Vi arbejder hver dag på at gøre gode ting bedre - og på at levere mobilitetsløsninger, der både flytter mennesker og fremtiden med.

Armering
 
Klargøring til støbning
 
Opbygning af træforskalling og støbeforme
 
Afformning og håndtering af betonelementer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra beton-, bygge- eller produktionsbranchen, men det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt og klar på at lære.
 
1 truckfører
 
Du kommer primært til at arbejde med intern transport og håndtering af større betonelementer - blandt andet udendørs.

Har gyldigt truckcertifikat

Er indstillet på udendørs arbejde året rundt
 
1 medarbejder til finish

Opgaverne består bl.a. af:
 
Mindre reparationer af betonelementer
 
Udbedring af kanter, hjørner og mindre skader efter afformning

Andre praktiske håndværksmæssige opgaver

title: Vi søker varebilsjåfører i Sandnes – midlertidige stillinger ved Sandnes postterminal
description:
Vil du ha en aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag og samtidig være en viktig del av samfunnets transport- og logistikktjenester? Posten Bring AS søker serviceinnstilte og pålitelige varebilsjåfører til vår virksomhet i Sandnes.

Som varebilsjåfør hos oss får du ansvar for å hente og levere ekspresspakker til bedrifter, privatpersoner og pakkebokser i Sandnes og omegn. Du arbeider selvstendig ute på ruten, men er samtidig en del av et lag som samarbeider for å levere god kvalitet og gode kundeopplevelser.

Om stillingene:

  • Midlertidig stilling: 100 prosent, mandag–fredag. Arbeidstiden varierer innenfor tidsrommet kl. 06:00–17:00. Det kan bli mulighet for fast ansettelse senere.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Klargjøre kjøretøy, utstyr og sendinger før avreise.
  • Laste og losse pakker på en sikker og effektiv måte.
  • Hente og levere ekspresspakker til bedrifter, privatpersoner og pakkebokser.
  • Bruke digitale arbeidsverktøy til skanning, navigasjon og registrering av leveranser.
  • Ha kontakt med kunder og representere Posten Bring på en profesjonell og serviceinnstilt måte.
  • Utføre daglig kontroll, rydding og renhold av kjøretøy samt melde fra om feil, mangler eller skader.
  • Bidra med andre oppgaver ved behov og hjelpe kolleger når driften krever det.

Kvalifikasjoner – dette må du ha:

  • Gyldig førerkort klasse B.
  • Minimum to års sammenhengende førerrett i klasse B. Dette er nødvendig ved kjøring av aktuelle elektriske kjøretøy med tillatt totalvekt over 3 500 kg og inntil 4250kg.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig, slik at du kan kommunisere med kunder og forstå arbeids- og sikkerhetsrutiner.
  • Evne til å bruke digitale arbeidsverktøy.
  • Evne til å utføre fysisk arbeid med løft, bæring og mange inn- og utstigninger gjennom arbeidsdagen.
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.
  • Det er en fordel om du har erfaring fra distribusjon, transport, budtjenester eller kundeservice.
  • Kjennskap til Sandnes/Stavanger og omegn.
  • Erfaring med varebil og kjøring i bytrafikk.

Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Du kjører trygt og har sikkerhet som førsteprioritet.
  • Du er pålitelig, punktlig og tar ansvar for egne oppgaver.
  • Du arbeider strukturert og effektivt, også når arbeidsdagen er hektisk.
  • Du er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av at kundene skal få en god opplevelse.
  • Du trives med å arbeide selvstendig, men bidrar også positivt i teamet.
  • Du er fleksibel og løsningsorientert når planer eller ruter endres.
  • Arbeidsdagen starter normalt med klargjøring og lasting før du kjører ut på egen rute.
  • Jobben innebærer stor grad av selvstendighet, fysisk aktivitet og kontakt med mange ulike kunder. Værforhold, trafikk, leveringssteder og mengde kan variere, og du må derfor kunne håndtere endringer på en rolig og effektiv måte.

Hva kan du forvente hos oss?

  • Lønn og tillegg i henhold til gjeldende avtaler.
  • Årslønn 529 400,- (270 Kr i timen)
  • God opplæring og oppfølging i oppstartsperioden.
  • Moderne kjøretøy, teknologi og digitale arbeidsverktøy.
  • Et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med godt samhold.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling og videre karriere i Posten Bring.

Om Oss

  • Bildrift er Posten Bring-konsernets samlede transportmiljø for bil og sjåfør. Vi har virksomhet over hele landet og har fokus på sikkerhet, kvalitet, miljø og profesjonell drift. Som medarbeider blir du en del av et stort fagmiljø med viktige oppgaver for kunder og samfunn.

Ikke vent med å søke. Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.

Søknadsfrist: 31.08.2026

Oppstart etter avtale.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte oppgitt kontaktperson i annonsen.

title: Principal UX Engineer, Ads
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal UX Engineer, Ads based in the United States.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role at the intersection of product design and engineering.
You’ll use code as a design medium to prototype ideas, test assumptions, and shape product direction.
You’ll work across advertising products and experiences, partnering with Design, Research, Product, Engineering, and Data Science.
The role combines deep technical craft with systems thinking, enabling teams to move from concepts to polished products faster.
You’ll establish reusable tools, components, and workflows while raising the bar for accessibility, performance, and interaction quality.
You’ll also explore how AI can transform both advertising experiences and the way product teams design and build.
As a principal-level contributor, you’ll influence multiple product areas, mentor others, and help define the future of UX Engineering.

Accountabilities:

  • Define and lead the UX Engineering strategy across multiple advertising product areas, influencing product direction beyond individual projects.
  • Build sophisticated, high-quality prototypes and functional experiences that help teams explore concepts, validate assumptions, and make informed product decisions earlier.
  • Partner with senior leaders across Design, Research, Product, Engineering, and Data Science to clarify complex opportunities and translate ideas into compelling user experiences.
  • Develop reusable tools, systems, components, and workflows that improve collaboration between design and engineering and accelerate the path from exploration to production.
  • Establish high standards for interaction design, accessibility, performance, usability, and technical implementation across advertising experiences.
  • Investigate and apply AI-enabled approaches to improve both advertiser-facing products and internal design and development workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve UX Engineering practices, tooling, and processes across the broader organization.
  • Mentor UX engineers and other practitioners, share technical and design expertise, and help strengthen UX Engineering as an organizational capability.
  • Navigate ambiguous, high-impact problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, business priorities, and product strategy.

    • Requirements:

    • Extensive experience working at the intersection of product design and software engineering, with a strong portfolio of sophisticated interactive products or experiences.
    • Advanced hands-on expertise with modern frontend technologies, particularly React and TypeScript.
    • Strong product, interaction, and visual judgment, with the ability to transform complex concepts into intuitive, polished, and accessible experiences.
    • Proven ability to operate across multiple teams or product areas and influence product strategy at a senior level.
    • Strong systems-thinking skills, including experience developing reusable components, platforms, tools, frameworks, or workflows that enable other teams to work more effectively.
    • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments, identify tradeoffs, and bring diverse perspectives together to reach strong decisions.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly when working with senior cross-functional stakeholders.
    • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to influence without relying on direct authority.
    • Genuine interest in remaining deeply hands-on while mentoring others and raising the technical and product quality of the broader team.
    • Experience in advertising is helpful but not required; relevant backgrounds may include marketplaces, enterprise software, analytics, commerce, developer platforms, AI-powered products, or other complex multi-sided ecosystems.
    • Ability to explore emerging technologies, including AI, and translate them into practical improvements to product development and user experiences.

      • Benefits:

      • Base salary: $245,800–$344,100 USD, with final compensation determined by factors such as skills, experience, credentials, and location.
      • Equity compensation through restricted stock units.
      • Commission eligibility may apply depending on the position offered.
      • Comprehensive healthcare benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
      • Income replacement programs.
      • 401(k) with employer match.
      • Global benefits designed to support professional development, workspace needs, caregiving, and different lifestyles.
      • Family planning support.
      • Gender-affirming care.
      • Mental health and coaching benefits.
      • Flexible vacation and paid volunteer time off.
      • Generous paid parental leave.
      • Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans throughout the hiring process.
      • For select roles and locations, interviews may be recorded, transcribed, and summarized using AI, with the option to opt out before scheduled interviews.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
As a DevOps Engineer at Billion Careers Private Limited, you will be a key member of our Product team, responsible for ensuring the stability and growth of our SaaS platform. Your expertise will be instrumental in automating processes, managing AWS infrastructure, and collaborating with various teams to enhance our platform's performance and scalability. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the success of our SaaS platform and drive innovation within the Product team.
  • Automate and optimize deployment processes to ensure efficient and reliable software releases.
  • Manage and monitor AWS infrastructure, including EC2 instances, S3 buckets, and RDS databases, to maintain high availability and performance.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to identify and implement best practices for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Implement and maintain monitoring tools to track system performance, identify bottlenecks, and ensure optimal system health.
  • Design and develop scalable and secure infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Ensure security and compliance by implementing security measures, conducting regular security audits, and staying updated with industry best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working closely with the operations team to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
  • Document and maintain comprehensive documentation for all DevOps processes, ensuring knowledge transfer and easy onboarding for new team members.
  • Stay updated with the latest DevOps tools, technologies, and trends, and propose innovative solutions to improve our platform's efficiency.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance and support to other team members on DevOps-related queries and challenges.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps role, with a proven track record of successfully managing AWS infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and configuration management.
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and container orchestration platforms.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and experience with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or similar.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles and experience with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or AWS CloudWatch.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
  • Passion for continuous learning and staying updated with the latest DevOps trends and best practices.

Vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende




Vi tilbyder

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 151,52 kr. i timen som faglært og 142,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst fra HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

title: Site Engineers and Project Engineers
description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

Job Description

About the Project:

Acciona as part of the ActivUS Alliance is nearing the delivery phase of The Logan and Gold Coast Faster Rail (LGC) Project, which will double the number of rail tracks and upgrade stations for a 20 kilometer section of the Beenleigh and Gold Coast lines between Kuraby, a suburb south of Brisbane’s CBD, and Beenleigh, a suburb of Logan City.

About the Opportunity:

ACCIONA is actively seeking Site Engineers and Project Engineers - to join the team.

Opportunities exist across the following disciplines:

  • Rail Civil
  • Civil Engineering
  • Structural Engineering

As part of our team, you will contribute to the planning, coordination, and delivery of major works within a diverse engineering environment on one of QLD's most significant rail infrastructure projects.

Key Accountabilities

  • Drive a positive safety culture while ensuring rigorous adherence to safety, quality, and environmental requirements.
  • Deliver works to project specifications, standards, and technical requirements
  • Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and construction activities
  • Support design reviews, technical assessments, and constructability inputs
  • Prepare progress reports, project documentation, and engineering records
  • Drive innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence across your discipline

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Degree in Civil, Structural, or related Engineering discipline
  • Experience on major infrastructure projects
  • Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to manage safety, compliance, and project standards
  • Problem-solving mind-set and commitment to safe, sustainable engineering delivery

What we Offer:

  • Opportunity to work on a landmark infrastructure project shaping QLD's future
  • Exposure to complex civil and structural challenges
  • Career development through ACCIONA's global training and development programs
  • Collaborative, high-performing team culture

Apply now!

ACCIONA has been given the Top Employer 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025 certification in Australia, which certifies the company's commitment to excellence in human resources management and those who focus on putting their people first through their exceptional HR policies. Since establishing a presence in Australia in 2002, ACCIONA has made significant investments in local opportunities and project development. ACCIONA employs more than 3,000 people in its renewable energy, infrastructure and water projects across Australia & New Zealand.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and promote equality and diversity. Indigenous Australians and candidates from minority groups are encouraged to apply.

title: Director, Email Deliverability
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Email Deliverability based in Canada.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to build and own an enterprise-scale email deliverability function from the ground up.
You will define the strategy, infrastructure, and standards that ensure customer messages consistently reach the inbox.
The role combines deep technical expertise with customer advisory responsibilities across a large portfolio of e-commerce brands.
You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to shape deliverability tooling and platform capabilities.
You will also establish scalable processes, monitoring frameworks, and industry relationships that strengthen sender reputation and performance.
As the function matures, you will have the opportunity to recruit, mentor, and lead a specialized deliverability team.
This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-moving environment and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into measurable business outcomes.

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end email deliverability strategy, including IP pool architecture, domain strategy, and shared versus dedicated sending models.
  • Design and manage IP and domain warming programs that enable new senders to scale volume safely while protecting sender reputation.
  • Establish and maintain authentication standards covering SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, and DMARC alignment across customer sending domains.
  • Monitor sender reputation, inbox placement, blocklists, spam rates, and other deliverability indicators, leading rapid remediation when issues arise.
  • Track evolving requirements from major mailbox providers, including Gmail, Yahoo, and Microsoft, and ensure sending practices remain aligned with current standards.
  • Act as the senior deliverability advisor for customers by auditing email programs, diagnosing inbox-placement challenges, and developing actionable remediation strategies.
  • Lead deliverability onboarding for customers migrating email programs, including reputation assessment, reputation transfer, and warming strategies.
  • Translate complex technical deliverability concepts into clear recommendations that marketing and business stakeholders can understand and implement.
  • Manage customer escalations and help protect and improve inbox placement and sender reputation across customer programs.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define deliverability infrastructure, monitoring capabilities, tooling, and roadmap priorities.
  • Establish scalable playbooks, processes, standards, feedback loops, reporting, and monitoring systems that support thousands of senders.
  • Implement and leverage tools such as Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, feedback loops, and internal reporting to provide visibility into deliverability health.
  • Build relationships with mailbox providers, industry partners, and the wider email deliverability community.
  • Maintain compliance with relevant email marketing and privacy regulations, including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and mailbox-provider policies.
  • Leverage AI tools and internal systems to improve monitoring, diagnostics, reporting, and customer guidance.
  • As the function grows, recruit, mentor, and lead a team of deliverability specialists while establishing a strong culture of expertise and accountability.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of dedicated email deliverability experience, ideally within an ESP, CDP, high-volume sending platform, or comparable technology environment.
    • Deep technical expertise in SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, IP and domain warming, sender reputation, feedback loops, and inbox placement.
    • Hands-on experience managing deliverability for high-volume senders, including diagnosing and resolving blocklisting, reputation, spam-rate, and inbox-placement issues.
    • Strong working knowledge of Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and current Gmail, Yahoo, and Microsoft bulk-sender requirements.
    • Established relationships with mailbox providers and/or active involvement in professional deliverability communities such as M3AAWG or Email Geeks is strongly preferred.
    • Strong understanding of e-commerce and direct-to-consumer brands, including how email contributes to customer engagement and revenue.
    • Excellent consulting and communication skills, with the ability to translate highly technical deliverability concepts into practical strategies for non-technical marketing teams.
    • Player-coach mindset with the ability to remain hands-on while developing scalable processes, documentation, and team capabilities.
    • Demonstrated ability to build a new function, establish operational standards, and create structure in a fast-paced or early-stage environment.
    • Comfortable working with AI and emerging technologies to improve monitoring, diagnostics, analysis, and operational efficiency.
    • Strong strategic thinking, analytical problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
    • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail, reliability, and follow-through.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, customers, and external industry stakeholders.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to work from Canada.
      • Opportunity to build and lead a critical business function from the ground up.
      • High-growth technology environment with significant opportunities for professional impact and career development.
      • Opportunity to influence the email infrastructure and deliverability experience supporting thousands of e-commerce brands.
      • Collaborative team culture focused on innovation, e-commerce, and emerging technology.
      • Flexible paid time off to support rest and personal well-being.
      • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to diversity and equal employment opportunities.
      • Opportunities to work with AI-powered tools and shape the future of multi-channel customer engagement.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Just deploy it. Even on Fridays.

Polar Squad is the platform engineering consultancy your teams and technology deserve. We build developer, infrastructure, cloud and AI environments that keep delivering, and we fix the foundation so software teams can focus on what matters. We're a small, elite team where people always come first. All business, no bull, but never dull.

We're looking for a Principal Engineer to help lead where Polar Squad goes next. This is a hands-on senior role. Around half your time you're a billable, credible expert on client projects, writing code and solving hard problems side by side with the team. The other half you spend growing Polar Squad and, above all, its people.

One thing up front: this is a picture of the range the role can cover, not a checklist. Nobody is all of these at once, a deep technical expert, a known thought leader, a natural mentor and a sharp account grower. We're looking for someone who is strong across several of these areas and genuinely wants to grow into the rest. You don't need to tick every box.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be a loud voice externally. You help build our thought leadership through writing, communities, or perhaps speaking at events, making platform engineering better known with our clients and beyond.

  • Grow client accounts. You spot client needs, build trust, and grow engagements from single projects into long-term partnerships.

  • Contribute to our offering. You help develop Polar Squad's services, from cloud and developer platforms to AI platforms and managed services, together with the team.

  • Steer what we learn. You influence and steer, together with our experts, what we should be learning, and make sure new skills spread across the organization.

  • Shape our technological direction. Together with our experts you help shape where our skills and technology choices are heading, especially as AI reshapes the field quickly.

  • Coach and spar with the squad. You take our consultants under your wing to coach, mentor and spar with them, helping our people grow and get the best out of them, in the spirit of Polar Care.

GROWTH, PEOPLE AND LIFE AT POLAR SQUAD

We're committed to your growth: continuous learning, mentorship, and room to build your own path. We also believe a balanced life leads to better work and happier people. From rock climbing and game nights to cooking classes and book clubs, there's always something bringing us together as a team. Check out our Instagram () to see life at Polar Squad and the people who make it special.


YOUR SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES OF SUCCESS

  • Typically 10+ years in platform, cloud or infrastructure engineering, including time in senior, lead or principal-level work.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across platform engineering: public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, CDK, Bicep), containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability.

  • Proven ability to design scalable, resilient and secure architectures that align with business objectives and industry standards.

  • Credibility at both the technical level and with client leadership; you can carry a room and still write the code.

  • A track record of growing people through mentoring and coaching, and lifting the team around you.

  • Comfort being visible externally, whether through writing, communities or speaking.

  • The ability to steer technical direction and turn learning into something that actually spreads across an organization.

AND MAYBE YOU EVEN

  • Have held a principal, staff, lead or head-of role before.

  • Have built or run internal developer platforms (IDPs).

  • Have AI platform experience: AIOps, DataOps, AI observability or cost optimization.

  • Speak at events or publish regularly.

  • Hold certifications from one or more clouds.

COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package matching a principal-level role.

If you're excited about platform engineering, about lifting the people around you, and about helping shape where a small elite team goes next, we'd love to hear from you. At Polar Squad you're not just filling a role, you're becoming part of a community that cares about your growth, your well-being and your success. Let's build amazing platforms together.

Please note while applying: we can currently only hire talents within the EU, preferably located in Finland. The perfect candidate does not exist. We are all a mix of different skills and experiences, and that is great. If you could see yourself working at Polar Squad and have 8+ years of technical experience, we would love to hear from you.

Note for agencies/recruitment companies: we are happy to take good care of our recruitment process and candidates on our own, no external assistance required at this point.

Director, Engineering & Project Delivery






Med en voksende projektpipeline og stigende aktivitet inden for etablering af nye vedvarende energianlæg søger vi en Director, Engineering & Project Delivery, som kan tage det overordnede ansvar for at føre vores projekter fra investeringsbeslutning til kommerciel drift. 



Rollen indgår som en vigtig del af ledelsen i NRGi Renewables og skal sikre den fortsatte udvikling og skalering af vores engineering og project delivery-organisation inden for vind, sol og BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems).



Hvem er vi?

NRGi Renewables udvikler, opfører, ejer og driver vedvarende energiprojekter i Danmark med det formål at accelerere den grønne omstilling og understøtte samfundets elektrificering. Projekterne udvikles i tæt samspil med lokale interessenter med fokus på lokal forankring og værdiskabelse.



Vi er ejet af NRGi og Sampension-fællesskabet og dermed af mere end 235.000 østjyske andelshavere og 350.000 pensionskunder. Ansvarlighed, fællesskab og bæredygtige investeringer er derfor centrale værdier i vores virksomhed.



I dag er vi blandt Danmarks største producenter af landbaseret vedvarende energi med drift af 72 vindmøller og 2 solcelleparker - og vi har fortsatte væsentlige ambitioner understøttet af en solid pipeline af projekter.



Jobbet

Du bliver leder af en teknisk organisation bestående af fem specialiserede medarbejdere med kompetencer inden for engineering, teknisk projektledelse, netintegration, byggeledelse og BESS. Sammen med teamet skal du sikre, at projekterne gennemføres fra investeringsbeslutning til kommerciel drift med fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet, økonomi, tidsplan og effektiv risikostyring.



Rollen omfatter ansvar for grid compliance, nettilslutning og koordinering med relevante DSO'er og TSO'er. 

Du får samtidig en central rolle i de tekniske beslutninger på tværs af projektporteføljen - fra de tidlige udviklingsfaser til kommerciel drift - og skal sikre de rette tekniske løsninger, designkrav og tekniske grænseflader i projekterne.



Du får ansvaret for at sikre professionel projektledelse af byggeaktiviteterne og drive samarbejdet med leverandører, entreprenører, rådgivere, myndigheder og øvrige interessenter. Derudover bliver du en vigtig samarbejdspartner for indkøbsfunktionen i forbindelse med strategiske leverandøraftaler og forhandling af væsentlige leverandørkontrakter.



Som leder får du ansvaret for at videreudvikle engineering og project delivery-organisationen og skabe de rette rammer for fortsat vækst, samtidig med at du sikrer høje standarder inden for arbejdsmiljø, kvalitet og bæredygtighed.



Du bliver en del af en erfaren ledergruppe og refererer direkte til den administrerende direktør.



Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren leder med dokumenterede resultater inden for gennemførelse af komplekse tekniske projekter og større projektorganisationer. Du trives i spændingsfeltet mellem strategi og eksekvering og formår at sætte retning, skabe fremdrift og samle forskellige fagligheder om fælles mål.



Din baggrund er formentlig inden for vedvarende energi, energiinfrastruktur, forsyning, industri eller en anden projekttung branche. Erfaring med etablering af landbaserede vedvarende energiprojekter vil være en fordel, men vigtigst er, at du har erfaring med at lede komplekse anlægsprojekter og navigere sikkert mellem tekniske, kommercielle og organisatoriske hensyn.



Du har en solid elteknisk forståelse, sandsynligvis opnået gennem en uddannelse som civilingeniør eller tilsvarende teknisk baggrund, kombineret med strategisk forståelse og god kommerciel indsigt. Samtidig er du en tillidsvækkende kommunikator, der skaber tætte relationer både internt og eksternt og kommunikerer flydende på dansk og engelsk, mundtligt såvel som skriftligt.



Vi tilbyder

Du får en central rolle i et voksende forretningsområde inden for vedvarende energi. Stillingen giver mulighed for at arbejde med betydningsfulde projekter og bidrage konkret til den grønne omstilling i et professionelt og resultatorienteret miljø præget af samarbejde og korte beslutningsveje.



Dit primære arbejdssted bliver på Dusager i Aarhus N.



Interesseret?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte adm. direktør Jakob Bundgaard på telefon 22 10 08 53.



Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

OM NRGi



I mere end 100 år har vi arbejdet aktivt for at fremme elektrificeringen. Vi skal væk fra fossile brændsler og hen mod vedvarende energi, som er nøglen til et klimaneutralt samfund.



Den mission handler vi på. Hver dag. Til glæde for vores andelshavere, vores kunder og samfundet omkring os. Vi er nemlig ikke kun et energiselskab med energi til fremtiden. Vi tager også aktiv del i samfundet og de lokale fællesskaber omkring os. Ingen skaber forandring alene - men sammen gør vi.



Vores vision

Vi arbejder for et klimaneutralt samfund til glæde for alle os, der er her i dag, og alle dem, der skal tage over efter os.



Vores ambition

NRGi accelererer den grønne omstilling ved at bidrage markant til en reduktion i CO2-udledninger. Vores ambition er at bidrage til et elektrificeret, energieffektivt og fleksibelt energisystem gennem vores aktiviteter.

 Sætter du pris på godt bagerhåndværk? 

 Brug din faglighed i Bilkas bageri, hvor du bliver omgivet af dygtige kolleger. Her får du gode forhold med fri i helligdagene og mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. 

 Bilka som arbejdsplads og karrierevej
 I Bilka har vi en klar ambition om at være Den Bedste Arbejdsplads i detailbranchen. Hver eneste dag arbejder vi målrettet på at gøre os fortjent til den titel blandt vores medarbejdere. 

 Som medarbejder i Bilka - uanset niveau - har du mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og menneskeligt og forfølge dine karriereambitioner - ikke kun i Bilka, men på tværs af hele koncernen. Og vi ved, at jo mere tilfredse og dygtige medarbejdere vi har, desto bedre rustede er vi til at sikre, at kunderne vælger at handle hos os. 

 Vi bager fra bunden - hver dag 
 Hos Bilka-bageren laver vi brød helt fra bunden - som i de gode, gamle dage. Du bliver en del af et rigtigt bageri, hvor faglærte bagere hver dag blander, ælter, hæver og bager brød. 

 Fra baguetter og pitabrød til rugbrød, hvedebrød og foccacia. Som bagersvend er du med til at sikre, at vores udvalg er stort og at vi lever op til vores kvalitetsmål for friskt og lækkert bagværk. 

 Skab gode brødoplevelser 
 Du bliver en del af et bagerteam på mellem 25 og 50 medarbejdere - fra bagersvende og bagermestre til produktionsledere og teamkoordinatorer. 

 Din opgave bliver at deltage i den daglige drift i bageriet, hvor du gennem din faglighed er med til at sætte en høj standard. 

 Her er muligheder for dig, der kan og vil 
 Vi tror på, at alle har en leder i maven. Uanset om du skal lede dig selv, dit team eller en hel afdeling, så klæder vi dig på til at løse opgaven. Du får daglig sparring fra din leder og mulighed for at komme på interne kurser. For vi tror på, at dygtige medarbejder er vejen til en god arbejdsplads med glade kolleger og kunder. 

 Du brænder for det gode håndværk  
 
 Du er uddannet bager og går op i kvalitet. 

 Du er god til at samarbejde - og vil gerne være med til at sikre, at dit team er de bedste til det, I laver. 

 Du trives med at følge faste opskrifter og processer for dit daglige arbejde.   
 
   

  Her kan du læse mere om vores bageri.  

 Lyder det som noget for dig, så send os din ansøgning med det samme gennem linket her på siden. 

 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.  

   

 Bilka er et hypermarked i konstant vækst. Vi har en brændende ambition om at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads i dansk detailhandel. Så grib chancen, realiser dit potentiale og få 8.500 ambitiøse kolleger, der slet ikke kan lade være med at udvikle og forbedre.

title: Head of Product Strategy & Requirement Planning (3)
description:
We are looking for a Head of Product Strategy & Requirement Planning to join our Global Product Marketing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating market intelligence, customer insights, and regulatory developments into a clear and actionable product strategy for the Global South region. Acting as a key liaison between regional stakeholders and global product management, this role will ensure product requirements are effectively consolidated, prioritized, and aligned with business objectives.

Your strategic mindset and commercial acumen will drive the development of a competitive and future-focused product portfolio across our Distribution and Vocational segments. By shaping the product roadmap and fostering cross-functional collaboration, you will play a critical role in delivering scalable, profitable, and customer-centric solutions that support Daimler Truck's long-term growth ambitions.

Become part of our team: You make the difference - YOUMAKEUS

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT:

Main Overview of Tasks

  • Define and drive product strategy, portfolio planning, and lifecycle management across Distribution, Vocational, and Long-Haul segments.
  • Translate market intelligence, customer insights, regulatory requirements, and business needs into actionable product strategies and development roadmaps.
  • Consolidate regional product requirements and application needs into structured specifications for Global Product Management and Engineering teams.
  • Develop business cases, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, application analyses, and duty cycle assessments to support product decisions.
  • Drive product positioning and portfolio optimization to ensure market competitiveness, complete portfolio coverage, and avoidance of internal product cannibalization.
  • Support product introduction, enhancement, lifecycle management, and rationalization decisions across regional markets.
  • Act as the primary liaison between Regional Product Marketing, Regional Centres, Market Intelligence, Engineering, and Global Product Management teams.
  • Align stakeholders across markets and regions on product priorities, strategic initiatives, and development plans.
  • Facilitate governance forums, steering committees, and cross-functional decision-making processes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team while ensuring compliance with Daimler Truck processes, governance standards, and best practices.
  • Foster collaboration, capability development, and continuous improvement to support long-term business growth and customer success.

THAT'S WHY YOU ARE A MATCH:

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.
  • An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is considered an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Product Strategy, Product Management, Portfolio Management, Market Intelligence, Business Planning, Marketing, or a related strategic role.
  • Proven experience managing regional and/or global product portfolios within the commercial vehicle, automotive, mobility, transportation, or industrial sectors.
  • Experience working across multiple countries and emerging markets, with exposure to multicultural and matrix organizations.
  • Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across regional and global functions.

Specific Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong expertise in Product Strategy, Portfolio Planning, Product Positioning, and Lifecycle Management.
  • In-depth understanding of market intelligence, customer segmentation, clustering methodologies, and competitive benchmarking.
  • Experience in requirements management, product development processes, and translating business needs into product specifications.
  • Solid commercial and technical business acumen, including pricing structures, business models, and portfolio optimization.
  • Advanced analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex market, customer, and business data.
  • Strong business case development skills, including Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modelling, application analysis, and duty cycle assessments.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, drive stakeholder alignment, and manage governance processes in international environments.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and executive reporting skills.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint with the ability to communicate insights through data-driven storytelling.
  • Strong leadership capabilities, including team development, coaching, performance management, and capability building.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, cross-functional, and matrix organization.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required to support regional and global collaboration.

Language

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
  • German, Portuguese, Spanish, and/or Arabic language skills would be advantageous.

                     Er du Rentas nye kollega? 
 Renta har tralvt i deres afdeling i Hillerød, og leder efter en kollega. 

 Er du praktisk orienteret og har lyst til at arbejde blandt industrimaskiner, så kan du være at du den person som Renta leder efter. 

 Hvilke arbejdsopgaver kan du se frem til? 

 De første 3 måneder vil fokusset være på vask og tankning af Rentas industrimaskiner efter endt lejemål.  

 Når du har lært industrimaskinerne at kende og er klædt på vil du også indgå i de nedenstående opgaver: 
 
 Mindre reparationer af materiellet 

 Lave funktionskontrol inden udlevering 

 Pakke ordre til udlevering 

 Udlevering af materiel til vores kunder 

 Modtage materiel fra vores kunder, efter end lejemål 

 Registrering af forbrug, fejl og mangler efter endt lejemål 

 Papirgang ved udlevering/modtagelse af materiel 

 Diverse ad hoc-opgaver 
 
 Hvad forventes af dig som person og kollega? 

 Det er ikke afgørende om du har branche erfaring eller kendskab til industrimaskiner. Det vigtige er at du kender til vigtigheden af at være en del af et team og vil være med til at skabe en god arbejdsplads og give en god kundeoplevelse 

 Vi ser gerne, at du er omhyggelig og selvkørende i dit arbejde og er udstyret med et godt overblik - også i pressede situationer, hvor du fortsat er kunde- og servicemind og bevarer det gode humør. 

 Derudover skal du  have et gyldigt kørekort og truckcertifikat. 

 Hvad får du som ansat hos Renta?
 Du kan se frem til en alsidig stilling med spændende faglige udfordringer, som du selv er med til at præge. Du vil blive en del af en virksomhed i hurtig vækst og et team af dygtige og engagerede kolleger. 

 Hos Renta har de en uformel og god tone, og virksomheden har de generelt fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø, og de leder efter dig, som både kan se værdien i et godt arbejdsmiljø samt bidrage positivt til dette. 

 Du vil få en grundig introduktion og oplæring. 

 Ansøg 

 Lyder jobbet som noget for dig? 

 Send dit CV via nedenstående link.
 Ansættelse er snarest muligt, og vi afholder samtaler løbende. 

 Der er tale om et 3 måneders vikariat med potentialet for fastansættelse. 

 Temp-Team varetager denne rekruttering og al kommunikation skal gå via os.
   

 Temp-Team
 Temp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og bemandingsbureau. Vi har 45 års erfaring inden for rekrutteringer til faste jobs og vikarløsninger og dækker et bredt udsnit af brancher. Vi har fokus på høj kvalitet og tæt, personlig kontakt til både kandidater og kunder.

title: Senior Director, Strategic Information/Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (SI/MEL), Health Programs
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Strategic Information/Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (SI/MEL), Health Programs based in the United States.

This senior leadership role provides strategic and technical direction for SI/MEL across a complex portfolio of global health programs.
You will shape data, monitoring, evaluation, analytics, surveillance, and learning strategies that influence major public health and development outcomes.
The position combines portfolio leadership, technical quality assurance, organizational strategy, and innovation.
You will strengthen data governance, interoperability, digital health systems, and evidence-based decision-making across diverse programs and country contexts.
Working with senior leaders, project teams, donors, and partners, you will establish standards and promote consistency, learning, and continuous improvement.
The role also offers significant influence over talent, resources, partnerships, business development, and technical strategy.
It is an opportunity for an experienced global health leader to use data and evidence to improve program performance at scale.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership for strategic information, monitoring, evaluation, learning, surveillance, analytics, and data systems across a portfolio of Health Programs.
  • Establish and continuously refine portfolio-wide SI/MEL frameworks, methodologies, tools, technical standards, and quality assurance approaches.
  • Oversee SI/MEL implementation across multiple projects, ensuring data is timely, accurate, actionable, comparable, and aligned with organizational and donor requirements.
  • Resolve complex methodological and measurement challenges across awards, including inconsistent indicator definitions, non-comparable denominators, data-quality gaps, and evaluation design trade-offs.
  • Strengthen institutional data governance, interoperability, and integration across platforms and systems, including DHIS2, electronic medical records, logistics management systems, and custom databases.
  • Ensure project data systems support donor reporting requirements and enable effective programmatic decision-making at project, country, portfolio, and organizational levels.
  • Analyze project performance, indicator trends, data quality assessments, and portfolio-level results to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Provide actionable recommendations and innovative SI/MEL solutions to improve program effectiveness, efficiency, and long-term impact.
  • Serve as a senior technical advisor to project leadership, SI/MEL directors and advisors, headquarters management, and other technical stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance on surveillance, data use, epidemic control, global health security, infectious diseases, HIV, tuberculosis, maternal and child health, malaria, antimicrobial resistance, and health systems strengthening.
  • Build relationships with internal teams, donors, implementing partners, and external stakeholders to facilitate evidence sharing, knowledge exchange, and collaboration.
  • Promote organizational learning by synthesizing lessons learned, disseminating best practices, and contributing to publications, conferences, proposals, and thought leadership.
  • Support business development and proposal development by contributing SI/MEL technical strategies, results frameworks, and relevant written sections.
  • Build the capacity of technical teams and local partners in data management, visualization, analytics, and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Lead and develop a team of experienced technical professionals, including supervision, performance management, professional development, and resource planning.
  • Provide matrixed technical oversight to project-level SI/MEL leaders, establishing technical expectations and contributing to performance reviews in collaboration with their administrative managers.
  • Advise on SI/MEL staffing structures, recruitment, onboarding, capacity requirements, and specialist or surge support across the portfolio.
  • Manage resources, budgets, risks, and stakeholder priorities while maintaining high standards of technical and programmatic quality.
  • Where assigned to a specific bilateral award or requested by a global project, provide direct oversight of SI/MEL activities, including work plans, performance monitoring plans, and periodic reporting.
  • Drive innovation, continuous improvement, and the adoption of best practices that strengthen organizational impact and contribute to sustainable development outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent in a relevant field such as public health, international development, research, technology, economics, business administration, or a related discipline.
