title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Hardware & Manufacturing
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager, Hardware & Manufacturing based in Canada.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex programs spanning hardware, software, manufacturing, testing, and deployment for advanced autonomous systems. You’ll coordinate multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams to turn technical plans into reliable, production-ready products. The role combines strategic program ownership with deep technical understanding, enabling you to identify dependencies, remove roadblocks, and improve development processes. You’ll help drive robot upgrades, new product initiatives, and feature development from planning through execution. Success requires strong cross-functional leadership, clear communication, and the ability to translate complex technical challenges into actionable plans. This is an opportunity to contribute to innovative robotics systems designed to operate safely and effectively in real-world environments.

Accountabilities

  • Define program scope, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and risk mitigation strategies for complex hardware and software initiatives.
  • Lead cross-functional programs involving mechanical, electrical, embedded, systems, software, manufacturing, product, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate robot feature development, continuous upgrade programs, new product development, manufacturing test activities, and deployment initiatives.
  • Gather requirements, align priorities, establish delivery plans, and maintain clear communication across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Identify technical and operational roadblocks early, drive resolution, and manage risks and dependencies throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Develop and improve processes that streamline engineering workflows, product development, manufacturing, and cross-functional handoffs.
  • Help teams establish and execute effective sprint processes to prioritize work, track progress, and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Evaluate existing processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and execution.
  • Coordinate broad stakeholder communications and provide concise, structured updates on program health, milestones, risks, and priorities.
  • Create and maintain detailed technical specifications, project plans, roadmaps, schedules, status reports, and other program documentation.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering and operational teams to ensure smooth transitions from development through manufacturing and deployment.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that advance robot upgrades, product development processes, and new feature delivery.
  • Build strong relationships with senior leaders, engineers, product teams, and operational stakeholders to maintain alignment and accountability.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
    • 3–5 years of experience in engineering program management or technical program management.
    • 3–5 years of experience working with hardware, systems, autonomous systems, or comparable product development processes.
    • Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional technical programs and delivering product features into production environments.
    • Strong understanding of hardware and software development lifecycles, with the ability to understand technical dependencies and translate them into executable program plans.
    • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, product, manufacturing, operations, and business functions.
    • Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Proven ability to establish effective working relationships with senior leaders and engineering teams across multiple functions.
    • Strong organizational and project-management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, dependencies, and risks.
    • Ability to maintain a strategic view of complex programs while providing clear, concise, and appropriately tailored communication to different audiences.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying process improvements and resolving execution challenges.
    • Experience working in fast-paced, collaborative environments where priorities and requirements may evolve.
    • A Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is an advantage.
    • Experience with robotics and autonomous systems, particularly technologies operating in public environments, is highly valued.
    • Experience working on products subject to regulatory, policy, safety, or compliance requirements is a strong advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Remote position available in Canada, including British Columbia, Montreal, and Toronto.
      • Full-time opportunity focused on advanced robotics, autonomous systems, hardware, software, and manufacturing.
      • Base salary range of $150,000 – $187,000, with the final level and compensation determined by experience, domain expertise, geographic location, and interview performance.
      • Equity opportunities.
      • Opportunity to work on complex real-world products combining robotics, machine learning, computer vision, hardware, and software.
      • Cross-functional environment involving experienced engineering, product, operations, and design professionals.
      • Opportunity to influence product development processes, manufacturing workflows, robot upgrades, and new feature delivery.
      • Collaborative and agile work environment focused on solving complex technical challenges.
      • Opportunity to contribute to the development and scaling of autonomous systems designed for real-world urban environments.

title: Senior Project Manager / Project Director – Supervision
description:
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

We are seeking an experienced and delivery-focused Senior Project Manager / Project Director – Supervision to lead the day-to-day management and successful delivery of major Property & Buildings supervision projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

The role will be responsible for project leadership, client management, supervision operations, commercial performance, bid support, project governance, and multidisciplinary team coordination. Working closely with the Project Director and Director of Supervision, the successful candidate will ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, profitably, and in accordance with WSP's quality standards and client expectations.

The role requires strong leadership, client-facing capabilities, operational management, and commercial acumen, ensuring successful project outcomes and long-term client satisfaction.

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead the delivery of major supervision projects from mobilisation through to completion.
  • Manage multidisciplinary supervision teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  • Develop and maintain project execution plans, resource plans, and delivery strategies.
  • Monitor project progress, project risks, and key performance indicators.
  • Ensure effective coordination between clients, contractors, consultants, authorities, and project stakeholders.
  • Lead project review meetings and ensure proactive resolution of delivery issues.
  • Support project close-out, handover, and lessons learned activities.

Client Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary client contact for assigned projects.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, developers, contractors, and government authorities.
  • Ensure client expectations are understood and consistently achieved.
  • Drive high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
  • Participate in client presentations, project reviews, and progress meetings.
  • Support account development within existing client portfolios.

Supervision Operations

  • Manage the operational delivery of supervision services across assigned projects.
  • Ensure appropriate deployment and utilisation of project resources.
  • Coordinate Resident Engineers, discipline leads, inspectors, and specialist teams.
  • Monitor workforce requirements and resource planning.
  • Promote consistency in project controls, reporting, and supervision practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across project delivery.

Commercial Management

  • Manage project budgets, revenue, resource utilisation, and profitability.
  • Monitor project financial performance and forecasting.
  • Identify commercial risks and opportunities and implement mitigation measures.
  • Support contract administration, variation management, and change control processes.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
  • Assist with claims management and commercial discussions where required.

Bid & Business Development Support

  • Support proposal preparation, technical submissions, and tender responses.
  • Participate in client interviews and project presentations.
  • Contribute project delivery expertise to work-winning activities.
  • Support opportunity identification within existing projects and client accounts.
  • Assist with pipeline development and pursuit activities within KSA.

Governance, Risk & Quality

  • Ensure compliance with WSP project management systems and governance requirements.
  • Maintain oversight of project risk registers and mitigation plans.
  • Drive quality assurance and quality control across project delivery.
  • Monitor project compliance with contractual, regulatory, and authority requirements.
  • Ensure lessons learned and best practices are captured and implemented across projects.
  • Promote a strong culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.

Health, Safety & Environment

  • Champion WSP's safety-first culture across all project activities.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality standards.
  • Monitor project HSE performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
  • Support the development of a proactive safety culture across project teams.

People Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop project teams.
  • Support performance management, coaching, and capability development.
  • Foster collaboration, teamwork, and high-performance behaviours.
  • Support graduate and junior staff development.
  • Promote WSP's values, culture, and professional standards.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline.
  • Master's Degree desirable.
  • PMP or equivalent project management qualification preferred.
  • PE, CEng, or equivalent professional accreditation is advantageous.
  • 20+ years of project management and construction supervision experience.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale building projects within Saudi Arabia or the Middle East.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams and major client relationships.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, contract administration, and commercial management.

Why Join WSP?

At WSP, you will be part of one of the world's leading professional services firms, delivering some of Saudi Arabia's most significant and transformative developments. You will have the opportunity to lead complex projects, work with major clients, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to shaping the built environment across the Kingdom.

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende

title: Dual master's degree with SIBE:  Talent Management at Allianz SE (m/f/d)
description:

  1. Group People and Culture (GPC) shapes Allianz's global people strategy, using high-quality data to deliver a superior employee experience and fair, transparent people decisions.
  2. Within this, the Talent & Leadership Department partners with the AZ SE Board of Management, business divisions, and Operating Entity People Directors worldwide to build a strong leadership talent pipeline and improve talent experience and decision quality.

In addition to exciting topics and a collaborative work environment, we support and challenge you and your development. During your time with our team, you will complete a two-year, work-integrated Master's program at the School of International Business and Entrepreneurship (SIBE), the Graduate School for Leadership & Management at Steinbeis University. You can find more information about the study programs and their content here: Programs – SIBE | Steinbeis-Hochschule

Please note that successful completion of an assessment center is a prerequisite for admission to the program. We wish you the best of luck with the next steps!

How can you make an impact?

  • Innovate with Technology: Utilise tools like Power BI to develop solutions that enhance team capabilities.
  • Craft Compelling Narratives: Design and prepare presentations for the senior management, focusing on layout and storyline to influence top-level decision-making.
  • Collaborate Globally: Partner with colleagues at Allianz SE and talent experts across Allianz entities, driving success in global talent management initiatives.
  • Enhance Processes: Identify and implement improvements in talent management processes.

What are you made of?

  • Enrolled in a relevant study program (e.g., Business Administration, Data Science, Human Resources Management, Psychology, Communication or Media Studies) for the entire duration of the position.
  • Advanced experience in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiar with data analysis techniques; experience with Power BI or similar tools is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with a proactive mindset, taking initiative in driving own topics forward.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in English; capable of crafting compelling narratives and engaging with diverse stakeholders.
  • Fluent German is not necessary, but would be a plus.
  • Openness to creative and innovative solutions, as well as a passion for working with forward-thinking technologies such as artificial intelligence or internal ChatGPT.

Our highlights for you:

Health & well-being: Numerous sports and health offers as well as preventative measures lay the foundation for your physical and mental health.

Remuneration: In addition to an attractive salary, you can expect a monthly travel allowance of 30,00 € and a daily lunch allowance in our excellent staff restaurants.

Time & flexibility: With our "New Work" model, you can achieve an even better work-life balance. We work flexibly, hybrid, mobile and on site.

Career development: Comprehensive educational opportunities in the form of training courses and access to LinkedIn Learning or Degreed enable continuous further development.

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

To learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment Process

Appointment date: as soon as possible

Are you interested? Then we look forward to receiving your application online on our careers page - careers.allianz.com.

Our colleagues at recruiting-operations@allianz.de will be happy to answer any technical or professional questions you may have.

Note: Allianz in Germany has an internal recruitment team that focuses on the direct search for outstanding candidates. No unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies or recruitment firms will be accepted.

Who are we?

Are you keen on driving innovation? Do you thrive in a culture of equality, collaboration and trust? Then let's care for tomorrow. At Allianz SE, you can count on having a voice, driving innovation and change and making an impact – for us, yourself and the world. For more about Allianz SE, Click Here

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Great to have you on board. Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Reservation Agent
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons is dedicated to perfecting the travel experience through continual innovation and the highest standards of hospitality. The deeply instilled Four Seasons culture is personified by its employees – people who share a single focus and are inspired to offer great service. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating every one we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us, discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. Four Seasons Langkawi Resort, Voted the #1 Resort in Malaysia by Condé Nast Readers’ Choice Awards 2020, it's Flanked by a tropical rainforest, limestone cliffs and the emerald waters of the Andaman Sea, the natural beauty on our Island of Legends is as dramatic as it is serene. Tucked away within an UNESCO World Geopark, our Resort’s Malay-style pavilions and villas offer both quiet, romantic havens for lovebirds as well as versatile family-oriented retreats.

About the role

This position is responsible for selling the rooms and providing information to prospective guests. Besides, to capture sales from the incoming calls and coordinate details of each reservation to ensure the guest’s satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Handling all incoming enquiries by phone or by email regarding accommodation and converting calls into room sales.

  • Liaising with VIP clients, wholesalers and travel agents to make, amend and confirm reservations.

  • Be well informed about all hotel facilities including the Restaurant, Bar and Spa in order to upsell the Hotel products and services.

  • Contact guests or travel planners to clarify any discrepancies in the preferences or requests before guests’ arrival.

  • Assist with the development of all direct sales presentation material for both travel industry and group sales.

What you bring

  • Must be well organized and used to working in a multi-tasking environment.

  • Pleasant personality.

title: Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate based in Italy.

This is an opportunity to lead engaging, high-impact virtual learning experiences for diverse audiences developing skills in machine learning and AI data workflows. You will deliver live technical instruction in German while collaborating professionally in English with program and operations teams. The role combines technical expertise, instructional leadership, and the ability to make complex AI concepts practical and accessible. You will help learners understand how data labeling influences machine learning systems, generative AI, multimodal models, and applied AI workflows. Sessions may range from smaller groups to audiences of thousands of learners in a highly interactive online environment. You will also contribute to curriculum refinement and continuous course improvement. This is a part-time contract position with a remote setup and scheduled sessions aligned with the EST/CEST time zones.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and facilitate live virtual classes for diverse learner groups, potentially ranging from 100 to more than 8,000 participants, while maintaining strong engagement and an effective learning environment.
  • Deliver technical instruction in German on machine learning data workflows, generative AI, foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG, multimodal AI, responsible AI, and related concepts.
  • Explain how data collection, annotation, labeling decisions, model training, evaluation, and deployment are connected, helping learners understand the downstream impact of their work.
  • Manage virtual classroom dynamics, including Q&A, chat activity, pacing, learner engagement, and timely delivery of planned content.
  • Adapt instructional approaches, explanations, and lesson pacing to accommodate learners with different backgrounds and levels of technical understanding.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each lecture and ensure that technical content is delivered accurately, clearly, and in an accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with program and operations teams in English to support smooth delivery, communicate updates, escalate issues, and maintain alignment on schedules and learner needs.
  • Contribute to curriculum design and continuous improvement, including suggesting edits, refining lessons, and supporting the development of hands-on learning activities.
  • Provide constructive feedback before and after sessions to strengthen course quality and learner outcomes.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful, responsive, and empathetic presence when interacting with learners, colleagues, contractors, and guest speakers.

    • Requirements:

    • Fluency in German sufficient to deliver all instruction and learner support professionally, combined with strong English proficiency for written communication, meetings, alignment, and issue escalation.
    • Strong practical understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, model training, evaluation, and deployment, with the ability to explain how labeling decisions affect model behavior and downstream outputs.
    • Solid knowledge of generative AI and foundation models, including concepts such as pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and human feedback for model alignment.
    • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot prompting, and the ability to teach learners how to interpret requirements, identify task constraints, and evaluate output quality.
    • Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and production AI workflows, including the ability to explain how to assess outputs for relevance, faithfulness, and groundedness.
    • Understanding of multimodal and cross-modal AI, including how models process and generate text, images, audio, and video, and how these capabilities influence annotation and evaluation tasks.
    • Knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, confidentiality, security, bias awareness, and transparency principles relevant to data labeling and AI workflows.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality live virtual instruction, ideally to large and diverse audiences.
    • Experience supporting technical curriculum development, lesson refinement, skills labs, or similar instructional content.
    • Strong communication, presentation, empathy, adaptability, and classroom-management skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts easy to understand.
    • A positive and collaborative mindset, with strong attention to preparation, professionalism, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
    • Preferred: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) certification or equivalent expertise, particularly experience aligning training content with certification domains and supporting exam readiness.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work: Work remotely from Romania or another location compatible with the required time zone.
      • Part-time contract: Flexible engagement structured around scheduled instructional sessions and program needs.
      • Virtual-first environment: Deliver impactful learning experiences entirely online using modern virtual classroom tools.
      • High-impact teaching: Reach diverse learner populations and contribute to workforce development in AI and data.
      • Professional collaboration: Work alongside program, operations, and instructional teams in an international environment.
      • Curriculum involvement: Contribute ideas and expertise to the development and continuous improvement of technical training content.
      • Potential schedule flexibility: Program dates and lecture times may be adjusted depending on program requirements and instructor availability.
      • Inclusive environment: Participate in a learning culture focused on respect, accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity.

title: EverHealth - Backend Claims Management Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an EverHealth - Backend Claims Management Specialist based in United States.

This role plays a key part in improving healthcare revenue cycle performance through expert claims management and data-driven problem solving.
You will investigate complex claims, denials, reimbursement issues, and aged receivables to identify barriers to timely payment.
Working closely with Service Managers, BPO teams, Revenue Cycle, Operations, and Client Services, you will turn claims insights into practical improvements.
The role combines hands-on operational expertise with analysis of payer trends, denial patterns, and root causes.
You will also help strengthen team capabilities through education, standardized processes, and best-practice guidance.
Your work will directly contribute to cleaner claims, stronger client outcomes, improved financial performance, and higher client retention.
This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact in a collaborative, distributed healthcare technology environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Manage complex claims and reimbursement issues by investigating denials, identifying payment barriers, resolving discrepancies, and escalating complex payer or operational matters when necessary.
  • Analyze revenue cycle performance by reviewing denial trends, aged accounts receivable, reimbursement patterns, and other operational data to identify root causes and opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve claims outcomes by recommending and supporting actions that increase clean claim rates, reduce denials and aged receivables, and optimize reimbursement performance.
  • Build payer and operational expertise by developing a strong understanding of payer policies, reimbursement methodologies, client workflows, emerging payer trends, and potential operational risks.
  • Partner with Service Managers and operational teams to improve client health, address revenue cycle challenges, and implement solutions that strengthen financial and operational performance.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders, clearly communicating performance trends, identified issues, and proposed corrective actions.
  • Support customer success and retention through proactive identification and resolution of claims and revenue cycle problems.
  • Educate and support BPO teams by providing guidance and training on claims processing, denial prevention, reimbursement practices, and quality standards.
  • Develop standardized processes that improve consistency, quality, efficiency, and scalability across claims and revenue cycle operations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Revenue Cycle, Operations, Client Services, and other teams to drive continuous improvement and strengthen customer outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, medical billing, or healthcare claims management.
    • Strong knowledge of claims processing and denial management, including payer reimbursement methodologies and common causes of payment delays or denials.
    • Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify trends, conduct root cause analysis, interpret performance data, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
    • Experience with data analysis and performance reporting, including the ability to use operational metrics to assess revenue cycle performance.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex claims and reimbursement issues clearly and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Experience in healthcare revenue cycle operations, denial prevention, appeals, or payer relations is preferred.
    • Experience driving operational improvements and process optimization is a plus.
    • Collaborative and customer-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, service managers, and BPO partners.
    • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, particularly when managing complex claims and identifying patterns across large volumes of data.
    • Ability to work independently in a distributed environment while remaining responsive, adaptable, and focused on measurable outcomes.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
    • Occasional travel to company headquarters or other U.S. office locations may be required.

      • Benefits:

      • Base compensation: approximately $16–$22 USD per hour in most U.S. locations, with final offers determined by location, market conditions, experience, and expertise.
      • Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely, in-office, or in a hybrid setup within the United States.
      • Health and wellness benefits available from Day 1, including an annual wellness stipend.
      • 401(k) plan with up to a 4% employer match and immediate vesting.
      • Flexible and generous FTO (Flexible Time Off).
      • Employee Stock Purchase Program.
      • Ongoing investment in professional development and career growth.
      • Opportunity to work with distributed teams across multiple regions.
      • Occasional travel opportunities to U.S. offices and headquarters as required.

Kan du tage medansvar for den daglige drift i butikken og bidrage til, at kunderne får en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye salgsleder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et verdensklasse sammenhold, og sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Vi investerer i dig som medarbejder, og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.




Om jobbet


Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse 

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Åbne og/eller lukke butikken

Bestille varer hjem til butikken




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen

Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives med en travl hverdag

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som salgsleder i Lidl får du:

Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidlvest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0535, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

description:
Bogholder til kreditorafdeling, barselsvikariat - Eurowind Energy
        
        
        
        

        
        

        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        

        

        

        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
                

    
     

    
    

        




    


    

                    
            





Bogholder til kreditorafdeling, barselsvikariat




    


        

            
Vi søger en struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret Bogholder til vores Purchase to Pay (P2P) team i Eurowind Energys hovedkontor i Hobro.

Eurowind Energy er en ledende og global udvikler, ejer og operatør af vind- og solprojekter. Med base i Danmark har vi aktiviteter i 16 lande rundt i Europa og i USA, og vi vækster løbende vores projektportefølje. Vi tror på en fremtid, der består af vedvarende energi, og vi har en ambitiøs plan om at blive næste generations "Power Major". Med en fuld værdikæde fra udvikling af projekter og teknologier til salg af strøm og med mere end 700+ dedikerede medarbejdere rundt i verden er vi med til hver dag, skridt for skridt at skabe en grønnere fremtid.




Din rolle

I rollen får du en central funktion i at sikre korrekt og effektiv håndtering af leverandørrelaterede processer. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i Finance og på tværs af organisationen og bidrage til høj kvalitet, stabile processer og løbende forbedringer. Du refererer direkte til Manager, P2P & O2C, og bliver en del af et jordnært team med stort fokus på videndeling, proceskvalitet og en “work smarter, not harder"-tilgang.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

Bogføring og håndtering af leverandørfakturaer

Gennemførsel af betalinger

Kreditoropfølgning og håndtering af leverandørhenvendelser

Afstemning af Mastercard/kreditkort

Afstemning af kreditorer

Deltagelse i månedsluk og øvrige periodeafslutningsopgaver

Diverse ad hoc opgaver inden for P2P




Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling inden for bogholderi, regnskab eller P2P

Arbejder struktureret og har stor sans for orden og kvalitet i processerne

Trives i et samarbejdende miljø og bidrager med en positiv og hjælpsom tilgang

Tager ansvar for egne opgaver og bidrager til løbende forbedringer

Kommunikerer professionelt med både interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere




Hvad vi tilbyder

En stabil og veldefineret rolle i en international virksomhed i vækst

Et P2P team med stærkt fokus på samarbejde, videndeling og forbedringer

En positiv og uformel arbejdskultur med klare rammer og høj faglighed

Mulighed for at få indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder og udvikler vores processer

En arbejdsplads, hvor professionalisme går hånd i hånd med en nede på jorden tilgang

En fleksibel arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde




Vedvarende energi er vores fremtid. Det samme er vores medarbejdere! 

Hos Eurowind Energy gør vi vores bedste for at skabe en kultur, hvor alle føler sig anerkendt, set og hørt. Det vil du mærke i din hverdag, hvor det, du siger, bliver hørt, og hvor dine ønsker er vigtige for os. Vi ved nemlig, at når du udvikler dig, så gør vi også!

Vi har en høj arbejdsglæde, og det er vi stolte over! Vi tilbyder høj fleksibilitet og har fokus på en god balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv. Du bliver en del af et internationalt miljø med mange gode og dygtige kolleger og en spændende og attraktiv branche. Du indgår desuden i firmaets bonusordning.

Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed styrker vores arbejdsplads, og vi byder derfor ansøgninger velkommen fra kandidater med forskellige baggrunde, perspektiver og personlige karakteristika




Lyder det som noget for dig?

Dejligt! Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag via linket i bunden.  

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Betina H. Jensen, Manager, P2P & O2C, på bhj@ewe.dk

Send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Samtaler afholdes løbende. Opstart hurtigst muligt.

At udvikle, drifte og administrere vindmølle- og solcelleparker handler ikke udelukkende om forretning for os. Det er vores måde at anskue verden på. Og med dette verdenssyn følger en forpligtelse og en ambition. En ambition om at være én af de ledende udviklere i Europa. Fordi dét at skabe en fremtid drevet udelukkende af vedvarende energi betyder noget for os.

Vi forvalter vores egne porteføljer, og samtidig varetager vi både den tekniske og økonomiske administration af projekter. Vi har igennem adskillige år oplevet vækst i antallet af udviklede projekter samt selskaber under administration, og vi forventer, at det fortsætter. At udvikle er en del af vores DNA, uanset om det drejer sig om projekter, selskaber eller vores ansatte.

Se mere om Eurowind Energy på vores hjemmeside eller LinkedIn.

*Hvor har du set jobopslaget?




Betingelser & vilkår









Eurowind Energy A/S er dataansvarlig for de personlige oplysninger, som du har indtastet og indsendt i vores rekrutteringssystem. Eurowind Energy A/S anvender kun indtastede data til vores behandling i forbindelse med ansøgningsprocessen for den stilling, som du ansøger, og personlige oplysninger bliver behandlet fortroligt. Vi deler udelukkende din samlede ansøgning med de parter, som er involveret i rekrutteringen. Læs venligst vores Databeskyttelsespolitik



Dine personlige oplysninger er indsamlet med dit samtykke, som du har givet ved at klikke af i "Jeg accepterer vilkårene". Du kan til enhver tid trække dit samtykke tilbage ved at kontakte os og få slettet din ansøgning. Hvis du vælger at trække dit samtykke tilbage, påvirker det ikke lovligheden af vores behandling af dine personoplysninger på baggrund af dit tidligere meddelte samtykke op til tidspunktet for tilbagetrækningen. Hvis du tilbagetrækker dit samtykke, har det derfor først virkning fra dette tidspunkt.



 



Ved fremsendelse af din ansøgning til dette job giver du samtykke til, at vi må behandle dine personoplysninger i rekrutteringsprocessen. 



 



Når rekrutteringsprocessen er afsluttet, og vi har ansat den rette kandidat til jobbet, opbevares alle ansøgninger og andre dokumenter, som andre ansøgere har fremsendt, i op til 6 måneder efter rekrutteringsprocessens afslutning. Herefter opbevares således ikke personoplysninger fra ansøgere.



 



Ved at indsætte dine personlige data accepterer du:



	
at du har læst og forstået ovenstående

	
at du samtykker til behandlingen af de registrerede og gemte oplysninger

title: TMA Operator Full Time Nightshift
description:
Primary Location

VIC - Clayton

Job Description Summary

Service Stream are on the hunt for TMA Operators to join our team in permanent roles including nightshift based in the Clayton and Frankston regions.

About the Role

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries. We keep communities connected.

Service Stream are now delivering routine maintenance and defect rectification works, and refurbishment and upgrade projects under a major long-term contract with the Victorian Government (Metropolitan Victorian Road Maintenance Contract (VRMC) - South Central Region).

We have opportunities for TMA Operators Fulltime Nightshift to join our team in permanent roles based in the Clayton and Frankston regions. Working under the direction of our Supervisors, you will be critical in delivering services under this contract.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring the safety of road workers and motorists in work zones
  • Completing all works with a strong focus on safety, quality and efficiency.
  • Recording works-related data in the field, in line with work instructions, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

About You:

Our ideal candidates will have:

  • TMA experience and accreditation.
  • Ability to be a committed team player who drives for service excellence and continuous improvement.
  • A track record of working with a relentless focus on worker, road user and community safety.
  • High levels of self-motivation, exceptional time-management skills and a proven ability to work efficiently with minimal supervision.

About Us:
Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries. We keep communities connected.

Benefits of working with us include:

  • Career development – we are growing and support internal mobility across our business units. There are opportunities to upskill through training pathways and leadership development programs.
  • Discounts - access to hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing.
  • Paid Leave - parental, cultural, community service, study, corporate volunteering and purchased leave available.
  • Culture – we are dedicated to fostering a workplace environment that values diversity and inclusion, and we recognise and celebrate excellence throughout the year.

How to apply:
Please submit your interest with the apply button where you will be directed to create a profile on our system. We celebrate diversity at Service Stream and welcome applications from people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, people with a disability or neurodivergence, and those from LGBTIQA+, Veteran or other diverse groups. Applications must be received by our system however if you reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process please email us at talent.transport@servicestream.com.au.

Department

Field Services

How to Apply

If this sounds like you apply now to the Service Stream Recruitment Team via the online application button.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
About the Job

The Supply Chain Analyst at SATURDAYS is responsible for turning merchandising and sales data into clear insights that support assortment, pricing, and promotional decisions.

This hybrid position is based in Jakarta, Indonesia, with flexibility for partial work from home. Day-to-day tasks include gathering and cleaning data from multiple sources, conducting detailed sales and inventory analyses, building reports and dashboards, and identifying trends in product performance and customer behavior.

The role collaborates closely with merchandising, marketing, and operations teams to recommend actions that optimize product mix, improve margins, and enhance the overall customer experience.

The Merchandising Data Analyst will also support forecasting, test-and-learn initiatives, and performance reviews of new collections and channels.

Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Merchandising, or a related field.

  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in Data Analytics and Statistics.

  • Proficiency in Data Modeling and working with large datasets to build reports and dashboards.

  • Clear and effective communication skills for presenting insights to cross-functional teams.

  • Comfort with tools such as Excel/Google Sheets and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience in retail or e-commerce merchandising analytics is highly beneficial.

  • Ability to work in a hybrid environment, manage deadlines, and prioritize multiple projects.

  • Attention to detail, curiosity about customer behavior, and a data-driven approach to problem solving.

title: International Consultant/Trainer on Gender-Responsive Police Response to Violence against Women and Domestic Violence, UN Women Kazakhstan
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

Violence against women and girls is one of the most pervasive violations of human rights and is rooted in gender inequality. Domestic violence is one of the most common forms of violence against women and has specific dynamics associated with the relationship between the survivor and the perpetrator, the recurrent nature of violence and the risk of escalation. Its consequences affect women’s safety, health and well-being, their children and families, and their ability to live free from violence.

Kazakhstan has undertaken important legislative and institutional reforms aimed at strengthening the prevention of and response to domestic violence and enhancing the protection of women and children. In 2025, specialized units on combating domestic violence were established within the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan (MIA), together with a dedicated division within the Administrative Police Committee. Approximately 1,000 officers currently serve in these units across the country. Given the critical role of police as often one of the first points of contact for survivors, the establishment of the specialized units highlights the importance of strengthening officers’ knowledge and practical skills, including gender-responsive and survivor-centered approaches that support survivors’ safety, access to protection and justice, and prevention of secondary victimization. At the same time, the demanding nature of this work and regular exposure to complex and emotionally challenging cases highlights the importance of preventing professional burnout and occupational stress and strengthening officers’ psychological resilience and well-being.

Within this context, UN Women Kazakhstan, in cooperation with the MIA, plans to conduct a series of pilot two-day training sessions for officers of specialized domestic violence units in 2–3 regions of Kazakhstan between 28 September and 9 October 2026. The training will focus on gender-responsive and survivor-centered approaches to domestic violence, drawing on international standards and relevant international practice while considering Kazakhstan’s national legislation and law-enforcement context. The programme will also address professional burnout, occupational stress and professional deformation and provide practical approaches to strengthening officers’ psychological resilience.

UN Women therefore seeks to engage an International Consultant/Trainer on Gender-Responsive Police Response to Violence against Women and Domestic Violence to provide international technical expertise, develop and adapt practical training content and materials, and deliver training sessions for officers of the specialized domestic violence units.

The International Consultant will report to the UN Women Project Manager and will work under the overall guidance of the UN Women Programme Specialist. The Project Manager will serve as the primary focal point for technical guidance, contract administration and payment-related matters. The International Consultant will work in close coordination with a National Consultant/Trainer and other experts engaged for the assignment, as well as designated representatives of the MIA.

Description of Responsibilities/ Scope of Work

  • Review relevant national legislation, policies, institutional arrangements and available materials related to the prevention of and response to domestic violence in Kazakhstan, with particular attention to the mandate and practice of the newly established specialized domestic violence units.
  • Review relevant international standards, guidance and good practices on gender-responsive and survivor-centered police response to violence against women and domestic violence and identify approaches applicable to the Kazakhstan context.
  • Participate in consultations with UN Women, the MIA and the National Consultant/Trainer to identify priority capacity-development needs and practical challenges faced by officers of the specialized units.
  • Develop a two-day practice-oriented training programme and accompanying materials for specialized domestic violence units, including presentations, case studies, practical exercises and other tools, adapted to the Kazakhstan context and covering key aspects of gender-responsive and survivor-centered police response to domestic violence.
  • Deliver the agreed training sessions in 2–3 pilot regions of Kazakhstan using interactive adult-learning methods and practical cases relevant to the work of specialized police units.
  • Collect and analyse participant feedback and observations emerging from the pilot trainings, including recurrent challenges, capacity gaps and areas requiring further professional development.
  • Based on the review, consultations and pilot trainings, develop concise practical recommendations for the Government of Kazakhstan/MIA on strengthening gender-responsive response to domestic violence and further capacity development of specialized units, including recommendations on areas that could be addressed through future training, practical guidance or methodological materials.
Deliverable Expected completion time (due day) Payment Schedule
Training programme and training package developed and agreed with UN Women, including a detailed two-day agenda, presentations, practical case studies/exercises and participant materials on gender-responsive and survivor-centered police response to domestic violence, adapted to the Kazakhstan context. By 17 September 2026 30% of contract amount
Series of two-day in-person training sessions delivered for officers of specialized domestic violence units in 2–3 pilot regions of Kazakhstan, in accordance with the agreed programme and methodology. 28 September – 9 October 2026 70% of contract amount
Practical recommendations developed for strengthening gender-responsive response to domestic violence and further professional development of specialized domestic violence units, based on the review of the Kazakhstan context, consultations and issues identified during the pilot trainings. By 16 October 2026
Final training package and brief assignment report submitted, incorporating relevant adjustments following the pilot training and participant feedback. By 23 October 2026

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy with official travel to Kazakhstan required for the delivery of in-person training sessions. As part of this assignment, the Consultant will undertake travel to 2–3 pilot regions of Kazakhstan to deliver two-day training sessions between 28 September and 9 October 2026. The exact locations and travel schedule will be determined by UN Women in coordination with the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Travel arrangements and applicable travel-related costs will be covered by UN Women in accordance with UN Women rules and regulations.

Competencies:

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of gender-responsive and survivor-centered approaches to violence against women and domestic violence.
  • Strong understanding of international standards and good practices related to police response to domestic violence.
  • Strong training and facilitation skills, including adult-learning methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Education and Certification:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in gender studies, human rights, law, social sciences, criminology, psychology or another relevant field is required.
  • A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in the area of violence against women and/or domestic violence is required.
  • At least 4 years of experience in developing and delivering training programmes on violence against women and/or domestic violence for police or other law enforcement professionals is required. As part of the application, candidates are required to submit a brief technical proposal (maximum one A4 page) outlining a proposed approach to a two-day training programme, including key thematic areas, suggested training methods and examples of practical/case-based exercises.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing policy recommendations, guidance or analytical products related to violence against women and/or domestic violence is required.
  • Previous professional experience with UN agencies, other international organizations and/or government agencies in the area of violence against women and/or domestic violence is required.
  • Experience working in Central Asia or other comparable contexts is an asset.

Languages:

  • Fluency in Russian is required.
  • Working knowledge of English is an asset.

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate based in Portugal.

This is an opportunity to lead engaging, high-impact virtual learning experiences for diverse audiences developing skills in machine learning and AI data workflows. You will deliver live technical instruction in German while collaborating professionally in English with program and operations teams. The role combines technical expertise, instructional leadership, and the ability to make complex AI concepts practical and accessible. You will help learners understand how data labeling influences machine learning systems, generative AI, multimodal models, and applied AI workflows. Sessions may range from smaller groups to audiences of thousands of learners in a highly interactive online environment. You will also contribute to curriculum refinement and continuous course improvement. This is a part-time contract position with a remote setup and scheduled sessions aligned with the EST/CEST time zones.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and facilitate live virtual classes for diverse learner groups, potentially ranging from 100 to more than 8,000 participants, while maintaining strong engagement and an effective learning environment.
  • Deliver technical instruction in German on machine learning data workflows, generative AI, foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG, multimodal AI, responsible AI, and related concepts.
  • Explain how data collection, annotation, labeling decisions, model training, evaluation, and deployment are connected, helping learners understand the downstream impact of their work.
  • Manage virtual classroom dynamics, including Q&A, chat activity, pacing, learner engagement, and timely delivery of planned content.
  • Adapt instructional approaches, explanations, and lesson pacing to accommodate learners with different backgrounds and levels of technical understanding.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each lecture and ensure that technical content is delivered accurately, clearly, and in an accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with program and operations teams in English to support smooth delivery, communicate updates, escalate issues, and maintain alignment on schedules and learner needs.
  • Contribute to curriculum design and continuous improvement, including suggesting edits, refining lessons, and supporting the development of hands-on learning activities.
  • Provide constructive feedback before and after sessions to strengthen course quality and learner outcomes.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful, responsive, and empathetic presence when interacting with learners, colleagues, contractors, and guest speakers.

    • Requirements:

    • Fluency in German sufficient to deliver all instruction and learner support professionally, combined with strong English proficiency for written communication, meetings, alignment, and issue escalation.
    • Strong practical understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, model training, evaluation, and deployment, with the ability to explain how labeling decisions affect model behavior and downstream outputs.
    • Solid knowledge of generative AI and foundation models, including concepts such as pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and human feedback for model alignment.
    • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot prompting, and the ability to teach learners how to interpret requirements, identify task constraints, and evaluate output quality.
    • Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and production AI workflows, including the ability to explain how to assess outputs for relevance, faithfulness, and groundedness.
    • Understanding of multimodal and cross-modal AI, including how models process and generate text, images, audio, and video, and how these capabilities influence annotation and evaluation tasks.
    • Knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, confidentiality, security, bias awareness, and transparency principles relevant to data labeling and AI workflows.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality live virtual instruction, ideally to large and diverse audiences.
    • Experience supporting technical curriculum development, lesson refinement, skills labs, or similar instructional content.
    • Strong communication, presentation, empathy, adaptability, and classroom-management skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts easy to understand.
    • A positive and collaborative mindset, with strong attention to preparation, professionalism, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
    • Preferred: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) certification or equivalent expertise, particularly experience aligning training content with certification domains and supporting exam readiness.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work: Work remotely from Romania or another location compatible with the required time zone.
      • Part-time contract: Flexible engagement structured around scheduled instructional sessions and program needs.
      • Virtual-first environment: Deliver impactful learning experiences entirely online using modern virtual classroom tools.
      • High-impact teaching: Reach diverse learner populations and contribute to workforce development in AI and data.
      • Professional collaboration: Work alongside program, operations, and instructional teams in an international environment.
      • Curriculum involvement: Contribute ideas and expertise to the development and continuous improvement of technical training content.
      • Potential schedule flexibility: Program dates and lecture times may be adjusted depending on program requirements and instructor availability.
      • Inclusive environment: Participate in a learning culture focused on respect, accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity.

description:
Skoleleder søges til Behandlingsskolen Kompasset i Vanløse @ Behandlingsskolerne
        
        
        

    








    
        






Skoleleder søges til Behandlingsskolen Kompasset i Vanløse

 12. august 2026 



Skoleleder søges til Behandlingsskolen Kompasset i Vanløse

Har du lyst til at gå forrest og tage ansvaret for en helt særlig skole? Vil du hjælpe børn med særdeles komplekse psykiske problematikker godt på vej? Og kunne du tænke dig at være leder for en gruppe medarbejdere, der er kendetegnet ved høj professionalisme, bred faglighed, og stort engagement? Hvis ja, så læs videre her. 

En synlig del af elevernes og medarbejdernes hverdag

Kompasset er en dagbehandlingsskole for børn og unge inden for adfærdssegmentet, som har udfordringer med ADHD, angst, PTSD og andre relaterede problematikker, som betyder, at de trives og udvikler sig bedst i et særligt tilrettelagt skole- og behandlingstilbud.

Der er på nuværende tidspunkt indskrevet 35 elever fordelt på 4 klasser.

Som skoleleder er du en synlig del af hverdagen. Du kommer helt tæt på elever, forældre og den tværfaglige personalegruppe.

Du har det primære ansvar for ledelsen af medarbejdergruppen på ca. 18 medarbejdere bestående af lærere og pædagoger. Du har ansvaret for skolens daglige drift, for mål og rammer for skolens undervisningstilbud og for driftsbudgettet. Du indgår i et tæt samarbejde med den ledende psykolog og souschefen.

Sammen udgør I skolens ledelse.

Du bliver også en del af en gruppe på i alt 13 skoleledere på tværs af Behandlingsskolerne, og du har derfor gode muligheder for at sparre med ligestillede. Behandlingsskolerne har en velfungerende administration, der sikrer dig god støtte fra IT, regnskab, kommunikation, HR m.fl.   

Hverdagen på Kompasset

Vi optager elever på alle klassetrin. Mange børn og unge kommer til os, når folkeskolen eller specialskolen ikke længere kan hjælpe dem.

Vi tror på, at eleverne kan udvikle sig på trods af de udfordringer, de måtte stå over for.

På Kompasset tilbyder vi individuel undervisning i små klasser. Vores dedikerede lærere og psykologer tilpasser undervisningen efter hver elevs behov. Vi arrangerer ture ud af huset for at styrke elevernes sociale færdigheder i det offentlige rum. Hver elev har en behandlingsansvarlig psykolog, der samarbejder tæt med pædagoger og lærere for at forbedre elevernes mulighed for at lære. Vi giver børnene strategier og værktøjer, der øger deres selvværd og muligheder for at få et godt og selvforsørgende voksenliv.

På Kompasset opfylder vi de samme krav til fag, timer, læringsmål, meddelelsesbøger, afgangsprøver og test, som de almene folkeskoler gør. Vi har høje ambitioner på vores elevers vegne, og vores mål er bl.a., at vores elever får en fuld afgangseksamen.

Som skoleleder er dine vigtigste opgaver

Som skoleleder er dine vigtigste opgaver at fortsætte udviklingen af Kompasset som en skole og arbejdsplads, hvor alle trives og udvikler sig. Herunder:

At lede lærere og pædagoger og sikre, at alle har de rette kompetencer, trives og er engagerede

At kvalificere undervisningstilbuddet, herunder dokumentere faglige resultater og indsatser med henblik på, at alle vores elever udnytter deres faglige potentiale optimalt

At sikre et godt samarbejde med forældre og samarbejdspartnere

At sikre en god drift med øje for normeringer og økonomiske rammer

Vi søger dig, der:

Har ledelseserfaring og en god og solid faglig ballast i forhold til målgruppen

Evner at navigere og trives i en kompleks og dynamisk hverdag

Kan skabe og implementere strukturer og systemer, der skaber overblik og sammenhæng i arbejdet på skolen

Er en synlig leder, der gennem stærke kommunikative kompetencer og empati skaber følgeskab

Evner at tilpasse sin ledelsesstil til den pågældende medarbejder

Har erfaring med at lede forandringsprocesser og kan omsætte organisatoriske strategier til konkrete handlinger

Evner at skabe en forståelse for den organisation, du er en del af

Kan skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer til dem omkring dig ved at være inddragende og nysgerrig i din tilgang

Er god til konflikthåndtering og kan bevare roen i en omskiftelig hverdag

Har interesse for og erfaring med arbejdet med psykisk sårbare børn og unge

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du er uddannet skolelærer, og eventuelt har taget en lederuddannelse, men det er ikke et krav.

Du vægter det tværfaglige samarbejde højt og har lyst til at være tæt på både elever, medarbejdere og forældre i hverdagen.

Sammen med skolens øvrige ledelse får du en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af Kompasset som et stærkt skole- og behandlingstilbud.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.




Om jobbet


Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse 

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Åbne og/eller lukke butikken

Bestille varer hjem til butikken




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen

Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives med en travl hverdag

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som salgsleder i Lidl får du:

Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

 

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

Klik på "Søg nu"

Udfyld formularen

Vedhæft dit motiverede CV 

 

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på  jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!







Medarbejdergoder









Medarbejderrabat
Lidl-rabat: Få 10 % eller 20 % rabat på dine indkøb i vores butikker på udvalgte dage.





Rabatordning
Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.













        

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. Vi værdsætter vores medarbejderes mangfoldighed og fremmer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor hver enkelt føler sig velkommen og respekteret. Vi ser diversitet som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at søge. #SammenErViVerdensklasse.


    



























Butik
Frederiksværksgade 154

3400 Hillerød









Arbejdsopgaver






Arbejdet i kassen
Når du kommer i gang med arbejdet ved kassen, kommer du til at lære mere om de forskellige funktioner og opgaver i forbindelse med kassearbejdet. Du vil lære, hvordan vi ekspederer vores kunder, hvordan vores Lidl Plus app fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer penge i kassen og forskellige typer af kundehenvendelser.











Vareopfyldning
Det lyder måske som en nem opgave at fylde varer op - alligevel er der en række principper for vareopfyldning, som er vigtige at følge. I din oplæring vil du bl.a. lære, hvordan vi præsenterer vores varer, så vi sikrer et optimalt salg.











Rengøring og affaldssortering
Vi tilbyder altid vores kunder rene og ryddelige butikker. Derfor er rengøring og affaldshåndtering centrale opgaver i butiksdriften for at vi får skabt gode kundeoplevelser. Du vil  under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan vi kører med "Berta", som vasker vores gulve, hvordan pappresseren fungerer, og hvordan vi håndterer butikkens afskrivninger og affald korrekt, så alt altid står snorlige.











Frugt og grønt
Vi får leveret frisk frugt og grønt hver eneste dag til butikken.  Du vil under din oplæring lære mere om vores friskhedskoncept, og hvordan vi løbende kontrollerer og sikrer kvalitet og friskhed i frugt og grønt afdelingen - i hele butikkens åbningstid.











Bake off
Vi tilbyder vores kunder friskbagt bagværk af høj kvalitet til en pris, der betaler sig. Vi bager som udgangspunkt frisk bake off i butikken 3 gange om dagen, og du vil under din oplæring blandt andet lære, hvordan du følger et bageskema og andre procedurer i bake off’en.











Nonfood
Nonfood er den betegnelse, vi bruger for varer, som ikke er dagligvarer. I nonfood området er der et stort udvalg af kampagnevarer indenfor bl.a. husholdning, børn, hus og have og tekstil, som skiftes to gange om ugen.  Det er vigtigt, at vores nonfood står skarpt og ser pæn ud hele dagen. Du vil under din oplæring bl.a. lære, hvordan vi "trimmer" (det betyder, at vi rydder op) og håndterer nedmærkning og returvarer til lageret.

 Vedligeholdelsestekniker søges til daghold i Lemvig 

                            
 
                                
 Vi søger på vegne af en samarbejdspartner en vedligeholdelsestekniker til fast daghold. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift, hvor du bidrager til at sikre, at produktionsudstyr, procesanlæg og bygninger fungerer optimalt. 

 Stillingen byder på en bred vifte af opgaver og stor variation i hverdagen, hvor både planlagt vedligehold og akutte opgaver indgår som en naturlig del af jobbet. 

 
  

 Arbejdstider (Fleksible): 
 
 Mandag til torsdag: 07.00 - 15.30 

 Fredag: 07.00 - 12.30 
 
 
  

 Løn: 200kr/t (el. efter kvalifikationer) 

                             


                            
                                
 Arbejdsopgaver 

                                
 
                                    
 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært bestå af: 
 
 Vedligeholdelse af produktionsmaskiner og procesanlæg 

 Fejlfinding på mekaniske og elektriske komponenter 

 Reparation af udstyr ved driftsstop 

 Arbejde med hydrauliske systemer 

 Vedligeholdelse af bygninger og faciliteter

                                    kvalifikationer 

                                
 
                                    
 Det forventes, at du har: 
 
 Erfaring med vedligeholdelse af maskiner og tekniske anlæg 

 Baggrund som fx mekaniker, smed, industrimontør eller lignende 

 Kendskab til hydraulik og el-styringer 

 Teknisk forståelse og interesse for produktionsudstyr 
 
 
  

                                 

                            

                            
                            

                            
                                
 Vi tilbyder 

                                
 
                                     
 Try & Hire-stilling med henblik på fastansættelse 

 Fritvalgsordning 

 Pension og fritvalgsordning 

 Uformelt og støttende arbejdsmiljø 

 En alsidig hverdag med stor variation i opgaverne
