title: Senior/Principal Graphics Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior/Principal Graphics Engineer based in Canada.

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve high-performance graphics technology for a large-scale, cross-platform social gaming experience.
You will work at the engine level, developing sophisticated C++ systems focused on real-time rendering, performance, scalability, and visual quality.
The position involves close collaboration with engine engineers, gameplay developers, artists, and designers to deliver exceptional experiences across a broad range of devices.
A major focus will be profiling and optimizing CPU and GPU performance, particularly for mobile platforms and varying performance tiers.
You will contribute to rendering features, graphics pipelines, engine components, and developer tools while helping maintain a robust technical foundation.
As a senior technical contributor, you will also mentor teammates, share engineering practices, and help advance the team's graphics capabilities.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced graphics engineer passionate about pushing the boundaries of real-time rendering and modern game technology.

Accountabilities

  • Develop high-performance C++ systems for a proprietary game engine, with a strong focus on real-time rendering, scalability, and runtime performance.
  • Design, implement, and maintain advanced rendering features, core engine components, graphics pipelines, and supporting development tools.
  • Collaborate closely with engine engineers, gameplay programmers, artists, designers, and other technical stakeholders to translate creative and product requirements into robust graphics solutions.
  • Profile, diagnose, and optimize CPU and GPU performance across a wide range of devices, with particular emphasis on mobile hardware and different performance tiers.
  • Work with modern rendering technologies and graphics APIs, including Vulkan and Metal, to deliver high-quality cross-platform experiences.
  • Investigate complex graphics and engine challenges and develop efficient, maintainable solutions that improve both visual fidelity and performance.
  • Write clean, well-structured, maintainable C++ code with appropriate documentation and clear code-level comments.
  • Contribute to the evolution of graphics architecture, rendering workflows, and engine technology as platform capabilities and industry standards develop.
  • Mentor other engineers, share technical knowledge and best practices, and contribute to the growth and effectiveness of the engineering team.
  • Stay current with developments in graphics programming, rendering techniques, GPU architectures, mobile platforms, and emerging industry technologies.

    • Requirements

    • At least 6 years of professional experience in the game industry, with a proven track record of contributing to or shipping large-scale 3D games.
    • Expert-level proficiency in C++, including deep knowledge of performance optimization, multithreading, and low-level engine systems.
    • Strong understanding of modern real-time rendering pipelines and graphics programming principles.
    • Hands-on experience with graphics APIs such as Vulkan and Metal.
    • Proven experience working with game engines and art or content production pipelines.
    • Strong proficiency with GPU profiling and debugging tools and the ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
    • Experience developing graphics or engine technology across multiple platforms and hardware configurations.
    • Strong understanding of CPU/GPU architecture, performance tuning, and scalability considerations.
    • Ability to write clean, maintainable, well-documented code and communicate technical decisions effectively.
    • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, artists, designers, and other cross-functional partners.
    • Demonstrated ability to mentor teammates, share knowledge, and contribute to technical direction.
    • Passion for graphics technology and a willingness to continuously explore new rendering techniques and platform capabilities.
    • Familiarity with SIMD instruction sets is a plus.
    • Experience pushing the boundaries of Android graphics, particularly with Vulkan, is highly valued.
    • A portfolio or technical demonstration of graphics work, such as a project shared through ShaderToy or a comparable platform, is a plus.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States or Canada; employment visa sponsorship or transfer is not currently available.

      • Benefits

      • Annual salary range of $150,000–$220,000 USD, depending on experience and compensation factors.
      • Opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus.
      • Fully remote work environment for eligible candidates in the US and Canada.
      • Paid time off, paid holidays, and a two-week winter break.
      • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, beginning on the first day of employment with no waiting period.
      • Pet insurance.
      • Compassionate leave to support employees caring for family members.
      • Pre-tax wellness stipend.
      • Pre-tax work-from-home stipend.
      • 401(k) savings plan with company matching.
      • Mental health resources, including Headspace membership and an Employee Assistance Program.
      • Discount portal for everyday goods and services.
      • Employee inclusion and diversity initiatives.
      • Support for personal and professional development.
      • Opportunity to work on technically challenging graphics and engine problems across multiple platforms and performance tiers.

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.


Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

title: FEA Engineer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand and define the engineering problem, project scope, objectives and expected deliverables in coordination with global engineering counterparts.
  • Develop an appropriate engineering analysis/simulation approach for assigned projects, seeking guidance for complex or unfamiliar problems as required.
  • Independently execute assigned FEA and engineering analysis projects supporting Product Development, Submittal, Sustaining Engineering and field failure investigations.
  • Interpret and critically evaluate simulation results, identify potential structural or vibration-related concerns, and provide sound engineering recommendations.
  • Perform appropriate hand calculations and engineering assessments to support design decisions and validate/interrogate simulation results.
  • Support product design optimization, troubleshooting and resolution of engineering issues, including field failure investigations and vibration-related problems.
  • Prepare and communicate engineering calculations, FEA reports and technical deliverables to meet project requirements and applicable engineering standards.
  • Coordinate with global and cross-functional teams to discuss analysis requirements, communicate findings, incorporate feedback and complete assigned engineering deliverables.
  • Willing to travel to local/global sites for short- to long-duration assignments based on business needs.

Must have

  • Strong understanding of Mechanical Engineering fundamentals, structural mechanics and FEA principles.
  • Hands-on experience with ANSYS Mechanical / Workbench or equivalent FEA software.
  • Good working knowledge of static structural analysis, including appropriate material properties, boundary conditions, contacts and loading conditions.
  • Understanding of material and contact nonlinearities and their appropriate application in FEA.
  • Good understanding of vibration fundamentals and structural dynamics.
  • Ability to perform engineering hand calculations and critically evaluate FEA results using sound engineering judgment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with global and cross-functional teams.

Good to have

  • Experience with pumps, rotating equipment or other mechanical equipment and vibration-related engineering problems.
  • Experience with field failure investigation, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis using FEA and engineering calculations.
  • Knowledge of engineering standards such as ASME, API, Hydraulic Institute or equivalent.
  • Experience with Creo/NX or other 3D CAD software.

Qualifications

  • Full Time M.Tech. / M.E. in Machine Design, Mechanical Engineering or CAD/CAM.
  • 2–3 years of relevant hands-on FEA / structural simulation experience in a product development or engineering environment.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Payment Lifecyle Specialist
description:
Are you ready to be at the forefront of digital payment innovation? Join our Payments Operations team and make a meaningful impact by ensuring seamless financial transactions. This is your opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced environment, where your contributions will be valued and your skills will be honed.

As a Payment Lifecycle Specialist IV within Payments Operations, you will play a crucial role in the smooth transfer of funds between various parties. Working under regular supervision, you will help maintain our reputation for excellent service and secure financial transactions. Your responsibilities will include payment processing across various products, such as the transfer of funds between financial institutions, cardholders, merchants, corporate and retail clients, and the reconciliation of purchase and sales options, futures, or securities. This may involve sanctions screening, payment investigations, funds control, exception processing, resolving reconciliation breaks, and invoicing or cash management activities.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Execute high-volume payment processing tasks, including validating global currency fund transfers to ensure accurate and timely transactions, following established procedures.
  • Process payments for cash, trade, merchant, or commercial card transactions as well as customer accounts and verification, performing basic research, reviewing sanctions, fraud, fund controls, and client investigation.
  • Identify, resolve, or escalate either procedural issues or operational errors that may arise during payments processing including upholding compliance and risk standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-locational teams and clients, maintaining productive relationships to drive mutually beneficial outcomes in line with team objectives.
  • Detect and escalate potential fraudulent threats and help prevent financial and reputational damage to the institution.
  • Contribute to process optimization initiatives including projects to identify inefficiencies, improve quality, and enhance the customer experience.
  • Coach, train, or mentor team members to deliver to our high service standards for productivity, quality, and customer experience.
  • Interface with other operations departments to research and resolve inquiries, including escalated matters.
  • Learn and apply skills in innovation, market product knowledge, and artificial intelligence to identify opportunities to improve or optimize payment lifecycle processes.

Required Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:

  • Intermediate knowledge of global payment processing operations or similar operations, including understanding of standard operating procedures and customer-specific instructions.
  • Skilled in effective execution and task management, with strong time management abilities to ensure timely and accurate completion of work.
  • Proven ability in decision making and problem solving, utilizing critical and analytical thinking to ensure accuracy and effective solutions in moderately complex situations.
  • Proficiency in data analysis techniques, with the ability to interpret and communicate data effectively to inform decision-making processes.
  • Demonstrated communication skills and emotional intelligence, including a growth mindset and personal resiliency, to collaborate productively with management, teams, and other stakeholders in diverse and dynamic environments.
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, influence outcomes, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in payment processing.
  • Intermediate computer, software, and technical skills, including alpha/numeric data entry and typing skills.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity controls and anti-fraud strategies to assist in identifying and addressing potential threats to protect information and systems.

Preferred Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:

  • Knowledge of ISO or Swift message processing or management.

title: HR Processing & Staffing Specialist
description:
Title: HR Processing & Staffing Specialist
Location: Washington, DC
Schedule: Full-time, onsite Monday–Friday
Salary: $71,000 – $80,000 per year

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring an HR Processing & Staffing Specialist to join our team and provide HR operational support to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Human Capital Management Office (HCMO) in Washington, DC.

In this role, you will help support the FTC’s day-to-day HR operations, primarily focusing on employee benefits and retirement services while also assisting with HR processing and staffing needs.

This position is a strong fit for a federal HR professional who is organized, detail-oriented, comfortable handling sensitive information, and able to support both benefits and HR processing needs.

Applicants are reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Benefits & Retirement Administration
  • Promote and support wellness and work-life programs
  • Triage incoming benefits inquiries and direct complex matters to FTC Benefits Specialists
  • Support Open Season activities, seminars, and workforce engagement events
  • Provide basic benefits counseling to employees; in-depth counseling is performed by FTC Benefits Specialists
  • Review and process FEHB, FEGLI, TSP, and related benefits forms
  • Communicate with OPM, DFAS, insurance carriers, payroll providers, and other agencies as necessary
  • Request military service documentation and provide deposit and redeposit guidance using FTC calculation tools
  • Calculate redeposit service, FICA, and military deposits
  • Compile and verify employee service histories for retirement purposes
  • Independently prepare retirement packages with oversight from the Benefits Officer
  • Deliver benefits-related briefings during new-hire orientation
  • Maintain and update benefits-related systems, including e-Comp, FHR Navigator, and FPPS
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely records of benefits activities
HR Processing & Staffing
  • Code and process personnel and payroll actions in FPPS within required timeframes
  • Prepare pre-appointment packages and assist with new-hire in-processing
  • Extend tentative and official job offers as directed
  • Review personnel and payroll forms for accuracy and completeness
  • Request, upload, and maintain eOPF records and convert paper files to electronic records
  • Audit personnel records to ensure accuracy and policy compliance
  • Process leave transfers for incoming and current employees
  • Provide customer service regarding HR systems, processes, and procedures
  • Identify and correct HR processing errors
  • Track commemorative awards and maintain award-related files and logs
  • Coordinate and conduct new employee orientation
  • Respond promptly to employee and management inquiries
  • Maintain complete documentation of HR processing activities
Documentation, Quality & Customer Support
  • Deliver high-quality, accurate, and timely support across assigned duties
  • Adhere to applicable federal regulations, agency policies, and privacy and PII requirements
  • Provide courteous, professional customer service to employees, managers, and stakeholders
  • Maintain organized, complete, and audit-ready documentation for assigned activities
  • Collaborate with HCMO personnel and escalate complex issues appropriately
  • Remain flexible in shifting between benefits and HR processing work based on workload demand
  • Use Government systems, tools, and templates in accordance with provided guidance
  • Incorporate Government comments into draft and final work products within 5 business days of receipt
  • Support weekly/bi-weekly activity updates and updated SOPs or workflows as requested

REQUIRED BACKGROUND
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in federal HR processing or benefits
  • Ability to process forms, maintain records, calculate retirement service, and use FPPS and benefits systems
  • Experience with federal benefits and retirement administration or federal HR processing
  • Ability to review and process personnel, payroll, and benefits forms accurately and within required timeframes
  • Ability to maintain complete and accurate HR, benefits, and personnel records
  • Hands-on FPPS experience is preferred; comparable federal payroll or personnel system experience will be considered
  • Ability to provide professional customer service and respond to employee and management inquiries
  • Ability to protect personally identifiable information and other sensitive FTC information

EDUCATION
  • High school diploma required

LOCATION
  • FTC Headquarters, 600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20580

WORK HOURS
  • Full-time, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week

TELEWORK
  • Limited telework may be available with prior approval

SECURITY
  • Must meet FTC background investigation, fingerprinting, and suitability requirements
  • Must complete required pre-employment security screening and forms
  • Must complete FTC Security and Privacy Awareness Training when using agency systems

EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION
  • Employment Classification Eligibility—Exempt

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager 
    
   Share 
  
    
   
 
 
 

  
 
 
  Opportunity 
 
 
  

  

  

  

 This position is available in Aarhus or Copenhagen. 

  

 Join Maersk and Help Deliver Critical Logistics Solutions Around the World! 

 
 At Maersk, we don't just move cargo—we move global trade. As a global leader in logistics, connecting and simplifying supply chains across more than 130 countries, we help customers navigate complexity and unlock opportunity. Every year, we facilitate approximately 20% of global trade, powered by over 110,000 employees working together to create smarter, more resilient supply chains. 

 
 We are now looking for an experienced Project Manager within Aid, Relief & Government to join our specialized Project Logistics team in Aarhus or Copenhagen, Denmark.
 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of logistics, project management, and Aid, Relief and Government operations, managing complex international transport projects that make a real impact on mission-critical supply chains. 

 
 Why Join Maersk Project Logistics?
 Our Project Logistics teams are trusted experts in managing the transportation of complex, oversized, and sensitive cargo across the globe. Combining traditional freight forwarding expertise with advanced project planning, transport engineering, procurement, and end-to-end project management capabilities, we deliver solutions where others see obstacles.
 As part of this team, you will collaborate with industry experts, work on strategically important projects, and help design innovative logistics solutions for  Aid, Relief & Government customers worldwide.   

 
 The Opportunity
 As Project Manager, Aid, Relief & Government, you will be responsible for managing logistics projects on behalf of our customers, ensuring seamless transport execution and outstanding service delivery. 
 You will play a key role in building up a new team handling a new customer win. You will be coordinating everything from quoting/solution design to operating the shipment, within the different transport modes, as air, sea & road. 
 This position offers significant exposure to international stakeholders, complex logistics challenges, and strategic customer engagements. 

 
 What You'll Be Doing
 •    Manage end-to-end logistics projects for customers across Aid, Relief and Government.
 •    Coordinate the transportation of equipment across ocean, air, and land modes.
 •    Capture and analyze project requirements to develop tailored logistics solutions.
 •    Support planning, costing, pricing, and proposal development activities.
 •    Lead project execution to ensure successful delivery against customer requirements.
 •    Create and optimize process flows for critical operational activities.
 •    Manage smaller tender processes and help secure competitive, commercially attractive solutions.
 •    Conduct site visits and engage local stakeholders to gather insights and support execution.
 •    Develop innovative logistics concepts and value-added service offerings.
 •    Collaborate with cross-functional teams across the global Maersk network. 

  

 What We're Looking For
 You are a proactive and solution-oriented logistics professional who thrives in complex environments and enjoys turning challenges into opportunities.
 Ideally, you bring:
 •    Proven experience within Government/Defense or Aid/Relief business 
 •    Strong project management capabilities and a track record of successful execution.
 •    Commercial awareness and an interest in developing customer-focused solutions.
 •    Excellent relationship-building skills with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
 •    A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across global teams.
 •    Strong organizational skills and the ability to remain composed under pressure.
 •    Excellent communication skills in English.
 •    A solid understanding of logistics products, services, and supply chain solutions. 

 
 What We Offer
 At Maersk, you'll join a truly global organization where innovation, collaboration, and personal growth are encouraged every day.
 You'll benefit from:
 •    The opportunity to work on high-profile Aid, Relief & Government project. 
 •    Exposure to international logistics operations and stakeholders.
 •    Career growth within one of the world's leading logistics companies.
 •    A collaborative and supportive team environment.
 •    Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
 •    A diverse and inclusive workplace where every perspective is valued. 

  

 Ready to Make an Impact?
 If you're passionate about project logistics, thrive in complex environments, and want to contribute to critical Aid, Relief & Government supply chain operations, we'd love to hear from you.
 Join Maersk and help shape the future of global project logistics.

title: Offsite Medical Specialist - Echocardiography Technician, Brooklyn, New York, Full Time, Days
description:
Performs quality echocardiographic studies assisting physicians in diagnosing and monitoring various cardiac conditions, enabling the delivery of accurate and timely patient care. This role requires a combination of technical proficiency, interpersonal skills, and a commitment to patient well-being.

  1. Prepares and examines all patients, verifying their identity for ultrasound examinations in accordance with established departmental procedures and techniques, which includes obtaining health status and medical history, patient’s cooperation or ability to tolerate the examination. Confirms that the ultrasound examination correlates with patient clinical history and presentation. Inform physician in charge of any contraindications or changes needed to the procedure.
  2. Communicates with the patient explaining the exam and instructions, answering questions that are unrelated to specific diagnostic, treatment and/or prognosis.
  3. Develops and/or modifies a procedure plan from health status and medical history, using age and gender appropriate considerations. Uses independent professional judgment to adopt the procedure plan to optimize exam results. Performs exams under general or direct physician supervision as defined by the procedure, adjusting scanning technique to optimize image qualify and spectral waveform characteristics.
  4. Analyzes sonographic findings so comprehensive exams sufficient for a physician to direct patient management and render a diagnosis can be obtained. Perform measurements and calculations according to laboratory and IAC protocols and guidelines. Minimize patient exposure to acoustic energy without compromising exam quality or completeness.
  5. Notifies appropriate health care provider when immediate medical attention is needed. Evaluates patient's physical and mental status prior to discharge from the ultrasound department.
  6. Records diagnostic images and data for use by the interpreting physician in rendering a diagnosis and for archival purposes. Provides a summary in Studycast.
  7. Applies the necessary technical judgment to obtain studies of an acceptable diagnostic quality according to written protocols and the patients’ needs.
  8. Assists, prepares and positions patients as required to perform Echo procedures.
  9. Provides patient education relevant to specific imaging procedures by informing the patient of the nature of the procedure, the area to be imaged and any specific instructions the patient may need.
  10. Ensures all images are appropriately labeled as specified by the department SOP.
  11. Assists with QA/QC program ensuring compliance with all regulatory agency requirements.
  12. Assists physician directly as required during procedures (e.g., Bubble studies, Ablations, etc.)
  13. Ensures images are transmitted to Studycast in a timely fashion.
  14. Ensures Echo room and equipment cleanliness, at the start and at the end of the shift, to include removal of soiled or dirty linen.
  15. Maintains supplies and accessories in imaging room necessary to safely perform duties, as required.
  16. Accurately records all required patient tracking information, and exam notes into Epic and Studycast.
  17. Ensures that all studies performed are correct and completed in Studycast immediately after completion of exam.
  18. Performs related clerical duties in the absence of support personnel.
  19. Informs supervisor or appropriate personnel of needed repairs to equipment or unsafe conditions.
  20. Prevents the spread of infection to self, patients, visitors, and other employees by adhering to infection control policies and protocol.
  21. Attends in-services and other professional development meetings as required.
  22. Maintains appropriate Continuing Medical Education credits.
  23. Performs related clerical duties in the absence of support personnel.
  24. Assist with department accreditation.
  • Associates degree (AA) or equivalent from an accredited college or technical school
  • 0-2 years of experience as Echocardiogram Technician.
  • SPI Certification and a graduate from an accredited Ultrasound Technician program and will complete the ARDMS within one year of hire. American Registry of Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS and RDCS) RVT certification must also be completed within one year of hire.

Compensation Statement

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $51.13 - $54.20 Hourly. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

Vil du være med til at sikre, at de rette varer bliver leveret til vores butikker? Så er du måske vores nye logistikassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som logistikassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, hvor du er med til at sikre de rette varer til vores butikker. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både fagligt og personligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Kerneopgaverne som logistikassistent vil være at modtage chauffører fra hele verden, prioritere dem i forhold til booket tider, sikre at de får tildelt pladser til aflæsning på lageret, samt sikre en korrekt bogføring af de modtagne varer, når kontrollanterne har afsluttet deres optællinger. Størstedelen af din arbejdsdag vil gå med betjening af SAP fra vores varemodtagelseskontor, hvor vi tager imod ind-/udenlandske chauffører som skal aflevere varer. Kendskab til SAP, Google Workspace og sheets  er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det har større betydning at du er lærenem ved en computer og har flair for IT.  

Arbejdstiden er i tidsrummet 05.00 til 17.00, mandag til søndag, weekend arbejde planlægges i rul med dine kollegaer. 

 

Dine opgaver kan være som nedenstående: 

 


Tage imod chauffør med henblik på administrativ behandling af følgesedler/fragtbreve 





Overvågning af varemodtagelser i samtlige områder (køl, kød, brød, frugt & grønt, frost & tørvarer)  





Afhjælpe ved driftsproblemer  





Du vil i samarbejde med dine kollegaer skulle løse komplekse opgaver for at sikre flow og drift er så effektivt som muligt 





Om dig


Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke så vigtig. Det er en fordel, at du har erfaring med administrativt arbejde fra en logistik-, lager- eller produktionsvirksomhed og er daglig bruger af IT, specielt Google Sheets og SAP. title: Kitter, 1st Shift, Marathon Equipment
description:
Job Description:

Position Title: Kitter

Operating Company: Environmental Solutions Group – Marathon Equipment

Location: Vernon, AL

Reports to: Production Supervisor

Department: Operations

Shift: 1st shift

Position Summary:

This position is primarily responsible for organizing kitting based on load schedules and for determining parts availability based on information in ERP system.

Roles and Key Responsibilities:

Observes all safety regulations and reports any unsafe working conditions to Department Supervisor.

Reads work orders to determine kitting requirements and extensive use of ERP system to determine parts availability and follows Department Supervisor’s direction to ascertain materials or parts to be moved with the use of forklifts.

Determine when parts are needed and communicate requirements to Fab department.

Monitor and update Excel-based load schedule with orders to be kitted and labeled.

Prioritize kits based on load schedules.

Maintain certification for forklift use or other certifications as required for specialized equipment (coordinate with supervisor and local HR resource).

Manually load and unload parts up to 40 pounds, and assist employees with loading and unloading parts above 40 pounds and above to and from their designated locations.

Performs preventative maintenance checks to all equipment prior to use, including forklifts, pallet jacks, etc. Completes maintenance checklists as required and submit maintenance requests to Maintenance Department when necessary.

Identify materials and parts as required.

Support of production requirements as necessary may require overtime coordinated through supervisor or management.

Maintain work area and equipment clean and ordered.

Prepare production kits as required or assigned. Kits may include but not limited to raw material, parts, sub-assemblies, purchased parts or combinations of those or other parts/material as listed on bills of materials (BOM’s) or special instructions provided by supervisor or management.

Perform any other task as required to support operations and customer satisfaction provided it can be performed safely and without special training requirements.

Requirements:

Knowledge: Requires knowledge and experience on different production lines for familiarity with different Marathon equipment models and the associated fabricated parts used on these models. Requires ability to understand general arithmetic; ability to write in an understandable manner; understand verbal or written instructions; ability to read and understand instructions, lists and billing materials; use PC based applications, including Mainstar, JD Edwards, Outlook, and Microsoft Office, knowledge normally acquired through high school or equivalent experience.

Mental: Requires normal attention with periods of high concentration intermittently to operate machinery approximately 50% of time.

Physical: Requires walking/standing approximately 30%, sitting approximately 50% and lifting up to 40 pounds approximately 20% of time; involves repetitive overhead work approximately 15% of time; involves repetitive stooping, forward bending and crouching approximately 10% of time.

Manual Dexterity: Requires use of hands, arms and feet for repetitive lifting; use of hands and arms to operate all manufacturing equipment, meters, chains hoists, automatic drills and general hand tools and to record written information.

Audible Demands: Requires ability to follow verbal instructions and to hear for safety purposes.

Visual: Requires the ability to visually observe essential functions for satisfactory job performance and safety; color and depth perception required.

Environmental: Exposure to plant environments with the presence of dust, fumes, noise, and fluctuating temperatures due to lack of climate control.

Note: Supersedes All Preceding Job Descriptions:

The above job description is intended to describe the general content, identify the essential job functions, and set forth the requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of job functions or requirements.

How to Apply:

To apply for this position at Environmental Solutions Group, please apply via HR Central.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.




If you are interested in an open position but feel you may not meet all the listed qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

About Terex:

Terex Corporation is a global leader in specialized equipment solutions, serving essential sectors such as emergency services, waste and recycling, utilities, and construction. Our diversified portfolio positions us in resilient, high-demand markets with strong long-term growth potential.

We design and manufacture advanced specialty vehicles—including fire, ambulance, and recreational vehicles—alongside waste collection vehicles, materials processing machinery, mobile elevating work platforms, and equipment for the electric utility industry. Through our global dealer, parts and service network and true value-creating digital solutions, we deliver best-in-class lifecycle support, helping customers maximize return on investment.

With a strong manufacturing footprint in the United States and operations across Europe, India, and Asia Pacific, Terex combines global reach with local expertise to capture opportunities worldwide. Our strategy is clear: exceed customer expectations, invest in innovation, leverage our diversified portfolio, and deliver consistent, profitable growth for our shareholders.

For more information, please visit .

Additional Information:

We are passionate about producing equipment that helps improve the lives of people around the world and providing our team members with a rewarding career and the opportunity to make an impact. We are committed to recruiting, engaging, developing, and retaining team members at all levels of our global workforce. Our culture is defined by our Terex Way Values – Integrity, Respect, Improvement, Servant Leadership, Courage, and Citizenship. Our values are the driving force behind our commitment to maintain an inclusive, supportive, non-discriminatory, and safe workplace for all team members. To that end, we are committed to actively foster a culture where every team member feels valued, listened to, and appreciated. We are committed to being fair and impartial in our decisions. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. If you are a qualified individual with a disability, including disabled veterans, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting the recruiting department (person or department) at Globaltalentacquisitions@terex.com.

The Company offers competitive salaries, advancement opportunities, and a full range of benefits, including paid vacation, 401(k), medical, dental, and vision.

title: Senior Software Engineer I, AI/ML
description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer to own agents, copilots, and platform services end to end—and to raise the engineers around you as you do it.

DigitalOcean is building the substrate for an AI-native company, and the AI Engineering team is doing that work. It spans three connected pillars: internal AI copilots and agents for teams across Finance, People, Sales, Marketing, Support, and IT; the internal AI platform that powers them—model access and routing, agent runtimes, evaluation harnesses, and the developer tooling around them; and re-architecting business processes across our enterprise systems footprint to be AI-native. Our engineers in the US and India work together across time zones, each owning delivery end to end for their business domains while contributing to the shared platform.

You will join the team in India as a fully proficient engineer who takes an ambiguous-but-scoped problem from design to shipped, instrumented software with limited guidance. Building the agent is the easy part; making it reliable enough that a finance analyst trusts it on a Monday morning is the job. That means you care about evaluation as much as features, and you understand that an agent nobody can debug is an agent nobody will keep using.

What You'll Do

  • Own the design and delivery of features and small services end to end—agents, copilots, and platform components—with limited guidance.
  • Build agentic systems properly: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, memory and state, and the evaluations that keep them honest as models and prompts change.
  • Define the evaluations, regression tests, and observability for what you ship, and take part in on-call and incident response for systems whose output is not deterministic.
  • Contribute to the internal AI platform—agent runtimes, model access and routing, tool interfaces built on open standards such as the Model Context Protocol, and developer tooling—following the paved paths our architect sets, and improving them when they get in your way.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders to scope problems and turn them into well-built, measurable solutions. Understand the workflow before you design for it.
  • Mentor early-career engineers through code review, pairing, and design feedback, and hold the quality bar on the work around you.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently ship well-designed features and services that get adopted in production, with quality, safety, and evaluation coverage you can point to.
  • You need little guidance to take a scoped but ambiguous problem all the way to instrumented, working software.
  • Early-career engineers around you get better faster because of your reviews and mentorship.

What You'll Add to DigitalOcean

  • Engineering Depth: Roughly 4+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning and shipping features or services in production—not just contributing to them.
  • Applied AI Experience: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications—retrieval-augmented generation, agents and tool use, prompt design—and a working understanding of evaluation and LLMOps practice: prompt and agent versioning, regression testing, and observability for non-deterministic outputs.
  • Agentic Tooling: Familiarity with orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents), Model Context Protocol tooling, vector stores, and runtime guardrails.
  • Production Fundamentals: Proficiency in at least one production language (Python, Go, TypeScript, or Java) and comfort with modern cloud-native infrastructure—containers, Kubernetes or serverless, CI/CD, observability stacks.
  • Evaluation Instinct: You reach for a golden dataset before you reach for a prompt tweak, and you can tell the difference between an agent that works and an agent that demoed well.
  • Clear Communication: You explain technical trade-offs to engineers and to non-engineering stakeholders, and you collaborate well across time zones.

Bonus Points

  • Integrating with enterprise systems—HRIS, Financial systems, GTM Systems, or similar—including their data models and permissioning.
  • Contributing to internal developer platforms or productivity tooling that engineers chose to adopt.
  • Agent evaluation and observability tooling (LangFuse, Arize, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry-based tracing, or equivalents).

*This job is located in Bengaluru, India

JR: 2026-7955

#LI-Hybrid

Why You’ll Like Working for DigitalOcean

  • We innovate with purpose. You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.
  • We prioritize career development. At DO, you’ll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000+ courses to support their continued growth and development.
  • We care about your well-being. Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences.
  • We reward our employees. The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • DigitalOcean is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Application Limit: You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180-day period. This policy promotes better role-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
WOULD YOU LIKE TO BE PART OF A RAPIDLY GROWING ORGANIZATION?

JOIN US AS HR COORDINATOR AT HEAD QUARTERS IN UTRECHT.

ABOUT ODYSSEY

We are Odyssey Hotel Group, one of Europe’s most ambitious hotel operators and the team behind several internationally recognised hospitality brands.

We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop and operate distinctive hotels across Europe, ranging from Holiday Inn Express properties to hotels within Marriott’s Autograph Collection.

Supported by more than 700 employees and ActivumSG as our major shareholder, our purpose is to create wonderful stories through unique, locally inspired hotel concepts and close attention to detail. We achieve this through a culture where our teams have the freedom and support to become masters of the art of hospitality.

ODYSSEY CULTURE

You’ll be joining a fast-moving, ambitious and successful team that’s shaking up the industry we love. If you thrive on responsibility, share a passion for great service, and are a natural collaborator, we’ll be a good fit. We pride ourselves with a collaborative mindset.

THE POSITION

As an HR Coordinator you oversee HR operations, provide guidance to management, analyse HR trends and metrics, resolve complex issues, suggest HR strategies aligned with business goals, improve work relationships and productivity, build morale and increase retention.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support recruitment processes, including posting vacancies, scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, and supporting hiring managers throughout the selection process.

  • Support the onboarding and offboarding of employees, including preparing documentation, coordinating introductions, and ensuring all required steps are completed.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and process HR changes within the HR system.

  • Prepare employment documents, letters, reports, and other HR-related administration.

  • Support key Learning and Development initiatives, including coordinating training sessions, tracking participation, and communicating with employees and training providers.

  • Act as a first point of contact for employees and managers regarding general HR questions.

  • Support the HR team with employee relations, performance management, absence management, and other HR processes.

  • Assist with payroll preparation by collecting and checking relevant employee information.

  • Support the implementation and improvement of HR policies, procedures, and systems.

  • Contribute to HR projects related to employee engagement, recruitment, development, well-being, and process improvement.

  • Assist with HR reporting and ensure employee data remains accurate and complete.

  • Work closely with colleagues across the hotels and headquarters to support consistent HR processes.

HOW YOU’LL DO IT

  • By being a warm and helpful communicator and being people-oriented.

  • With the ability to put things in perspective.

  • Thinking out of the box to create unique experiences.

  • By being a great team player and being proactive.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or related field.

  • Basic HR knowledge and familiarity with local labour laws.

  • Proficiency in Dutch and English.

  • At least two years of previous work experience in HR.

  • Excellent people management skills.

  • Analytical and goal oriented attitude.

WHY THIS ROLE AT ODYSSEY?

The advantage of joining via Odyssey means that you’ll be empowered to be your very best. Together we grow. You get the opportunity to grow to our other brands and headquarters.

  • Attractive benefits package.

  • Employee discount rates in more than 8000 hotels, for you and your family.

  • Your personal development taken seriously. You have the option to grow within our diverse hotel brands and our headquarters.

  • Access to resources through Alleo to support your personal well-being.

  • Room to contribute your ideas and take ownership of your work.

  • The opportunity to work from inspiring locations.

  • The opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of our European hotel portfolio.

  • Working in a dynamic and expanding work environment where no day is the same.

  • A culture where great colleagues become true friends.

  • Diversity in the work and tasks and getting involved in projects.

INTERESTED?

Please apply via this vacancy and our colleagues from the Talent team will contact you as soon as possible.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Job Description:

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Product Owner supporting t the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Premium Stabilization Program (PSP) and EDGE programs. Our work depends on Product Owner with a Consultant Mindset to lead the evolution of our Salesforce platform. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring the Salesforce ecosystem delivers maximum value to the organization. You’ll approach problems strategically, ask the right questions, challenge the status quo, and align platform capabilities with business goals. You will be required to perform several diverse functions, from participating and contributing to technical tasks to leading development and infrastructure projects across the FSSSO program’s enterprise. This is more than just a product role — it's a strategic partnership role at the heart of our digital transformation. Work visa sponsorship will not be provided for this role.

HOW A PRODUCT OWNER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Maintain the Salesforce product roadmap, prioritizing enterprise features, enhancements, new products, and tools based on business value

  • Act as the voice of the customer and key liaison between business users, IT teams, and Salesforce developers

  • Elicit and document requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and data analysis

  • Translate complex business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications

  • Collaborate with Salesforce admins, developers, testers and solution architects and provide programmatic expertise through all phases to deliver scalable solutions

  • Lead enterprise backlog grooming, sprint planning, and user acceptance testing, ensuring proper bandwidth utilization, timely ticket resolution and compliance

  • Providing timely schedule inputs, risk alerts, and status reporting to program management

  • Working complex helpdesk cases for assigned product and program areas

  • Supporting demos, briefings, and presentations to CMS and internal leadership.

  • Acting as the voice of the customer by synthesizing user needs, policy constraints, technical considerations, and program deadlines.

  • Ensure the clarity, accuracy, and efficiency of the program’s technical processes and documentation, including standard operating procedures and workflows, process and email templates, monthly architectural updates, System Design Document (SDD), semi-annual security testing documentation, and Technical Review Board (TRB) documentation

  • Document and manage meeting minutes, action items and blockers, ensuring timely completion and appropriate follow-up

CONSULTANT MINDSET – WHAT SETS YOU APART:

  • Strategic Thinker: You look beyond immediate needs and understand the bigger picture

  • Problem Solver: You break down complex problems and design actionable solutions

  • Technical Translator: You can translate technical requirements into business language and vice versa

  • Change Agent: You drive user adoption and champion continuous improvement

  • Empathetic Listener: You actively listen to stakeholder needs and challenge assumptions constructively

  • Influencer: You build trust, manage expectations, and lead with credibility

REQUIRED QUALIFICIATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 9+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role, having supported Application Programming Interface (APIs), system integrations, and/or data exchange

  • In-depth experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools, including Jira and Confluence

  • Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

  • Experience leading large teams, managing work and action items for 7+ projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize and adjust rapidly to shifts in priorities

  • Excellent oral, written and presentation communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical topics to various stakeholders, management levels, and non-technical audiences, and to independently lead various development and architecture meetings, such as weekly development team meetings, exploration deep dives, and ad-hoc architecture and technical calls

  • Ability to gather and analyze information skillfully and develop alternative solutions, resolving issues with minimal oversight

  • Experience working with Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) or similar federal agency, preferably within the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)

  • General understanding of CMS Section 508 compliance requirements

  • Candidate must have resided in the U.S. 3 out of the last 5 years

  • Candidate must be willing and able to obtain a CMS Public Trust clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICIATIONS:

  • Hands-on technical experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Experience Cloud and/or Lightening Components

  • Active Salesforce certification(s)

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, AWS and OWN

  • Hands-on experience developing automation testing scripts

  • Experience with software DevSecOps/DevOps pipeline processes and tools

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:

  • 401K with company match

  • Comprehensive health and wellness packages

  • Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications

  • Cutting-edge technology you can learn from

  • Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays

The likely salary range for this position is $112,840 - $149,500. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Less than 10%

Telecommuting Options:

Remote

Any Location / Remote

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. Role Summary

Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team in India. You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing scalable applications across the entire software stack. What you will do

title: KØKKENCHEF
description:
Ærlig mad på mere end 40 restauranter













































































































































































































KØKKENCHEF







Vil du være med på holdet på Madklubbens nye restaurant i Pilestræde?






Med kræfter fra holdet bag Jade åbner vi snart en ny restaurant i hjertet af Pilestræde, og vi søger et stærkt team, der vil være med til at skabe og forme en ny og spændende restaurantoplevelse fra bunden.

Konceptet forener moderne sushi, dumplings og små deleretter i et stilfuldt og luksuriøst univers, hvor stemningen er levende, servicen nærværende og kvaliteten er i højsædet. Her er der fokus på smag, håndværk og en oplevelse, der får gæsterne til at vende tilbage igen og igen.





Jobbet

Som køkkenchef er du overordnet ansvarlig for hele køkkenets drift og personale. Det betyder, at du skal kunne være i stand til, og synes det er sjovt, at have flere bolde i luften og samme tid holde det kølige overblik.  



Der vil være opgaver ved siden af, at du selvfølgelig kører service med dit team.

Jobbet indebærer bl.a. ledelse af dine kokke og køkkenassistenter. Derudover vil din hverdag blandt andet, men ikke udelukkende, bestå af vagtplanlægning, udvikling af nye retter og menuer i samspil med den gastronomiske chef, økonomistyring, varebestilling, rengøring, opfølgning, hygiejne og egenkontrol. 

 

Du bruger størstedelen af din tid i service side om side med dit hold og du er ansvarlig for - og tager aktiv del i, udviklingen og træningen af alle på holdet.

Succesen er at køre en aften med fantastisk mad, serveret til tiden i godt humør og med glade kollegaer, som føler sig motiveret, inspireret og anerkendt i dit selskab. 





Vi leder efter

Du har tidligere erfaring som leder i et køkken.

Du er en dygtig håndværker og begejstret fagnørd med oprigtig interesse for detaljen og smagen.

Du arbejder altid med ja-hat og ser udfordringer frem for problemer.

Du er god til tidsplanlægning og prioritering af din tid.

Du er en stærk leder og en dygtig købmand med lysten til at lære nyt.

Du er konkurrenceminded og trives med KPI-målinger på din og holdets performance.

Du er vant til travlhed og stor volumen samt klar på at omstille dig, når det kræves.

Du kan lide at gå forrest for et team, som leverer hver dag, og du holder altid hovedet koldt.

Du er iderig og kreativ og vil gå ekstra langt for at sikre en oplevelse udover forventningerne for alle vores gæster.

Holdet er internationalt, så du skal kunne tale og forstå både dansk og engelsk.





Vi tilbyder 

Som en del af Madklubben-familien med +40 restauranter, bliver du en del af et socialt fællesskab, hvor du finder et stærkt bagland til at hjælpe dig med at blive dygtigere og endnu mere succesfuld.  
Derudover tilbyder vi følgende:  


Gode uddannelses- og udviklingsmuligheder såsom f.eks. hospitality og lederkurser. 


Sociale arrangementer og personalefester. 

50% personalerabat til at besøge vores andre restauranter.  

Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Pension og helbredssikring (10/5 ordning). 





Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt 
Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, hvis den rigtige dukker op, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning allerede i dag.  
 
Opstart: Midt september-start oktober.
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Kontakt Gastronomisk chef Asger Klausen på asger@madklubben.dk.








Om Madklubben
Madklubben er én stor familie af restauranter i fordelt over hele landet.





Lige siden vi åbnede vores første restaurant i 2007, har vi haft en målsætning om at gøre restaurantbesøget tilgængeligt for flere i Danmark. Med langt over en million besøgende om året er vi godt på vej. Vi beskæftiger flere tusinde mennesker fordelt på 40+ restauranter, og vi har ambitioner om endnu flere. Derfor er vi altid på udkig efter talentfulde personligheder, der har lyst til at blive en del af Klubben.

title: Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate based in Ireland.

This is an opportunity to lead engaging, high-impact virtual learning experiences for diverse audiences developing skills in machine learning and AI data workflows. You will deliver live technical instruction in German while collaborating professionally in English with program and operations teams. The role combines technical expertise, instructional leadership, and the ability to make complex AI concepts practical and accessible. You will help learners understand how data labeling influences machine learning systems, generative AI, multimodal models, and applied AI workflows. Sessions may range from smaller groups to audiences of thousands of learners in a highly interactive online environment. You will also contribute to curriculum refinement and continuous course improvement. This is a part-time contract position with a remote setup and scheduled sessions aligned with the EST/CEST time zones.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and facilitate live virtual classes for diverse learner groups, potentially ranging from 100 to more than 8,000 participants, while maintaining strong engagement and an effective learning environment.
  • Deliver technical instruction in German on machine learning data workflows, generative AI, foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG, multimodal AI, responsible AI, and related concepts.
  • Explain how data collection, annotation, labeling decisions, model training, evaluation, and deployment are connected, helping learners understand the downstream impact of their work.
  • Manage virtual classroom dynamics, including Q&A, chat activity, pacing, learner engagement, and timely delivery of planned content.
  • Adapt instructional approaches, explanations, and lesson pacing to accommodate learners with different backgrounds and levels of technical understanding.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each lecture and ensure that technical content is delivered accurately, clearly, and in an accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with program and operations teams in English to support smooth delivery, communicate updates, escalate issues, and maintain alignment on schedules and learner needs.
  • Contribute to curriculum design and continuous improvement, including suggesting edits, refining lessons, and supporting the development of hands-on learning activities.
  • Provide constructive feedback before and after sessions to strengthen course quality and learner outcomes.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful, responsive, and empathetic presence when interacting with learners, colleagues, contractors, and guest speakers.

    • Requirements:

    • Fluency in German sufficient to deliver all instruction and learner support professionally, combined with strong English proficiency for written communication, meetings, alignment, and issue escalation.
    • Strong practical understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, model training, evaluation, and deployment, with the ability to explain how labeling decisions affect model behavior and downstream outputs.
    • Solid knowledge of generative AI and foundation models, including concepts such as pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and human feedback for model alignment.
    • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot prompting, and the ability to teach learners how to interpret requirements, identify task constraints, and evaluate output quality.
    • Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and production AI workflows, including the ability to explain how to assess outputs for relevance, faithfulness, and groundedness.
    • Understanding of multimodal and cross-modal AI, including how models process and generate text, images, audio, and video, and how these capabilities influence annotation and evaluation tasks.
    • Knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, confidentiality, security, bias awareness, and transparency principles relevant to data labeling and AI workflows.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality live virtual instruction, ideally to large and diverse audiences.
    • Experience supporting technical curriculum development, lesson refinement, skills labs, or similar instructional content.
    • Strong communication, presentation, empathy, adaptability, and classroom-management skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts easy to understand.
    • A positive and collaborative mindset, with strong attention to preparation, professionalism, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
    • Preferred: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) certification or equivalent expertise, particularly experience aligning training content with certification domains and supporting exam readiness.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work: Work remotely from Romania or another location compatible with the required time zone.
      • Part-time contract: Flexible engagement structured around scheduled instructional sessions and program needs.
      • Virtual-first environment: Deliver impactful learning experiences entirely online using modern virtual classroom tools.
      • High-impact teaching: Reach diverse learner populations and contribute to workforce development in AI and data.
      • Professional collaboration: Work alongside program, operations, and instructional teams in an international environment.
      • Curriculum involvement: Contribute ideas and expertise to the development and continuous improvement of technical training content.
      • Potential schedule flexibility: Program dates and lecture times may be adjusted depending on program requirements and instructor availability.
      • Inclusive environment: Participate in a learning culture focused on respect, accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity.

Er du nysgerrig på at arbejde i spændingsfeltet mellem jura og kommercielle hensyn? Som Legal Student i Telenor bliver du en del af et juridisk team, der arbejder tæt på forretningen og rådgiver om alt fra kontrakter, forbrugerret og markedsføring til privacy. Du får en alsidig studenterstilling, hvor du omsætter din teoretiske viden til praksis og opbygger værdifuld erfaring fra en af Danmarks største televirksomheder. Interesseret?



"Vi ser vores studenter som en vigtig del af teamet. Derfor får du ansvar og mulighed for at arbejde med reelle juridiske problemstillinger fra starten. Samtidig bliver du en del af et team, der gerne deler viden og giver dig plads til at udvikle både dine juridiske og kommercielle kompetencer."
 - Britt Bess Orbuch Røjtburg, Head of Legal Affairs



Du omsætter jura til praksis
Som studentermedhjælper i Legal Affairs bliver du en del af en central juridisk funktion i People & Corporate Affairs. Her understøtter vi forretningen i at finde løsninger, der både er juridisk holdbare og kommercielt bæredygtige. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af Norden og er involveret i både drift og strategiske initiativer i en kompleks og spændende reguleret branche. 


Du får mulighed for at omsætte din teoretiske viden til praksis gennem opgaver inden for blandt andet kontraktsret, forbrugerret, markedsføringsret og GDPR. Fra starten bliver du involveret i konkrete juridiske problemstillinger og får ansvar for egne opgaver. Samtidig arbejder du tæt sammen med teamets jurister og samarbejder med kolleger på tværs af forretningen, hvor der ofte skal findes løsninger, der balancerer juridiske og kommercielle hensyn. Rollen giver dig en bred indsigt i, hvordan jura anvendes i praksis i en af Danmarks største televirksomheder, og mulighed for at udvikle både dine juridiske kompetencer og din kommercielle forståelse gennem opgaver, der har betydning for både forretningen og vores kunder.



Du udvikler både dine juridiske og kommercielle kompetencer
Vi søger en studentermedhjælper, der har lyst til at omsætte sin juridiske viden til praksis og lære mere om samspillet mellem jura og forretning. Du er nysgerrig af natur og motiveres af at finde løsninger i samarbejde med både kolleger og forretningen.

Samtidig arbejder du struktureret og formår at bevare overblikket, også når du har flere opgaver i gang. Du har blik for detaljen, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og har lyst til at stille spørgsmål, gribe nye opgaver eller kaste dig over juridiske problemstillinger, som du ikke nødvendigvis har arbejdet med før.

Vi forestiller os, at du:


Læser stud.jur. eller stud.merc.jur.



Har interesse for kontraktsret, forbrugerret, markedsføringsret eller persondataret.



Er velorganiseret og har blik for detaljen uden at miste helheden



Trives med at samarbejde og skabe relationer på tværs af organisationen.



Er nysgerrig, initiativrig og bidrager med en løsningsorienteret tilgang.




En arbejdsplads fyldt med Fantastiske forbindelser 
Du bliver en del af en foranderlig organisation, hvor der, på tværs af forretningen, venter engagerede og dygtige kolleger, som kontinuerligt arbejder for at udvikle fremtidens teleselskab. Vi arbejder agilt, fokuserer indsatsområder ved hjælp af Kanban og praktiserer Tight-Loose-Tight som ledelsesfilosofi.

I teamet venter der dig 13 Fantastiske forbindelser fordelt mellem København og Aalborg. Vi har en uformel kultur med høj faglighed, tæt samarbejde og plads til humor i hverdagen. Vi trækker på hinandens viden og erfaringer, og der er altid mulighed for sparring med dygtige kolleger, så vi sammen finder de bedste løsninger. Som udgangspunkt vil din arbejdstid være ca. 15 timer om ugen med mulighed for tilpasning i forbindelse med studiet. Stillingen kan være placeret i enten København eller Aalborg.

Du er velkommen til at læse mere om os her.



Interesseret?
Har du spørgsmål eller vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Legal Affairs, Britt Bess Orbuch Røjtburg via mail BBEO@telenor.dk eller tlf. 60 50 61 42

Kan du se dig selv i rollen og har lyst til at blive vores nye Fantastiske forbindelse, søger du blot stillingen via linket her på siden. Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning, men vi ser gerne et CV fra dig. Derudover har du mulighed for at sætte et par ord på dig selv gennem vores ansøgningsskema.

Telenor er mere, end du tror. Med høj energi når vi vores ambitiøse mål i tværfaglige teams. Som mennesker er vi ligetil og udvikler hinanden. 

Vi udfordrer os selv og markedet ved at gå nye veje med vores innovative tankegang og teknologier. Med de nyeste løsninger og det mest effektive netværk skaber vi små mirakler i en verden, der aldrig står stille.  

Vores formål er at hjælpe mennesker med en sikker og stabil forbindelse til det, der betyder noget for dem. Vi er meget mere end simkort og smartphones. Vi er den digitale livsnerve, der forbinder mennesker, virksomheder og samfund.
