description:
Summary

We are looking for a highly capable and future-ready Senior Designer to join Scoot's Brand Studio.

The role combines strong design fundamentals with an openness to innovation and emerging technologies. Working across a wide range of brand, commercial and operational projects, the Designer will create, adapt and optimise creative assets while ensuring consistency with Scoot's visual identity.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong visual judgment, attention to detail and a passion for delivering effective design solutions. Beyond design execution, the role plays an important part in safeguarding Scoot's brand standards, improving creative workflows and leveraging AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and creative quality.

Job Description

Our ideal candidate is a versatile designer with strong foundations in visual communication, typography and digital design.

Equally comfortable working independently or with agency partners, the incumbent understands how design contributes to business and communication objectives and can translate creative concepts into compelling, effective deliverables across a variety of channels.

Responsibilities

Creative adaptation and production

  • Developing and adapting creative assets across digital, social, CRM, web, OOH, airport and onboard touchpoints.

  • Translating master campaign concepts into market-ready executions while maintaining creative integrity.

  • Designing assets that are fit for purpose, audience-centric and channel appropriate.

  • Managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and accuracy.

Brand stewardship

  • Acting as a guardian of Scoot's visual identity across all creative outputs.

  • Ensuring all assets adhere to established brand guidelines and design standards.

  • Reviewing and providing feedback on partner and agency-produced materials where required.

  • Identifying opportunities to strengthen visual consistency and brand impact.

AI-enabled design and innovation

  • Leveraging AI-powered creative tools to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery.

  • Applying emerging technologies to support concept visualisation, image generation, localisation and production workflows.

  • Continuously exploring new tools, trends and working methods that improve design effectiveness.

  • Contributing to the development of scalable and efficient creative workflows.

Creative quality and design thinking

  • Applying strong design principles including hierarchy, composition, typography and storytelling.

  • Challenging briefs and solutions where improvements can be made to clarity, usability or effectiveness.

  • Recommending more impactful approaches rather than simply executing requests.

  • - Staying current with evolving design, digital and content trends.

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Advertising, Multimedia Design or a related discipline preferred.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in graphic design, visual communications or creative production.

  • Experience working in an agency, brand or in-house creative environment.

  • Demonstrated portfolio showcasing strong digital and integrated marketing work.

  • Experience developing assets across multiple channels including digital, social, CRM and print.

  • Experience working within established brand systems and visual identity frameworks.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and workflows.

title: Product Counsel (Money Movement Legal - APAC)
description:
Product Counsel, Money Movement Legal (Asia-Pacific)

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Product Legal team at Stripe manages the legal and regulatory aspects of designing, building, and launching products and services. The team works on technical, commercial, and regulatory matters and advises product, engineering, and partnerships teams on issues across financial services, business, and technology.

This role supports the Money Movement and Storage business across Asia-Pacific. The business includes stored-value and e-money, foreign exchange, cross-border transfer, stablecoin and digital asset, and other financial products. The team helps ensure these products comply with applicable laws and regulations while supporting responsible product development and commercialization.

What you'll do

As Product Counsel, you'll advise teams on the legal and regulatory considerations for money movement products across Asia-Pacific. You'll partner with product, engineering, partnerships, compliance, risk, marketing, and Legal teams to navigate emerging requirements and bring products to market.

Responsibilities

  • Help the Product Legal team deliver products that comply with laws and contractual commitments to users globally
  • Advise product teams on the intersection of technological innovation, e-commerce user experiences, and financial services compliance
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, partnerships, compliance, risk, and marketing teams on product development and commercialization
  • Advise teams on new and emerging legal and regulatory developments, identify potential effects on business activities, and apply existing laws to new technologies
  • Partner with colleagues across the global Legal team to support regulatory structures, customer agreements, and strategic financial partnerships
  • Scope and build scalable processes for legal review and product launches
  • Stay up to date on money movement laws and regulations, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior managers

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a qualified lawyer in a law firm, in-house legal team, or government agency, with expertise in payment services laws and regulations, such as the Payment Services Act of Singapore
  • Qualification to practice law, preferably in a jurisdiction in Asia-Pacific
  • Experience advising technology teams and translating complex legal requirements into clear, actionable advice
  • Ability to collaborate with teammates, share knowledge, understand complex business models and product use cases, and exercise sound judgment with imperfect information
  • Strong written and verbal communication, project management, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience advising on the development of stablecoin and digital asset products, particularly across multiple regions
  • Experience supporting legal, regulatory, or commercial matters for money movement or financial services products

Butik

























Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.


Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse - på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

title: Sr. Adviseur bedrijfsvoering financiën
description:
Jouw meerwaarde als Sr. Adviseur bedrijfsvoering financiën

Als Sr. Adviseur bedrijfsvoering financiën bij de Dienst Automatisering speel je een sleutelrol in een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. Jij brengt overzicht, structuur en richting in een complexe IT-omgeving waar samenwerking, continuïteit en innovatie centraal staan. Op strategisch en tactisch niveau verbind je het Diensthoofd, teamleiders en de afdeling Financieel Economische Zaken en zorg je dat risico’s, afhankelijkheden en knelpunten tijdig zichtbaar worden.

Met jouw scherpe blik en verbindende aanpak help je teams om beter te sturen op planning, prognoses en resultaten. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar heldere stuurinformatie en concrete handelingsopties, zodat het Diensthoofd goed onderbouwde keuzes kan maken. Tegelijkertijd houd je grip op budgetten, prognoses en operationele processen en zorg je dat alles soepel verloopt.

De dynamiek van de Dienst Automatisering vraagt om iemand die snel schakelt, overzicht houdt en mensen weet mee te nemen. In een omgeving met veel onderlinge afhankelijkheden en externe partijen zorg jij voor samenhang, duidelijke kaders en sterke regie over teams en projecten heen. Daarmee lever je direct een bijdrage aan een betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige dienstverlening binnen de Tweede Kamer.

Belangrijkste taken

Je:

  • adviseert het Diensthoofd en de teamleiders over bedrijfsvoering, sturing en risico’s;

  • stelt het jaarplan van de afdeling op;

  • ondersteunt en daagt teamleiders uit bij prognoses, capaciteit en planning;

  • signaleert en analyseert knelpunten en risico’s die meerdere teams raken en zorgt voor samenhangende oplossingen;

  • bewaakt het overzicht en de samenhang in de bedrijfsvoering binnen een complexe IT-omgeving;

  • coördineert de operationele bedrijfsvoering en stuurt circa 2 fte ondersteuning functioneel aan;

  • bent eerste aanspreekpunt voor FEZ en bewaakt budgetten, prognoses en realisatie;

  • zorgt voor afstemming en regie tussen interne en externe stakeholders, inclusief externe project- en programmamanagers;

  • vertaalt informatie naar concrete adviezen en stuurinformatie voor besluitvorming;

  • draagt bij aan het verbeteren en professionaliseren van processen en werkwijzen binnen de bedrijfsvoering.

Wat we jou bieden

  • Een betekenisvolle functie in een unieke werkomgeving waar je direct bijdraagt aan het functioneren van de democratie.

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.818,39 en € 7.094,18 bruto per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek. De functie is ingedeeld in schaal 12. Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van kennis en ervaring; indien van toepassing kan een aanloopschaal worden toegepast.

  • De arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO Rijk. Functies binnen de Tweede Kamer worden gewaardeerd volgens het functiewaarderingssysteem FUWASYS.

  • Een maandelijks individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,50% dat je bijvoorbeeld kunt laten uitbetalen of kunt omzetten in vakantiedagen.

  • Extra vrije dagen, 64 uur (IKB-uren), op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.

  • Een pensioen bij het ABP.

  • Alle nodige faciliteiten om jezelf persoonlijk en professioneel verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Aanvullende regelingen voor bijvoorbeeld ouderschapsverlof.

  • Een vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer.

  • Je krijgt maximaal € 750 voor de meubilering en stoffering van je thuiswerkplek. Aanvullend kun je maximaal € 750 van je IKB-budget inzetten.

  • De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

Wat we van je vragen

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde, finance of bedrijfseconomie.

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring in een adviserende rol op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering, financiën of control binnen een complexe organisatie.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen en het talent om structuur, overzicht en samenhang aan te brengen in complexe vraagstukken.

  • Goede communicatieve en adviesvaardigheden, met het vermogen om op strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau te schakelen en stevig gesprekspartner te zijn voor management en stakeholders.

  • Een zelfstandige, verbindende en stressbestendige werkstijl, passend binnen een dynamische en politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving.

Waar je komt te werken

Je komt te werken in het tijdelijke onderkomen van de Tweede Kamer aan de Bezuidenhoutseweg 67, op loopafstand van station Den Haag Centraal.

Je maakt deel uit van de Dienst Automatisering bestaande uit ongeveer 120 medewerkers. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor een betrouwbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige informatievoorziening en IT-dienstverlening voor de Tweede Kamer. De dienst ondersteunt Kamerleden en medewerkers dagelijks met moderne digitale werkplekken, applicaties, infrastructuur, informatiebeveiliging en IT-projecten.

De Dienst Automatisering bestaat uit verschillende teams, waaronder beheer, servicedesk, informatiebeveiliging, architectuur, projecten en bedrijfsvoering. Jouw team, bedrijfsvoering, bestaat uit een compacte groep professionals die zich richt op financiële sturing, planning, control en ondersteuning van het management. Samen zorgen jullie voor overzicht, samenhang en een solide basis voor de dienstverlening van de Tweede Kamer.

Bijzonderheden

  • Als onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure vragen wij, in het kader van ons integriteitsbeleid, een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

Meteen solliciteren

title: Project Manager (Software Engineering Research)
description:
Our Software Engineering Research Department focuses on integrating scientific innovation into JetBrains products. Leveraging our expertise in research and academic collaborations, we ensure our tools remain at the forefront of technology.

We're seeking a diligent and proactive individual to join us, helping to streamline our operations and foster closer collaboration between JetBrains teams. By taking on organizational responsibilities, you'll enable our tech specialists to concentrate on driving innovation and adding even more value to the company.

What you will do:

As a Project Manager for our Research Department, you'll play a central role in the department's core activities. Here’s a quick glance at your responsibilities:

  • Process management: Crafting and maintaining robust processes to ensure our projects deliver research outcomes efficiently and consistently, even when dealing with the inherent unpredictability of research — from evolving goals and unexpected outcomes to shifting requirements and unforeseen technical challenges.

  • Support across projects: Providing comprehensive support to teams across various projects, handling administrative, organizational, and legal tasks to ensure smooth operations.

  • Promoting transparency and collaboration: Acting as a bridge for transparent and collaborative relationships between our team and other stakeholders involved in our projects.

  • Communication facilitation: Utilizing communication channels effectively to synchronize efforts and ensure alignment among all stakeholders, keeping everyone informed and engaged.

  • Thorough task analysis: Delving deep into project tasks, meticulously analyzing and verifying their completeness and accuracy to set the stage for success.

What you should bring to the table:

  • Process management mastery: Demonstrated expertise in setting up and managing processes to navigate projects with high levels of uncertainty, ensuring both timeliness and quality. Knowledge of SDLC and frameworks is a plus.

  • Technical background: Understanding of ML and AI principles. Ability to facilitate technical discussions and identify potential risks and challenges associated with ML/AI projects.

  • Effective communication: Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with a talent for facilitating seamless information flow and fostering alignment among diverse stakeholders.

  • Analytical rigor: Strong analytical capabilities, enabling you to dive deep into project tasks, ensuring meticulous definition of scope and requirements and effective execution for optimal outcomes. A background as a system or business analyst could be beneficial.

  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, quickly adapting to evolving project requirements and priorities.

  • Detail-oriented organization: Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, enabling you to manage multiple tasks and projects concurrently without compromising quality.

Even if you don’t fit 100% of the above criteria, feel free to apply anyway! We’re looking for someone who’s eager to learn, and we’ll provide all the mentoring and support you might need.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

 Som rådgiver i vores lokale bank i Køge Bugt får du mulighed for at kombinere vores engagement i lokalområdet med alle de muligheder og fordele, vi som foreningsejet bank kan tilbyde vores kunder og kolleger. Vi er nemlig ikke helt som de andre - og det vil du også mærke, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som seniorprivatrådgiver.

Det indebærer, at du er nysgerrig og opsøgende, så du får afdækket kundernes behov - også dem, de ikke selv har fået øje på endnu. Du får en bred produktportefølje og en række digitale værktøjer at gøre godt med, og kombineret med din høje faglighed formår du at finde den bedste løsning til netop de kunder, du arbejder med.

  Nogle af dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver: 
 
 Skabe nye kundeforhold og udvikle din egen portefølje. 

 Sikre en effektiv og nærværende kundeoplevelse. 

 Bygge relationer gennem dialog, tillid og professionel rådgivning. 

 Bidrage aktivt til et fagligt dygtigt teammiljø, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode. 
 
 Er det dig, vi leder efter?
 Vi ser gerne, at du: 
 
 er finansielt uddannet og har erfaring med rådgivning inden for investering, pension, bolig og daglig økonomi, 

 er nysgerrig og motiveret, og du formår at se helheden i kundens økonomi, 

 trives i en udadvendt og opsøgende rolle, 

 er dygtig kommunikativt og finder motivation i relationer, 

 bidrager aktivt til fælles løsninger og teamets samlede succes.  
 
 Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. 

 Dit nye team
 Du bliver en del af byens bedste Lokalbank med 35 engagerede kolleger, og du vil blive en del af et større kompetencecenter, hvor der er privatrådgivere, totalrådgivere og erhvervsrådgivere.

Vi ikke bare håber, men forventer, at du kommer til at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt, mens du er ansat hos os. Du vil blive mødt med komplekse opgaver, og din erfaring udvikles gennem sparring med specialister og kolleger. title: Sr. Clinical Quality Auditor - Shockwave Medical
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Clinical Quality Auditor – Shockwave Medical based in United States.

This fully remote role provides critical quality oversight across clinical studies supporting innovative medical device therapies.
You’ll lead and support GCP and compliance audits across internal teams, investigative sites, and external clinical vendors.
The position plays an important role in maintaining regulatory readiness and ensuring clinical research activities meet global quality standards.
You’ll work closely with clinical, quality, regulatory, and external partners across multiple studies and projects.
The role combines independent audit leadership, compliance expertise, procedural improvement, and inspection readiness.
It offers the opportunity to influence clinical quality systems while working in a fast-paced, highly regulated MedTech environment.
Success requires sound judgment, meticulous attention to detail, strong communication, and the ability to operate confidently with limited supervision.

Accountabilities:

  • Serve as a Clinical Quality Auditor Lead for clinical trials, supporting project teams in maintaining compliance with applicable national and international medical device regulations and GCP requirements.
  • Support the development of audit management plans, risk-based audit strategies, and audit plans for ongoing clinical studies.
  • Conduct internal system audits and external investigative site and vendor audits in accordance with GCP and applicable regulatory expectations.
  • Lead initial and ongoing audits of clinical study vendors, including CROs, imaging core laboratories, central laboratories, and other third-party partners.
  • Document and communicate audit findings to management, provide recommendations for resolution, and verify that appropriate corrective and preventive actions are implemented and documented.
  • Identify, assess, and escalate site, vendor, and study-related compliance issues as appropriate.
  • Support regulatory authority inspections and assist clinical study sites and internal teams with inspection preparation and readiness activities.
  • Develop, review, and revise standard operating procedures, work instructions, forms, templates, and other quality documentation.
  • Participate in the development and implementation of departmental procedures and continuous quality improvement initiatives.
  • Deliver or support training programs covering GCP, inspection readiness, and other clinical quality topics.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, external vendors, clinical research teams, and regulatory partners.
  • Manage multiple audits and quality initiatives while adapting to changing priorities, timelines, and project requirements.
  • Work independently once projects are assigned while exercising sound judgment and maintaining consistent communication with relevant stakeholders.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline or related field.
    • 5+ years of experience directly supporting clinical research, quality assurance, or a relevant medical/scientific function.
    • Demonstrated experience conducting audits of clinical research vendors and investigative sites.
    • Experience interacting with regulatory authority inspectors and supporting clinical study sites through regulatory inspections.
    • Proven experience reviewing and revising SOPs, procedures, work instructions, or related quality documentation.
    • Thorough knowledge and practical application of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant medical device requirements, including FDA regulations, ISO 14155, and MDR.
    • Experience supporting medical device pre-market and/or post-market clinical studies.
    • Medical device industry experience strongly preferred, ideally with exposure to cardiovascular therapies or clinical research.
    • Basic understanding of peripheral and coronary artery disease and related therapies preferred.
    • ACRP or SOCRA certification is preferred.
    • Strong independent thinking, planning, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, combined with the ability to operate independently and influence stakeholders across functions.
    • High attention to detail and accuracy, with a strong commitment to quality and compliance.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and projects.
    • Flexible and adaptable approach to changing business and regulatory requirements.
    • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30–40% domestically and internationally.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position within the United States.
      • Anticipated base salary range of $91,000–$147,200 USD.
      • Eligibility to participate in a long-term incentive program.
      • Retirement benefits including pension and 401(k) savings plan participation, subject to applicable plan terms.
      • 120 hours of vacation per calendar year.
      • 40 hours of sick time per calendar year, with higher allocations in certain states.
      • 13 paid holidays, including floating holidays, per calendar year.
      • Up to 40 hours of Work, Personal and Family Time annually.
      • Up to 480 hours of parental leave within one year following birth, adoption, or foster care placement.
      • Bereavement leave for eligible family circumstances.
      • Caregiver leave of up to 80 hours in a rolling 52-week period.
      • 32 hours of volunteer leave per calendar year.
      • 80 hours of military spouse time-off per calendar year.
      • Opportunities to contribute to innovative medical device clinical research and strengthen expertise in global GCP and regulatory compliance.
      • Collaborative environment with exposure to clinical quality, regulatory, and external research partners.

About Hevo

Hevo moves data for more than 2,000 companies, including IcelandAir, Shopify, Postman, ThoughtSpot. What looks simple on the surface sits on top of some of the most complex machinery in software: pipelines pulling from 150+ sources, running every hour of every day, failing in a hundred different ways and recovering before anyone notices.

Your job is to make all of that feel obvious.

This is one of the harder product design jobs going in India right now, and we want you to know that upfront. You are not designing a three-screen consumer app or a marketing site. You are designing for data engineers and analysts. They are technical, they are in a hurry, and they have no patience for design that gets in their way. If a workflow confuses them, they do not "figure it out." They leave. Good design here is not decoration. It is the product.

One more thing before you read further: this role is AI-first, and we mean it as a requirement, not a bonus. We explain exactly what that means below. Please read it closely.

What you will own

The experience of complex workflows. You will own the UX for the hard, high-stakes parts of the product end to end, from research and problem framing to the final shipped screen. Large scope, real ambiguity, technical users.

The full design process, not a slice of it. User journeys, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity mockups. You take a fuzzy problem and turn it into something people can actually use, then you stand in front of product, engineering, and customers and explain why you made the calls you made.

The design system. You will extend and strengthen the system that keeps the Hevo dashboard feeling like one product instead of ten. Consistency at our scale is a real, engineering-grade problem, not a coat of paint.

Shipping, measured. You will watch how people actually use what you built, read the data honestly, and change your mind when the numbers tell you to. Designers who fall in love with their first idea do not do well here.

The bar for the whole team. You will push product and engineering to care about the details most teams skip: accessibility, edge cases, the unglamorous states. Seniority here means raising everyone's standard, not just doing your own work well.

What "AI-first" means here

We mean two things, and we need both.

One: you design AI-native products, not old screens with an AI button bolted on. The best software today is being rebuilt around what AI can now do: agents, generation, suggestions, systems that act on a user's behalf. These experiences behave differently from the deterministic screens most of us grew up designing. They are probabilistic. They are wrong sometimes. They need new patterns for trust, control, and letting a user correct the machine. You should have real opinions on how to design for this, and ideally, work that shows it.

Two: AI is part of your daily craft. You use it to research faster, generate directions, write product copy, and build working prototypes in hours instead of weeks. You are not precious about doing everything by hand. The strongest designers we are meeting today treat AI like the sharpest junior on their team and direct it well. That is the bar we are hiring against.

If you are curious about AI but have not actually shipped with it, this role will be a stretch, and we would rather say that now than waste your time.

Who you are

  • 4 to 8 years designing and shipping real products inside a cross-functional team. In-house, not agency-only.

  • SaaS background. You have designed software that businesses pay for and rely on every day. This is a requirement.

  • Web app design experience. You have designed complex, interactive web applications, not just websites, mobile screens, or brand work. This is a requirement.

  • AI-first, in both senses above. This is a requirement.

  • Strong UX for technical or enterprise products. You are comfortable when the subject matter is hard and the users know more than you do.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking, not just your pixels. We want to see the problem, the messy middle, the decisions you made, and the result.

  • Fluent in the tools, Figma above all, plus whatever helps you prototype and test quickly.

  • A strong communicator. You can explain a design decision to an engineer, a PM, and a customer, and win each of them over on the merits.

Why this is worth your time

At most companies, design sits at the end of the line. Someone hands you a spec, you make it look good, it ships. Not here.


At Hevo, design decides whether a deeply technical product feels human or feels like a machine you have to fight. You will sit with product and engineering from day one, not get handed the leftovers. Your work goes live in front of teams at companies like DoorDash and Shopify. It is not a demo that dies in a folder.


We are a Series B company, backed by Sequoia, Chiratae, and Qualgro, building category-defining technology out of India for the world. The hard product work happens here in Bangalore. This is a rare seat: senior enough to own a real surface, early enough that what you build shapes the whole product.


If making genuinely complex things feel simple is the work you want to be known for, we should talk.

Kan du motivere branchens bedste kolleger og bidrage til, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar? Så er du måske vores nye souschef.

Hos Lidl bliver du en del af Europas største dagligvarekæde med 150+ butikker i Danmark. Sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, og på #teamlidl kommer du med på en succesfuld rejse -- på et hold med høje ambitioner til fælles. Vi har brug for stærke ledere, der giver vores medarbejdere retning og overskud, så vi sammen skaber rammerne for landets bedste indkøbsoplevelse.
Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.
   




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

title: Dækmontør til aftenhold hos Audi Hørsholm - En del af Semler Mobility Joboplysninger | SEMLER
description:
Dækmontør til aftenhold hos Audi Hørsholm - En del af Semler Mobility
     
                         
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Job ID: 
         

     4566
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Sted: 
         

     
			
 

					 Kokkedal, DK, 2980
					 
			 


			
     
                 

             

         

     

    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
                 
 Er du klar til at blive en del af et stærkt team, hvor tempo, kvalitet og godt humør går hånd i hånd? Så er du måske vores nye dækmontør til den kommende hjulskiftesæson. 


   


 Om jobbet
 Som dækmontør hos Audi Hørsholm bliver du en vigtig del af vores team i hjulskiftesæsonen. 


   


 Du får blandt andet ansvar for: 

 

 Professionelt hjulskifte på premiumbiler 


 Kontrol af dæktryk, slid og skader, da vi ikke går på kompromis med sikkerheden 


 Afbalancering af hjul for optimal kørekomfort 


 Rengøring og opmærkning af hjul til opbevaring 


 Samarbejde med teknikere og værkstedsledelse for at sikre en effektiv drift 


 Kvalitetssikring af dit arbejde, så vores kunder altid får den bedste oplevelse 

 

   


 Du bliver en del af et team, hvor effektivitet, kvalitet og præcision er nøgleord, og hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen for at sikre, at hver bil forlader værkstedet i topform. 


   


 Stillingen er på vores aftenhold mandag til torsdag kl. 15.30-21.00. Det er en tidsbegrænset ansættelse på ca. 2-3 måneder med opstart den 14. september, men med mulighed for en eventuel fastansættelse for den rette person. 


   


 Om dig
 Vi leder efter dig, der: 

 

 Trives i et højt tempo og bevarer overblikket 


 Har øje for detaljer og leverer høj kvalitet hver gang 


 Er en holdspiller med godt humør, som bidrager positivt til teamet 

 

   


 Derudover forventer vi, at du har kørekort (minimum kategori B). 


   


 Erfaring med hjulskifte, dækmontering eller andet værkstedsarbejde samt kendskab til Audi er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi lægger større vægt på din motivation og lyst til at lære, og sørger for en grundig oplæring, så du får de nødvendige kompetencer til rollen. 


   


 Om os
 Audi Hørsholm er en del af Semler Gruppen, som har over 100 års erfaring inden for import og salg af biler, og består af mere end 3.000 medarbejdere. Vores specialiserede medarbejdere og mangeårige erfaring giver os en stærk placering på markedet. Det kræver at vi er dedikerede og sætter en ære i vores arbejde hver eneste dag. 


   


 Vi tilbyder løn efter kvalifikationer, pension, sundhedssikring og en hel del andre fordelagtige medarbejdergoder samt muligheden for at blive en vigtig del af en stor og professionel organisation. 


   


 Lyder det som noget for dig?
 Så vil vi se frem til at se din ansøgning. Vi indkalder løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag. 


   


 Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Værkstedchef Lars la Cour Kramer på mail larkr@audi.dk 


   


 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

                 
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
     
                 

             

         

     


    
 
        
 
         

     

                                         

                                        
 
    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
  

     

    
    
 
        
   Din vej. Fælles fremtid  


 Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.   



 At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.  



 Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.   



 Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i.   



 Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.   



 Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.  



 Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Digital solutions - front-end developer
description:
Overview

The Front‑end Developer 2 is responsible for the front‑end development of sci ORIAN™, a cloud‑based Service & Application Solution platform that enhances Kemin's existing products and services. In collaboration with both internal and external developers, all custom dashboards and applications for the platform are analyzed, shaped, and developed. These include, but are not limited to, data visualizations, user flows, internationalization, reports, customized notifications, and mobile development. A key role is played in the entire application development cycle, from analysis to development and release. Additionally, technical support is provided to the Digital Solutions management team throughout the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities Work in a cross‑functional team to deliver data‑driven digital solutions from specification through implementation and deployment (CICD). Take ownership of features, collaborate with domain experts, and contribute to architectural decisions. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code that meets project requirements. Develop deeper understanding of programming concepts, architectures, and technologies. Contribute to the development of the product architecture with attention to UI/UX and performance. Conduct thorough testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and software upgrades to validate functionality and ensure high‑quality deliverables. Work independently or facilitate a team to address user‑reported bugs and provide quick resolutions to issues reported in production applications. Create and maintain up‑to‑date documentation of code, (non‑)functional application requirements, business processes, workflows, systems architecture, features and user guides ensuring that relevant information is easily accessible. Stay up to date with the latest software development trends, technologies, and frameworks. Collaborate effectively within an agile team environment, actively participating in daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Communicate daily work, challenges, and solutions, share ideas and receive feedback constructively with team members. Play a pro‑active role in beta testing and market introduction of sci ORIAN™. Qualifications Bachelor or Master’s Degree in Information Technology, Electronics‑ICT, Computer Science, Software Engineering or comparable relevant. Minimum 5‑10 years of experience in software development. ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCES Excellent analytical skills (critical thinking, data analysis, research, communication, problem solving, …). Proficient with web development technologies (Angular, Java Script/Type Script, HTML5, …). Strong UI programming skills (s/CSS, responsive design, handicap access, …). Experience with frontend frameworks and tools (Ng Rx, ECharts, Rx JS, Storybook, Nx Monorepo, …). Experience with UI and UX design projects. Experience with development in an international environment (translations, units, time zones, …). Experience with mobile development (PWA, Ionic, …). Familiar with Agile practices (Azure Dev Ops). Creative, critical mind and design knowledge. Highly motivated, with an outgoing personality, well organized and able to work independently and in a team. Willing to join a strategic fast‑growing solution platform at Kemin and committed to contributing to its success. Communicate fluently English. ADDITIONAL DESIRED/TYPICAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES Interested in Io T architecture - from connectivity to aggregation, analytics, and visualization layers. Affinity for industrial automation. Experience in feed mill and/or rendering process technology is a plus. Experience with liquid dosing techniques is a plus. PHYSICAL EFFORT NEEDED

Sitting, concentrating, and utilizing computer for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of telephone/email communication, and verbal communication. Some light lifting (5 kg) periodically is possible, as well as bending, pushing, climbing stairs, reaching, walking, and standing for extended period of time are possible.

TRAVEL Travel may be required.

Vores SBS PenduLift er et fleksibelt og pladsbesparende transportsystem til transport af løsvarer og anvendes i bl.a. fødevare- og procesindustrien hos kunder i både Danmark og udlandet. Vi arbejder med kundetilpassede løsninger, hvor maskinerne opbygges i moduler og tilpasses den enkelte kundes behov. Som værkstedsmontør bliver du en del af arbejdet med at samle og klargøre disse maskiner på vores værksted i Høng, ligesom der vil være mulighed for at komme med ud til kunder i forbindelse med service og installation. Derudover repræsenterer vi Goudsmit Magnetics Group BV og MESUTRONIC Gerätebau GmbH i Danmark.

Kan du tage medansvar for den daglige drift i butikken og bidrage til, at kunderne får en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye salgsleder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et verdensklasse sammenhold, og sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Vi investerer i dig som medarbejder, og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.




Om jobbet


Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse 

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Åbne og/eller lukke butikken

Bestille varer hjem til butikken




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen

Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives med en travl hverdag

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter

Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Klik på "Søg nu"

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

title: FORCIT Defence, IT Systems and Cyber Security Specialist
description:
FORCIT on johtava räjähteiden ja puolustusjärjestelmien valmistaja sekä niihin liittyvien palvelujen toimittaja. Jatkuva tuotekehitys, vahva ammattitaito ja nykyaikainen teknologia takaavat korkealaatuiset tuotteet. FORCIT-konserni työllistää tällä hetkellä yli 800 henkilöä. Tutustu meihin tarkemmin osoitteessa .

Haemme vahvistusta ICT tiimiimme,

IT Systems and Cyber Security Specialist

Työskentelet FORCIT Defence-liiketoimintayksikön ICT tiimissä tehden tiivistä yhteistyötä Defence liiketoiminnan ja FORCIT-konsernin ICT-tiimin kanssa. Työtehtäväsi jakautuvat tietojärjestelmien hallinnan, laiteasennusten, käyttäjätuen, kyber- ja tietoturvaan liittyvien tehtävien välillä.

Pääasialliset vastuualueesi:

  • Kyber- ja tietoturvan kehittäminen yhdessä toimittajiemme ja konsernin IT-tiimin kanssa.

  • Päivittäiset IT-järjestelmiin, kyberturvaan, tietoturvaan ja vaatimustenmukaisuuteen liittyvät hallinnolliset tehtävät.

  • Tietoturvakäytäntöjen ja -linjausten määrittely, jalkautus ja kouluttaminen.

  • Loppukäyttäjien tukeminen ICT:n ja tietoturvaan liittyvissä ongelmissa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

  • Hyvää osaamista Microsoft Windows-käyttöjärjestelmistä, M365:sta, MS AD:sta ja -Entra ID:sta.

  • Loppukäyttäjän laitteiden tietoturvan tuntemus (koventamiset, päivitykset, haavoittuvuuksien hallinta).

  • Vähintään kahden vuoden kokemus tietoturvan hallinnasta IT-alalla - tai vähintään 5 vuoden kokonaiskokemus IT-alalta.

  • Perustiedot joistakin tunnetuimmista tietoturvakehyksistä ja -säännöksistä (esim. ISO27001, KATAKRI tai NIST Cyber Security Framework).

  • Olet oma-aloitteinen tiimipelaaja, jolla on kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja halu positiiviseen muutokseen.

  • Verkko-osaaminen ja aikaisempi kokemus kyberturvallisuus tehtävistä ovat eduksi.

Miksi liittyä meihin?

FORCIT tarjoaa sinulle monipuolisen ja joustavan työn, jossa voit näyttää kykysi ja vaikuttaa työpäiväsi sisältöön, kilpailukykyisen palkan ja edut (mm. joustavan työajan, ravintoedun, e-Passin kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedun sekä bonuspalkkiojärjestelmän), mukaan lukien mahdollisuudet ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista työtäsi tukevaa tiimiä ja sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa osana yrityksemme menestystä.

Jos koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, lähetä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut heti soveltuvien henkilöiden haettua paikkaa, kuitenkin viimeistään 30.8.2026 mennessä.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, mutta mahdollisimman pian. Tehtävä sijoittuu Tampereen toimipisteeseemme.

Tehtävään valitulle tullaan tekemään turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumetesti.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lisätietoja sinulle antaa rekrytointikumppanimme Adeccon konsultti, Sari Ojanen, sari.ojanen@adecco.fi

title: Research Software Engineer
description:
Role type: Full Time; Fixed term for 2 years
Faculty: Medicine, Dentistry & Health Sciences
Department: Department of Infectious Diseases
Salary: Level A - $83,368 $113,862 OR Level B.1 $124,656 - $148,023 p.a. plus 17% super

  • Work at a world-leading infectious diseases institute / build cutting-edge data platforms / support global pandemic therapeutics
  • Join us to design robust data systems that accelerate research breakthroughs in infection and immunity.
  • Investing in you – 17% superannuation, benefits package including salary packaging, health and wellbeing programs, discounted services, and professional development opportunities.

The University of Melbourne
We take pride in our people, who all contribute to our mission to benefit society through the transformative impact of education and research. Discover more via our website.

Your next career opportunity
In this role, you will design and deliver data systems that power CGCPT’s pandemic therapeutics research.
You will link complex biological and clinical datasets, enabling advanced AI and analytics across the Doherty Institute.
You will collaborate with leading scientists and clinicians while growing your expertise in health data engineering.

What you will deliver:

  • Design and maintain databases and data-lakes that securely store and retrieve diverse biological and clinical data.
  • Develop software infrastructure to link pathogen, immune response, clinical and epidemiological data at sample level.
  • Implement data integration and sharing workflows that enable AI/ML training and analytics within and beyond CGCPT.
  • Partner with governance, ethics, executive and research stakeholders to align data solutions with approvals and strategy.
  • Contribute to grant proposals, presentations, seminars and supervision activities that strengthen data science capacity.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Hold a Bachelor or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
  • Bring proven experience delivering software engineering projects, from design through implementation and ongoing maintenance.
  • Develop and optimise databases using SQL or similar technologies, including solutions for data integration.
  • Use Git and GitHub confidently to manage code, version control, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Build modern web applications with JavaScript or TypeScript, Node.js and contemporary web frameworks.
  • Demonstrate strong self-management, stakeholder engagement and communication skills within multidisciplinary environments.

For further information, please refer to the attached PD.

What we offer you!
We offer the opportunity to be part of a vibrant community and enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits to support your success and sense of fulfilment, including:

  • Build future financial security with 17% superannuation
  • Supportive flexible work arrangements underpinned by our commitment to inclusion and well-being
  • Career development opportunities, including access to a range of tailored programs, such as Academic Women in Leadership, and learning platforms including LinkedIn Learning
  • Progressive, considerate leave provisions to empower your work-life balance and well-being, including leading parental leave, gender affirmation leave and cultural leave
  • Salary packaging and access to a range of discounted services including Bupa health insurance, and access to unique cultural and recreational benefits such as discounts for the Melbourne Theatre Company
  • Health and well-being services including a leading Employee Assistance Program

For more information check out our benefits page!

Your new team –
The Peter Doherty Institute is a world-leading centre for infectious diseases and immunity, with proven global impact.
Within it, the Department of Infectious Diseases, CGCPT and Computational Sciences Initiative unite clinicians, scientists and data experts.
Together, they harness cutting-edge computational and data sciences to transform pandemic preparedness and therapeutic discovery. Joining this team, you will collaborate across disciplines, access rich datasets, and drive meaningful health outcomes.

title: Senior Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead, Beijing
description:
Help Shape the Future of Biotechnology

At CSL, our work saves lives.

As one of the world's leading biotechnology companies, we are driven by a promise to patients and a commitment to advancing scientific innovation. Every day, our teams work at the intersection of breakthrough science, cutting-edge technology, and global collaboration to develop therapies that improve and save lives.

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead to serve as CSL's senior representative within one of the world's leading biotechnology innovation hubs. This highly visible role offers a unique opportunity to influence CSL's future pipeline by connecting groundbreaking science, entrepreneurial innovation, and strategic business partnerships.

Working at the forefront of external innovation, you will help identify transformative opportunities, shape CSL's presence across the biotech ecosystem, and position the company as the partner of choice for researchers, entrepreneurs, investors, and emerging biotechnology companies.

This is more than a business development role. It is an opportunity to help bring the next generation of therapies to patients around the world.

What You'll Do

As CSL's senior leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, you will:

Build CSL's Presence and Influence

  • Act as the face of CSL across the local biotechnology, academic, venture capital, and innovation community.
  • Elevate CSL's reputation as a trusted partner, collaborator, and investor in breakthrough science.
  • Develop new partnership opportunities that strengthen CSL's strategic presence and innovation pipeline.

Discover the Next Breakthrough

  • Identify and source high-value external innovation opportunities aligned with CSL's therapeutic area strategies and long-term portfolio priorities.
  • Monitor emerging scientific advancements, disruptive technologies, and evolving industry trends.
  • Provide critical market intelligence on competitive activity, innovation hotspots, and ecosystem developments.

Create Meaningful Partnerships

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across leading universities, research institutes, incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, and biotechnology companies.
  • Connect external innovators with CSL's scientific experts, business leaders, and decision makers.
  • Represent CSL at major scientific, investment, and industry events, ensuring strong visibility and engagement.

Lead Strategic Transactions

  • Play a senior leadership role on regional business development and licensing opportunities.
  • Support transactions from early opportunity identification through evaluation, due diligence, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner closely with R&D, Business Development, Legal, and Therapeutic Area leaders to assess and advance opportunities.

Influence the Broader Industry

  • Pursue leadership positions on industry boards, advisory committees, and professional associations.
  • Represent CSL's perspective in shaping the future direction of the biotechnology sector.
  • Foster strong connections across government, industry, academic, and investment communities.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 12+ years of experience within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, business development, external innovation, venture investing, or related fields.
  • Strong track record of building strategic partnerships and generating high-value deal flow.
  • Demonstrated success identifying, evaluating, and executing external innovation opportunities.
  • Deep understanding of the regional biotechnology ecosystem and key industry stakeholders.

Leadership and Influence

  • Established credibility with biotechnology executives, academic leaders, investors, and scientific communities.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders and operate effectively within complex global organisations.

Scientific Expertise

  • Advanced scientific or medical degree required (PhD, MD, PharmD, or equivalent).
  • Strong ability to evaluate scientific innovation and emerging technologies.

Additional Requirements

  • Fluency in Mandarin.
  • Experience operating within the local regulatory, business, and innovation environment.
  • Willingness to travel and represent CSL across the broader regional ecosystem.

Why CSL?

At CSL, you'll join a purpose-driven organisation with a proud heritage of scientific innovation and a global footprint spanning more than 100 countries.

You'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in biotechnology, helping to shape a pipeline of innovations that have the potential to transform patient outcomes worldwide.

Together, we are driven by a simple but powerful purpose: to save lives and protect the health of people around the world.

If you're passionate about science, partnerships, and unlocking the next generation of medical breakthroughs, we'd love to hear from you

​

About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.


CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit and CSL Plasma at .

Our Benefits

For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.

You Belong at CSL

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

title: Senior SOC Verification Engineer
description:
Overview

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantage to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the Verification & Validation team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

#SCHIE #CSME



Responsibilities

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

  • Establish yourself as an integral member of a pre-silicon SoC verification team, owning aspects of performance verification, and aligning with architecture, design, firmware, and emulation
  • Become knowledgeable on the overall SoC architecture, including tradeoffs that effect power and performance
  • Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies
  • Apply your knowledge of performance verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral
  • Run tests, correlate results with architecture, debug failures to root cause, recommend fixes
  • Apply your growth mindset to learn and adapt in a complex and dynamic environment
  • Engage with partners to drive continuous improvement to the architecture, design, and verification plans/collateral, and to methodology to prevent, reduce, and/or find bugs sooner, more easily, or more reliably
  • Mentor and coach team members
  • Apply your One Microsoft mentality to collaborate with and influence architects, logic designers, post-silicon validators, other verification engineers, and IP and tool providers
  • Embody our culture and values


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of pre-silicon SOC or subsystem or IP verification experience.
  • Candidate should have at least a bachelor’s in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree
  • OR master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree  
  • 6+ years of verification experience working on CPU/SOC designs
  • 2+ years of design for debug verification experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as part of a CPU, SoC and/or IP development team focusing on performance
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following:
    • Performance verification
    • ARM architecture
    • CPU architecture
    • Memory Controller/PHY IPs, DDR protocols
    • Coherent and non-coherent fabric IPs and protocols
    • PCIe Controller/PHY IPs and protocols
    • ACE lite or CHI bus protocols
  • Working knowledge of C/C++
  • Experience with emulation, constraints, and implications on performance verification
  • Proficient communication, collaboration and teamwork skills and ability to contribute to diverse and inclusive teams.

These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure - AI Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure - AI Platform based in the United States.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building and operating critical data infrastructure within a highly regulated government cloud environment. You’ll work on the distributed serving layer that powers fast, reliable data access for mission-critical investigations. The role combines database performance optimization, pipeline reliability, production operations, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. You’ll have meaningful ownership over systems where reliability, compliance, and speed are essential. As a key member of a distributed engineering team, you’ll collaborate closely with data platform, product, and forward-deployed engineering teams. The environment rewards independent problem-solving, technical rigor, adaptability, and strong operational ownership. It’s an opportunity to deepen your distributed systems expertise while contributing to technology designed to support safer communities.

Accountabilities

  • Optimize distributed data infrastructure: Own performance tuning for the serving layer, using query profiling and AI-assisted tooling to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they affect customers.
  • Build reliable data pipelines: Develop, maintain, and harden pipelines that support government cloud investigations, with a strong focus on reliability, correctness, and compliance.
  • Strengthen operational resilience: Become a second independent owner of the serving infrastructure, reducing single points of failure and improving incident response capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot production systems: Use AI-assisted debugging, log analysis, code exploration, and other engineering tools to investigate incidents and drive efficient root-cause resolution.
  • Own production reliability: Participate in on-call responsibilities, respond to incidents, improve runbooks, and implement learnings from production retrospectives.
  • Deliver infrastructure improvements quickly: Take ownership of infrastructure initiatives from investigation and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation.
  • Support compliance requirements: Build and maintain infrastructure capabilities that meet evolving government cloud security, reliability, audit, and data-retention requirements.
  • Collaborate across engineering and product: Work closely with Data Platform, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and other teams to maintain reliable and consistent capabilities across government and commercial environments.
  • Use AI as an engineering multiplier: Apply AI tools to accelerate debugging, code reviews, documentation, configuration work, research, and other repeatable engineering workflows while maintaining high technical standards.
  • Contribute to technical decision-making: Make architecture and infrastructure trade-offs based on evidence, operational experience, and system requirements, while sharing knowledge with the broader engineering organization.

    • Requirements

    • Strong experience with query tuning, database performance optimization, and distributed systems at scale.

    • Ability to apply AI thoughtfully to improve engineering speed and output quality rather than simply automate routine tasks.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to identify problems proactively and drive solutions from discovery through production.
    • Excellent technical judgment, communication, and collaboration skills.
    • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with evolving priorities and a degree of ambiguity.

title: Intern, Process Engineering (Advanced Packaging)
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Job's mission

Join ASM’s Advanced Packaging R&D team and help shape the future of semiconductor technology. This internship focuses on developing advanced surface preparation solutions that enable high-quality hybrid bonding, a critical technology that allows chips to communicate at extremely high speeds with minimal power loss. Working alongside experienced researchers and engineers, you will contribute to cutting-edge innovation that supports the next generation of semiconductor devices.

What you will be working on

  • Develop advanced surface preparation solutions for hybrid bonding interconnect applications.
  • Define process specifications and requirements to achieve targets for bonding strength, defectivity, uniformity, and overall process performance.
  • Perform process validation activities and help establish best-known methods (BKMs) for process integration.
  • Design, execute, and analyze experiments to evaluate process performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with ASM’s Advanced Packaging R&D team on leading-edge technology development.
  • Present findings and recommendations based on experimental results and data analysis.

What Success Looks Like in This Internship

  • Build a strong understanding of hybrid bonding principles and become proficient in operating process and metrology equipment independently.
  • Design and execute basic experiments, analyze data, and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Deliver one or more process solutions, best-known methods, or integration concepts that support technology development.
  • Contribute to the successful startup and advancement of hybrid bonding processes for future customer engagements

What we are looking for

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent degree in Electronics Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in semiconductor manufacturing processes and advanced packaging technologies
  • Ability to analyze technical data and communicate findings clearly.
  • Effective teamwork and problem-solving skills

What sets you apart

  • Knowledge of semiconductor process technologies.
  • Experience with material surface characterization techniques.
  • Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a passion for innovation in semiconductor technology.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

description:
Sælger deltid SPORT 24, 0-8 timer at SPORT 24 Esbjerg





  




































































































Spil sammen med SPORT 24 Esbjerg som vores nye sportssælger
SPORT 24 Esbjerg søger lige nu en sælger på 0-8 timer med lyst til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og fede arbejdsdage med god energi sammen med resten af holdet i butikken.



Din plads på holdet er vigtig 
DU bliver det ansigt, kunderne møder, når de går ind i en knivskarp SPORT 24 for at købe lækkert sportstøj og få solid viden og vejledning af dig. Som sælger er du med til at gøre fortællingen om SPORT 24 til en god fortælling. Derfor er det vigtigste for os, at du kan se dig selv i det, vi står for - nemlig at sælge bevægeglæde og give kunden en rigtig god oplevelse i vores butikker. Salg er vigtigt, for det lever vi af, men den gode kundeoplevelse er vigtigere - og den leverer du. Du knytter gode bånd mellem os og kunderne. Derfor har du stor betydning for os! 



Vi håber, at du … 

er bidt af en gal ketcher/hockeystav/golfbold/yogamåtte og går op i det, du sælger. 


ser folk i øjnene og møder dem åbent med et smil - både kunder og kollegaer. 


er fleksibel og loyal overfor din arbejdsplads og vil hjælpe, når der er brug for det. 


har let ved at danne gode relationer, for den evne bruger vi hver eneste dag. 


er handlekraftig og ikke bange for at tage eget initiativ for at få alt det praktiske i butikken til at spille (vareeksponering, -opfyldning osv.). 


er måldrevet, dedikeret og konkurrenceminded. Vi vil nemlig så gerne drive SPORT 24 endnu længere sammen med dig. 


kan fremvise en straffeattest. Så er formalia også på plads. 

Vi spiller fair play på holdet 
Det skal være fedt at gå på arbejde hos SPORT 24 - også for dig! Du bliver en helt naturlig og vigtig del af det hold, der hver dag får butikken til at køre som smurt. Vi er helt nede på jorden, elsker et godt grin og har ingen tykke manualer, så alle i butikken får lov at tænke selv og hjælpe hinanden. Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig og gøre dig til en del af vores hold. Sammenhold og en god teamkultur er noget, vi går op i at skabe rammerne for. For det spiller jo bare bedst, når vi spiller sammen. Vil du spille med?



Sådan søger du 
Spids den elektroniske blyant og send en ansøgning til os, hvor du fortæller lidt om, hvem du er, og hvorfor du ser dig selv hos os. Det er jo DIG, vi ansætter. Så hvem er du? 




Ansættelse: Hurtigst muligt. 

Ansøgningsfrist: Vi kalder løbende til samtaler og fjerner opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.
