title: SOC Lead
description:
Institutt for energiteknikk (IFE) er et av Norges største forskningsinstitutt med 670 ansatte fra over 38 nasjonaliteter. Vår visjon er «forskning for en bedre fremtid», og vi utvikler bærekraftige løsninger innen energi, miljø og digitale systemer. IFE har store eiendommer som skal utvikles i årene fremover på Kjeller og i Halden. Vi har utarbeidet en masterplan og er i prosess med Lillestrøm kommune for utvikling av eiendommen på Kjeller til en fremtidsrettet teknologi- og forskningspark.

Som driftsgruppeleder i SOC vil du ha det overordnede ansvaret IFE Security Operations Center (IFE SOC). Rollen skal sørge for å ivareta og beskytte IFE’s digitale verdier. Rollen vil også bidra til videreutvikling av IFEs strategi innen cyber security-forskning.

Rollen skal lede og videreutvikle SOC i henhold til gjeldende krav og behov i IFEs virksomhet, og være fagmessig ansvarlig for personell tilknyttet SOC. Videre er rollen en del av den operasjonelle bemanningen for IFE SOC. Rollen er organisert i avdeling DSD - Digital Service Delivery og rapporterer til Avdelingsleder DSD.

Rollen inngår i IFEs til enhver tid gjeldende beredskapsorganisasjon.

Sikkerhetsklarering på nivå Hemmelig/Nato Secret er en forutsetning for å inneha rollen. Det vil også utføres bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Operasjonelt ansvar for IFE SOC og videreutvikle kapasiteter for økt deteksjon og håndtering av hendelser innenfor digital sikkerhet

  • Lede og videreutvikle IFE SOC med faglig utvikling av SOC analytikere og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av prosesser med fokus på automatiserings av rutiner for økt kvalitet

  • Lede arbeidet med overvåking og analyse av sikkerhetslogger og sårbarheter med fokus på å undersøke, dokumentere og rapportere om informasjonssikkerhetsproblemer og holde seg oppdatert på nye trender

  • Utarbeide analyser for orienteringer til ledelsen og ivareta tett samarbeid med relevante fagmiljøer og roller i organisasjonen, inkludert CISO og sikkerhetsarkitekt.

  • Planlegge og delta i beredskapsøvelser, samt bidra til optimalisering og forvaltning av risikoer og risikohåndtering innenfor digital sikkerhet.

Listen er ikke uttømmende, og konsulenten skal utføre øvrige arbeidsoppgaver som avtales med område eller avdelingsledelsen.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Utdanning på Bachelor eller masternivå innen IKT og/eller IKT-sikkerhet, erfaring vil kunne kompensere for krav om formell utdanning.

  • Praktisk erfaring fra SOC-prosesser og analyse innen deteksjon- og hendelseshåndtering

  • Erfaring med drift av IKT-infrastruktur eller IKT-systemer generelt og digitale sikkerhetssystemer spesielt (eksempelvis brannmur, IPS, WAF, endepunktbeskyttelse)

  • Erfaring med bruk av IKT-sikkerhetsverktøy (eksempelvis SIEM, logganalyse)

  • Erfaring med hybride skyløsninger er en fordel

  • Kjennskap til ISO27001/2, NIST Cyber Security Framework og NSMs Grunnprinsipper for IKT

Personlige egenskaper

  • Evne til å være styrende, men samtidig pragmatisk og løsningsorientert

  • Ha et sterkt personlig engasjement for fagområdet og evne til å være visjonær og fremtidsrettet

  • Ha evne til å ta raske beslutninger basert på erfaring og risikoforståelse

  • Være en endringsagent for nytenkning og ha evne til å kommunisere både med tekniske- og ikke tekniske personer.

  • Være en synlig representant for IFE, IFEs verdier og IKTs løsninger og visjoner både internt og eksternt.

I helhetsvurdering av søkere vil det bli lagt vekt på personlig egnethet, relevant kompetanse og erfaring.

Oppstart: Snarest

Varighet: 31.12.2026 med mulighet for forlengelse

Opsjon: 1+1 år

Arbeidssted: Halden

title: Cloud Solution Architecture
description:
Overview

Overview

With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. CE&S drives cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring we consistently exceed customer expectations across every interaction.

Job Purpose

As a Cloud & AI Infrastructure Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) in iCSU, you will partner with Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers to design, migrate, modernize, and operate secure, resilient, and AI‑ready Azure infrastructure platforms. You will lead customer‑funded technical engagements, remove adoption blockers, and drive production outcomes across migration, modernization, security, resiliency, and AI readiness scenarios.

This role enables you to accelerate your technical and leadership growth, deepen your cloud and AI infrastructure expertise, and strengthen your business acumen by linking architectural decisions to measurable customer value, consumption, and long‑term success. The role supports hybrid work aligned to customer and business needs.

Company Culture Statement

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We embrace a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals. We build a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive.



Responsibilities
  • Own end‑to‑end technical delivery outcomes (Job 1) for Cloud & AI Infrastructure engagements, driving committed milestones to close across migration and modernization initiatives.
  • Lead secure, resilient, and scalable Azure infrastructure architectures across landing zones, networking, storage, compute, backup, DR, monitoring, and governance.
  • Enable AI‑ready infrastructure by ensuring customer environments meet security, resiliency, data, and performance requirements for AI workloads at scale.
  • Drive Job 2 outcomes by identifying next best actions and generating incremental pipeline from every delivery engagement.
  • Provide delivery oversight and escalation support for Factory and Unified engagements, ensuring quality, repeatability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Partner closely with CSAMs, STUs, engineering, and partners to deliver One Microsoft outcomes following MCEM.
  • Contribute to and reuse repeatable IP, reference architectures, and accelerators to improve scale and delivery efficiency.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing insights and feedback to influence product and service improvements.
  • Maintain deep technical expertise through ongoing skilling, certifications, accreditations, and community participation.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications (RQs)

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years of experience in cloud / infrastructure technologies, IT consulting, systems administration, architecture, or equivalent experience.
  • Hands‑on experience with Azure infrastructure services including compute, networking, storage, monitoring, backup, and security.
  • Experience delivering migration and modernization projects using Azure Migrate, Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well‑Architected Framework (WAF), and Landing Zones.
  • Knowledge of security and resiliency principles including Defender for Cloud, identity, networking security, and business continuity & disaster recovery.
  • Ability to work in customer‑facing roles, leading technical discussions with senior IT and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

  • 8+ years of experience in cloud or infrastructure architecture, consulting, or delivery roles.
  • Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Security Engineer Associate.
  • Experience with hybrid and multi‑cloud scenarios including Azure Arc, AVS, or regulated / sovereign environments.
  • Exposure to infrastructure‑as‑code using Bicep or Terraform and DevOps practices.
  • Experience supporting SAP on Azure, Linux, Windows Server, databases, or mission‑critical workloads.

title: EL Fagansvarlig
description:
Position 

             
                EL Fagansvarlig
             
            
                
 
                     
                        
    
        
    
    
    
    
    
        
 
             
             
             
             
             
         
    


        
    


                     
                 

            
            
             Job description 
            
 
  Job description  
 Location 
 
 Kalundborg, Denmark 
 
 Job category 
 
 Engineering & Technical 
 
    Apply now       
 
 
 
     

 Er du klar til at tage det faglige ansvar for EL-sikkerheden og compliance på et komplekst farmaceutisk produktionsanlæg - og se din ekspertise understøtte produktionen af livsvigtig medicin? Bliv vores nye EL Fagansvarlig for bygning DF og PS WH, hvor din viden hver dag er med til at sikre installationer, mennesker og patienter.
 
  

 Din nye rolle 

 Som EL Fagansvarlig bliver du fagligt ansvarlig for EL-området i bygning DF og PS WH jf. LBK nr. 30 af 11/01/2019, med ansvar for af Kvalitets Ledelses System (KLS) inden for EL-området. Du refererer direkte til Novo Nordisk A/S' ledelse i henhold til gældende organisationsdiagram i virksomhedens KLS-system og bliver den go-to-ekspert, der sikrer compliance, sikkerhed og fremdrift i et travlt miljø med høje krav. 

 Dine daglige opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte: 
 
 Tilsikre at nuværende såvel som fremtidige bygnings- og maskininstallationer inden for EL-området opfylder gældende myndighedskrav (undtaget er rum S.04.10 og S.103.3, som varetages af CFA) 

 Udarbejdelse af CR-sager, lukning af CR-aktioner, input til SOP'er og eventuel praktisk træning samt udarbejdelse og opdatering af vedligeholdes planer og EL-dokumentation 

 Godkendelse af medarbejdere, som må udføre L-AUS arbejde (EN 50110) i FPMDK og på PS WH, samt myndighed til at standse arbejde, der kan medføre brist på EL-sikkerheden eller personsikkerheden 

 Sikre, drive og supportere struktureret problemløsning (A3), deltage i og afholde tavlemøder og teammøder samt drive projektgennemførsel ved større projektopgaver, ombygninger og nyindkøb 

 Udarbejdelse af arbejdstilladelser og tilhørende risikoanalyser samt udbudsmateriale og indhentning af tilbud på EL-opgaver 

 Håndtering og kommunikation af akut opståede EL- og BMS-problemer, der medfører eskalering i organisationen, og tæt samarbejde med eksterne parter, herunder energiforsyning KA og grundejerforeningen Hallas Allé 

 Fungere som Local Records Manager Suppleant og deltage i NN ERFA-gruppen på EL- og energiområderne for tværgående samarbejde og vidensdeling 

 Varetage rollen som Process Responsible og Local Process Responsible - monitorere processen, sikre compliance, drive forbedringer og bekræfte inspection readiness ved audits og inspektioner 
 
   

 Din nye afdeling 

 I Global Manufacturing & Supply dækker vi hele værdikæden fra udvikling af lægemidler og devices til de færdige Novo Nordisk-produkter på markedet. Vi er mere end 30.000 kolleger på tværs af kloden med et fælles ansvar for at opskalere molekyler, processer, devices og produkter - dedikerede til at levere livsvigtig medicin til de patienter, der har mest brug for den. 

   

 Du får base i Kalundborg, i bygning DF - et af vores mest interessenttunge produktionsmiljøer - og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger på tværs af FPMDK og PS WH. Teamet er kendetegnet ved tæt samarbejde, teknisk stærke kompetencer og et udpræget sikkerhedsfokus. Her har dit arbejde direkte betydning for en pålidelig drift på et komplekst site, og hver forbedring, du driver, er med til at sikre, at vores produkter når ud til de millioner af patienter, der er afhængige af dem. 

   

 Dine kompetencer og kvalifikationer 

 Vi søger en teknisk stærk og sikkerhedsbevidst profil, der trives i en rolle med både myndighedsansvar, interessenthåndtering og praktisk problemløsning. Du har: 
 
 Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring inden for EL-området, gerne fra et GMP-reguleret farmaceutisk miljø eller en sammenlignelig teknisk branche 

 En uddannelse som el-installatør, ingeniør eller lignende teknisk uddannelse med mulighed for at få personlig el-autorisation, samt godkendelse (eller kvalifikationerne til at opnå godkendelse) hos 

 Sikkerhedsstyrelsen som fagligt ansvarlig for EL 

 Solidt kendskab til GMP, ISO 9001, CE-mærkning og gældende myndighedskrav på EL-området samt erfaring med at supportere Energi- og EHS-audits 

 Stærke samarbejdsevner - du trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger på tværs af en stor interessentbase og opbygger tillidsfulde relationer til både interne teams og eksterne samarbejdspartnere 

 Gode kommunikations- og koordineringsevner, en systematisk tilgang til dine opgaver samt evnen til at agere på både operationelt (daglig drift) og taktisk (tværorganisatorisk) niveau 

 Flydende dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale 
 
 På det personlige plan er du selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst, teknisk velfunderet og kendt for din strukturerede tilgang og gode samarbejdsevner. 

   

 At arbejde hos Novo Nordisk 

 Hver dag søger vi de løsninger, der kan besejre alvorlige kroniske sygdomme. Vi går til opgaven med vedholdenhed, konstant nysgerrighed og en forpligtelse til at finde bedre veje frem. I mere end 100 år har denne dedikation drevet os til at opbygge en virksomhed med fokus på varig forandring for langsigtet sundhed. En virksomhed, hvor forskellige perspektiver, fælles formål og gensidig respekt sammen skaber ekstraordinære resultater. Når du starter hos os, starter du ikke bare et job - du bliver en del af en historie, der strækker sig over generationer. 

   

 Vi tilbyder 

 Hos Novo Nordisk bliver du en del af en global medicinalvirksomhed med en unik kultur og stærke resultater. Vi fokuserer på, og tilbyder kontinuerlig læring, karriereudvikling og goder, der er skræddersyet til dit liv og det stadie, din karriere befinder sig i. 

   

 Løn og goder 

 Den årlige grundløn varierer fra 570,200.00 til 838,100.00 `DKK og fastsættes i forhold til stillingsniveauet. Placeringen inden for lønintervallet vurderes under rekrutteringsprocessen ud fra kandidatens færdigheder, kompetencer, viden og relevante erfaring. 

   

 Der tilbydes en attraktiv lønpakke, herunder en pensionsordning (i øjeblikket 13% arbejdsgiverbidrag og 5% medarbejderbidrag) i overensstemmelse med den gældende overenskomst for funktionærer (Industriens Funktionæroverenskomst eller “IFO"). 

   

 Lønpakken omfatter desuden en fritvalgskonto som i øjeblikket er på 10% og 4% i feriegodtgørelse.

Job Description

The purpose of this position is to provide direct supervision and leadership of technology staff supporting infrastructure and service operations, ensuring strong team performance, accountability, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement. The Director leads and actively participates in day-to-day operations and the execution of technology initiatives aligned with the institutional strategic plan.

The Director builds strong relationships with faculty and staff, leading collaborative conversations to assess technology needs and guide the selection and use of tools that enhance teaching, learning, and lab-based environments. The role ensures technology services and infrastructure are delivered securely, reliably, and with a strong customer service focus through hands-on leadership and operational discipline.

This position supports departmental planning, budgeting, and resource alignment and requires broad knowledge across technology domains to effectively lead work across infrastructure, service, and security functions by leveraging team expertise and available resources.

Salary Range:

$40.01 - $69.11 Hourly

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressive experience in information technology operations, infrastructure and/or end-user support services within the past five (5) years.
  • Including two (2) years of progressive staff supervision experience, including, supervision of various level of IT staff, hiring, coaching, performance management, and accountability for staff performance and outcomes within the last five (5) years.
  • Experience leading or contributing to day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting, incident response, and service delivery.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles and practices, including risk mitigation and exposure to security frameworks within the last five (5) years.
  • Experience supporting the development and management of budgets, including technology purchasing and resource allocation.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple operational responsibilities in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong customer service orientation and ability to effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders.

*A Master’s degree in Information Technology or related field substitutes for 18 months of experience; a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field substitutes for 12 months; an associate’s degree Information Technology or related field substitutes for 6 months.

Preferred Qualification

  • Master’s degree in Information Technology, computer science, educational technology or related field.
  • Experience in a higher education setting.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead across multiple technology domains by leveraging team expertise while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
  • Experience leading teams that support both infrastructure and service desk/end-user support functions within the last five (5) years.
  • Experience with NIST cybersecurity assessments, audits, or framework implementation within the last five (5) years.
  • Demonstrated success developing and improving operational processes, service standards, and performance metrics.
  • Experience implementing or improving IT service management practices.
  • Experience partnering with faculty or instructional staff to support technology use in classroom or lab-based learning environments.

Other Requirements

Hennepin Technical College is currently unable to sponsor work visas or green card applications due to regulatory complexity, budget constraints, and alignment with our current hiring strategy. Applicant must be legally authorized to work in the US at the start of employment.

Full-Time - Monday - Friday

No

About

Founded in 1972, Hennepin Technical College is the largest technical college in Minnesota. With campuses in Brooklyn Park and Eden Prairie, Hennepin Technical College has a diverse student population of more than 9,500 and offers degree and non-degree coursework in over 45 programs. Achieving a 99% job placement rate within its network of industry partners, Hennepin Technical College prepares students for in-demand and high-paying employment opportunities Hennepin Technical College is a member of Minnesota State, which includes 30 community and technical colleges and seven state universities serving approximately 400,000 students. It is the fourth-largest system of two-year colleges and four-year universities in the United States.

Hennepin Technical College with campuses in Brooklyn Park and Eden Prairie is a member of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities System. The college is strategically positioned to meet the economic and workforce development needs of business and industry throughout Minnesota. Hennepin Technical College faculty and staff are committed to preparing students to be successful in obtaining the education and skills that can result in employment and a career. Curriculum is industry validated and delivered in an environment that emulates the work setting. Students receive a well-rounded educational experience that gives them the skills and ability to secure the first job in their career as well as to advance in their career. title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Creative Designer based in the United States.

This is a high-ownership creative role focused on shaping how a growing performance advertising business presents itself across marketing, sales, and customer experiences.
You’ll combine creative strategy, visual storytelling, and hands-on execution to strengthen brand consistency and elevate the quality of every customer touchpoint.
The role spans websites, campaigns, presentations, content, social, sales enablement, video, motion, and digital experiences.
You’ll translate complex advertising, data, measurement, and product concepts into compelling and accessible visual stories.
Working closely with marketing, sales, product, client success, and leadership teams, you’ll help turn business objectives into effective creative solutions.
You’ll also introduce scalable systems, templates, external resources, and AI-assisted workflows that allow a lean team to move faster without sacrificing quality.
This opportunity is ideal for a multidimensional designer who thrives in a fast-moving environment and enjoys owning work from the initial brief through final delivery.

Accountabilities

  • Translate brand positioning, messaging, and visual identity into distinctive creative experiences across marketing, sales, customer, and digital touchpoints.
  • Maintain and evolve the visual system across typography, imagery, illustration, data visualization, motion, video, presentations, and digital experiences.
  • Establish practical templates, guidelines, and asset libraries that improve consistency and enable teams to work more efficiently.
  • Develop creative concepts for brand campaigns, product launches, vertical initiatives, customer stories, and demand-generation programs.
  • Turn business objectives, audience insights, and messaging into creative that performs effectively across paid, owned, social, email, website, event, and sales channels.
  • Design and enhance website pages, landing pages, and email experiences within Webflow, with attention to usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and conversion.
  • Create presentations, sales decks, case studies, research reports, guides, product materials, sell sheets, one-pagers, and other customer-facing collateral.
  • Transform complex advertising, measurement, product, and data concepts into clear visual narratives, diagrams, frameworks, and data visualizations.
  • Develop video concepts, treatments, scripts, storyboards, and visual direction for brand, product, customer, and executive content.
  • Create or edit lightweight motion and video assets when appropriate and manage external production partners for larger projects.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for ideation, imagery, presentations, video, prototyping, editing, versioning, and production while maintaining strong creative judgment.
  • Own assignments from brief through final delivery, managing requirements, timelines, stakeholder feedback, revisions, and production details.
  • Balance multiple concurrent workstreams and prioritize requests according to business value, urgency, and available capacity.
  • Manage freelancers, agencies, and external production resources as needed while building efficient creative processes without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Identify recurring creative needs that can be transformed into scalable templates, systems, or self-service resources.
  • Help establish a dependable creative ecosystem that reduces unnecessary agency reliance and enables stronger, faster execution.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve briefs, strengthen creative concepts, and deliver work that supports measurable business goals.

    • Requirements

    • 7–10 years of experience in brand, marketing, visual, multidisciplinary, or related creative design roles.
    • Meaningful in-house experience, ideally within a growing B2B technology, SaaS, media, advertising technology, or marketing technology environment.
    • Demonstrated ability to operate as a highly accountable designer within a lean, fast-moving organization.
    • Portfolio demonstrating strong work across websites, campaigns, presentations, content, video, social, and sales enablement.
    • Strong visual design fundamentals and the ability to simplify complex products, data, technical concepts, and business messages.
    • Proficiency with Webflow, Figma, Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
    • Working capability in motion design, video editing, storyboarding, or related multimedia production.
    • Experience managing projects from initial brief through final production and delivery.
    • Strong communication, organization, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Ability to receive direct feedback, collaborate across functions, and confidently explain the creative rationale behind design decisions.
    • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to personally execute both high-profile creative projects and everyday production work.
    • Experience using AI-powered creative tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Krea, Gamma, or comparable platforms.
    • Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve ideation, imagery, presentations, video, prototyping, versioning, or production workflows.
    • Sound judgment when evaluating AI-generated content, with the ability to recognize generic, inaccurate, off-brand, or inappropriate outputs.
    • Willingness to continuously test emerging creative technologies and develop practical workflows that improve speed, quality, and creative range.
    • Hands-on Webflow experience is a strong advantage.
    • Experience with CTV, streaming video, performance advertising, or adtech is a plus.
    • Motion, animation, video editing, or production/shoot-direction experience is advantageous.
    • Experience managing freelancers or external creative and production partners is preferred.
    • Familiarity with creative testing, versioning, performance data, copywriting, headline development, or verbal brand development is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Base salary range of $140,000–$160,000 USD.
      • Fully remote position within the United States.
      • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
      • 401(k) plan.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Paid holidays.
      • Professional development opportunities.
      • Company offsites and team gatherings.
      • Opportunity to make a significant creative impact within a rapidly growing performance advertising business.
      • Broad creative ownership spanning brand, campaigns, digital experiences, content, sales materials, video, and emerging AI-powered workflows.
      • Opportunity to establish scalable creative systems and help shape the visual direction of a growing organization.

Senior Process Engineer for Microelectronics - Demant Hearing Aid


Please note the short application deadline, as the start date is October 1st - onsite Ballerup.


 


Job Brief


We are looking for a team member, who will be involved with developing and implementing new processes for microelectronic production used within the hearing aid industry. A successful candidate will be expected to contribute towards improving functionality and performance by introducing up to date technologies, provide data driven qualitative analysis and results, as well as support ongoing manufacturing processes, new product introduction and innovative development projects.


 


The Role


You will join a team of four Process Engineers collaborating in an Agile setup.


 


The team’s and your primary tasks are:



Development of new processes and designs for new generations of microelectronic assemblies.


Optimisation of existing production processes to improve quality, capacity, capability, and reduce costs.


Evaluate and qualify new production equipment and materials.


Create and communicate statistical reports and illustrative presentations of experimental results for current production processes and products in development.


Challenge existing design rules and determine new - in collaboration with product development team.


Active technology, process and methods scouting.









Your Experience


You have a relevant education, e.g. engineering, with a focus on materials, microelectronics, manufacturing, or chemistry.


 


Furthermore, you have minimum 5 years of professional experience in working in a manufacturing environment, where you have regularly utilised analytic and systematic problem solving.


 


It will be considered an advantage if you have experience with:



SMD and microelectronics production optimisation using 6-Sigma and DoE methods.


Optical Analysis methods and equipment (AOI, SPI etc).


Processes and materials evaluation, characterisation, and application.


Metrology methods and Statistical analysis using tools like R, Python, or similar.


2D and 3D CAD/CAM, PCB design principles and engineering drawings e.g. CAM350, Creo, OnShape.


Manufacturing of medical equipment.



 


About You



You have good collaboration skills and experience in working in an active team environment and forming good working relations with white- and blue-collar staff alike. Adaptiveness to dynamic situations is very much appreciated.


You can prioritise between different tasks to reach your own and the team’s common goals.


You have an analytic and structured approach to your work methods - with attention to details, prioritise quality over quantity, provide findings backed by authentic data, and a drive to identify new methods and technologies.


Fluency in English is required, but it is an advantage if you speak Danish.



 


You can start onsite Ballerup from 1st of October 2026.








Our Work Environment


Demant Enterprise A/S in Ballerup is our Centre of Excellence regarding automated production using the latest surface mount technologies (SMT). New assemblies are frequently released, e.g., for Oticon’s latest hearing aids and consequently new production equipment and technologies are necessary.


 


You will communicate, cooperate, and collaborate with different people, mainly internal colleagues from other teams, but also from other Demant locations and external partners. Occasional travelling is part of the job.


 


You will work in a smaller department with high flexibility - and at the same time be a part of a large organization.


 


The team uses advance and modern methods to deliver production technologies for the benefit of product projects, production capability, and, ultimately, the hearing-impaired customer.


 


 


Be part of a great team and organization


Please submit you CV and a short application no later than the 18th of August 2026.


 


We screen applications frequently and arrange interviews with short notice.


 


We only accept applications that are received through Demant’s official recruitment system.


 


For more info, please contact Daniel Paul, on +45 41499617 or e-mail, DAUO@demant.com.


 


At Demant, we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I), and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality. #LI-HYBRID#LI-BS1 




                
    
                

            

        

    

    
    

        

About Demant



Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

title: Vessel Analytical Engineer
description:
Title:

Vessel Analytical Engineer

Job Title

Vessel Analytical Engineer

Division

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.

Responsibilities:

1.Candidate will be responsible for analytical design and specification of process vessels such as trays and packed columns, knock out drums and vapor-liquid-liquid separators, fixed bed reactors and storage tanks.

2.Vessel analytical engineer will perform detailed process and hydraulic calculations using KBR proprietary correlations and the related industry standards to determine the vessel size and design/ specify internals necessary to achieve process requirements.

3.Also should have working understanding of use of tray and packing vendor’s software and be familiar with FRI design guidelines.

4.Candidate is expected to plan, schedule and conduct work on a relatively independent basis and provide technical guidance to junior engineers in preparation of basic engg. Design packages of KBR technologies. Candidate will also be required to interface with vessel internals vendors and clients with a possibility of overseas assignments.

5.Shall be managing direct reports, establishing individual performance goals and objectives and reviewing performance against objectives.

6.Work sharing with Houston.

7.Maintains a safe working environment, ensuring compliance with all governmental regulations and corporate safety guidelines. Ensures that all personnel assigned to the operations receive appropriate safety training and adhere to all safety standards.

Qualifications including Required Education, Experience, & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or chemical engineering.

  • Minimum of 0-5 years related experience, with typical experience ranging from 0-5 years.

Skill: Experience in sizing and designing process equipment for a wide range of applications within the process plant industry.

Decarbonization – Energy Transition – Sustainability

title: DHI Software Developer
description:
Software Developer 
				
  

			
 
 Profile overview 

 We are seeking a proactive Software Developer who demonstrates a strong passion and proven experience in scientific and geospatial data engineering. Your initial focus will be on the next generation of shared data foundations that underpin DHI's scientific software ecosystem across our products and advisory work: the components that move scientific and geospatial data efficiently between our simulation engines, desktop applications, GIS software, and the scientific Python ecosystem. This work reflects DHI's strong commitment to open standards and interoperability. At a later stage you will also contribute to broader development across DHI's software portfolio. 

 Based in Hørsholm, Denmark, you will be part of a global development team focused on developing our MIKE product suite, which is used worldwide. 

 Responsibilities: 
 
 Design and develop essential core and common components for handling structured grids, unstructured meshes, time series, and raster and vector geospatial data, and for moving these efficiently between DHI's products, GIS tools, and the scientific Python ecosystem 

 Transform legacy code to modern tech stacks 

 General development across DHI’s software portfolio and shared components 

 Write production code backed by unit tests and automated checks 

 Work together with developers, project managers, product owners and other colleagues 
 
 You possess some of these professional qualifications: 
 
 Experience with both C++ and C# 

 Experience with desktop application development for Windows and Linux 

 Experience with geospatial data (vector and raster) and interoperability with GIS software 

 Experience with Python and the scientific Python ecosystem (e.g. NumPy, xarray); awareness of open standards in the scientific data community is a plus 

 Experience with AI-guided development 

 Experience with scientific software and mathematics-based programming 

 Experience with performance-aware I/O and data handling for large datasets, including formats such as Zarr and netCDF (chunking, lazy evaluation, efficient subsetting) 

 Experience with domain decomposition libraries such as METIS for partitioning large computational domains 

 Experience with documenting software APIs and architecture 

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing for cross-platform native code (Windows and Linux) 
 
 Personal Qualifications 
 
 Ability to work individually as well as in a team 

 Good communication and interpersonal skills 

 Proficiency in written and spoken English 
 
 We offer 
 
 An international work environment, with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues 

 Flexible working conditions 

 The opportunity to make a difference for water environments around the world through the products and projects that DHI delivers every year 
 
 Office location 

 Hørsholm, Denmark 

 Application / Next step 

 Application deadline: 26 August 2026. Please submit your motivation in Danish or English, including your CV, via the relevant job posting on the DHI website:  www.dhigroup.com/careers . Valid Danish work permit required - Visa sponsorship not available 

 If you require any further information, please feel free to contact Jesper Grooss who is leading the Product team that you would work in ( jgr@dhigroup.com ). The recruiting line manager is Lasse Kelman Christensen ( lac@dhigroup.com  ).

title: Senior Technical Office Architect
location: El Sheikh Zayed City, Giza Governorate, Egypt
description:
A leading Construction firm specializing in residential. We are dedicated to delivering innovative, functional, and high-quality architectural solutions. We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Office Architect to lead our technical team, oversee shop drawings, manage site coordination, and ensure seamless project delivery.

Job Brief
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Technical Office Architect with a minimum of 10 years of experience to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between architectural design, engineering disciplines, and construction execution. You will be responsible for leading the technical office team, reviewing and approving technical submittals, managing shop drawings, resolving complex site interface issues, and ensuring compliance with project specifications and local regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and manage the technical office team, overseeing day-to-day operations and task allocation.
  • Review, refine, and approve detailed shop drawings, architectural details, and working drawings before submission or site release.
  • Coordinate multi-disciplinary architectural and engineering drawings (MEP, Structural, Interior Design) to identify and resolve spatial and technical clashes.
  • Oversee the Request for Information (RFI) process, technical submittals, material approvals, and mock-up evaluations.
  • Ensure all technical deliverables comply with project specifications, local building codes, contract documents, and quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Consultants, Subcontractors, and Site Engineers to resolve technical challenges and prevent delay.
  • Assist in quantity surveying, bill of quantities (BOQ) verification, variation orders, and value engineering proposals.
  • Conduct regular technical reviews and site visits to monitor implementation alignment with approved technical drawings.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or Architectural Engineering.

Minimum of 10 years of proven experience in technical office management within construction or engineering consultancy firms.

Strong background in large-scale [Commercial / Residential / Infrastructure / Mixed-Use] projects.

Advanced proficiency in BIM/Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, and MS Office applications.

In-depth knowledge of local building codes, statutory approvals, and construction methodologies.

Strong technical detailing skills and a thorough understanding of architectural materials and finishing systems.

Excellent leadership, team management, and problem-solving abilities.

Outstanding communication and negotiation skills in English (Arabic is a plus).

Benefits

Competitive salary package based on experience.

Comprehensive health/medical insurance.

Professional development and career growth opportunities.

Paid annual leave and official holidays.

title: Lead Product Designer, Growth (Upper Funnel)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Product Designer, Growth (Upper Funnel) based in Canada.

As a Lead Product Designer focused on Growth, you will shape the experiences that guide users from first discovery through activation, engagement, and expansion. You’ll own critical growth journeys across acquisition, onboarding, pricing, upgrade flows, and lifecycle touchpoints. This is a hands-on role combining exceptional product design craft with data-informed experimentation and systems thinking. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to turn behavioral insights into meaningful product improvements. Alongside your individual contribution, you’ll coach and develop a small group of designers while helping establish growth design practices across the organization. The role offers significant influence over how millions of users discover value, build trust, and engage with a collaborative digital product.

Accountabilities

  • Define and deliver user-centered experiences across discovery, activation, onboarding, monetization, pricing, upgrade, and lifecycle journeys, creating scalable patterns across the product.
  • Own design work from early concepts through production, including UX, visual design, interaction design, prototypes, and rapid AI-assisted experimentation.
  • Use behavioral data, funnel metrics, experiment results, and user signals to identify opportunities and inform design decisions.
  • Develop and lead experiments across acquisition, activation, and expansion funnels, partnering closely with Product and Data Science from hypothesis through measurement and read-out.
  • Establish reusable growth patterns within the design system that balance conversion, clarity, usability, and long-term user trust.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure designs are implemented accurately and meet a high standard of quality.
  • Reframe complex growth challenges at the journey and funnel level, helping teams understand where users gain or lose value.
  • Lead workshops and collaborative working sessions around onboarding, pricing, packaging, upgrade experiences, and other growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Research, Product, and Data Science to define success metrics, develop experiment hypotheses, and interpret outcomes.
  • Directly manage and coach approximately one to three designers, including goal setting, regular 1:1s, feedback, performance support, and career development.
  • Balance hands-on design execution with people leadership, remaining deeply involved in product design rather than moving into a purely managerial role.
  • Mentor designers working on growth-related surfaces and raise the team’s capabilities around hierarchy, motivation, friction, funnel thinking, and user trust.
  • Contribute to design critiques, cross-functional collaboration, and the development of growth design practices and standards.
  • Champion the connection between growth quality and overall product quality, advocating for sustainable experiences rather than short-term conversion tactics.
  • Explore AI-assisted tools and rapid prototyping techniques to accelerate ideation, simulate user journeys, test concepts, and stress-test growth experiences.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of product design experience, ideally within SaaS, productivity, collaboration, self-serve, or product-led growth environments.
    • Demonstrated ownership of growth, monetization, activation, or conversion-focused design initiatives rather than solely contributing to them.
    • Strong understanding of acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion as interconnected parts of a broader user journey.
    • Experience designing onboarding, sign-up, discovery, activation, upgrade, pricing, or other upper-funnel product experiences.
    • Exceptional product design craft, with strong command of visual hierarchy, interaction design, spacing, motion, clarity, and usability.
    • Proven ability to design within established systems while understanding how decisions affect multiple surfaces, journeys, and user relationships.
    • Strong data instincts, including the ability to interpret behavioral data, funnel metrics, experiment results, and other quantitative signals.
    • Experience working closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science teams in fast-moving, experiment-driven environments.
    • Experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading other designers, with the ability to raise the quality of work around you.
    • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and guide cross-functional stakeholders toward user-centered outcomes.
    • Curiosity and proactive problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify edge cases, anticipate constraints, and move forward when requirements are ambiguous.
    • Empathy for first-time users and a strong understanding of trust, motivation, cognitive load, and the factors influencing user commitment.
    • Experience working in environments where design patterns and growth playbooks are still being established.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools, rapid prototyping, and AI-enabled workflows is highly valued.
    • Experience with pricing architecture, packaging, monetization models, organic acquisition, experimentation frameworks, causal inference, or 0-to-1 growth systems is an advantage.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in design, product, interaction design, or a related discipline is beneficial.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position available to candidates based in Canada.
      • Estimated Canadian base salary range of CA$158,728 – CA$198,410, with compensation determined by factors such as location, level, knowledge, skills, and experience.
      • Opportunity to influence growth experiences used by millions of people worldwide.
      • Hands-on leadership role combining individual design contribution, strategic ownership, and people management.
      • Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science teams.
      • Opportunity to shape emerging growth design practices and establish scalable systems and patterns.
      • Exposure to AI-assisted design, prototyping, experimentation, and product development workflows.
      • Inclusive environment with reasonable accommodations available throughout the hiring and employment process.
      • Opportunity to contribute to a product-centered culture focused on collaboration, evidence, design excellence, and meaningful user outcomes.

  Position description  
	Job title
 
 Motiverende Functional Instruktør - Roskilde  
 
	Become a part of the team behind the largest Fitness community in Denmark
 
 
	
  

 Vil du være rollemodel og inspirationskilde for vores medlemmer? Vi er på udkig efter dig, der er imødekommende, smilende og passioneret omkring instruktørrollen. Får du energi af at undervise andre og kan skabe en fed oplevelse for vores medlemmer? Lige nu søger vi en instruktør til vores center på Algade 49 i Roskilde. 

 
 1 ud af 4 medlemmer hos os går på hold. Som holdinstruktør i PureGym er du således en vigtig del af at give vores medlemmer en positiv oplevelse, samt inspirere og motivere dem til at leve et aktivt liv med sunde vaner. Du vil blive en del af et team, hvor sammenhold, arbejdsglæde og engagement går i spænd med en travl hverdag og glade medlemmer.  

   

 Om stillingen og dig 
 Som Funktionel instruktør forventes det at du har indgående kendskab til træningsøvelser hvor hele kroppen arbejdes igennem.  

 Functional Training er et hold hvor der ønsker fokus på både styrketræning og konditionstræning med alsidigt træningsudstyr. Du bygger timen op af 1-3 blokke og skal indekluderer både styrke- og kredsløbsøvelser. Det er vigtigt at du kan benytte træningsmetoder så medlemmerne selv kan styre sværhedsgraden og alle derfor kan være med. 

 TRX er en effektiv træningsform, hvor du træner styrke, smidighed, balance og kondition ved hjælp af din egen kropsvægt og en TRX-sele. TRX står for Total body Resistance Exercise og er en innovativ træningsmetode, der udnytter din egen kropsvægt som modstand. Det centrale element er et specialdesignet slyngesystem med greb, der giver dig mulighed for at udføre en bred vifte af øvelser. Du kan enten holde fast i TRX-grebene med hænderne, eller lade fødderne hvile på dem.  
 Det forventes derfor at du har kendskab til TRX-selen og træning med disse.  

 Vi søger lige nu: 

 TRX instruktør til hver tirsdag kl.17.00 - 18.00  

  

 
 
	Your qualifications
 
 
	
  
 
 Du skal have gennemført en relevant uddannelse for at varetage rollen som instruktør. Hvis du er certificeret personlig træner, vil du have mulighed for blive holdinstruktør og undervise i Functional Training og Core & Glutes.   

 Du formår at planlægge din undervisning og mestrer at sammensætte et motiverende program.  

 Du brænder for at undervise, motivere og videreformidle sunde vaner.  

 Du er en ægte performer, der nyder at stå i front og skabe et rum fyldt med energiske vibrationer, så du formår at tage vores medlemmer gennem en spændende og underholdende time - Hver gang!  
 
 Som instruktør i PureGym vil du have mulighed for personlig udvikling og efteruddannelse til gode personalepriser. Derudover står du selv for planlægning og gennemførelse af dine timer, og er dermed perfekt for dig, der trives med "frihed under ansvar".  

   

 Ansøgning  
 Har du lyst til at gå forrest og samtidig være med til at skabe sunde vaner for den danske befolkning? Så send os din ansøgning nu - og husk også at uploade et bevis på, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for denne type holdundervisning, da dette er et krav. Det vil desuden være en klar fordel, hvis du laver en kort præsentationsvideo, hvori du viser hvilken inspirerende performer, du er. 
 Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag eller snarest muligt.  
  Har du nogle spørgsmål er du velkommen til at komme forbi centret og møde os og høre mere.   

   

 Bliv en del af PureGym - Bliv en del af noget større 
 Som medarbejder i PureGym bliver du en del af Danmarks største fitnesskæde med over 130 centre fordelt i hele landet. PureGym DK er en del af en af Europas største fitnesskæder, med hovedkontor i London, UK, med centre i Danmark, England, Schweiz, UAE og New York, US.  
 Vores mission er at inspirere til et sundere liv med ’Fitness for alle’ som omdrejningspunkt. Vi ser os selv som mere end bare en fitnesskæde. Vi hjælper vores medlemmer med at passe på deres fysiske og mentale sundhed i de bedste rammer med professionel support fra vores passionerede medarbejdere. 
   
 Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning!  
   
 Er vi endt i spam?

Vil du være med til at holde godset i bevægelse på aftenholdet i Brabrand?





Kan du lide en aktiv arbejdsdag, hvor samarbejde, struktur og tempo går hånd i hånd? Trives du med fysisk arbejde og med at være en vigtig del af den daglige drift? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores terminal i Brabrand.



Hos Danske Fragtmænd bliver du en del af et stærkt team, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at sikre, at gods og pakker kommer sikkert videre. Her hjælper vi hinanden, har en uformel omgangstone og sætter pris på kolleger, der tager ansvar og bidrager til det gode samarbejde.



En hverdag med ansvar og samarbejde

Som terminalarbejder på aftenholdet får du en vigtig rolle i den daglige drift. Arbejdet foregår i et højt tempo, hvor det er vigtigt, at du kan bevare overblikket og trives med en aktiv hverdag.



Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:



	
Læsning og losning af trailere

	
Sortering af paller og pakker

	
Forefaldende terminalarbejde

	
Sikre struktur og flow på terminalen




Vi forventer, at du:

Du passer godt ind hos os, hvis du møder stabilt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Du kan bevare overblikket, når der er mange ting i gang på én gang, og du bidrager til samarbejdet - også på de aftener, hvor det går ekstra stærkt.



Du behøver ikke have truckcertifikat for at søge jobbet. Har du det, er det en fordel.



Vi tilbyder:



	
En spændende arbejdsplads i udvikling  

	
Oplæring og sparring med kolleger

	
Løn efter ATL-overenskomsten

	
En aktiv personaleforening

	
Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

	
Forskellige rabatordninger

Der vil også være mulighed for at kunne møde for kl. 15.00 - 23.00.

Der er stor sandsynlighed for, at du allerede kender os. Det er os med de blå lastbiler. Bag det stærke, genkendelige logo står 3.500 medarbejdere - og nu kan du også blive en del af holdet.

title: Servicerådgiver søges til et spændende job, hvor du får en central og koordinerende rolle sammen med et stærkt team hos Audi Amager - en del af Semler Mobility
description:
Servicerådgiver søges til Audi Amager - en del af Semler Mobility 
 Trives du i en udadvendt rolle, hvor du fungerer som bindeled mellem kunden og vores værksted? Så er du måske vores nye kollega! 
 Om jobbet 

 Din vigtigste opgave er at sikre gode kundeoplevelser og levere kundebetjening på et meget højt niveau, når kunden afleverer sin bil til service eller reparation. Du får en central, koordinerende rolle, hvor du arbejder sammen med kolleger og sikrer, at dagligdagen fungerer bedst muligt - både for kunder og team. 

 Dine arbejdsopgaver er bl.a.: 
 

 Rådgivning af kunder om servicemuligheder, afdækning af behov og oprettelse af værkstedsordrer. 


 Vurdering af garantier og servicekontrakter, koordinering af aftaler og sikring af korrekt udførelse af reparationer. 


 Aktiv anbefaling af relevante tillægstjenester og reparationer, samt løbende kontakt med kunden gennem hele processen. 


 Kvalitetskontrol, fakturering og forberedelse af bilens udlevering. 


 Personlig rådgivning med fokus på langvarig kundeloyalitet og tilfredshed. 

 
 Om dig 

 Du er kendetegnet ved en kunde-, service- og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsstil. Du er servicerådgiver, eller har en teknisk uddannelse med erhvervserfaring fra autobranchen. Du har flair for digitale tjenester og kommunikerer let med kunder - både digitalt og personligt. 


 Du arbejder struktureret, finder løsninger i fællesskab med andre og bevarer overblikket i forskellige situationer. Du trives med ansvar for vores kunder igennem alle processer, og giver gerne dine kolleger en ekstra hånd i en travl situation. Det er en forudsætning for stillingen, at du har kørekort i kategori B. 

 Om os 

 Audi Amager er en del af Semler Gruppen, som er landets største virksomhed i bilbranchen med over 100 års erfaring inden for salg og servicering af biler. Vi repræsenterer nogle af de stærkeste brands på markedet, bl.a. Volkswagen, Audi, ŠKODA, SEAT, CUPRA og Porsche. Vi tilbyder et udfordrende og alsidigt job i en spændende organisation, med dedikerede kolleger og mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på hverdagen, så vi sammen når de opstillede mål. Hos os vil du opleve et stærkt team, der med respekt for kolleger og kunder går til opgaverne med et smil på læben. 


 Derudover tilbyder vi løn efter kvalifikationer, sundhedssikring og mange andre fordelagtige medarbejdergoder samt muligheden for at blive en vigtig del af en stor og professionel organisation. 

 Lyder det som noget for dig? 

 Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Du søger stillingen ved at klikke på "Send ansøgning". 


 Ansøgninger behandles løbende. 


 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Charlotte Mortensen på tlf.  43 22 38 19  


 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

 Din vej. Fælles fremtid  

 Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler. 


 At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.  


 Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på. 


 Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i. 


 Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål. 


 Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilo. 


  Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
Woven between all the stages of the delivery process is the work of a Quality Analyst: the technologist who focuses on the complexity and risk inherent in building solutions. By collaborating with each team member—Developer, Business Analyst, Designer, etc.—they ensure quality is thoughtfully examined in both processes and technology. QAs are more than testers; they're team motivators and strive to inspire all teammates to weave quality into their mindsets and code.

Job responsibilities

  • Advocate for quality being built into software and products and aspire to 'shift quality to the left' i.e. highlight and put measures for risk mitigations within the team as early as possible.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teammates to embed quality at every stage of product evolution from ideation to customer usage.
  • Regularly carry out exploratory testing to gain insights and uncover potential risks.
  • Offer improvements to code, tests, testability and suggest tools and frameworks.
  • Examine end-to-end processes including test coverage across all layers of the tech stack, ensuring quality is embedded throughout.
  • Contribute to the creation of a reliable and maintainable automated testing suite to ensure simple, effective analysis of failures and avoid any test case duplication.
  • Alter team approach based on standards and regulations in certain industries.
  • Coach the client's team and encourage them to adopt a quality mindset.
  • Advocate QA expertise to the broader tech community in Thoughtworks, speaking at conferences and acting as a mentor for junior-level QAs.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • You have worked as a Quality Analyst as part of a wider development team, pairing with Devs, Business Analysts, Infrastructure Engineers, and Designers to embed quality and testing mindsets within different roles.
  • You have experience with agile, code management, deployment strategies and release management.
  • Familiarity with practices such as TDD, BDD, CI/CD and models such as Test Pyramid and Swiss cheese.
  • You are comfortable suggesting changes to both on premise and cloud architectures for enhancing quality.
  • You can perform different types of functional and cross-functional testing including performance and security testing across varied architectures.
  • You know how to best leverage metrics to improve lead time, deployment frequency, mean time to recovery and change fail rate.
  • You can design quality strategies and can produce one for the team.
  • Knowledge of user experience and user research including prototyping, personas and AB testing, which can be translated into a test strategy.

Professional Skills

  • You enjoy influencing teammates and advocating for quality as a shared team responsibility.
  • You are passionate about ensuring the correct product is being built, not just that it is being built correctly.
  • You work in a communicative and collaborative way.
  • You thrive in safe, collaborative environments where different opinions, ideas and perspectives are freely shared.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

title: Technical Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Quality Assurance Engineer based in United States.

This role offers the opportunity to shape software quality across healthcare revenue cycle management applications, APIs, data platforms, and integrated solutions. You will design and execute comprehensive testing strategies that ensure reliable, secure, scalable, and high-performing systems. Working closely with Software Development, Data Development, Product Management, and Implementation teams, you will validate complex workflows and integrations from end to end. The position combines hands-on functional testing, API and data validation, automation, and quality engineering. You will play an important role in identifying defects, improving testing efficiency, and strengthening release confidence. This is a collaborative environment where analytical thinking, continuous improvement, and strong technical execution are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive testing strategies, plans, test cases, and scenarios for both new and legacy applications.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, system, API, end-to-end, and data validation testing across complex software environments.
  • Develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts using Java, Python, JavaScript, or comparable technologies.
  • Write complex SQL queries and validate data across SQL and NoSQL databases, ensuring accuracy throughout application and system workflows.
  • Validate data flows between applications, APIs, databases, file exchanges, and third-party systems.
  • Test REST APIs, web services, and healthcare-related integrations using appropriate testing tools and methodologies.
  • Partner with developers and product teams to reproduce defects, validate fixes, troubleshoot issues, and improve overall software quality.
  • Support performance, scalability, reliability, and release testing activities to ensure systems meet business and customer expectations.
  • Apply quality engineering best practices, risk-based testing approaches, and continuous improvement initiatives across the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure testing reflects healthcare and revenue cycle management workflows and supports reliable customer outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • At least 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering, or a closely related role.
    • Demonstrated experience testing database-driven applications and validating backend data.
    • Strong SQL and NoSQL database experience, including the ability to investigate and troubleshoot complex data issues.
    • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar technologies.
    • Experience testing REST APIs and web services using Postman, Newman, or comparable tools.
    • Familiarity with defect tracking and test management platforms.
    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to investigate complex software, database, and integration issues.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Healthcare, revenue cycle management, patient engagement, billing, collections, or related industry experience is preferred.
    • Familiarity with telephony, SMS/texting APIs, or integrated communication technologies is a plus.
    • Experience supporting performance, scalability, reliability, and release testing is advantageous.
    • Strong interest in automation, scalable quality engineering, and continuous process improvement.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
    • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire; employment visa sponsorship is not provided.
    • Candidates residing in New York are not eligible for this position.
    • Successful completion of a pre-employment background check is required.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive annual salary of $85,000–$115,000 USD, depending on skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
      • Comprehensive paid training.
      • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
      • HSA and FSA options.
      • 401(k) plan with company matching.
      • Paid wellness time and holidays.
      • Employer-paid life insurance and long-term disability coverage.
      • Opportunities for internal career growth and development.
      • Full-time, remote position in the United States.
      • Monday–Friday, first-shift schedule.

Stillingen
Som erhvervskonsulent i HTH Glostrups Projektafdeling bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at sikre en professionel og effektiv håndtering af projekter fra tilbudsfasen til projektudførelsen.

Du refererer til erhvervschefen for den pågældende projektafdeling og får en bred kontaktflade til blandt andre arkitekter, bygherrer, entreprenører, underleverandører og i nogle tilfælde privatkunder ved individuelle tilvalg.

Du får ansvar for egne projekter og skal sikre, at opgaverne løses professionelt og struktureret i overensstemmelse med HTH's gældende procedurer, retningslinjer og kvalitetskrav samt i tæt samarbejde med HTH's projektledere.

Dine primære arbejdsopgave


Udarbejdelse af tilbud på baggrund af modtaget udbudsmateriale samt granskning af beskrevet materiale og omfang.



Udarbejdelse og opdatering af tilbud, tegninger, projektinformation og budgetter i forbindelse med tilkøb, eller genberegninger.



Indhentning af tilbud fra underleverandører på specialløsninger



Visualisere, tegne og præsentere forskellige indretningsløsninger



Kunde møder med arkitekt, entreprenør samt bygherre i butikken eller på byggepladsen, med præsentation af tilbud samt materialevalg.



Ostartsmøder med entreprenør og HTH-projektleder



Rådgivning og salg i forbindelse med beboertilvalg og individuelle kundeløsninger.



Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende kunderelationer samt aktivt og opsøgende salgsarbejde i samarbejde med HTH Key Account Manager


Din tilgang til jobbet
Som Erhvervskonsulent forventes du at være professionel, struktureret og kundeorienteret. Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs, samtidig med at du bidrager aktivt til et stærkt samarbejde på tværs af projektafdelingen og resten af organisationen.

Du har fokus på kvalitet, økonomi, deadlines og den gode kundeoplevelse og formår at skabe gode relationer til både kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Der er flere indgangsvinkler til jobbet, det kan være du allerede har erfaring fra branchen, men det kan også være du har erfaring fra en anden lignende salgsstilling fx i møbelbranchen eller entreprenørbranchen.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:


Erfaring med salg er en fordel



Trives i et selvstændigt job og har evnen til at strukturer de mange sideløbende opgaver



Kan sætte kunden i fokus, forstår at sætte dig ind i deres ønsker og evner at bygge stærke relationer



Har flair for tal og kan udarbejde tilbud



Har grundlæggende it-forståelse og nemt kan sætte dig ind i nye programmer



Kan tænke kreativt og sætter en ære i at finde den rigtige løsning



Holder af at arbejde i teams og sammen med kollegaer

Kan du tage medansvar for den daglige drift i butikken og bidrage til, at kunderne får en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse? Så er du måske vores nye salgsleder!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et verdensklasse sammenhold, og sammen er vi drevet af et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Vi investerer i dig som medarbejder, og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som salgsleder i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver, som vi selvfølgelig klæder dig på til fra start gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt.




Om jobbet


Som salgsleder har du en vigtig rolle i butikken. Du bliver en del af lederteamet og er medansvarlig for den daglige drift. Dine opgaver bliver derudover blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse 

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Åbne og/eller lukke butikken

Bestille varer hjem til butikken




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, har du allerede erfaring fra branchen. Den erfaring bruger du sammen med vores grundige oplæringsforløb, hvor du får styr på vores butikskoncepter og processer.
Derudover forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Ser butikken som et team, der arbejder sammen

Forstår hvordan teamet består af individuelle roller og ansvar

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives med en travl hverdag

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som salgsleder i Lidl får du:

Ansvarsfulde opgaver, og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 157,62 kr. i timen som faglært og 148,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

title: Senior Associate Director Development (Major Gifts)
description:
We now have an exciting new contract opportunity until February 2028 for a Senior Associate Director of Development, Brain and Mind Centre

Join a team who are transforming brain and mind health with world-leading research and to help us achieve even more in the coming years. Through developing relationships with the University of Sydney's alumni and donors you will raise philanthropic support for research, education and outreach endeavours.

About Brain and Mind Centre

The Brain and Mind Centre’s teams, partner across borders and disciplines in pursuit of a common goal: the development of better treatments for conditions of the brain and mind, improving health outcomes now and for future generations.

The Brain and Mind Centre is a global leader in research and treatment. In particular, focusing on conditions that affect child development, youth mental health and brain ageing. Our work aim’s to understand individual circumstances and to develop solutions that improve the quality of life for both patients and their loved ones.

About the Position

With support from across the team and the leadership, you will build relationships through face-to-face meetings with donors, alumni and friends of the university. The most unexpected conversations will lead to great things. Your work could give a student the opportunity to study at the oldest university in Australia thanks to a donation towards scholarship support, or could enable researchers to find breakthroughs in the latest cancer treatment. Your work will not only have a huge impact but will also be considered one of the best things the donor and you, as a fundraiser, have ever achieved during your lifetime.

About you

The University values courage and creativity; openness and engagement; inclusion and diversity; and respect and integrity. As such, we see the importance of recruiting talent aligned to these values and are looking for Senior Associate Director of Development, Brain and Mind Centre who has:


  • background in major gift fundraising, with a demonstrated ability to identify and negotiate $1 million plus gift opportunities
  • a strong track record of achievement and meeting stretch financial targets
  • demonstrated relationship building and strong leadership skills with the ability to engage internal and external stakeholders
  • has experience leading a team and can manage and drive team performance supporting the team targets as well as well as owning a specific pipeline
  • has highly developed emotional intelligence – you are self-aware with exceptional interpersonal skills
  • can work autonomously and is naturally a high-achiever and driven by success both professionally and personally
  • demonstrated mentoring/coaching of junior development colleagues
  • has superior time-management, prioritisation and organisation skills
  • an understanding of, and is passionate about how the brain works, mental health, child development and neurodegeneration

About us

The Advancement Portfolio team at the University of Sydney is one of the most successful fundraising program in Australian higher education. Having completed the nation’s first $1BN fundraising campaign, the team is not only the finest performing, its success facilitates the largest real-world impact that philanthropic giving makes possible.

Since its inception 175 years ago, the University of Sydney has led to improve the world around us. We believe in education for all and that effective leadership makes lives better. These same values are reflected in our approach to philanthropy and underpin our long-term strategy for excellence and growth. We’re Australia's first university and have an outstanding global reputation for academic and research excellence.


How to apply
Intending applicants are welcome to seek further information about the position and for recruitment-related enquiries, or if you require reasonable adjustment or support filling out this application, please contact Sarah Scott, Recruitment Partner (Advancement Portfolio), at sarah.scott@sydney.edu.au

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. For a continuing position, you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or an Australian Permanent Resident.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role required pre-employment or background checks in terms satisfactory to the University. Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

Closing date: 11:59pm Sunday, 6th September 2026


The University of Sydney is committed to diversity and social inclusion. Applications from people of culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds; equity target groups including women, people with disabilities, people who identify as LGBTIQ; and people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, are encouraged.

The University reserves the right not to proceed with any appointment.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Position Overview

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at NorthropGrummanUK, you will design, develop, and maintain the critical infrastructure that powers our services. You’ll work on a variety of exciting projects and complex challenges, delivering core capabilities that have real‑world impact. You will lead technical initiatives, guide engineers, and support customer and programme requirements.

Your Responsibilities

  • Perform hands‑on development and actively contribute to the code base, including undertaking peer reviews.
  • Design engineering features that support delivery of the product roadmap and clearly articulate design decisions.
  • Break down large pieces of work into well‑defined tasks aligned with Agile delivery.
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines, taking ownership of build and deployment processes.
  • Demonstrate development progress to internal and external customers through clear, confident presentations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a DevOps Engineer with strong skills in CI/CD, containerisation, deployment technologies and cloud platforms (e.g., Jenkins, Kubernetes, IaC, Docker, AWS).
  • Experience in Linux system administration or similar operating systems.
  • Understanding of database technologies, such as SQL, Elasticsearch or MongoDB.
  • Strong communication, collaboration and problem‑solving skills, ideally gained in an agile environment.
  • Curiosity, potential and a willingness to learn.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our work, you must be British National and currently hold the Highest Level of UK Government security clearance.

Benefits

  • Flexible working options, including hybrid working and an optional compressed fortnight.
  • Private healthcare Cash health plan.
  • Holiday buy/sell scheme.
  • Career development programmes and professional training.
  • Performance‑based bonuses.

NorthropGrumman is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce, and encourages individuals from all backgrounds and all abilities to apply and consider becoming a part of our inclusive workforce.
