title: Senior Security Solutions Executive
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

In your role as Senior Security Solutions Executive, you’ll be finding the right technology to help ensure our executive customers of large enterprises keep their systems secure and spot risks before they become real threats. But you’ll be doing more than just providing IT security—you’ll help customers prepare for the unexpected, defend their systems, and protect their business, brand, and bottom line.

  • Forging strong customer relationships with senior leaders and key influencers.

  • Evaluating and identifying vulnerabilities and risks in customer systems and business risk profiles.

  • Proposing tailored solutions to address customer security threats and risks.

  • Working closely with the account team across all aspects of sales from start to finish.

  • Assessing results and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Promoting the Verizon cyber security value proposition across your sales territory.

What we’re looking for...

Selling & Solutioning runs in your DNA. You’re up to date and seen as the expert on the latest security technology and know just how it can help your customers. You thrive in an environment where you get to combine it all: people, technology and sales. Your strong dedication for sales success, customer service excellence, and your consultative selling approach have earned you the respect and trust of others. The value and high level design of complex security solutions are understood because you explain them in human terms. You know how to relate to senior leaders and orchestrate big deals.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Experience in relevant IT or cyber security sales roles.

  • Experience in selling or consulting on IT and cyber security solutions.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally.

  • Fluency in Japanese and English.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • A degree.

  • Experience in presenting compelling business cases to c-suite buyers, ideally in large global accounts.

  • Experience in evaluating and documenting customer technical needs. Ideally, relating to IT security.

  • Experience in selling complex security solutions, ideally in: Cyber Intelligence and Analytics, Critical Infrastructure, Global Managed Security Services, Threat and Risk Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Governance Risk and Compliance, or Security & Network Architecture. Ideally, managed solutions.

  • Experience in meeting challenging sales goals thru planning, enablement and collaboration.

  • Experience in anticipating and mitigating technical barriers to sale or implementation.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

37.5

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: SERVICETEKNIKER TIL VÆRKSTED
description:
Har du teknisk flair, arbejder du struktureret, og motiveres du af at gøre maskiner klar til drift? Så er du måske vores nye servicetekniker.

Grundet travlhed hos PM Pack søger vi en servicetekniker til vores tekniske team i Horsens. Du vil primært arbejde på vores værksted, hvor du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores maskiner og løsninger altid er præsentable, velfungerende og klar til både demonstration og levering til kunder.

Vi leverer pakkemaskiner, pakkeløsninger og emballage til virksomheder inden for både food- og nonfood-sektoren i hele Danmark.


Arbejdsområder og opgaver:

Som servicetekniker hos PM Pack bliver dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Klargøring og test af nye maskiner inden levering til kunder.

  • Opbygning, justering og kvalitetssikring af pakkeløsninger.

  • Sikre at vores showroom altid fremstår præsentabelt, opdateret og med køreklar maskinpark.

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af prøvepakninger for eksisterende og potentielle kunder.

  • Fejlsøgning, vedligeholdelse og optimering af maskiner på værkstedet.

  • Teknisk support og sparring med kolleger i salg og service.

  • Deltage i installation og idriftsættelse af nye maskiner hos kunder, når behovet opstår.

  • Instruktion og oplæring af kunder i brugen af vores løsninger i forbindelse med leverancer.

Din profil:
Som vores nye Servicetekniker forventer vi, at du:

· Har en teknisk uddannelse, fx elektriker, automatiktekniker, mekaniker eller lignende.

· Har praktisk erfaring med montage, service eller vedligeholdelse af maskiner.

· Arbejder struktureret og trives med at have ansvar for kvalitet og detaljer.

· Er en rutineret PC-bruger og har interesse for styringer og tekniske systemer.

· Har gyldigt kørekort kategori B.

· Taler og forstår engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau.

· Er serviceminded og trives med kontakt til både kunder, leverandører og kolleger.

· Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig være en aktiv del af teamet.

Hvorfor vælge PM Pack?

· Et spændende og alsidigt job med base på vores hovedkontor i Horsens.

  • Bliv en del af et effektivt og velfungerende team

  • Få et selvstændigt job i en solid virksomhed

  • Tilbydes et grundigt introduktionsprogram for at sikre dig den bedste start.

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Er du klar til at tage skridtet? Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. For spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte servicechef Lars Vissing på tlf. 76 28 83 05 eller på e-mail: lva@pmpack.dk

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt og er en fuldtidsstilling.

 Are you passionate about solving complex business challenges and driving strategic impact? Join Group Strategy & M&A and gain the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders, influence key business decisions, and accelerate your professional development in a highly visible role at the heart of a global market leader. 

  

  

 Meet your future team 

 You will join Group Strategy & M&A, the internal strategy and advisory team of the VELUX Group, based at our headquarters in Hørsholm. Reporting directly to the VP, Group Strategy & M&A, you will become part of a high-performing team that supports the CEO, Executive Group Management and senior leaders across the organisation. 

 Our team works on some of the most important strategic priorities facing the VELUX Group. We operate as internal consultants and trusted advisors, helping the organisation navigate evolving market dynamics, identify growth opportunities and make informed strategic decisions. We combine analytical rigour with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and collaborate closely with stakeholders across all parts of the business. 

  

  

 What we offer 

 As a Strategy Consultant, you will have the opportunity to contribute to high-impact strategic initiatives across the VELUX Group while developing your consulting toolbox, business acumen and leadership capabilities. 

  

 More specifically, your tasks will be to: 
 
 Lead or support strategic projects across different parts of the VELUX value chain, including Sales & Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Supply Chain and Operations 

 Conduct strategic analyses, develop business cases and evaluate growth opportunities, market trends and business challenges 

 Facilitate strategic decision-making processes and support senior leaders in translating strategy into action 

 Prepare clear and compelling presentations, recommendations and decision materials for Executive Group Management 

 Collaborate closely with stakeholders across functions, business units and geographies 

 Support the development and execution of corporate and functional strategies 

 Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to address complex business questions and identify actionable solutions 

 Contribute to strengthening strategic capabilities and best practices within Group Strategy & M&A 
 
  

  

 What you will bring 

 Depending on your experience and capabilities, the position may be offered at Junior Consultant, Consultant or Senior Consultant level. 

 You are analytical, structured and curious by nature. You enjoy tackling complex business problems and thrive in an environment where you are expected to create meaningful impact through insight, collaboration and execution. 

  

 You combine strong analytical capabilities with business understanding and stakeholder management skills. You are comfortable navigating different perspectives, building relationships and presenting recommendations in a clear and convincing way. At the same time, you are a team player who values collaboration and actively contributes to a strong team culture. 

  

 Moreover, we expect that you: 
 
 Hold a strong academic degree and demonstrate an excellent academic track record 

 Have 1-4 years of experience in strategy consulting or a similar strategic role in a larger international organisation 

 Possess a solid consulting toolbox, including structured problem solving, stakeholder management and storytelling 

 Are able to communicate complex business topics clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing 

 Build trust and credibility with stakeholders across organisational levels 

 Are proactive, driven and motivated by creating tangible business impact 

 Work effectively in a collaborative and international environment 

 Communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written 
 
  

  

 Ready to apply? 

 Learn more about the VELUX Group online at  www.velux.com , where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process. 

 We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. 

 All inquiries will be treated confidentially. 

  

  

 About VELUX 

 In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air. 

 The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage" and “mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world. 

  

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer 

 At the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of the VELUX Group. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

  

 We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

title: Senior Designer (Principle Prototyping)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Designer (Principle Prototyping) based in United States.

As a Senior Designer, you will bring a high-profile mobile product concept to life through sophisticated interaction design and high-fidelity prototyping.
You will work closely with an established product design team to transform Figma designs into realistic, engaging interactive experiences.
The role centers on Principle, with a strong focus on motion, transitions, gestures, and thoughtful microinteractions.
You will help ensure that prototypes accurately communicate the intended user experience while adding polish and behavioral detail.
This is a hands-on opportunity for a designer who combines strong visual and interaction design instincts with deep prototyping expertise.
You will work in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where iteration, experimentation, and attention to craft are highly valued.
The ideal candidate is an independent practitioner who can move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality and fidelity.

Accountabilities

  • Build high-fidelity, interactive mobile product prototypes using Principle, accurately representing intended product behaviors and user journeys.
  • Translate established Figma designs into polished, realistic, and engaging interactive experiences.
  • Design and refine motion, transitions, gestures, animations, and microinteractions to create intuitive and compelling product experiences.
  • Partner closely with product designers to understand design intent and ensure prototypes faithfully communicate the envisioned user experience.
  • Collaborate with existing design teams while independently owning prototyping deliverables and maintaining a high level of execution quality.
  • Iterate rapidly on prototypes based on stakeholder feedback, refining interactions and details to meet project objectives.
  • Apply strong interaction and motion design principles to create prototypes that effectively demonstrate both functionality and experience.
  • Contribute design expertise and prototyping recommendations throughout the development of high-profile mobile product experiences.

    • Requirements

    • Extensive professional experience creating high-fidelity prototypes using Principle, which is required for this role.
    • Strong interaction design and motion design skills, with a sophisticated understanding of transitions, gestures, animation, and microinteractions.
    • Demonstrated experience creating realistic and highly interactive prototypes for mobile products.
    • Proficiency with Figma and the ability to work effectively from established design systems and design files.
    • Strong understanding of mobile user experience and the ability to translate static designs into dynamic, intuitive interactions.
    • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver polished work while collaborating closely with established design teams.
    • Strong attention to detail, visual craft, and interaction quality.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to incorporate feedback quickly and effectively.
    • Experience prototyping consumer-facing mobile applications is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Apple Human Interface Guidelines is preferred.
    • Experience contributing to large-scale product design initiatives is an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Expected contract compensation of $65–$96 per hour, depending on location, experience, and skillset.
      • Three regional US pay ranges adjusted for cost of living.
      • Potential benefits available in accordance with applicable law and company policy.
      • Benefit eligibility may depend on hours worked and the duration of the assignment.
      • Opportunity to contribute to a high-profile mobile product experience alongside an established design team.
      • Collaborative environment focused on experimentation, craft, interaction design, and innovative digital experiences.
      • Opportunity to work as part of a freelance network on impactful brand, marketing, and product initiatives.

title: Vocational Navigator
description:
Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with a lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify as LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Support carers to achieve their goals and re-enter the workforce with confidence

  • SCHADS 4B ($46.70 per hour) + Super + Salary packaging benefits + leave loading

  • Part-time (22.8 hours) opportunity based in Upper Mount Gravatt/ North lakes QLD

About the Program

The Carer Gateway Vocational Pathway Program is designed to create greater opportunities for carers to enter or re-enter the workforce, pursue volunteering, or engage in higher education. The program empowers carers to achieve their personal and vocational goals, leading to increased financial security, reduced social isolation and stronger self-esteem.

About the Role
Are you passionate about supporting people to achieve their employment goals? We're looking for a compassionate and proactive Vocational Navigator to join our team and provide ongoing individualised support to carers transitioning into the workforce and volunteer space.

In this role you will build strong trusting relationships with community organisations, carers, conduct comprehensive needs assessments and develop tailored vocational plans. You’ll deliver one-on-one and group coaching sessions, provide post-placement support and ensure carers are connected with the right community services to meet their broader needs.

About You

We're looking for someone who’s passionate about making a real difference in people’s lives, someone with a background in career coaching, employment services or vocational counselling who thrives on helping others succeed. You’ll bring exceptional communication skills and natural ability to connect with people along with an understanding of the unique challenges carers face when returning to work.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • TertiaryQualification in a relevant field ofstudy and/or equivalent experience

  • Current valid Driver License

  • Highly developed writing skills

  • Highly developed IT skills

  • Satisfactory National Police Records Check

  • Queensland Yellow and Blue card

  • Right to Work within Australia

  • NDIS Worker Orientation Module Certificate

  • Available to participate in out of hours activities asrequired to undertake
    the requirements of the role

Desirable

  • Previous experience leading and/or working in vocational/carer programs

  • Lived and Living Experience as a Family Carer


What we will offer you…

  • A purpose driven culture where people can thrive, everyone is respected, and differences are valued

  • An equitable, diverse, and socially inclusive work environment

  • Salary packaging up to $15,899 enables you to spend a portion of your salary before it is taxed to pay for things like rent, mortgage repayments, car leasing

  • Meal and Entertainment allowance via salary packaging up to $2,650 per annum

  • Receive 17.5% leave loading every time you take annual leave

  • Paid parental leave after 12 months of ongoing employment

  • Access for you and your family to our Employee Assistance Program

Ready to Apply?
If you're ready to help shape the future of vocational support for carers, we want to hear from you! For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Kate Mulvaney at KMulvaney@wellways.org

Please ensure you submit your updated CV/Resume along with a Cover Letter outlining your relevant experience.

To view the full Position Description click APPLY

Wellways Australia Limited is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. All applicants applying for roles within Wellways must undergo a screening process prior to their successful appointment.

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential. We aim to specifically promote safety and inclusivity for LGBTIQ+ and First Nations communities.

This is your opportunity to join a values based, growing, innovative and nationally recognised organisation with over 2,000 staff members across 93 sites.

SUSHIKOK







Vil du være med på holdet på Madklubbens nye restaurant i Pilestræde?






Med kræfter fra holdet bag Jade åbner vi snart en ny restaurant i hjertet af Pilestræde, og vi søger et stærkt team, der vil være med til at skabe og forme en ny og spændende restaurantoplevelse fra bunden.

Konceptet forener moderne sushi, dumplings og små deleretter i et stilfuldt og luksuriøst univers, hvor stemningen er levende, servicen nærværende og kvaliteten er i højsædet. Her er der fokus på smag, håndværk og en oplevelse, der får gæsterne til at vende tilbage igen og igen.





Hvem er du?

Du er en dygtig sushikok med sans for håndværk, præcision og råvarer af høj kvalitet.

Du har øje for detaljen og sætter en ære i at levere sushi med ensartet kvalitet og flot præsentation.

Du arbejder altid med ja-hat og ser udfordringer frem for problemer.

Du er struktureret og god til at planlægge dit arbejde - også når tempoet er højt.

Du trives i et travlt køkken med stor volumen og kan omstille dig, når service eller produktion kræver det.

Du er kvalitetsbevidst og har lyst til at bidrage med idéer til nye retter og smagsoplevelser.

Holdet er internationalt, så du skal kunne tale og forstå både dansk og engelsk.

Du har erfaring som sushikok.





Vi tilbyder

Som en del af Madklubben-familien med +40 restauranter, bliver du en del af et socialt fællesskab, hvor du finder et stærkt bagland til at hjælpe dig med at blive dygtigere og endnu mere succesfuld.  
Derudover tilbyder vi følgende:  


Gode uddannelses- og udviklingsmuligheder såsom f.eks. økonomi og lederkurser. 


Månedlige sociale arrangementer og personalefester. 

Personalerabat til at besøge vores andre restauranter.  

Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Pension og helbredssikring (tilbydes fuldtidsansatte).





Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt.
Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, hvis den rigtige dukker op, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning allerede i dag.  
 
Opstart: Midt september-start oktober. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Kontakt Gastronomisk chef Asger Klausen på asger@madklubben.dk.




Om Madklubben
Madklubben er én stor familie af restauranter i fordelt over hele landet.





Lige siden vi åbnede vores første restaurant i 2007, har vi haft en målsætning om at gøre restaurantbesøget tilgængeligt for flere i Danmark. Med langt over en million besøgende om året er vi godt på vej. Vi beskæftiger flere tusinde mennesker fordelt på 40+ restauranter, og vi har ambitioner om endnu flere. Derfor er vi altid på udkig efter talentfulde personligheder, der har lyst til at blive en del af Klubben.

Vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren

Fylde varer op på hylderne




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du: 

Er smilende og glad for kundekontakt

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende




Vi tilbyder


Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du:

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 151,52 kr. i timen som faglært og 142,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst fra HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

 

Vil du med på #teamlidl?
Sådan søger du stillingen:

Klik på "Søg nu"

Vedhæft dit motiverede CV

 

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00. 

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV!

Lidl-rabat: Få 10 % eller 20 % rabat på dine indkøb i vores butikker på udvalgte dage.





Rabatordning
Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.













        

        Klar til at søge jobbet?
Du behøver ikke vedhæfte en ansøgning når du søger et job hos os. I stedet ser vi gerne, at du skriver et par sætninger i starten af dit CV om, hvorfor du søger lige præcis det her job. For at sikre en effektiv og retfærdig rekrutteringsproces, bedes du undlade at tilføje et billede i dit CV.
Vi forpligter os til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces.
I Lidl har vi en klar vision om at være 1. valg som arbejdsgiver og det er vigtigt for os at være en inspirerende og attraktiv arbejdsplads for alle. title: Bliv proceskonsulent med fokus på AI-governance og compliance
description:
Bliv proceskonsulent med fokus på AI-governance og compliance 
             

             
            
 
                
 
                    
 
                 

             


             
             
                
 

 Vil du være med til at skabe værdi for Nykredits kunder og kolleger? Brænder du for at udvikle governance-, risiko- og complianceprocesser i en tid, hvor AI bliver en integreret del af forretningen? Har du en god analytisk sans og evnen til at omsætte komplekse krav til praktiske rammer og arbejdsgange, som kollegerne let kan arbejde efter? Så har vi en spændende mulighed til dig.
 
  Som vores nye kollega bidrager du til at udvikle og videreudvikle rammer, processer og kontroller for AI Governance, Risk & Compliance med fokus på at operationalisere dem i organisationens processer. Du arbejder tæt sammen med blandt andet forretningen, udviklingsteams, Tech Legal, IT-sikkerhed, Risk og Compliance for at skabe klarhed om regler, krav og risici med henblik på at omsætte dem til standarder og processer, som andre kan følge.
 
 Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver: 
 
 Omsætte regulatoriske krav, herunder AI Act og GDPR, til konkrete processer og standarder for AI indkøb, udvikling og implementering. 

 Bidrage til udvikling af et rammeværk for ansvarlig AI med fokus på at operationalisere krav og sikre rette systemunderstøttelse af AI GRC regler og processer. 

 Bidrage til risikoafdækning og kontroldesign, herunder etablere strukturer for løbende opfølgning og rapportering. 

 Sparre med procesejere, løsningsejere og udviklingsteams for at fremme risikobevidsthed og god praksis i udvikling og drift af AI-løsninger. 

 Bidrage til AI CoE'ets interne GRC forståelse gennem træning og kommunikation om ansvarlig brug af AI. 

 Medvirke til at modne organisationens anvendelse af AI gennem retningslinjer, processer og træning. 
 
 Er det dig, vi leder efter?
 Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse og solid erfaring inden for governance og risikostyring i komplekse og regulerede miljøer. Du har erfaring med AI-regulering og GDPR samt kendskab til finansiel lovgivning. Du har arbejdet med udvikling af processer og metoder i forbindelse med operationalisering af compliancekrav og regulatoriske initiativer. 

 Du har dokumenteret evne til at løse opgaver selvstændigt og bidrage til større initiativer, og du trives i en rolle, hvor du samarbejder tæt med interessenter fra blandt andet forretningen, IT og compliancefunktioner.
 
 Som person er du nysgerrig, struktureret og vant til at drive opgaver selvstændigt. Du skaber fremdrift omkring dig og bidrager til, at dine kollegaer lykkes. Du udviser naturligt ejerskab og har et solidt helhedssyn på området. Du trives med mange opgaver i spil og med frihed under ansvar, hvor du følger ting til dørs. Du motiveres af at skabe nyt og finde løsninger, selv når du møder modstand. 

 Du er dygtig i kommunikation og interessenthåndtering, kan formidle kompleks viden tydeligt og bidrage til forandring omkring dig. Du kan begå dig på flere niveauer i organisationen og har en god evne til at skabe netværk og relationer. Du er engageret i dit arbejde, og din energi smitter af på andre. Du er en holdspiller, som sætter holdet før dig selv og motiveres af at skabe resultater sammen. 

 Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan. 

 Dit nye team
  Du bliver en del af et tværgående team bestående af mere end 25 kolleger, som brænder for at drive AI- og new tech-agendaen frem i Nykredit-koncernen. Vi arbejder på tværs af organisationen og samarbejder tæt med både forretningen og specialistfunktioner for at sikre en ansvarlig og værdiskabende anvendelse af AI. 

 Hos os får du en inspirerende arbejdskultur, hvor der er plads til alle, og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig og tage øget ansvar i takt med din udvikling. Høj faglighed, samarbejde og humor er vigtige værdier for os. Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega. 

 Vil du vide mere?
 Du er velkommen til at kontakte Chefspecialist i AI CoE, Andrea Bidstrup, på telefon 20 91 18 70, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. 

 Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk. 

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV senest den 04.09.2026. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og lære mere om, hvordan du kan bidrage til Nykredits fortsatte arbejde med ansvarlig anvendelse af AI.

title: Principal Engineer - Hydroelectric & Pumped Storage Systems
description:
The role and responsibilities essentially includes -

- Technical Delivery & Expertise

- Lead and deliver mechanical, hydraulic and electromechanical engineering for conventional hydroelectric and pumped storage projects across feasibility, basic and detailed design, procurement, construction, commissioning and operational stages.

- Undertake and technically oversee key engineering activities, including:

- Project configuration, installed-capacity optimisation, number and rating of units, operating range and powerhouse arrangement

- Hydraulic design of intakes, waterways, pressure shafts, penstocks, manifolds, spiral casings, draft tubes, surge systems and tailraces

- Calculation of gross head, net head, design discharge, hydraulic losses and equipment design pressures

- Hydraulic transient, water-hammer and surge-control assessments for start-up, shutdown, load rejection, pump trip and emergency conditions

- Selection and sizing of Francis, Kaplan, Pelton and other applicable turbines for conventional hydro projects

- Selection and sizing of reversible pump-turbines and evaluation of fixed-speed, variable-speed and ternary pumped storage arrangements

- Review of hill charts, four-quadrant characteristics, efficiency, cavitation, vibration, pressure pulsation, runaway speed and operating restrictions

- Selection and specification of generators and motor-generators, including rating, speed, inertia, cooling, excitation, braking and starting arrangements

- Design and specification of main inlet valves, gates, stoplogs, trash racks, hoists and other hydro-mechanical equipment

- Design of cooling water, lubrication, drainage, dewatering, compressed air, service water, fire protection and mechanical auxiliary systems

- Powerhouse layouts, erection and maintenance clearances, lifting requirements, access and major equipment replacement arrangements

- Plant operating philosophy covering generation, pumping, start-up, shutdown, mode change, synchronous condenser operation and emergency sequences

- Prepare and review design basis reports, calculations, equipment selection studies, specifications, data sheets, P&IDs, layouts, bills of quantities and tender drawings.

- Coordinate turbine-generator and mechanical-system interfaces with civil, structural, geotechnical, electrical, grid and control-system teams.

- Provide mechanical and hydraulic inputs to energy modelling, feasibility assessment, project cost estimates, schedules, operating strategies and lifecycle evaluations.

- Identify risks relating to hydraulic transients, cavitation, erosion, vibration, fatigue, reliability, constructability and maintainability, and recommend mitigation measures.

- Assess existing hydro assets for refurbishment, uprating, efficiency improvement, residual life, equipment obsolescence and operational optimisation.

- Advisory, Procurement & Project Support

- Support pre-feasibility studies, feasibility studies, owner’s engineering, lender’s engineering, technical due diligence and independent engineering assignments for hydro and pumped storage projects.

- Prepare technical tender documents and evaluate OEM and contractor proposals for turbines, pump-turbines, generators, motor-generators, valves, gates and mechanical balance-of-plant packages.

- Review OEM calculations, drawings, performance curves, model-test results, guarantees, manufacturing documents and proposed technical deviations.

- Support manufacturing inspections, factory tests, construction, installation, commissioning, performance testing, equipment acceptance and site issue resolution.

-Technical Governance, Codes & Standards

- Establish SgurrEnergy’s hydro and pumped storage design philosophies, engineering procedures, calculation templates, specifications, checklists and technical review protocols.

- Ensure designs comply with applicable IEC, IEEE, ISO, ASME, IS and other relevant national and international hydropower codes, standards and statutory requirements.

- Act as the internal technical authority for critical mechanical and hydraulic deliverables and ensure assumptions, interfaces, design decisions and departures from standards are properly reviewed and documented.

- Quality Assurance & Reporting

- Prepare clear, technically robust and client-ready reports, design notes, specifications, bid evaluations, review comments, inspection reports, commissioning procedures and presentations.

- Support QA/QC reviews, supplier qualification, inspection and test plans, non-conformity resolution and acceptance criteria for major hydroelectric and pumped storage equipment.

- Collaboration & Capability Development

- Work across SgurrEnergy’s Business Verticals covering energy advisory, design and engineering, project management consultancy, power and grid dynamics, environmental and technical investigations, and quality assurance and inspections.

- Mentor engineers and develop internal capability in hydraulic machinery, hydro-mechanical systems, mechanical balance-of-plant, equipment selection and multidisciplinary hydroelectric power plant design.

- Develop training material, technical libraries, standard tools and lessons learned, and contribute to recruitment, knowledge-sharing sessions, technical papers and thought leadership.

- Operational Responsibilities

- Manage assigned technical scopes, resources, budgets, schedules, deliverables and multidisciplinary interfaces effectively.

- Travel domestically and internationally (approximately 15–25% of time) for site visits, investigations, client meetings, factory inspections and commissioning support.

- Support proposals, technical methodologies, effort estimates, client presentations and business development for hydroelectric and pumped storage opportunities.




Requirements

- In-depth expertise in complete hydroelectric power plant design, including turbines or pump-turbines, waterways, generators or motor-generators and mechanical balance-of-plant.

- Strong understanding of hydraulic transients, cavitation, sediment erosion, vibration, fatigue, equipment performance and plant operating requirements.

- Experience in feasibility, engineering design, specifications, OEM evaluation, manufacturing review, installation and commissioning.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, multidisciplinary coordination and engineering judgement.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to produce high-quality technical documentation and client presentations.

- Ability to lead complex assignments, mentor engineers and deliver quality work within agreed budgets and timelines.

title: Client Success Manager (Cybersecurity Focused)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cybersecurity Client Success Manager based in United States.

This role is a strategic, client-facing position responsible for ensuring organizations realize measurable value from their cybersecurity services. You will own the client relationship across the full security lifecycle, from onboarding and operational governance through renewals, service evolution, and escalations. Working closely with SOC analysts, security engineers, threat intelligence specialists, and advisory teams, you will connect technical delivery with business outcomes. The role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity operations alongside exceptional relationship and communication skills. You will help clients understand their security posture, risk exposure, and progress toward stronger security maturity. Success will be measured through client satisfaction, retention, value realization, and the quality of the overall security partnership.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation owner for assigned cybersecurity clients, building trusted relationships with client stakeholders and executives.
  • Own the complete client lifecycle, including onboarding, operational governance, renewal readiness, service transitions, and decommissioning.
  • Lead structured monthly and quarterly client governance meetings, ensuring clear agendas, documented outcomes, action tracking, and consistent follow-through.
  • Translate cybersecurity operations into executive-ready reporting covering security trends, investigations, risk posture, service performance, and other relevant metrics.
  • Demonstrate how managed security, SOC, and advisory services contribute to risk reduction, compliance readiness, and improved security maturity.
  • Partner with internal teams to establish and monitor success metrics aligned with each client's business and security objectives.
  • Coordinate between clients and SOC analysts, threat hunters, security engineers, advisory teams, finance, sales, and other delivery stakeholders.
  • Lead client escalations with urgency and sound judgment, minimizing friction and business disruption while protecting the client experience.
  • Support retention, renewal, and expansion opportunities by proactively communicating delivered value, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen security programs.
  • Identify service gaps, operational challenges, and process improvement opportunities, contributing to cybersecurity client success playbooks, dashboards, and standard operating procedures.
  • Monitor client outcomes and proactively identify opportunities to improve satisfaction, security maturity, and long-term partnership value.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience in client success, service delivery, account management, project coordination, or project management within cybersecurity, managed services, IT services, or a related environment.
    • Strong understanding of SOC operations, incident response, threat monitoring, and managed security service delivery models.
    • Demonstrated ability to explain complex cybersecurity and technical concepts clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.
    • Proven experience managing enterprise client relationships, renewals, escalations, and ongoing service delivery.
    • Strong client-first mindset with excellent relationship management, communication, organization, and stakeholder coordination skills.
    • Ability to operate confidently across technical and business environments while maintaining accountability for client outcomes.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage sensitive escalations calmly, decisively, and professionally.
    • Demonstrated commitment to integrity, accountability, continuous improvement, empathy, collaboration, and trust.
    • Cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are a plus.
    • Experience with SIEM platforms, SOC dashboards, security reporting tools, or similar cybersecurity technologies is preferred.
    • Experience with managed security services such as XDR, Continuous Vulnerability Exposure Management, penetration testing, or related offerings is advantageous.

      • Benefits

      • Annual salary of up to $90,000, depending on experience.
      • Comprehensive employee benefits.
      • Flexibility to work from another location, including an international destination, for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.
      • Opportunity to work in a client-focused cybersecurity environment with exposure to SOC, threat intelligence, security engineering, and advisory functions.
      • Culture centered on drive, empathy, collaboration, trust, inclusion, and continuous growth.
      • Equal opportunity workplace that values diverse skills, backgrounds, and experiences.
      • Support for reasonable interview accommodations where needed.

Til vores boligbutik i Næsby søger vi en dygtig salgskoordinator, med god energi og godt humør




























Er du klar til nye udfordringer og til at være den centrale del af en boligbutik med fuld fart på, og hvor dagene ikke er ens, så er du måske vores nye sagskoordinator i Næsby   



Vi søger en ambitiøs og selvstændig sagskoordinator, som gerne har erfaring med både før- og eftersagsbehandling og kan varetage den administrative del af en bolighandel fra start til slut.



Udover at være en del af et engageret team i butikken, hvor sparring er i hovedsædet, vil du også i dagligdagen have tæt sparring med vores ServiceCenter samt med de øvrige salgskoordinatorer i vores mange boligbutikker på landsplan. For os er det vigtigt, at der hele tiden er balance i din hverdag, således, at der hverken er alt for meget eller for lidt arbejde til dig som sagskoordinator. Dette klarer vi ved at udligne sagerne mellem afdelingerne, ligesom vi altid har en afdækningsplan for ferieperioderne.



Hos os lægger stor vægt på, at vores hverdag i butikken skal være god, og en hverdag hvor vi alle bidrager og bliver hørt. Vi bruger meget humor i dagligdagen og der er kort vej til et grin. Med faglighed og ordentlighed kommer vi langt, og vores overbevisning er, at arbejdsdagen bliver bedre og nemmere med god sparring og fleksibilitet fra alle sider. 



 



Dine arbejdsopgaver



Som vores nye sagskoordinator skal du:



	
Indhente nødvendige dokumenter til brug for salget

	
Deltage i udarbejdelse af boligpræsentation samt udarbejdelse af annoncer

	
Forberedelse og udarbejdelse af købsaftaler med kontakt til sælger og købers rådgiver

	
Digital tinglysning af skøde

	
Afslutning af salget samt udarbejdelse af refusionsopgørelse

	
Deltagelse i lokale markedsføringsaktiviteter 




 



Din baggrund 



Vi ser gerne at du har erfaring i et tilsvarende job, eller erfaring fra et servicecenter i mæglerbranchen - alternativ erfaring fra et advokatkontor. Er du administrativ trainee, gerne med 1 års erfaring i bagagen, hører vi også gerne fra dig. 



Du forstår vigtigheden af at arbejde struktureret og kan have mange bolde, såvel store som små, i luften på en gang. 



Du er af natur en fighter, der vil og kan få tingene til at lykkes ved en vedholdende indsats. Kendskab til Domidont og digital tinglysning vil være en fordel.



 



Vi tilbyder



Til gengæld kan vi tilbyde dig:



	
En fondsejet virksomhed med solidt økonomisk fundament

	
En attraktiv fast gage med tillæg af pensions- og sundhedsordning 

	
Et spændende og udfordrende job i en innovativ virksomhed i vækst

	
De allerbedste udviklingsmuligheder

	
Gode kolleger såvel i afdelingen som i alle vores øvrige butikker hvor sparring er i højsædet

	
Direkte kontakt og sparring med vores ServiceCenter

	
Sociale arrangementer på tværs af afdelinger

	
Løbende relevant efteruddannelse skræddersyet til dig




 



Fondsejet virksomhed



EDC Poul Erik Bech er for størstedelens vedkommende ejet af en almennyttig fond. Via overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter Poul Erik Bech Fonden primært foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Vores ønske er at være en aktiv bidragsyder til det lokalsamfund, som vi er en del af. Læs mere om fonden på www.poulerikbechfonden.dk



 



Din ansøgning



Din ansøgning bedes sendt til os via 'Søg stillingen', som du finder her på siden. Din ansøgning vil naturligvis blive behandlet fortroligt. Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte vores HR & Recruiting Manager Mette Hvilsom Forsbøl på mobil 2444 1808 mail mhf@edc.dk

Firmaet blev etableret i 1978, og er siden vokset til at blive Danmarks største og eneste landsdækkende ejendomsmæglervirksomhed. I dag består vi af flere end 77 boligbutikker og 19 erhvervscentre.

title: SOC Incident Responder
description:
Title:

SOC Incident Responder

The Opportunity

The SOC Incident Responder is responsible for identifying, investigating, containing, and responding to cybersecurity incidents affecting the organization's systems, networks, cloud environments, and users. This role serves as a key member of the Security Operations Center, performing rapid incident triage, threat analysis, containment actions, and escalation of significant security events.

The successful candidate will combine technical cybersecurity expertise with strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills to minimize risk and ensure timely response to cybersecurity threats.

Key Responsibilities

Incident Detection & Response

  • Monitor and investigate security alerts from Taegis, Defender as well as user or third-party reported incidents.

  • Perform initial triage and analysis of suspicious events and potential security incidents.

  • Determine incident severity, scope, and business impact.

  • Contain security incidents through actions such as:

    • Account disablement

    • Password resets

    • Session revocation

    • Device isolation

    • IP and domain blocking

  • Escalate complex or high-severity incidents to senior security personnel.

Investigation & Analysis

  • Analyze endpoint, network, identity, and cloud telemetry.

  • Correlate indicators of compromise (IOCs) with threat intelligence sources.

  • Conduct malware investigations and support forensic analysis activities.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure - AI Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure - AI Platform based in the United States.

This is a senior-level engineering role focused on building, optimizing, and operating critical data infrastructure in a highly regulated government cloud environment. You’ll work on a distributed serving layer that delivers fast, reliable data access for mission-critical investigations and applications. The role combines database performance engineering, data pipeline reliability, production operations, and modern AI-assisted development practices. You’ll take meaningful ownership of systems where availability, compliance, and operational resilience are essential. As part of a distributed and highly collaborative engineering team, you’ll work closely with data platform, product, and forward-deployed engineering partners. The environment values technical judgment, speed, experimentation, and end-to-end accountability. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise in distributed systems while contributing to technology with significant real-world impact.

Accountabilities

  • Own serving-layer performance: Lead performance tuning for a distributed OLAP serving layer, using query profiling and AI-assisted tools to identify and resolve inefficient query patterns before they become customer-facing issues.
  • Build and strengthen data pipelines: Develop and harden reliable pipelines supporting government cloud investigations, emphasizing correctness, scalability, maintainability, and compliance.
  • Improve infrastructure resilience: Become an independent operator of critical serving infrastructure, reducing single points of failure and strengthening the team’s ability to respond quickly to production incidents.
  • Lead production troubleshooting: Apply AI-assisted debugging, log analysis, code exploration, and systematic investigation techniques to identify root causes and resolve complex production issues efficiently.
  • Own operational reliability: Participate in on-call rotations, respond to incidents, improve operational procedures, and ensure lessons from production events are incorporated into runbooks and infrastructure improvements.
  • Deliver high-impact infrastructure projects: Take initiatives from technical investigation and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operational ownership.
  • Support compliance and security requirements: Build and maintain infrastructure capabilities that meet evolving government cloud requirements, including audit, data retention, backup, and reliability standards.
  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Data Platform, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and other engineering teams to maintain reliable capabilities and alignment across government and commercial environments.
  • Apply AI to engineering workflows: Use AI tools to accelerate debugging, code review, research, documentation, configuration, and other development workflows while maintaining strong engineering standards.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy: Make evidence-based decisions around system architecture, performance, reliability, and trade-offs, while sharing expertise with the broader engineering organization.
  • Drive continuous improvement: Participate in sprint planning, team discussions, production retrospectives, and asynchronous collaboration to improve systems, processes, and operational practices.

    • Requirements

    • U.S. citizenship is required due to government cloud data access requirements.
    • Strong hands-on experience operating distributed OLAP, analytical database, or serving-layer systems, such as StarRocks, Trino, ClickHouse, or similar technologies.
    • Demonstrated expertise in query tuning, database performance optimization, and distributed systems at scale.
    • Experience owning data pipeline reliability, production infrastructure, incident response, and operational troubleshooting.
    • Strong understanding of production systems and the ability to independently take ownership of unfamiliar infrastructure with limited oversight.
    • Experience with on-call responsibilities and a demonstrated commitment to operational excellence, reliability, and effective incident management.
    • Proven ability to use AI-powered engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor, or comparable platforms to accelerate debugging, code review, research, documentation, and development.
    • Strong applied AI fluency, with the ability to use AI not only for automation but also to structure problems, improve output quality, and increase engineering leverage.
    • Excellent technical judgment and a strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take problems from discovery through resolution and production deployment.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in distributed, cross-functional engineering environments.
    • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment where priorities may shift and ambiguity is common.
    • Ability to balance rapid execution with high standards for reliability, security, compliance, maintainability, and technical quality.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work for eligible US-based employees.
      • Opportunity to work on sophisticated data infrastructure supporting mission-critical government cloud applications.
      • Hands-on exposure to distributed database technologies, AI-assisted engineering, production systems, and highly regulated cloud environments.
      • High-autonomy engineering culture where system operators have significant influence over architecture and technical trade-offs.
      • Close collaboration with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams across data platform, product, and forward-deployed engineering.
      • Opportunity to work on technically challenging problems with meaningful real-world impact.
      • Fast-paced environment emphasizing ownership, experimentation, technical craftsmanship, and continuous learning.
      • Exposure to evolving AI engineering practices and an organizational culture where applied AI fluency is considered an important part of technical excellence.
      • Distributed-first working environment with strong asynchronous communication and clear ownership across projects.

AI Software Engineer

We are seeking a motivated and curious AI Software Engineer to help build and support next-generation AI solutions, including Agentic AI capabilities that can plan, reason, and complete tasks using tools and workflows. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate or early-career engineer with a passion for artificial intelligence, software development, and solving real-world business problems.

Working alongside experienced engineers and AI specialists, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of AI-powered applications that improve customer experiences and business operations while learning modern AI engineering practices.

This is not a Remote position but 4 days in the office and 1 Hybrid

Key Responsibilities

AI Application Development

  • Assist in designing, developing, and testing AI-powered applications and intelligent workflows.
  • Build and integrate APIs, internal services, and data sources that support AI solutions.
  • Help develop AI agents capable of completing business tasks using large language models (LLMs) and workflow orchestration tools.
  • Participate in improving the reliability, quality, and performance of AI applications.

Software Engineering

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code using modern software engineering practices.
  • Contribute to cloud-based applications and backend services.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines, testing, monitoring, and deployment activities.
  • Troubleshoot issues and participate in debugging and performance improvements.

Learning & Innovation

  • Learn emerging AI technologies, including large language models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and AI agent frameworks.
  • Experiment with new tools and techniques to improve AI capabilities.
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team knowledge sharing.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with software engineers, product managers, architects, and data teams to deliver AI solutions.
  • Help translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Contribute ideas and continuously improve development processes.

Security & Responsible AI

  • Help ensure AI applications protect sensitive information and comply with company policies.
  • Learn and apply responsible AI principles when developing AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with Python and an interest in learning additional programming languages as needed.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, object-oriented programming, and software development fundamentals.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) through coursework or projects is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies and grow in a collaborative environment.

Experience with any of the following through coursework, internships, research, hackathons, or personal projects:

  • Python AI frameworks such as Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar tools
  • Prompt engineering or LLM application development
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Docker or containerization
  • SQL and relational databases
  • JavaScript, Java, or Go
  • GitHub Actions or CI/CD concepts
  • AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor

What Success Looks Like

  • Successfully contributes to AI projects while growing technical expertise.
  • Delivers reliable, well-tested code and collaborates effectively with teammates.
  • Continuously learns new AI technologies and applies them to solve business problems.
  • Demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to take on new challenges.
  • Helps build AI solutions that improve customer experience and business operations.

description:

  Job Description:  

    Are you a skilled IT Project Manager looking for new assignments? Have you got experience and insights into IT Infrastructure? Do you like managing different stakeholders and ensuring coordination? If yes, this position within Infrastructure & Operations might be of your interest! 

  

  Satair is growing and we have several projects in the pipeline for Digital and IT, which will require careful and diligent management. To ensure a structured, transparent and controlled project execution, we’re looking for a new colleague who has this type of experience.  

  

  The position is based in our headquarters in Copenhagen in Infrastructure & Operations.   

  

 What the job is … 

  The colleague we’re looking for is a person who finds joy in working with people and gets motivation from driving forward projects. As we’re a global company, you will need good human skills and the ability to coordinate, communicate and most importantly plan. You will mainly be conducting the projects in accordance with the Waterfall methodology and work with colleagues in Satair, Airbus and with suppliers too.  

  

  You will be the colleague who brings together the others, to ensure that the overview is kept. You will be facilitating technical meetings and SteerCo meetings, requiring that you’re able to talk with different audiences. Most of our projects involve costs, so a financial understanding will be needed to manage the project budgets.  

  

  Our main collaboration is done on Google Workspace but, there are other tools in use for some projects such as Planisware and JIRA. Experience with these will therefore be a benefit.  

  

  An important element of the role is understanding urgency and importance and helping to put attention to deadlines and deliverables. It obviously requires an element of pacing and ensuring that all parties have the same priorities, here your efforts and persistence are needed.  

  

 Key responsibilities 
 
 
  Secure alignment of project objectives, scope, and success criteria with stakeholders  
 

 
  Coordinate, follow-up and monitor the activities conducted by the project team (from start to finish)  
 

 
  Maintain the baseline project plan, budget, and resource allocation, ensuring timely delivery of milestones  
 

 
  Report on projects and their budget/costs  
 

 
  Proactively identify, monitor, and mitigate risks, issues, and dependencies  
 

 
  Ensure compliance with governance processes, quality gates, and reporting standards  
 

 
  Provide regular and transparent status updates to the Steering Committee (SteerCo) and stakeholders  
 

 
  Assist with Portfolio Management, building of our roadmap, and update management on the high level priorities progress  
 
 
  

 How you will contribute to the team 

  

  You offer experience from previous positions that has a red line to the discipline of Project Management. The experience (hopefully) tells you that for every start, there’s an element of uncertainty which has to be addressed and managed. Your approach would ideally be to break a big task into smaller pieces, as you acknowledge that everything isn’t done in one stroke but, more likely, several strokes involving different colleagues.   

  

  You enjoy working with tasks and appreciate adding structure e.g. in terms of visible planning. You take personal pride in communicating our progress and ensure that the message is easily understood. We can’t take for granted that all stakeholders have the technical expertise, meaning your ability to adapt the message matters.  

  

  You have an interest in IT Infrastructure and know the overall aspects. We don’t expect you to be a technician within a certain area but, we foresee that knowing the basics will be of big help to everyone (including yourself).  

  

  You’re not scared by tasks where the goal is known but all of the means might not be identified yet. Many big IT Infrastructure projects have elements and dependencies to other areas than the one in topic, it’s therefore your responsibility to help us identify these so we can make qualified decisions.  

  

  As Satair is an international company, it is positive if you are motivated by working with colleagues from different cultures and in different locations. Satair is a subsidiary of Airbus and has strong connections to Airbus - we therefore see it as a plus if you have experience from working in a large organisation previously.  

  

  The company language is English so you will need to be able to practise this at a professional level.  

  

 What are we looking for? How much experience? What type of experience?  
 
 
  4-6 years of experience in a similar position  
 

 
  General understanding of IT and Operations (network, communication, security, hardware etc.)  
 

 
  An education relevant for the position, e.g. a bachelor degree  
 

 
  Knowledge and experience collaboration platforms and planning tools  
 

 
  Fluent in English both written and verbally  
 

 
  Can offer valid references to attest your  experience/skills/personality   
 

 
  A curious mindset and problem solving attitude  
 
 
  

 What does your next challenge look like? 

  

  At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.  

  

  We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.  

  

  In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.  

  

  Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.  

  

  If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.  

     

 Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company! 

  

 About SATAIR 

  Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable  transformation.    

  

  With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.  

  

  Welcome to the Satair family!  

     

  If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website    www.SATAIR.com    or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at       www.youtube.com/sataircompany     !  

     

  

 What do we offer at SATAIR? 

  At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.  

  

  SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!   

  

  Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:   

  Financial Benefits:   Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses   

  Employee Health and Wellbeing:   On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme, 4 care days, senior days  

  Learning and Development:   Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience  

  

 Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company 

  Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!  

  We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

title: Offsite Medical Specialist- Ultrasound Technologist, Radiology, Greenlawn, Long Island, New York, Full Time, Days,
description:
The Ultrasound Technologist performs or assists in ultrasound examinations and procedures, renders technical assistance to the Radiologist, and maintains and cares for all ultrasound equipment.

  1. Prepares and examines all patients, verifying their identity for ultrasound examinations in accordance with established departmental procedures and techniques, which includes obtaining health status and medical history, patient’s cooperation or ability to tolerate the examination. Confirms that the ultrasound examination correlates with patient clinical history and presentation. Inform physician in charge of any contraindications or changes needed to the procedure.
  2. Communicates with the patient explaining the exam and instructions, answering questions that are unrelated to specific diagnostic, treatment and/or prognosis.
  3. Develops and/or modifies a procedure plan from health status and medical history, using age and gender appropriate considerations. Uses independent professional judgment to adopt the procedure plan to optimize exam results. Performs exams under general or direct physician supervision as defined by the procedure, adjusting scanning technique to optimize image qualify and spectral waveform characteristics.
  4. Analyzes sonographic findings so comprehensive exams sufficient for a physician to direct patient management and render a diagnosis can be obtained. Perform measurements and calculations according to laboratory and ACR protocols and guidelines. Minimize patient exposure to acoustic energy without compromising exam quality or completeness.
  5. Notifies appropriate health care provider when immediate medical attention is needed. Evaluates patient's physical and mental status prior to discharge from the ultrasound department.
  6. Records diagnostic images and data for use by the interpreting physician in rendering a diagnosis and for archival purposes. Provides a written summary of preliminary findings to the radiologist.
  7. Applies the necessary technical judgment to obtain studies of an acceptable diagnostic quality according to written protocols and the patients’ needs.
  8. Assists, prepares and positions patients as required to perform Ultrasound procedures.
  9. Provides patient education relevant to specific imaging procedures by informing the patient of the nature of the procedure, the area to be imaged and any specific instructions the patient may need.
  10. Ensures all images are appropriately labeled as specified by the department SOP.
  11. Assists with QA/QC program ensuring compliance with all regulatory agency requirements.
  12. Assists physician directly as required during procedures (e.g., Biopsies, MSK injections, etc.)
  13. Ensures images are transmitted to PACS in a timely fashion.
  14. Ensures Ultrasound room and equipment cleanliness, at the start and at the end of the shift, to include removal of soiled or dirty linen.
  15. Maintains supplies and accessories in imaging room necessary to safely perform duties, as required.
  16. Accurately records all required patient tracking information, and exam notes into Epic Radiant
  17. Ensures that all studies performed are correct and completed in Epic Radiant and PACS immediately after completion of exam.
  18. Performs related clerical duties in the absence of support personnel.
  19. Informs supervisor or appropriate personnel of needed repairs to equipment or unsafe conditions.
  20. Prevents the spread of infection to self, patients, visitors, and other employees by adhering to infection control policies and protocol.
  21. Attends in-services and other professional development meetings as required.
  22. Maintains appropriate Continuing Medical Education credits.
  23. Performs related clerical duties in the absence of support personnel.
  • Associates degree (AA) or equivalent from a college or technical school
  • 0-2 years of experience as Ultrasound Technician.
  • SPI Certification and a graduate from an accredited Ultrasound Technician program and will complete the ARDMS within one year of hire. American Registry of Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) RVT certification must also be completed within one year of hire.
