title: Solution Architect
description:
The role

The Solution Architect is a client-facing consultant in Technical Services who turns complex client goals into secure, scalable solutions on Zeta's platforms. You lead discovery, design, estimation, build, and optimisation, balancing business outcomes, delivery effort, technical risk, and long-term maintainability.

You work across marketing automation, loyalty, data, and integrations, supporting work that ranges from targeted enhancements to complex enterprise programmes. You remain hands-on throughout the delivery lifecycle, leveraging AI and automation where appropriate to improve efficiency, quality, and time to value. You contribute to pre-sales scoping and collaborate closely with delivery, product, and technical colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Lead client scoping sessions and workshops on their business and technical challenges, uncover the use cases that drive the design, and take it through to requirements and sign-off.

  • Scope and estimate the work, design the most efficient solution to meet the client's goals on our platform, and advise on the fastest path to value.

  • Own the end-to-end solution design for assigned clients across marketing automation, people-based and email marketing, loyalty, and marketing cloud/CDP, covering identity, data, APIs, orchestration, and measurement. Be their main technical contact and keep delivery on track against what was agreed.

  • Consult on web and digital experiences, and design, deploy, and troubleshoot site tagging (i.e. GTM, Tealium, Adobe Launch, data layer, event/conversion tracking, identity sync, consent).

  • Produce and maintain clear technical artefacts: solution designs, data mappings, integration specs, test plans, handover docs, and reusable assets, and guide testing through to issue resolution.

  • Weigh trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, and time to value, and spot risks early with practical alternatives to resolve them.

  • Support project managers on timelines by giving input on each part of the solution and where the effort sits.

  • Get hands-on to build and test solutions, support the delivery team, and work with technical and data specialists where the design needs deeper input.

  • Feed client needs that go beyond current product capability back to the Product team, and support pre-sales scoping and effort estimates with sales and technical colleagues.

What you'll bring

We care most about solutioning and client-facing strength: running a workshop, working out what a client really needs, and turning it into a clear, efficient solution. Strong problem-solving, an eye for detail, and broad MarTech awareness matter more than knowing every tool on day one. Excited about the role but don't tick every box below? Apply anyway.

  • Solutioning & client-facing: you can run a workshop, draw out what a client really needs, shape it into a clear design, and hold your own in front of mid-market and enterprise clients.

  • Consulting or delivery experience: 4+ years turning business needs into working technical solutions, in solution architecture, consulting, integration, or SaaS delivery.

  • Requirements & documentation: comfortable capturing requirements and designs through BRDs, SSDs, FSDs, wireframes, workflows, diagrams, and mock-ups.

  • A technical foundation: comfortable across data, APIs, and web, and able to reason through integrations and trade-offs, even where a platform is new to you.

  • Communication & influence: you explain things clearly to both technical and executive audiences and guide clients to good decisions without needing polished decks.

  • Hands-on and curious: happy to get into the build, automate the repetitive, and learn new platforms quickly.

  • Marketing technology: marketing cloud or CDP, marketing automation, loyalty, or CRM platforms.

  • Web & tagging: JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, XML/XSL, REST and SOAP APIs, and site tagging with tools like Google Tag Manager, Tealium, or Adobe Launch.

  • Data: SQL and relational databases such as MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server, plus data modelling, ETL/ELT, JSON, and webhooks.

  • Delivery method: familiarity with the software delivery lifecycle and how requirements, design, build, testing, and maintenance fit together.

  • Identity & media: email identity, addressability, people-based marketing, or programmatic/DSP.

  • Automation & AI: scripting in Python and using AI or LLM tools to speed up delivery and QA.

  • Commercial awareness: a working understanding of the sales process and how solutioning supports it.

  • Ways of working: comfortable working with local and remote teams across time zones; a second language is a plus.

  • Education & certifications: a relevant technical or business qualification, or certifications in cloud, data, or delivery.

title: TAC2 Engineer
description:
Description:

BHARTI AIRTEL LTD

Job Description

Network TAC2 Engineer

Department: B2B/GSMC/Network Operations / Technical Support

Reports To: TAC Team Lead / Network Support Manager

Shift: 24×7 Rotational

Location: Manesar

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary

Bharti Airtel is looking for an experienced Network TAC2 Engineer to provide advanced technical support for enterprise networking infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting complex network issues, configuring and hardening Cisco devices, and ensuring high availability across the network environment, working in a 24×7 shift-based support model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 technical support for network-related incidents escalated from TAC1, ensuring timely diagnosis and resolution.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Cisco routers and switches in production environments.
  • Design and implement high-availability solutions using HSRP and other failover mechanisms to minimize downtime.
  • Configure and manage AAA (Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting) for secure network access control.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize BGP routing for WAN/ISP connectivity and multi-site environments.
  • Plan and execute Cisco IOS upgrades, including compatibility checks, rollback planning, and change management coordination.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or critical network incidents and provide permanent fixes.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, topology diagrams, and troubleshooting runbooks.
  • Collaborate with TAC1, NOC, and engineering teams to resolve escalations and improve network stability.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs for incident response and resolution.
  • Work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays as per roster.

Key Skills Required

Technical Skill

Description

Routing Protocol

Static, Dynamic (OSPF, BGP)

Redundancy Protocol

HSRP, VRRP, GLBP

Router configuration.

Hand-on experience on Cisco must. Fortinet, Huawei would be add-on.

IOS Upgradation

Planning and executing Cisco IOS upgrades with minimal downtime

Others

VLAN, AAA, IPSEC, Netflow, SNMP, TCP/IP, Subnetting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
  • 0–5 years of experience in network support/TAC roles, preferably in an ISP, telecom, or large enterprise environment.
  • Cisco certifications preferred: CCNP (Routing & Switching / Enterprise), CCNA as minimum.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, IPSEC, Failover and general networking fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (Everest/Zabbix/SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Work Details

  • Shift: 24×7 Rotational (Rotational offs)
  • Location: Manesar

title: Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market based in the United States.

This is a senior, high-visibility program leadership role responsible for shaping how complex go-to-market initiatives are planned, launched, and continuously improved.
You will lead major and minor product launches while building scalable operating models across Product, Design, Marketing, Communications, and Field Enablement.
The role combines strategic program management with hands-on execution, requiring you to turn ambiguity into clear decisions, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
You will also help transform traditional program management by embedding AI agents and automation into recurring workflows and cross-functional processes.
Working with significant autonomy and executive visibility, you will influence senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Success will be measured through business and customer outcomes such as pipeline, adoption, consumption, brand impact, and community engagement—not simply activity volume.
This is an opportunity to establish the operating model for a fast-moving, distributed organization and help define what AI-enabled go-to-market execution looks like at scale.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead a concurrent portfolio of high-priority go-to-market initiatives, establishing clear owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and decision points.
  • Own the planning and orchestration of major and minor product launches, including launches connected to company events, weekly announcements, customer adoption initiatives, and pipeline-generating activities.
  • Build and continuously improve scalable launch frameworks and program management practices that enable more than 15 launches annually to run with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Coordinate dependencies across Product Management, Product Design, Product & Technical Marketing, Growth Marketing, Communications, Social, Field Enablement, Sales, and other go-to-market functions.
  • Provide executives and senior stakeholders with concise context, risks, options, recommendations, and clear decisions rather than activity-focused status reporting.
  • Design decision stages and working processes that surface blockers and tradeoffs early, enabling teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Translate recurring manual coordination into AI-powered workflows and automations that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
  • Partner with the marketing AI transformation function when workflows require broader adoption, governance, skills development, or department-level implementation.
  • Establish quality controls throughout program execution and confirm that market-facing assets, messaging, and launch components land as intended.
  • Develop reusable playbooks, processes, and operating models so each launch cycle becomes more efficient and effective than the previous one.
  • Monitor outcomes with relevant data, including pipeline, adoption, consumption, brand impact, and community engagement, and incorporate learnings into future programs.
  • Lead retrospectives, identify systemic improvements, and remove unnecessary processes when they no longer create value.
  • Escalate decisions early with a clear recommendation or specific request when issues require senior leadership input.

    • Requirements:

    • Significant experience in go-to-market program management within the high-tech industry, particularly across complex, multi-stakeholder and cross-functional initiatives.
    • Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or transforming program operating models within large, distributed organizations, with measurable business results.
    • Proven hands-on experience with AI agents, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that have been deployed and used in real production environments.
    • A track record of identifying manual processes and converting them into practical AI workflows while helping teams adopt new ways of working.
    • Strong understanding of product releases and their implications for marketing, communications, enablement, sales, and broader go-to-market organizations.
    • Ability to establish effective launch and program frameworks without introducing unnecessary meetings, bureaucracy, or administrative overhead.
    • Strong strategic judgment and a bias toward action, with the ability to frame risks, evaluate options, and drive decisions across competing priorities.

title: HR Coordinator to GN Hearing
description:
HR Coordinator to GN Hearing

 locations

 time type 
 Full time   
 

 
 
      
  
      
 
 posted on

 job requisition id

 Be part of the team that keeps the employee experience running well every day. 

  

 In the role of HR Coordinator in our HR Operations team (part of People & Communication), you will deliver high-quality HR support across the employee lifecycle, while partnering closely with managers, employees and People & Communication (P&C) colleagues across GN. 

  

 You are someone who gets the details right, builds trust through collaboration, and combines a friendly, responsive approach with sound judgment. You are comfortable asking questions and thinking critically. 

 In this role, you will take ownership of your own primary business areas while working closely with colleagues across HR Operations and the wider P&C organization. You can expect a multicultural environment and a broad stakeholder landscape, both within the P&C team and across the business. 

  

 As GN undergoes an organizational change, this role will be key in supporting the Hearing business area. 

  

 The Team you will be part of: 

 You will join an experienced team of five HR specialists in Ballerup, delivering a broad range of HR operational services across the organization. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and continuously look for ways to improve our services, processes, and impact. 

 Beyond strong day-to-day support, we are shaping a more proactive and business-relevant HR Operations function. 

  

 We value different perspectives and believe strong results come from combining operational excellence with curiosity, teamwork, and a willingness to improve how we work. 

  

 Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:  
 
 
 Serve as a first point of contact for employees and managers, providing clear guidance and support on HR-related questions and processes 
 

 
 Manage employee lifecycle transactions: onboarding, hires, transfers, organizational changes, terminations, and data changes 
 

 
 Handle requests with a high level of quality, accuracy, and timeliness 
 

 
 Prepare employee documentation and maintain accurate HR records, including contracts and employment changes 
 

 
 Coordinate with Payroll on hires, changes, and terminations 
 

 
 Liaise with Pension providers on hires, changes and terminations 
 

 
 Partner with P&C Business Partners, Talent Attraction Partners, and managers in your assigned business areas 
 

 
 Maintain high data quality and compliance (incl. GDPR) in HR systems and files 
 

 
 Contribute to cross-functional HR initiatives, continuous improvement, and AI-enabled ways of working 
 
 
  

 Besides your main tasks, you will have room to shape your position and take up new responsibilities. If you for example have experience with describing and updating processes, policies, and intranet sites, this may also be part of your tasks. 

 At GN, we encourage flexible working whenever possible. We trust our people to manage their responsibilities, know when in-person collaboration creates the most value, and be present when it matters most. 

  

 To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:  
 
 
 Bring some years of experience from HR administration / HR Operations in a larger international company 
 

 
 Have what it takes to be a trusted advisor towards the business and partner effectively with managers, employees, and colleagues 
 

 
 Bring solid Workday experience and good understanding of HR processes and relevant legal requirements 
 

 
 Work in a structured way with attention to detail and high data quality in a changing environment 
 

 
 Are comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and managing changing priorities 
 

 
 Combine a friendly, service-oriented mindset with independent, critical thinking and the confidence to ask questions and push back constructively 
 

 
 Communicate clearly in Danish and English and build trust through collaboration 
 

 
 Can handle confidential and sensitive information with care 
 
 
  

 We encourage you to apply 

 Even if you do not match every qualification, we welcome your application if you believe you have relevant transferable skills. We value mindset and motivation alongside experience, and we are committed to supporting your growth as well as that of your team and the wider GN organization. 

  

 We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process 

 All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. We encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to support an equal application process. 

  

 If you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know when accepting the invitation. 

  

 How to apply? 

 Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than August 20th, 2026. Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying - quick and easy. 

  

 We review applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We will close and unpublish the position once we have identified the candidate to hire, which might be before the above-mentioned date. 

  

 Join us in bringing people closer  

 GN brings people closer through our intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we create technology that enhances hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and deliver great experiences for audio and gaming users. 

  

 GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement  here.   

  

 We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

title: Principal Engineer - Instrumentation and Control
description:
We are seeking an experienced Control & Instrumentation (C&I) Engineer to support the design, specification, implementation and commissioning of instrumentation and control systems for power generation and energy infrastructure projects. The role includes development of control philosophies, instrument specifications, DCS/PLC architecture, package integration, functional safety, and multidisciplinary engineering coordination throughout FEED, Detailed Design and EPC phases.

  • Prepare Instrument Index, I/O Lists and Instrument Datasheets.
  • Develop Instrument Specifications for Pressure Instruments, Temperature Instruments, Flow Measurement Systems, Level Instruments, Analysers (CEMS, Gas Detectors etc.), Control Valves, On-Off Valves.
  • Develop Hook-up Drawings and Installation Details.
  • Review vendor documentation and resolve technical queries.
  • Experience in Systems Configuration for DCS/PLC/SCADA, including logic building, graphics development, tuning, and point database creation.
  • Design Network Architectures for control systems, including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and redundant networks.
  • Interface with OEMs and engineering teams for system design, upgrades, migrations, and modernization projects.
  • Develop system backups strategies, security policies, and compliance with instrumentation standards.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and change management records.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation Engineering or related field.
  • Good knowledge on IEC codes.
  • Experience in C&I systems, preferably in power plants, CCGT, utilities, oil & gas, or process industries.
  • Strong Experience in reviewing interface with PLC, SCADA, DCS and Metering Systems.
  • Detailed design projects, FEED studies, performance testing and operational support consultancy services within the power industry.
  • Experience in preparation of EPC tender Documents.
  • Knowledge and experience of major industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in working with a major EPC Contractor on complex FEED or Detailed Design Projects
  • Experience preferably in power plants, CCGT, utilities, oil & gas, or process industries.

description:

title: Staff Data Engineer - AI Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Data Engineer - AI Platform based in the United States.

This is a staff-level engineering opportunity focused on the architecture, reliability, and performance of critical data infrastructure supporting a high-availability government cloud environment. You’ll work on a distributed serving layer that transforms complex datasets into fast, dependable answers for mission-critical investigations. The role combines deep data engineering, distributed systems, database optimization, production operations, and AI-assisted development. You’ll have broad technical ownership and play a key role in strengthening infrastructure resilience, scalability, and compliance. The environment is fast-moving and highly collaborative, with engineers empowered to make technical decisions close to the systems they operate. You’ll partner across data platform, product, and forward-deployed engineering teams while tackling technically challenging problems with real-world impact. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who thrives on autonomy, ambiguity, high standards, and meaningful technical challenges.

Accountabilities

  • Lead data infrastructure strategy: Provide technical leadership for the distributed serving layer and help shape its architecture, scalability, performance, reliability, and long-term evolution.
  • Own database performance: Drive performance optimization for the serving layer, using advanced query profiling and AI-assisted tooling to identify bottlenecks and resolve inefficient query patterns before they affect customers.
  • Build and harden data pipelines: Design, develop, and improve reliable pipelines supporting government cloud investigations, with strong attention to scalability, correctness, maintainability, and compliance.
  • Strengthen infrastructure resilience: Reduce single points of failure by becoming a senior independent owner of critical infrastructure and improving system redundancy, operational readiness, and incident response.
  • Lead production troubleshooting: Apply sophisticated debugging, log analysis, AI-assisted research, and code exploration to diagnose complex production problems and deliver rapid, durable fixes.
  • Drive operational excellence: Participate in on-call responsibilities, improve runbooks and monitoring, lead incident retrospectives, and translate operational learnings into lasting infrastructure improvements.
  • Deliver critical infrastructure initiatives: Take complex projects from technical discovery and architectural design through implementation, deployment, validation, and ongoing ownership.
  • Support regulatory and compliance needs: Build infrastructure capabilities that satisfy evolving government cloud requirements around availability, auditing, data retention, backups, security, and operational controls.
  • Champion AI-enabled engineering: Use AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, code reviews, documentation, configuration, research, and other workflows while maintaining rigorous technical standards.
  • Influence technical direction: Make evidence-based architectural and engineering decisions, communicate trade-offs clearly, and contribute technical perspective to broader Data Platform initiatives.
  • Mentor and raise engineering standards: Share expertise, improve engineering practices, and help create a culture of strong ownership, craftsmanship, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across functions: Work closely with Data Platform, Product, Forward Deployed Engineering, and other teams to ensure reliable capabilities and alignment across critical environments.

    • Requirements

    • U.S. citizenship is required due to government cloud data access requirements.
    • Extensive hands-on experience designing, operating, and scaling distributed OLAP, analytical database, or serving-layer systems, including technologies such as StarRocks, Trino, ClickHouse, or comparable platforms.
    • Deep expertise in query optimization, database performance, distributed systems, and large-scale data infrastructure.
    • Strong track record owning data pipeline reliability, production infrastructure, incident response, and operational excellence.
    • Demonstrated ability to take end-to-end ownership of complex infrastructure, from architecture and implementation through production operations.
    • Experience independently troubleshooting unfamiliar systems and making sound technical decisions in high-pressure production environments.
    • Strong experience with on-call operations, incident management, observability, and reliability engineering practices.
    • Advanced practical fluency with AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor, or similar platforms, using them to accelerate research, debugging, code review, development, documentation, and problem-solving.
    • Ability to use AI strategically to improve engineering quality, speed, leverage, and decision-making rather than simply automate repetitive tasks.
    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, compliance, and maintainability.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across teams and explain complex concepts clearly.
    • Demonstrated leadership through technical influence, mentorship, and the ability to raise engineering standards without relying solely on formal authority.
    • Comfortable operating in a high-velocity, high-ownership environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is part of the work.
    • Strong bias toward action, experimentation, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote work for eligible US-based employees.
      • Opportunity to provide technical leadership over sophisticated data infrastructure supporting mission-critical government cloud applications.
      • Significant autonomy and influence over architecture, infrastructure strategy, technical standards, and operational practices.
      • Hands-on exposure to distributed data systems, AI-assisted engineering, production infrastructure, and highly regulated cloud environments.
      • Opportunity to solve complex technical problems at the intersection of AI, security, public safety, and mission-critical technology.
      • Collaborative distributed-first culture with strong asynchronous communication and close cross-functional partnership.
      • Environment that values technical craftsmanship, ownership, experimentation, speed, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunities to mentor other engineers and shape engineering practices across the broader organization.
      • Meaningful work with tangible real-world impact and opportunities for continued technical growth.

title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
  • Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
  • Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
  • Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
  • Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

  • A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
  • A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
  • A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
  • A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
  • An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
  • Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
  • A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

What’s in it for you:

  • A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
  • Competitive compensation package + bonus
  • 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)
  • Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
  • Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
  • Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
  • Paid parental leave
  • Central office with a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
  • Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
  • Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms
  • Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Som souschef tager du aktiv del i det daglige arbejde i butikken, og får medansvar for butikkens drift og resultater. Hos os får du ansvar lige fra første arbejdsdag og bliver samtidig en del af et ambitiøst karriereudviklingsforløb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi nemlig høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen, med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig.
Som souschef i Lidl får du en ansvarsfuld rolle med spændende udfordringer og en konkurrencedygtig lønpakke. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, så du har forudsætningerne for at opnå succes i din nye stilling.




Om jobbet


Som souschef er du med til at drive butikken og lede medarbejderne. Du har medansvar for, at butikken lever op til kundernes forventninger, så de bliver ved med at handle hos os. Ud over at bestille varer, fylde op og ekspedere kunderne ved kassen, får du også følgende opgaver, som du løser i tæt samarbejde med butikschefen:

Planlægning af ressourcer og prioritering af arbejdsopgaver 

Oplæring af medarbejdere, så de efterlever Lidls værdier og butikskoncepter

Ledelse af medarbejdere så de lykkes i deres job

Sørge for, at vores butikskoncepter overholdes

Ansvar for butikken når butikschefen ikke er til stede 




Om dig


Du er en empatisk og stærk ledertype, der har nemt ved motivere dine medarbejdere. Du bliver respekteret for din faglighed, og du sætter en ære i at tage del i arbejdsopgaverne i den daglige drift, og være med til at sikre, at butikken altid står snorlige og salgsklar. 
Du er godt rustet til jobbet, hvis du:

Har brancheerfaring og gerne erfaring fra lignende stilling

Har gennemført et lederkursus eller er motiveret for at udvikle dig som leder

Har en venlig og professionel fremtoning

Inspirerer dine medarbejdere til at følge dit gode eksempel

Har overblik og fokus på detaljen 

Ser butikken som et team og ikke er bleg for at give en hånd med, når en kollega har brug for hjælp

Har god forståelse for arbejdsprocesser, procedurer og koncepter




Vi tilbyder


Som souschef i Lidl får du: 

En udfordrende rolle, hvor tingene går stærkt

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke på 26.000 - 32.500 kr. brutto om måneden

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst med HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Rabatordning hos flere udbydere af rejser, shopping, kultur, fitness mm.

  Position description  
	Job title
 
 Inspirerende Reformer Instruktør - Roskilde 
 
	Become a part of the team behind the largest Fitness community in Denmark
 
 
	
  

 Vil du være rollemodel og inspirationskilde for vores medlemmer? Vi er på udkig efter dig, der er imødekommende, smilende og passioneret omkring instruktørrollen. Får du energi af at undervise andre og kan skabe en fed oplevelse for vores medlemmer? Lige nu søger vi en instruktør i vores center på ALgade 49 i Roskilde. 

 
 1 ud af 4 medlemmer hos os går på hold. Som holdinstruktør i PureGym er du således en vigtig del af at give vores medlemmer en positiv oplevelse, samt inspirere og motivere dem til at leve et aktivt liv med sunde vaner.  

   

 Om stillingen og dig 
 Reformer maskinerne og dens funktioner er alfa og omega. Du kan undervise både i Reformer - Power og Reformer - Pilates. Forskellen på disse holdtyper er:   

 Reformer - Pilates   
 Reformer - Pilates er en klassisk pilatesbaseret reformertime, hvor fokus er på kontrol, stabilitet, åndedræt, samt muskelaktivering. Timen foregår i et roligt tempo, hvor øvelserne udføres med præcision og flow.   

 Reformer - Power   
 Reformer - Power er en styrkebaseret reformertime med høj intensitet med en dynamisk tilgang til træning. Modsat Reformer - Piltes fokuserer vi på muskelopbygning, udholdenhed og eksplosivitet, samtidig med at coremuskulaturen arbejder stabiliserende gennem hele timen. Du vil kunne give den gas med, høj musik og en masse sved på panden.    

  

 
 
	Your qualifications
 
 
	
  
 
 Du skal have gennemført en relevant uddannelse for at varetage rollen som instruktør.   

 Du formår at planlægge din undervisning og mestrer at sammensætte et motiverende program.  

 Du brænder for at undervise, motivere og videreformidle sunde vaner.  

 Du er en ægte performer, der nyder at stå i front og skabe et rum fyldt med god energi, så du formår at tage vores medlemmer gennem en spændende og underholdende time - Hver gang!  

 Du er stabil og er vild med at skabe glæde og sammenhold på dine hold.  
 
 Som instruktør i PureGym vil du have mulighed for personlig udvikling og efteruddannelse til gode personalepriser. Derudover står du selv for planlægning og gennemførelse af dine timer, og er dermed perfekt for dig, der trives med "frihed under ansvar".  

   Vi mangler til følgende dage på ugen:   

 Mandage - kl.06.00-07.00 & 07.00-08.00 

 Onsdage - kl.16.00-17.00 

 Tordage - kl.16.00-17.00 

 Fredage - kl.15.00-16.00, 16.00-17.00 & 17.00-18.00 

 Lørdage (Lige uger): 08.00-09.00, 09.00-10.00, 10.00-11.00 & 11.00-12.00 (enten at du kan tage alle 4 timer eller 2-3 hold i streg) 

   

 Vi søger dig som kan tage 1 til 4 hold om ugen hos os. 

 Vi tilbyder at betale reformer uddannelsen for dig, hvis du ikke er uddannet i forvejen. Vores reformer uddannelse er i København d. 26-27 sept. & 10-11 okt. 

   

 Ansøgning og ansøgningsfrist 
 Har du lyst til at gå forrest og samtidig være med til at skabe sunde vaner for den danske befolkning? Så send os din ansøgning nu - og husk også at uploade et bevis på, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for denne type holdundervisning, da dette er et krav. Det vil desuden være en klar fordel, hvis du laver en kort præsentationsvideo, hvori du viser hvilken inspirerende performer, du er. 
 Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag eller snarest muligt.  
 Har du nogle spørgsmål er du velkommen til at komme forbi centret og møde os og høre mere.   

   

 Bliv en del af PureGym - Bliv en del af noget større 
 Som medarbejder i PureGym bliver du en del af Danmarks største fitnesskæde med over 130 centre fordelt i hele landet. PureGym DK er en del af en af Europas største fitnesskæder, med hovedkontor i London, UK, med centre i Danmark, England, Schweiz, UAE og New York, US.  
 Vores mission er at inspirere til et sundere liv med ’Fitness for alle’ som omdrejningspunkt. Vi ser os selv som mere end bare en fitnesskæde. Vi hjælper vores medlemmer med at passe på deres fysiske og mentale sundhed i de bedste rammer med professionel support fra vores passionerede medarbejdere. 
  
 Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning!  
  
 Er vi endt i spam? 
 Du vil altid modtage en bekræftelsesmail, når du har sendt din ansøgning. Hvis ikke du modtager denne, så tjek dit spamfilter og sørg for at fjerne os derfra, så fremtidig kommunikation lander i din almindelige indbakke.

Finance Process & ERP Specialist 





















            

                









What if your next process improvement shaped the future of Finance? 



As Finance Process & ERP Specialist, you'll help shape how Finance Operations continues to evolve through stronger systems, smarter processes and automation that creates real business value. You’ll take ownership of Finance requirements for our ERP setup and work as Finance System Owner and ERP Superuser, while translating operational needs into scalable process and system improvements.  



 



DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE 



ERP ownership, finance systems and integrations will take up the largest share of your time, alongside process improvements, automation and selected accounting activities. 



Your mission is to: 



	

	
Drive process optimisation, automation, AI and digitalisation initiatives across Finance Operations. 

	




	

	
Provide specialist and hands-on support across selected accounting processes, including general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable, while identifying opportunities for process and system improvements. 

	




	

	
Take ownership of Finance requirements for Microsoft Dynamics AX2012 as Finance System Owner and ERP Superuser, identifying, prioritising, testing and implementing system enhancements. 

	




	

	
Translate finance process and ERP requirements into scalable solutions in close collaboration with Finance, Tech and relevant business stakeholders. 

	




	

	
Contribute to ERP development and future upgrade initiatives, ensuring Finance requirements are reflected in the future system landscape. 

	




	

	
Ensure reliable system integrations by monitoring performance, data quality and transaction integrity, and coordinating issue resolution when needed. 

	




 



JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS 



You’ll join our Accounting team in Finance Operations, where nine experienced colleagues deliver accurate and timely accounting across the Mind Energy Group. 



The team has a solid operational foundation and a clear eye for where processes and systems can work better. Selected areas are being developed to create a more scalable and data-driven accounting function while maintaining a solid operational foundation. 

Knowledge is shared openly, and colleagues use each other’s expertise when questions need more than one perspective. 



This position is based at our Aarhus office, with flexibility to work from home when it fits the work and the team. 



 



LET'S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU 



You have an eye for where processes and systems can work better. You explore new possibilities with curiosity and prioritise the improvements that create lasting value.  



We imagine you bring: 



	

	
5+ years of experience with finance processes, ERP systems, finance transformation, and process optimisation initiatives. 

	




	

	
Relevant education in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. 

	




	

	
Strong understanding of finance processes, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable and financial close. 

	




	

	
Experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics AX or similar, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions. 

	




	

	
Experience driving automation, AI or digitalisation initiatives in collaboration with Finance, Tech and business stakeholders. 

	




	

	
Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken. 

	




You don't need to tick every box. What matters most is solid finance process and ERP experience, combined with the curiosity to keep improving how systems and processes work. 



 



WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE 



People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional "Just Because" surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year. 



Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting and Christmas afternoons with your family and Santa. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It's easier to experience in person. 



We're mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognising that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more. 



 



LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED 



Upload your CV and tell us a bit about how you approach finance process improvements and ERP development in practice. You can answer the questions below in a separate document or include them in your CV. We're particularly interested in hearing about: 



	

	
A finance process, ERP improvement or automation initiative you've driven. What was the challenge, what approach did you take, and what business value did it create? 

	




	

	
A situation where you translated business requirements into a finance process or system solution. How did you work with stakeholders, and what was the outcome? 

	




If available, you're also welcome to include relevant certifications, educational transcripts or an anonymised process description, business case or functional specification, where confidentiality permits. 



Please send your application no later than 4 September 2026. We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment process early if we find the right match, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 



If you have any questions about the role, you're welcome to contact Ivan Pedersen, Head of Accounting, at ivpe@mindenergy.com  



For general recruitment matters, contact people@mindenergy.com  



 



What if this is where you achieve more?

  Energy is changing. Fast. And at Mind Energy, we’re right at the epicentre of it all.

For decades, we have led the way in European energy trading - impatiently pushing forward, turning our deep market knowledge into reliable solutions and trading strategies. Today, we trade across more than 40 markets. But it’s how we work that defines us: with curiosity, care and a mindset of “what if". We listen, share, and push ideas forward - together.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Spring til hovedindhold

















LEDIG STILLING

SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT & ARCHITECTURE


Senior Solution Architect



AARHUS



Can you turn complex business needs into scalable digital architecture and shape solutions where AI is a natural part of both the product and the way we build it?




Del via email












Are you good at seeing the full technical picture without losing sight of the details? Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, scalable solutions? And are you just as comfortable discussing architecture with developers and clients?


Then you might be the Senior Solution Architect we are looking for at Knowit.




As our Senior Solution Architect, you will help shape scalable and future-proof architecture for our clients’ digital platforms. We design and build complex web solutions for clients across many industries, and AI plays a growing part in that work. It shows up as intelligent features in the platforms we deliver and as a natural part of how our teams develop software.




You will be involved from the early stages of a project through implementation and continued development. Along the way, you will help connect business needs, user requirements and technical possibilities, making sure that our solutions work in practice and not just on paper.




The role



You will work closely with project managers, designers, UX professionals, developers, and clients. Together, you will turn requirements and ideas into digital solutions that are robust, maintainable, and ready to evolve.




In this role, AI is part of everyday work rather than a separate discipline. You will help decide when AI adds value to a solution, how it is integrated responsibly, and how our teams use AI tools without compromising quality, security or compliance.




Your responsibilities will include the following:




Shaping the overall architecture for new and existing digital platforms





Translating business requirements into clear technical solutions





Making well-founded decisions about platforms, technologies and integrations





Designing scalable and maintainable solutions across backend and frontend





Defining how content platforms, APIs, AI services and third-party systems work together





Assessing where AI adds value in a client solution and where a simpler approach serves the client better





Driving the responsible use of AI-assisted development in our teams, including coding standards, guardrails and governance





Identifying technical risks, dependencies and trade-offs early in the process, including data privacy and compliance considerations when AI is involved





Contributing to technical estimates, workshops and client discussions






Supporting high-quality delivery through coding standards, development practices and documentation





Staying curious about new technologies and bringing relevant, well-evaluated ideas into our projects





And naturally, you will not be doing it alone. You will work alongside skilled colleagues across technology, design, UX and project management. We take shared responsibility for creating solutions that make sense for the client, the users, and the people who will maintain them afterwards.




Who are you?



You have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable moving between architecture, development and client dialogue.




You know that good architecture is not about choosing the most impressive technology. It is about understanding the problem, asking the right questions, and making decisions that create value over time. You approach AI the same way. You are curious and hands-on, you evaluate before you adopt, and you can explain both the potential and the limitations to a client in plain language.




You work in a structured way and can explain complex technical topics clearly. You are open about uncertainties, willing to challenge assumptions and curious enough to change your mind when a better solution appears.




What we are looking for



We hope you can cross of most of the following:




At least five years of experience in web development or solution architecture, ideally from an agency or consultancy





Hands-on experience across modern backend and frontend technologies in common languages, such as C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Python, or similar. Experience with .NET-based and CMS systems is a plus.





A thorough understanding of common integration patterns and experience with integrations e.g. with CRM, ERP, PIM, CMS, gateways and other third-party systems





Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, and an informed view on how they fit into a professional delivery process





Practical experience with CI/CD across different hosting models, from managed PaaS to containers and client-operated environments, e.g. pipeline design, quality gates, supply chain security





An understanding of the compliance and governance side of AI/GDPR/NIS2 etc., including data privacy, security and the requirements that follow from regulation such as the EU AI Act





Experience working with project managers, designers, UX professionals and clients to connect technical architecture with business needs.





The ability to turn complex requirements into clear architectural decisions and practical technical plans in both project and bid scenarios.





A structured approach to coding standards, development best practices and documentation





About Knowit



At the intersection of technology, creativity, and business, we help ambitious organizations make better use of digital opportunities.





You will become part of an interdisciplinary environment where developers, architects, designers, strategists, and project managers work closely together. We believe the best solutions are created when different perspectives meet and when people are open about both what they know and what they still need to learn.




What can we offer you?



At Knowit, you will have the opportunity to work on complex digital platforms and influence their technical direction from the beginning.




Varied client projects with meaningful technical challenges





A real say in how we adopt AI, from client solutions to our own development practices and governance





Close collaboration across disciplines and direct dialogue with clients





A high degree of trust, responsibility and influence





Skilled colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other constructively





Opportunities to develop your expertise and explore new technologies





Flexibility and freedom to shape your working day





An attractive salary and pension package





A culture built on openness, curiosity and shared accountability





Would you like to join Knowit?



Instead of a traditional application, we would like to hear how you approach solution architecture in practice. You do not need to write at length or make it overly formal. Concrete experiences and honest reflections tell us much more than polished buzzwords.




When you apply, we would like you to answer one or more of the questions below.




Tell us about a digital platform where you shaped or significantly changed the solution architecture. What challenge were you solving, which decisions and trade-offs did you make, and what was the outcome?





Describe a project where you connect business needs with a complex technical landscape, such as a CMS, CRM, payment solution, APIs or other third-party systems. What was your role, and how did you arrive at an architecture that could work and evolve in practice?





Give us an example of how you have used AI in your work, whether in a client solution or in your own development process. What worked, what did not, and how did you decide where to draw the line?





Use specific projects as context where possible and tell us what you would bring from those experiences into the role at Knowit.




Send us your CV and application through the application link. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.





If you have questions about the role or Knowit as a workplace, please contact People & Culture Consultant Katrine Gyldenskjold at katrine.gyldenskjold@knowit.dk.




We look forward to hearing from you.

                    Permanent
                

                            

                    
                    Full-time
                

            

                
                20-09-2026
            

        

        


    


    






    





    

        
For Arkil A/S søger Moment Search & Selection en kalkulatør, der skal være med til at regne på både mindre og større anlægsprojekter på Sjælland. Her får du mulighed for at kombinere din praktiske forståelse for anlægsarbejde med kalkulation og tilbudsgivning - og være med til at finde de løsninger, der gør forskellen, når projekterne skal vindes.

Sæt din anlægsforståelse i spil allerede inden projektet starter

Hos Arkil bliver du en del af tilbudsorganisationen i Greve og får en central rolle i arbejdet med at skabe et solidt grundlag for kommende projekter.

Opgaverne spænder bredt inden for infrastruktur og anlæg og kan omfatte blandt andet jordarbejde, forsyninger, veje, belægning, grus og bortskaffelse. Arkil byder på projekter i forskellige størrelser - fra mindre anlægsopgaver til komplekse projekter på flere hundrede millioner kroner. Særligt projekter med volumen, kompleksitet og flere fagdiscipliner er interessante for forretningen.

Som kalkulatør handler dit arbejde derfor om mere end at sætte priser på en tilbudsliste. Du skal kunne gennemskue, hvordan projektet bedst udføres: Hvilke maskiner og ressourcer kræver opgaven? Hvordan skal arbejdet planlægges? Hvilke produktionsforudsætninger er realistiske? Og hvor findes de løsninger og synergier, der kan gøre tilbuddet konkurrencedygtigt?

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet:


Kalkulation og prissætning af anlægsprojekter



Gennemgang og vurdering af udbudsmateriale



Fastlæggelse af produktionsforudsætninger, bemanding, maskinvalg og logistik



Indhentning og vurdering af priser fra leverandører og samarbejdspartnere



Identificering af risici, muligheder og alternative løsninger i tilbuddene



Samarbejde med øvrige kalkulatører og specialister inden for blandt andet asfalt, beton og fundering



Udarbejdelse af tidsplaner og input til det samlede tilbudsmateriale



Præsentation og gennemgang af egne kalkulationer internt


Du vil typisk arbejde med flere tilbud sideløbende, og grundighed er et nøgleord. Hos Arkil er ambitionen ikke at regne på flest mulige projekter, men at prioritere de rigtige tilbud og komme tilstrækkeligt i dybden til at kunne aflevere en både realistisk og konkurrencedygtig pris.

Dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra anlægsbranchen og en solid forståelse for, hvordan anlægsprojekter gennemføres i praksis. Du kan allerede arbejde med kalkulation og tilbudsgivning - eller du kommer eksempelvis fra en rolle som entrepriseleder eller projektleder, hvor du har opbygget den praktiske forståelse, der skal til for at vurdere ressourcer, produktion, maskinvalg og logistik. Erfaring med udarbejdelse af tidsplaner og jordbalance er et klart plus.

Den optimale profil har både praktisk erfaring fra udførelsessiden og erfaring med kalkulation. Det afgørende er dog din forståelse for anlægsprocesserne og din evne til at omsætte denne viden til gode og konkurrencedygtige løsninger.

Du behøver ikke komme fra en af branchens største virksomheder. Erfaring fra en mindre entreprenørvirksomhed kan være mindst lige så relevant - særligt hvis du her har haft et bredt ansvar og været involveret i flere dele af tilbudsprocessen.

Som person er du nysgerrig, analytisk og grundig. Du kan lide at udfordre det umiddelbare svar og motiveres af at finde den løsning, der gør et tilbud lidt skarpere. Samtidig tager du ansvar for dine kalkulationer og trives med at præsentere og argumentere for de valg og forudsætninger, du har lagt til grund.

Du skal kunne læse og arbejde sikkert med dansk udbudsmateriale. Kendskab til specifikke kalkulationssystemer er ikke afgørende, da Arkil anvender eget setup i Navision, og erfaring fra andre kalkulationssystemer kan overføres.

Bliv en del af en tilbudsorganisation med ambitioner

Du bliver en del af tilbudsteamet i Greve, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med erfarne kalkulatører, tilbudsassistenter og kolleger med forskellige specialistkompetencer. Der er stor faglig sparring i teamet, og kalkulationerne bliver gennemgået sammen, inden de præsenteres for de ansvarlige i forretningen. 

Arkil har samtidig klare ambitioner om fortsat vækst og ønsker blandt andet at styrke sin position i Nordsjælland og på Vestsjælland. Det betyder, at du kommer ind i en organisation, hvor tilbudsarbejdet spiller en væsentlig rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af forretningen.

For den rette profil kan rollen også rumme interessante udviklingsmuligheder på længere sigt. Tilbudsorganisationen vil udvikle sig i de kommende år, og der kan derfor være mulighed for at tage et større fagligt eller ledelsesmæssigt ansvar - potentielt i retning af en tilbudschefrolle.

Stillingen har base på Arkils kontor i Greve. Der er fleksibilitet i hverdagen, men udgangspunktet er fysisk tilstedeværelse på kontoret, da den løbende faglige sparring er en vigtig del af arbejdet.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Moment Search & Selection varetager rekrutteringen af Arkils nye kalkulatør. Vi behandler kandidater løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette profil er fundet.

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang motiveret ansøgning. Det vigtigste er, at vi får mulighed for at lære dig og din erfaring bedre at kende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Malle Hansen, Moment Search & Selection, på 93 94 15 20.



    





    

        Apply job
    



    



    

        

            

                The company
                
Arkil er en af Danmarks største entreprenørvirksomheder og arbejder med en bred vifte af anlægs- og infrastrukturprojekter. Virksomhedens størrelse og faglige bredde gør det muligt at samle kompetencer på tværs af blandt andet anlæg, asfalt, beton og fundering og dermed byde ind på komplekse projekter med flere fagdiscipliner.

Hos Arkil er der fokus på ordentlighed, faglighed og samarbejde, samtidig med at virksomheden har ambitioner om fortsat udvikling og vækst. På kontoret i Greve er hverdagen uformel, og medarbejderne mødes også på tværs af fagområder gennem personaleforening og fælles arrangementer.

Please review the following job description:

This role is required to work in office at one of the locations listed on the requisition.

The purpose of the Small Business Direct team is to virtually deliver Truist to a segment of Small Business clients, with a focus of delivering ease, expertise, and care. The team is comprised of multiple roles serving two segments of clients.

• The Small Business Direct Advisor works alongside a pre-defined team to deliver relationship managed advice and expertise in a pooled model approach.
• The book of business managed by Small Business Direct Advisors is typically complex in nature and includes, though not limited to, depository, treasury, lending, and premier solutions.
• Small Business Direct Advisors will leverage their small business expertise and business acumen to facilitate relationship building and advisory conversations.
• They will partner with the Integrated Relationship Management team to deliver a suite of solutions tailored to solve the needs of clients and prospects and ensure service levels are exemplary.
• Small Business Direct Advisors are responsible for exhibiting key behaviors that align with Truist Code of Ethics and support our risk management culture, exercising sound judgment and executing assigned responsibilities with integrity and honesty.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.
1. Align with and embody Truist’s purpose, mission, values while consistently executing the Small Business value proposition of “Ease, Expertise, Care”.
2. Meet with clients via telephone to assess client needs, review financial management practices and solutions, conduct a cash cycle conversation, and make recommendations for products and services, where needed.

3. Perform application and fulfillment process directly on some solutions.

4. Make referrals to product and fulfillment experts, as required.
5. Demonstrate exceptional communication skills: clear, concise, and friendly conversationalist.

6. Discern and identify potential opportunities through value-added Small Business life cycle conversations with clients and prospects.

7. Manage/solve complex issues for clients, by maintaining a strong understanding of resources within Truist. Leverage branch, care center and other partners to deliver an exceptional client experience.

8. Utilize network and contacts in a virtual environment to deliver for clients and prospects. This includes, partnering with Integrated Relationship Management and supporting partner teammates to deliver high-quality strategic business reviews that drive revenue growth, retention, and exceptional client service.

9. Manage product and solution opportunity pipeline to fulfillment including deposit, loan, and fee-based services (follow-up with partners/support teammates, document conversations, fulfill solutions, etc.) in a fast-paced environment.

10. Demonstrate business acumen, industry knowledge, and organizational skills through pre-call planning, advising, and follow-up.

11. Maintain understanding of Truist capabilities and solutions and general industry/market trends.

12. Meets individual performance goals of revenue/profit growth matrix, client experience and operational / risk expectations while participating as an integral member, contributing to the overall team’s performance.

13. Adapt to technology enhancements swiftly and advise clients on new digital solutions.

14. Escalate concerns promptly to their leader for awareness while complying with all operational, risk, and credit requirements.

15. Participate in client events, both virtually and in-person to include but not limited to, financial education, business lifecycle advisory and client celebration.


QUALIFICATIONS
Required Qualifications:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance or equivalent financial services education, training, and work-related experience
2. 5+ years sales / client management relationship with Small Business or Business Banking clients
3. General knowledge of business banking products, lending, cash cycle, sales process, and remaining current on market/industry/business knowledge
4. Relationship-building and negotiation skills with clients, management, and partners Excellent verbal and written communication skills
5. Proficiency in basic computer applications including Microsoft Office and virtual connectivity software.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Completion of a credit training course or cash cycle training course

Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full-time or part-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site. Om stillingen

Billedkunstnernes Forbund (BKF) søger studentermedarbejdere til at hjælpe os i administrationen i vores kontor på Vesterbrogade i København. BKF er Danmarks faglige organisation for professionelle billedkunstnere med cirka 2.300 medlemmer. Du vil blive del af en organisation i rivende udvikling, hvor vi arbejder for at varetage billedkunstnernes faglige, økonomiske, sociale og juridiske interesser og for at fremme en så bred anvendelse af billedkunstneres arbejde som muligt.


Med et studenterjob hos BKF vil du blive en del af arbejdet med at skabe mere politisk bevågenhed og synlighed for billedkunsten og billedkunstnerne.


Som studentermedarbejder vil du være i tæt kontakt med vores medlemmer og det kunstfaglige miljø.


Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:



Besvarelse af forespørgsler fra medlemmer


Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af vores medlemsdatabase


Opdatering af kontaktoplysninger på vores mange kunstfaglige samarbejdspartnere


Redigering af hjemmeside og vores digitale opslagstavle


Deltage i udviklingen af vores mange medlemsfordele



Samt meget andet. BKF er en alsidig arbejdsplads, hvor du vil få kendskab til mange forskellige arbejdsområder, og et stort indblik i kunstverdenen.


Vi søger dig, som er:



Studerende på en videregående relevant uddannelse og har en interesse for kunstområdet


Struktureret, omhyggelig og har en god ordenssans


Serviceminded


Kan arbejde selvstændigt med dine opgaver



Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring med andet administrativt arbejde og kendskab til WordPress, Office pakken og Excel.

Ansøgningsfrist: 30. august.

Ansøgning og cv sender til bkf@bkf.dk


Ansættelsesvilkår:

Arbejdstiden er 8 timer om ugen.

Du ansættes som timelønnet studentermedhjælp, hvor de første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode. Lønnen udgør pt. kr. 171 i timen.

description:

Full time

Job Description:

The opportunity

The Digital Twin Solutions team within HVDC Engineering delivers IdentiQ, Hitachi Energy's digital twin platform for HVDC stations. IdentiQ provides customers with a comprehensive digital representation of their assets, enabling improved operational performance, asset visibility, sustainability insights, and data driven decision making throughout the asset lifecycle.

As Technical Solution Owner for IdentiQ, you will be responsible for defining and maintaining the standard technical solution used to deploy digital twins across HVDC projects. You will establish reusable designs, technical standards, and implementation methodologies that enable scalable and efficient delivery while minimizing project specific customization.

Working closely with Product Owners, Digital Twin Coordinators, software developers, engineers, and project teams, you will ensure customer requirements can be delivered through standardized, secure, and maintainable solutions. This is a highly collaborative role that combines technical leadership, solution design, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement to accelerate the adoption of digital twin technology across Hitachi Energy's HVDC portfolio.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Define, maintain, and continuously improve the standard technical design for IdentiQ deployments across HVDC projects.
  • Develop reusable solution patterns, templates, and implementation methodologies to minimize project specific engineering and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate with Digital Twin Coordinators and project teams to translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Work closely with Product Owners to ensure future product capabilities align with project implementation needs and technical standards.
  • Provide technical leadership and solution governance throughout project execution, supporting deployment, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Define and maintain cybersecurity requirements, secure design principles, and implementation standards for IdentiQ deployments to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and Hitachi Energy cyber security requirements.

Your background

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience delivering complex technical solutions, industrial software platforms, digitalization initiatives, or engineering systems in a multi stakeholder environment.

title: Senior .NET AppDev Consultant
description:

As a Senior .NET Application Development Consultant, you will partner directly with clients to transform complex business challenges into production-ready software solutions.
You will own technical work across the full lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
The role combines hands-on full-stack engineering with technical consulting, requiring strong expertise in .NET, C#, Angular, APIs, and modern cloud practices.
You will work within diverse codebases and technology environments, making thoughtful decisions that balance technical quality, maintainability, and business value.
Collaboration is central to the role, with opportunities to pair with engineers, lead technical discussions, and strengthen client engineering practices.
You will also help clients adopt modern approaches to testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and safe production delivery.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys autonomy, solving unfamiliar problems, and leaving clients stronger than when they started.

Accountabilities

  • Partner directly with client teams to understand business challenges, clarify requirements, evaluate technical options, and translate needs into practical software solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support production-quality applications using .NET, C#, Angular, and modern full-stack development practices.

  • Communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies, frameworks, codebases, and client environments while maintaining high engineering standards.
  • Share knowledge with client teams and help establish practices that enable them to independently maintain and evolve the solutions delivered.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions and confidently recommend solutions that balance client needs, technical constraints, long-term maintainability, and business value.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of professional full-stack software development experience with strong expertise in .NET and C#, combined with the ability to adapt to evolving technologies and technical environments.
