title: National Consultant/Psychologist on Occupational Well-being and Psychological Resilience of Law Enforcement Professionals, UN Women Kazakhstan
description:
Background:

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.

Violence against women and girls is one of the most pervasive violations of human rights and is rooted in gender inequality. Domestic violence is one of the most common forms of violence against women and has specific dynamics associated with the relationship between the survivor and the perpetrator, the recurrent nature of violence and the risk of escalation. Its consequences affect women’s safety, health and well-being, their children and families, and their ability to live free from violence.

Kazakhstan has undertaken important legislative and institutional reforms aimed at strengthening the prevention of and response to domestic violence and enhancing the protection of women and children. In 2025, specialized units on combating domestic violence were established within the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan (MIA), together with a dedicated division within the Administrative Police Committee. Approximately 1,000 officers currently serve in these units across the country. Given the critical role of police as often one of the first points of contact for survivors, the establishment of the specialized units highlights the importance of strengthening officers’ knowledge and practical skills, including gender-responsive and survivor-centered approaches that support survivors’ safety, access to protection and justice, and prevention of secondary victimization. At the same time, the demanding nature of this work and regular exposure to complex and emotionally challenging cases highlights the importance of preventing professional burnout and occupational stress and strengthening officers’ psychological resilience and well-being.

Within this context, UN Women Kazakhstan, in cooperation with the MIA, plans to conduct a series of pilot two-day training sessions for officers of specialized domestic violence units in 2–3 regions of Kazakhstan between 28 September and 9 October 2026. The training will focus on gender-responsive and survivor-centered approaches to domestic violence, drawing on international standards and relevant international practice while considering Kazakhstan’s national legislation and law-enforcement context. The programme will also address professional burnout, occupational stress and professional deformation and provide practical approaches to strengthening officers’ psychological resilience.

UN Women therefore seeks to engage a National Consultant/Psychologist on Occupational Well-being and Psychological Resilience of Law Enforcement Professionals to develop and deliver a practical training component aimed at preventing professional burnout and professional deformation, strengthening stress-management and emotional self-regulation skills, and supporting the psychological resilience and occupational well-being of officers working in specialized domestic violence units.

The National Consultant/Psychologist will report to the UN Women Project Manager and will work under the overall guidance of the UN Women Programme Specialist. The Project Manager will serve as the primary focal point for technical guidance, contract administration and payment-related matters. The Consultant will work in close coordination with other consultants/trainers engaged for the assignment, as well as designated representatives of the MIA.

Description of Responsibilities/ Scope of Work

  • Review available information on the mandate, functions and working context of specialized domestic violence units in Kazakhstan to inform the adaptation of the training module to their professional needs and operational realities.
  • Participate in consultations with UN Women, the MIA and other experts engaged for the assignment to identify key occupational and psychological challenges faced by officers of specialized domestic violence units.
  • Develop a practice-oriented training module and accompanying materials and tools on prevention and early recognition of professional burnout and professional deformation, management of occupational stress, emotional self-regulation, maintenance of professional boundaries and strengthening psychological resilience, including presentations, practical exercises, case-based activities and self-assessment/reflection tools adapted to the professional context of specialized police units.
  • Deliver the agreed training module as part of the two-day training sessions in 2–3 pilot regions of Kazakhstan, using interactive adult-learning methods and practical exercises.
  • Collect and analyse participant feedback and observations emerging from the pilot trainings and develop concise practical recommendations on measures that could further support the occupational well-being and psychological resilience of officers of specialized domestic violence units.

Deliverable Expected completion time (due day) Payment Schedule
Practice-oriented training module and accompanying materials developed and agreed with UN Women, including session plan, presentation(s), practical exercises, case-based activities and participant tools on professional burnout, occupational stress, professional deformation and psychological resilience. By 17 September 2026 30% of contract amount
Training module delivered as part of the two-day in-person training sessions for officers of specialized domestic violence units in 2–3 pilot regions of Kazakhstan. 28 September – 9 October 2026

70% of contract amount
Finalized training materials and concise practical recommendations submitted on measures to support occupational well-being and psychological resilience of officers, incorporating relevant observations and participant feedback from the pilot trainings. 16 October 2026

Consultant’s Workplace and Official Travel

This is a home-based consultancy with official travel within Kazakhstan required for the delivery of in-person training sessions. As part of this assignment, the National Consultant will undertake travel to 2–3 pilot regions of Kazakhstan to deliver two-day training sessions between 28 September and 9 October 2026. The exact locations and travel schedule will be determined by UN Women in coordination with the MIA.

Travel arrangements and applicable travel-related costs will be covered by UN Women in accordance with UN Women rules and regulations.

Competencies :

Core Values:

  • Integrity;
  • Professionalism;
  • Respect for Diversity.

Core Competencies:

  • Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;
  • Accountability;
  • Creative Problem Solving;
  • Effective Communication;
  • Inclusive Collaboration;
  • Stakeholder Engagement;
  • Leading by Example.

Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:

Functional Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of occupational psychology, professional burnout, occupational stress and psychological resilience.
  • Strong knowledge of psychological approaches applicable to law enforcement and other frontline professionals.
  • Strong training and facilitation skills, including interactive and adult-learning methodologies.
  • Ability to translate psychological concepts into practical tools and techniques applicable in professional settings.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Education and Certification:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in psychology, clinical psychology, counselling psychology or a related field is required.
  • A first-level university degree in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.
  • Relevant professional certification or specialized training in stress management, trauma, burnout prevention, psychological resilience or related areas is an asset.

Experience:

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in psychology, including work related to occupational stress, professional burnout, psychological resilience and/or psychological well-being, is required.
  • At least 4 years of experience working with or providing training/capacity development to law enforcement, security sector personnel, emergency responders or other frontline professionals exposed to high levels of occupational stress is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and delivering practical training programmes on stress management, burnout prevention, emotional self-regulation and/or psychological resilience is required (As part of the application, candidates are required to submit a brief technical proposal (maximum one A4 page) outlining a proposed approach to a two-day training programme, including key thematic areas, suggested training methods and examples of practical/case-based exercises).
  • Demonstrated experience in developing practical psychological tools, exercises, guidance or training materials for professional audiences is required.
  • Previous professional experience with government agencies, UN agencies and/or other international organizations is required.

Languages:

  • Fluency in Russian is required.
  • Working knowledge of Kazakh and English is an asset.

Statements :

In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment.

Diversity and inclusion:

At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need.

If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application.

UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.)

Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process.

title: KYC Specialist
description:
About us

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The role

This role is part of the international Customer Operations group.

In this role, you will be responsible for onboarding and verifying new GoCardless customers, as well as conducting Customer Due Diligence reviews for existing clients, ensuring all processes are both compliant and customer-centric. As a senior member of the Customer Operations team, the KYC Specialist will also act as a primary escalation point for compliance-related issues, both within the team and across other departments.

What excites you

  • Reviewing Adverse Media, PEP and Sanctions screening escalations and providing detailed risk assessments and recommendations.
  • Opportunities to upskill other team members, proactively share your knowledge with the team and propose process improvements.
  • Supporting our Merchants during their onboarding and verification stages.
  • Handle internal escalations to relevant teams, such as potential fraud, ML/TF activities, and complex cases.
  • Collaborating with various teams, such as AML Financial Crime and Customer Success, to help make sure we’re creating a seamless onboarding experience for customers.
  • Conducting due diligence checks on new and existing Merchants in accordance with internal and external requirements.

What excites us

  • You are verbally fluent in English and can communicate clearly in writing to support customers via email or over the phone.
  • You have previous experience in KYC or AML.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • You care deeply about providing customers with a great experience while keeping calm under pressure.
  • You're comfortable working with internal stakeholders at all levels, upholding our core product & compliance requirements with a problem-solving approach.
  • Prior experience using tools like Zendesk, Looker, Lexis Nexis is preferred, but not essential.

Base salary range: 18,400 EUR - 27,600 EUR

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range (18,400 EUR - 23,000 EUR) until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

  • Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
  • Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

title: Osastonlääkäri Diagnostiikkakeskus Radiologia
description:
Tervetuloa erikoislääkäriksi HUS Diagnostiikkakeskukseen!

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.

Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3500 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 170 toimipisteessä.

Haemme nyt osastonlääkäriä Diagnostiikkakeskukseen radiologian vastuualueelle, Peijaksen sairaalan röntgeniin

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä ammatissasi nykyaikaisen teknologian parissa. Yksiköissämme teemme monipuolisesti radiologisia tutkimuksia ja toimenpiteitä. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää radiologian erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä ja hakijalla tulee olla ajantasainen ja monipuolinen osaaminen eri modaliteeteista. Kokemus uroradiologisesta LPV-toiminnasta katsotaan eduksi.

Työhön liittyy lääketieteen opiskelijoiden sekä erikoistuvien lääkärien koulutusvelvollisuus.

Työtehtävät sijoittuvat pääasiassa Peijaksen sairaalan röntgeniin. Työhön liittyy päivystysvelvollisuus.

Osastonlääkärin tehtäväkohtainen palkka maksetaan lääkärisopimuksen (LS) mukaan, tällä hetkellä palkka on alkaen 6443,01 euroa kuukaudessa (uraportaalla 2A) ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät. Radiologialla on myös käytössä suoritepalkkiojärjestelmä.

Työn aloitus on 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 27.8.2026.

Hakija voidaan kutsua haastateltavaksi jo hakuaikana.

Tervetuloa työkaveriksemme Diagnostiikkakeskukseen!

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Erikoislääkärin pätevyys soveltuvalla erikoisalalla ja lisäksi laillistettu lääkäri tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

title: Software Technical Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Technical Lead based in United States.

As a Software Technical Lead, you will provide technical direction for teams building complex, mission-critical enterprise applications. You’ll combine hands-on Java development with architecture, engineering leadership, and AI-driven innovation. The role spans full-stack application design, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and modern AI capabilities. You’ll mentor engineers, establish strong technical practices, and help teams deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. You’ll also work closely with product, data, AI, and client stakeholders to translate business objectives into effective technical strategies. This is an opportunity for an experienced engineering leader to shape both the technology and the way modern AI-assisted software teams build products.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the technical architecture and design of full-stack Java applications using Spring Boot, microservices, distributed systems, and modern front-end frameworks.
  • Guide hands-on development while establishing high standards for code quality, maintainability, security, scalability, and engineering excellence.
  • Drive the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into enterprise solutions, including LLM-powered functionality, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Champion AI-assisted engineering tools and practices that improve development velocity, reliability, quality, and developer experience.
  • Mentor and coach engineers across different experience levels, fostering continuous learning, technical growth, and strong engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with product, data, AI, and engineering teams to define technical strategy and deliver cohesive end-to-end solutions.
  • Oversee application performance, scalability, observability, reliability, and security across the technology stack.
  • Contribute to cloud architecture, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices to support reliable and efficient software delivery.
  • Facilitate technical discussions with clients and stakeholders, translating complex engineering concepts into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and actionable decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve development processes, architecture, and technology adoption while keeping solutions aligned with business and client objectives.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on experience developing full-stack Java applications.
    • Deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and distributed system architecture.
    • Strong experience with modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.
    • Demonstrated experience integrating AI/ML services or developing AI-enhanced product capabilities, including familiarity with LLM-powered solutions or intelligent automation.
    • Strong understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Proven technical leadership experience, including mentoring engineers, guiding engineering teams, and making architecture and technology decisions.
    • Experience with observability, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, and secure software architecture.
    • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native development.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work directly with clients and explain complex technical concepts clearly.
    • Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous-improvement mindset, with an interest in using AI to enhance engineering outcomes.
    • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident residing in the United States and able to work without visa sponsorship.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead the technical direction of complex, mission-critical enterprise software initiatives.
      • Hands-on exposure to modern Java, cloud, distributed systems, and AI technologies.
      • Opportunity to influence how AI-assisted engineering is integrated into software development practices.
      • Collaborative environment spanning software engineering, data, AI, and product disciplines.
      • Strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentoring, and professional growth.
      • Direct interaction with clients and senior stakeholders on complex technology initiatives.
      • Remote work opportunity within the United States.
      • Focus on continuous learning, innovation, and improving engineering outcomes.

title: Freelancer: Adaptive Liaison |EMEA (m/f/d)
description:
HYROX is a global sports event series that combines running and functional fitness training in a unique race format. Founded in Germany in 2017, HYROX has evolved into a worldwide fitness movement with events across five continents, attracting tens of thousands of athletes every season.

As the main point of contact and champion for adaptive athletes across the region, the Freelancer: Adaptive Liaison Manager EMEA plays a crucial role in creating an inclusive, safe, and fair race environment. Reporting to the Global Para Sports Manager, this position ensures every athlete is fully supported while maintaining consistent application of HYROX standards and rules.

In this role, you will handle complex adaptive queries, manage pre-race communication, confirm athlete eligibility, and collaborate closely with the HYROX Timing, Ticketing, and Sports Teams. Expect a commitment of approximately 8 - 10 hours per month, depending on race volume and specific athlete support needs.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Regional Oversight: Coordinate with Timing, Ticketing, and Sports Teams for each race within the assigned region to confirm adaptive athletes are registered, categorized, and briefed. Ensure consistent application of the Adaptive Rulebook across all regional events.

  • Pre-Race Preparation: Communicate directly with adaptive athletes to confirm eligibility and division placement. Provide clear information on expectations, movement standards, and protocols. Ensure adherence to local legislation for accessible sport where necessary.

  • Race-Day Support: Remotely support the events by linking the Sports team with all adaptive athlete information. Assist with any special briefings to Head Judges and Race Directors on adaptive-specific rules and procedures.

  • Communication & Advocacy: Act as the primary liaison between adaptive athletes, the regional sports team, and the Global Adaptive Liaison. Champion community-building and adaptive athlete engagement across the region.

  • Process Improvement: Capture athlete feedback and event observations. Recommend operational and accessibility enhancements to the Global Adaptive Liaison.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Knowledge & Expertise: Foundational knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and adaptive classifications in sport.

  • HYROX Familiarity: Familiarity with HYROX race flow, workouts, and standards (training will be provided). An understanding of movement adaptations for functional fitness is preferred.

  • Communication & Organization: Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage event-based workflows (approx. 8-10 hours per month).

  • Mindset & Advocacy: A deep commitment to equity, inclusivity, and athlete advocacy within the sporting landscape.

  • Languages: English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Passion: A genuine love for sport, fitness, or live experiences, and a drive to make fitness accessible for everyone.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A relaxed work atmosphere in a supportive team, with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths, along with autonomy and creative freedom in your daily work.

  • The chance to grow, learn, and thrive with opportunities for development in a dynamic, expanding company.

  • The opportunity to grow with one of the world’s fastest-expanding sports brands

INTERESTED?

Then we look forward to receiving your application. Simply upload your CV as a PDF (no photo required) and answer the questions in the application form. Your contact person is Isabelle (HYROX People).

We are committed to creating an inclusive and respectful work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected characteristic. We value diversity and are committed to fostering equal opportunity for all.

title: Director, Performance and Assurance
description:
• Full time, 5-year fixed term senior leadership appointment within University Infrastructure

  • Lead the governance, performance and assurance functions that enable delivery of the University's infrastructure ambitions while building capability and operational excellence

  • Competitive remuneration package including 17% superannuation

About the opportunity

The University of Sydney is seeking an accomplished executive leader to join the University Infrastructure division as Director, Performance and Assurance. Reporting to the Chief University Infrastructure Officer (CUIO), this role leads the operating backbone of University Infrastructure, ensuring the function is safe, compliant, commercially sound and operationally disciplined to enable performance across the team.

The Director leads the enterprise operating system for University Infrastructure, providing accountability for policy, governance, risk and assurance, commercial frameworks, workforce operations, and data and reporting. The role ensures the frameworks, controls and systems that underpin infrastructure management are effective, practical and aligned to University requirements.

Focused on operational integrity, assurance and continuous improvement, the Director translates University policy and governance settings into deliverable operating frameworks that enable effective estate lifecycle management and sustainable performance.

The role drives strong governance, commercial discipline, workforce capability and data-informed decision-making across the division, fostering a culture of accountability, service excellence and continuous improvement.

About the role (skills, capabilities and experience)

The Director, Performance and Assurance provides operational leadership across a multidisciplinary division responsible for governance, compliance, commercial management, workforce operations, reporting, data management and enterprise performance.

As a trusted adviser to the CUIO, the Director establishes and oversees the frameworks, controls, systems and operating disciplines that support infrastructure delivery and asset management across the University. The role provides expert leadership in governance, compliance, performance, policy, risk management and continuous improvement, ensuring operational integrity and organisational maturity across the portfolio.

Leading a team of specialist professionals, the Director is accountable for:

  • Enterprise Program Management Office: Leading enterprise governance frameworks, standards and controls across the asset lifecycle including project controls, performance reporting, stage-gate reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Compliance, Risk and Assurance: Leading the compliance, risk and assurance framework, including regulatory, WHS and environmental obligations, risk-based assurance, compliance reviews and corrective actions.

  • Commercial and Contract Management: Leading commercial and procurement governance, strategic sourcing, supplier and contract management, ensuring probity, ethical practice, compliance and value for money.

  • Business Intelligence: Leading the University Infrastructure data service to deliver trusted data, executive reporting and business intelligence capabilities, enabling data-driven decision making through Power BI, M365, AI and automation.

  • Space Data Management: Managing enterprise-wide spatial data as a governed digital asset, supporting teaching, research and workplace decision-making, and enabling emerging capabilities including digital twin and predictive analytics.

  • Workforce Operations: Overseeing workforce planning and people operations, ensuring effective recruitment, onboarding, compliance and reporting processes while fostering a safe, efficient and high-performing workforce culture.

The role is responsible for the property and infrastructure-related policies, standards and frameworks, leading the full policy lifecycle from development and consultation through governance, implementation and continuous improvement. It translates University settings into practical requirements, controls and procedures that are deliverable in practice, aligned to risk appetite, and are cost-aware and operationally feasible.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Director balances risk, compliance, cost, deliverability and operational requirements across complex, high-value and high-risk infrastructure environments. The position is focused on strengthening operational capability, assurance and operational excellence to facilitate performance and service outcomes.

The role acts as the primary interface with Central Operations Services and works closely with the University Infrastructure Executive Leadership Team, Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Risk and ICT, as well as external consultants, contractors, auditors and regulators.

About You

You will bring tertiary qualifications in project management, commercial management, procurement, quantity surveying or an MBA, or an equivalent combination of training and experience, together with senior experience in infrastructure, operations, governance, risk or commercial fields within large and complex organisations.

Applicants must have:

  • a strong track record leading complex operational environments and multidisciplinary teams

  • proven experience leading policy development and governance frameworks, including end-to-end lifecycle ownership

  • a deep understanding of assurance, compliance and control environments in complex organisations

  • sound commercial acumen spanning contract governance, procurement and supplier management

  • experience establishing or overseeing enterprise reporting, data and systems environments

  • experience leading operational improvement initiatives and establishing frameworks, services and processes that enhance organisational performance and operational effectiveness

  • strong executive communication and advisory capability

A strong working understanding of infrastructure, construction, capital works or similarly complex operational environments will be highly regarded.

Key benefits

  • a University contribution of 17% of your base salary to your superannuation fund

  • tax-efficient salary packaging options for cars, laptops, and additional contributions to your superannuation fund

  • generous relocation allowance if moving from interstate or overseas

  • access to fitness passport, as well as discounted rates on university sports and fitness centers

  • gain the recognition of working in a leading University.

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to be eligible to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Term and remuneration

The successful candidate will be offered a 5-year fixed term position on a full-time basis, with the possibility for renewal subject to performance and funding agreement. The appointment is subject to completion of a satisfactory probation period for new appointees.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the successful completion of all pre-employment or background checks required for the role in terms satisfactory to the University. Also, to meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Eliminate Gender-Based Violence you will be asked to declare if you have been investigated for, or found to engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence in the course of previous employment or in a legal process. Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

Other

EEO statement

At the University of Sydney, our shared values are trust, accountability and excellence and we strive to be a place where everyone can thrive. We are committed to creating a University community that thrives through diversity and reflects the wider community that we serve. We deliver on this through our commitment to diversity and inclusion, evidenced by our people and culture programs, as well as key strategies to increase participation and support the careers of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People, women, people living with a disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and those who identify as LGBTQIA+. We welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds.

We are proud to be recognised as an Australian Workplace Equality Index (AWEI) Platinum Employer. Find out more about our work on diversity and inclusion.

Vil du sælge lejligheder i hjertet af København? 




























Har du minimum 2 års erfaring som uddannet mægler og brænder du for lejlighedssegmentet … så er denne stilling netop skræddersyet til dig!



Vi tror på, at du med dit drive og engagement, kan medvirke til at løfte vores markedsposition i København K for EDC Poul Erik Bech.



Vi hjælper dig til at få succes

Når du træder ind hos os, får du tilført den viden, der er krævet for at blive en succesfuld lejlighedsmægler i et særdeles konkurrencepræget marked. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du kommer med en stor appetit på at få fastslået EDC Poul Erik Bech’s navn som en "Top 5 ejendomsmægler i den indre by".  



Passion for at sælge lejligheder i den indre by 

Som ejendomsmægler, har du en særlig lyst for at tage lejligheder til salg og finde nye købere til de udbudte. Helt konkret bliver din mission selvstændigt at opbygge og vedligeholde kunderelationer med fokus på området København K. Det kræver, at du er arbejdsom, vedholdende og målrettet.



Din nye daglige gang, bliver på vores hovedkontor, som holder til i lækre lyse lokaler i hjertet af København lige ved Metroen på Kgs. Nytorv. Lige nu består afdelingen af afdelingsleder Rikke Krull og Benjamin Broustbo som assistent. Derudover er der tilknyttet en salgskoordinatorressource til afdelingen. Totalt arbejder ca. 140 medarbejdere på Bremerholm. Vi er så heldige, at vi nyder en lækker frokost, som vores helt egne kokke tilbereder dagligt. Er du social og glæder du dig til at hygge med dine kollegaer? Så tilbyder vi også en fredagsbar og i det gode vejr, nyder vi vores tagterrasse med udsigt over København.



Ring straks!

Vi vil gerne satse på dig og give dig de bedste rammer. Herunder:





Fondsejet virksomhed

EDC Poul Erik Bech er for størstedelens vedkommende ejet af en almennyttig fond. Via overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter Poul Erik Bech Fonden primært foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Vores ønske er at være en aktiv bidragsyder til det lokalsamfund, som vi er en del af. Læs mere om fonden på www.poulerikbechfonden.dk



Din ansøgning

Din ansøgning bedes sendt til os via 'Søg stillingen', som du finder her på siden. Din ansøgning vil naturligvis blive behandlet fortroligt. Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Rikke Krull på 2859 0508.



Du kan søge stillingen, så længe den er at finde på nettet. Vi har således ikke traditionelle ansøgningsfrister, men nedtager stillingen fra nettet, når den er besat.

Om EDC Poul Erik Bech


Firmaet blev etableret i 1978, og er siden vokset til at blive Danmarks største og eneste landsdækkende ejendomsmæglervirksomhed. I dag består vi af flere end 77 boligbutikker og 19 erhvervscentre.


Vores mere end 600 dygtige medarbejdere gør hver dag en forskel - og yder en ekstra indsats for, at vores kunder får en god og ordentlig handel. 


EDC Poul Erik Bech er uafhængig af banker og realkreditinstitutter og er den eneste fondsejede mæglervirksomhed. Størstedelen af virksomheden er ejet af den almennyttige fond Poul Erik Bech Fonden. Gennem overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter fonden frivillige foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Hvis du vil læse mere om virksomheden, og hvordan vi er som arbejdsplads, så besøg os på vores karriereside, LinkedIn eller Facebook.

title: AVS Digital Architect
description:
Additional Job Description

AVS Digital Architect
Location: Fort Worth Texas or Lake Forest California
Travel: Up to 25%

We are looking to expand our exciting team with someone who can manage projects, solve technical problems on medical networks, assist commercial teams with the sales process, communicate effectively, and deliver presentations in front of technical and non-technical leaders. The AVS Digital Architect is a hybrid engineer / project manager who is responsible for driving connectivity for ALCON AVS (Alcon Vision Suite) products as well as legacy Alcon Medical Devices. The AVS Digital Architect will also perform integrations with our customers and their EHR vendors. Integrations will involve general networking (TCP/IP), DICOM, HL7, FHIR, and all related networking. The AVS Digital Architect will also assist as needed to support any connectivity concerns (questions & troubleshooting) for all network capable medical equipment. As a hybrid technical professional, the AVS Digital Architect will both lead integrations and serve as a technical subject matter expert to solve interoperability challenges that may arise.

The successful candidate will join a growing team in a family-like atmosphere. No two days are quite the same as you will have a mixture of some of each of the following each day.

In this role, a typical day will include:

  • Ensure AVS installs are connected in a timely manner
  • Drive connectivity on all Alcon hardware (medical devices) and software (SaaS/SaMD) product lines
  • Manage all phases of Project Plans for hardware and software integrations including stakeholder management
  • Track time of installation of Alcon AVS products customers
  • Own regional integration process
  • Define data flow map for customer integrations
  • Ensure all project installation phases are completed in a timely manner by supporting all installation process phases
  • Follow processes related to proper documentation after each task
  • Respond to monitoring alerts indicating offline devices
  • Occasionally lead classes related to networking and medical device interoperability
  • Assist with User Acceptance Testing (testing product prior to hand over to customer)
  • Complete Alcon assigned training on time
  • Maintain professional communications when interacting with internal and external customers
  • Engage other Alcon functional teams as needed to address customer issues
  • Exhibit boundaryless collaboration ways of working when partnering with other teams
  • Own issues through the process until a handoff is confirmed
  • Proactively identify process improvements related to local and global tasks
  • Create presentations for customers and/or Alcon teams at every level including executives, medical staff, and I.T.
  • Backfill other roles on the team as needed, domestically and internationally
  • Proactively remain current on industry trends
  • Exemplify a customer focused attitude
  • Act with a sense of urgency / bias for action
  • Be results oriented
  • Perform duties ethically
  • Strict requirements to laws, regulations, and company policies

Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +13 yrs.
  • Assoc.+9 yrs.; M.S.+2 yrs.; PhD+0 yrs.)
  • The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English
  • 5 Years of Relevant Experience

Preferred requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in Healthcare or Medical industry
  • 2+ years experience with DICOM and/or HL7
  • Fluency in English (domestic and international meetings are conducted in English)
  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills
  • Able to explain difficult concepts to a wide audience including senior leadership, non-technical customers, and tech savvy customers
  • Experience in troubleshooting networks and general IT issues
  • Some level of travel (up to 25%) to attend regional leadership meetings, customer visits, attend conferences, etc
  • Ability to lift network equipment weighing up to 15 kg (not frequently)
  • Ability to work remote as needed
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Excel, Powerpoint, and Outlook; proficiency with project planning software is a plus
  • Scheduling flexibility including occasional after hours or weekends as needed
  • Ability to manage all aspects of customer service, customer satisfaction, and contractual commitments
  • Experience configuring network hardware; experience with servers and VMWare is a plus
  • Negotiation skills are critical; (influencing others)
  • Desired Characteristics:
  • Cisco Certifications - Any
  • Medical field certifications: DICOM, HL7
  • Understanding of FHIR
  • Project Management Certifications (PMP)
  • Experience supporting healthcare customers with BAA agreements
  • Experience with global security and privacy standards including GDPR, HIPAA, HITECH, network, security, data and privacy issues
  • Experience in developing/managing integration solutions, web services and schemas such as XML/JSON
  • Previous help desk experience
  • Previous network engineer experience
  • Previous firewall experience
  • Previous Project Management experience
  • Fluency in additional Americas based languages is a plus (Portuguese, Spanish, French)
  • Experience in relational database such as MySQL and/or Oracle is a plus

How to Thrive at Alcon:

  • Manage your own workload and schedule while hitting your set targets.
  • Build positive working relationships to achieve positive goals and business objectives.
  • Balance experiencing new environments and working autonomously in a remote sales environment.

title: Vil du være pædagogisk konsulent på dagtilbudsområdet i Gladsaxe Kommune?
description:
Brænder du for at skabe høj kvalitet for børn i dagtilbud? Trives du med at omsætte pædagogisk viden til praksis sammen med ledere og medarbejdere? Og motiveres du af at være tæt på hverdagen i dagtilbuddene?
Så er du måske vores nye pædagogiske konsulent.

I Gladsaxe Kommune søger vi en pædagogisk konsulent, der vil være med til at styrke og udvikle den pædagogiske kvalitet på tværs af kommunens dagtilbud. Vi søger en fagligt stærk og nysgerrig pædagogisk profil med ledelseserfaring, erfaring med udviklings- og forandringsprocesser, som kan arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og relationsskabende.

Om stillingen
Du bliver en del af et team på tre pædagogiske konsulenter, som sammen har en central rolle i udviklingen af dagtilbudsområdet i Gladsaxe.
Vi lægger stor vægt på, at konsulentteamet fungerer som et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi bruger hinandens perspektiver aktivt, giver ærlig og konstruktiv feedback og udfordrer hinanden fagligt. Vi tror på, at kvaliteten i vores arbejde styrkes, når vi udvikler løsninger sammen, deler erfaringer og står på et fælles pædagogisk fundament.
Du refererer til souschefen for Dagtilbud, og arbejder tæt på - både chef og souschef for dagtilbudsområdet.

En konsulentrolle tæt på praksis
Vi søger en kollega, som er optaget af børnenes hverdagsliv og af den pædagogiske kvalitet, der skabes i samspillet mellem børn og voksne. Derfor skal du have lyst til at være tæt på praksis, deltage aktivt i dagtilbuddenes hverdag og samarbejde med ledere og medarbejdere om at udvikle det pædagogiske miljø og forstærke deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:
  • understøtte udviklingen af høj pædagogisk kvalitet i dagtilbuddene, deltage aktivt i den pædagogiske praksis
  • facilitere udviklings- og forandringsprocesser i samarbejde med ledere og medarbejdere
  • bidrage til implementering og videreudvikling af Gladsaxe Kommunes fælles pædagogiske og didaktiske ramme
  • designe og facilitere lærings – og kompetenceforløb og faglige processer
  • understøtte arbejdet med deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • gennemføre og følge op på tilsyn
  • håndtere relevante forældrehenvendelser.

Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet pædagog og har en relevant videreuddannelse eller erfaring, der kvalificerer dig til at arbejde med udvikling af pædagogisk praksis.

Vi lægger særlig vægt på, at du:
  • har erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet og et solidt pædagogisk fundament, gerne med specialpædagogisk erfaring.
  • har ledelseserfaring eller erfaring med at understøtte ledere og udviklingsprocesser
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og systematisk i en kompleks organisation, er stærk relationelt og formår at skabe tillidsfulde samarbejder
  • trives med at veksle mellem strategiske opgaver og praksisnær understøttelse
  • kan udfordre og udvikle praksis på en respektfuld og tydelig måde
  • kan formidle viden engagerende både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Har et stærkt børnesyn med fokus på, at alle børn har ret til at opleve sig som betydningsfulde deltagere i fællesskaber
  • Bidrager til udvikling af stærke fællesskaber, hvor forskellighed ses som en ressource

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med:
  • undervisning, vejledning og facilitering
  • organisationsudvikling og forandringsprocesser
  • procesledelse
  • tværfagligt samarbejde
  • arbejde i en politisk styret organisation
  • forskning, evaluering og udvikling på dagtilbudsområdet.

Vi tilbyder
En stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen af dagtilbudsområdet i Gladsaxe Kommune.
Du får engagerede kolleger, et stærkt fagligt fællesskab og en arbejdsform, hvor samarbejde, feedback og fælles refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Din base er på Gladsaxe Rådhus, men en stor del af dit arbejde foregår ude i dagtilbuddene, hvor børn, medarbejdere og ledere er.
Vi prioriterer høj faglighed, gode relationer, humor og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at lykkes.
Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026 eller snarest muligt derefter. Ansøgningsfrist er søndag den 6. september 2026.

Vil du vide mere?
Beskrivelse af det pædagogiske grundlag for arbejdet i dagtilbuddene, samt uddybende kompetenceprofil kan rekvireres ved henvendelse til Heidi Kragelund, telefon 39 57 53 54 eller mail bkfhkr@gladsaxe.dk.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i forhold til overenskomst, til stillingen er tillagt et fast tillæg for ukontrollabel arbejdstid og der kan forhandles kvalifikations- og funktionsløn.

Nærmere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til souschef for Dagtilbud, Betina Larsen telefon 21 34 59 01 eller mail: dagbla@gladsaxe.dk

I Gladsaxe tager vi udgangspunkt i borgernes og virksomhedernes behov og trivsel i alt, hvad vi gør. Bæredygtig velfærd og udvikling er en mærkesag for os og vi arbejder for både social, miljømæssig og økonomisk bæredygtighed. Med FN’s verdensmål som ramme ser vi en bæredygtig fremtid som noget, vi skaber sammen – med borgere, virksomheder, foreninger og lokalsamfundet. Du kan læse mere om vores mål i Gladsaxestrategien.

Ingen ansatte i Gladsaxe Kommune må ryge eller bruge tobaksrelaterede produkter i arbejdstiden, som for eksempel snus og vapes.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn/identitet, seksualitet, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

title: Lærer
description:
MindKey Recruiting


    


    



        
    

	
To lærer til Atuarfik Tuiisaq Paamiut
Kommuneqarfik Sermersooq søger to dygtig og lærere til Atuarfik Tuiisaq Paamiut, med tiltrædelse pr. 1. oktober 2026 




Skolens vision og mål er bl.a. at skabe elever sunde elever med selvværd, nysgerrige, større viljestyrke og mod på at have store visioner.




Atuarfik Tuiisaq er en folkeskole beliggende i Paamiut med ca. 160 elever fordelt på undervisning fra yngste til ældste klassetrin. Skolen har engagerede og fagligt dygtige lærere samt øvrigt pædagogisk personale. Skolen er et vigtigt samlingspunkt i byen og vægter trivsel, faglighed og et godt samarbejde med forældre og lokalsamfund højt.




Udviklingsfokus:

Atuarfik Tuiisaq er i øjeblikket i implementeringsfasen af Projektbaseret Læring (PBL) i tæt samarbejde med forvaltningen. Skolen arbejder målrettet med at udvikle undervisningen, så den i højere grad understøtter elevernes aktive deltagelse, tværfaglighed, kreativitet og virkelighedsnære læring. Skoleinspektøren får en central rolle i at lede, understøtte og forankre denne pædagogiske udviklingsproces i tæt samspil med medarbejdere og forvaltning.




Atuarfik Tuiisaq har gennem de sidste par år været en 1 sporet skole med i alt 11. klasser fra 1.-10 og 1 specialklasse. Skolen er inddelt i 3. trin. Yngstetrinnet 1.-3. klasser, mellemtrinnet 4.-7.klasser og ældstetrinnet 8.-10. klasser. Elevantallet svinger mellem 155-170 i løbet af en skoleår. Skolens personale består af; 18 undervisere, en skoleinspektør, en viceskoleinspektør, en kontorfuldmægtig, en pedel og en pedelmedhjælper samt rengøringspersonale.




Atuarfik Tuiisaq er for øjeblikket i gang med en større renovering, så tålmodighed vil være en dyd.




Stillingens indhold:

Vi søger en læreruddannet - underviser til at indgå i underviserteamet og varetage de opgaver der hører til i et lærerteam.

·Forberedelse og undervisning i mellem- og ældstetrinnet

·Opfølgning på hver elevs undervisningsplan

·Evaluering af hver elev med lærerteamet flere gange årligt

·Deltage i pædagogiske møder

·Deltage i ugentlige lærermøder

·Deltage i de fælles aktiviteter




Opgaverne løses i tæt samarbejde med lærerteamet og afdelingslederen.




Forventninger til ansøgere:

·Er læreruddannet

·Kan arbejde i teams og bidrage til pædagogisk debat

·Glad for kreative udfordringer- og i samarbejd med dine kollegaer- er i stand til at tænke ud af boksen

·Arbejder med på at nå skolens visioner og mål




Vi lægger desuden vægt på at du:

·Er engageret

·Er rummelig

·Arbejder ansvarsbevidst og selvstændigt

·Udviser fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdsopgaver og løbende justeringer i arbejdsfordeling

·Er robust og udviser initiativ, overskud og handlekraft

·Er god til at samarbejde




Vi tilbyder:

Et spændende job i en afdeling, hvor vi hele tiden forsøger at have fingeren på pulsen, følge med i ny udvikling, og forbedre os fagligt på alle områder.




Straffe- og Børneattest:

Den stilling er omfattet af lov om pligt til at indhente straffe- og børneattest. I henhold til loven kan ansættelsen først begynde, når kommunen har modtaget tilfredsstillende straffe- og børneattest. Vi skal derfor gøre opmærksom på, at tiltrædelsestidspunktet først kan aftales, når kommunen har modtaget børneattest fra rigspolitiet samt straffeattest fra Politiet.




Børneattesten indhentes af kommunen med samtykke fra vedkommende, hvor straffeattesten indhentes af vedkommende hos Politiet. 




Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre, i henhold til den på tiltrædelsestidspunktet gældende aftale/overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre og pågældende forhandlingsberettigede organisation.




Ansættelsen vil ske med 3 måneders prøvetid.




Bolig:

Der vil til stillingen kunne anvises personalebolig, for hvilken der betales depositum og husleje, forbrug m.v. efter de til enhver tid gældende regler for huslejebetaling i Grønlands Selvstyres og kommunens ejendomme m.v. i Grønland. Såfremt permanent personalebolig ikke kan stilles til rådighed umiddelbart ved tiltrædelse, vil der for medarbejdere med ret til vakantbolig blive tilbudt en midlertidig vakantbolig, for hvilken der betales husleje, forbrug m.v. i henhold til ovenstående. For yderligere information om husleje herunder forbrug o.l. henvises til oplysninger på: www.iserit.gl




Tiltrædelsestidspunktet er afhængigt af hvornår der er en personalebolig til rådighed. Der ydes tiltrædelsesrejse samt bohaveflytning i henhold til gældende regler.




Yderligere oplysninger fås hos:

Såfremt stillingen har din interesse, er du velkommen til at tage kontakt for uddybende oplysninger om stillingen og tilhørende arbejdsopgaver til: Skoleinspektør Johanne Rosing Dahl, tlf. +299 36 76 81 eller e-mail: ks51joda@sermersooq.gl eller til: Viceskoleinspektør Angunnguaq Jakobsen, e-mail: ks37anja@sermersooq.gl




Ansøgning:

Ansøgning mærket med Job nr. 760-26, og vedlagt uddannelsesbevis og dokumentation for tidligere beskæftigelse m.v. skal være uploadede inden fristens udløb.




Sådan søger du:

Ansøgninger skal sendes elektronisk, via link nederst på denne side, hvor du kan vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV.




Bemærk:

Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger i papir eller mails, send venligst din ansøgning elektronisk ved stillingsopslaget.

Lagerekspedient til Viborg








Hos Davidsen sørger vi hver dag for, at vores kunder får de rigtige byggematerialer - til tiden og i den rigtige kvalitet. Det kræver et stærkt lagerteam med overblik, ansvarsfølelse og godt samarbejde.

Nu søger vi en lagerekspedient til vores lager i Viborg, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af hverdagen i en travl forretning.



En vigtig rolle i hverdagen



Som lagerekspedient hos os er du med til at sikre, at ordrer bliver pakket korrekt, varer er på plads, og kunder - både professionelle og private - får en god oplevelse, når de henvender sig. Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger og bidrager til, at tingene spiller, også når der er travlt.



Din primære opgave vil være:



	
Ekspedition og betjening af kunder

	
Vareopfyldning og orden på lageret

	
Truckkørsel og øvrige lageropgaver




Hvem er du



Du har erfaring med lagerarbejde og kundekontakt, gerne fra vores branche. Du kan også have en baggrund som håndværker, som tømrer eller murer og lyst til at prøve noget nyt. Uanset, er det vigtigt, at du trives i en hverdag, hvor du er fysisk aktiv, hvor tempo og struktur går hånd i hånd og så er det nødvendigt, at du har truckcertifikat.



Som person, arbejder du ansvarligt, møder stabilt og bidrager aktivt til samarbejdet. Du  er serviceminded og forstår, at lageret spiller en vigtig rolle i kundens samlede oplevelse af Davidsen. Du kan bevare overblikket, også når der er mange opgaver på én gang, og du går til arbejdet med en positiv og engageret tilgang.



Du er vigtig for os



Hos Davidsen bliver du en del af et erfarent og professionelt team, hvor ordentlighed, samarbejde og engagement er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi har et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med plads til forskellighed og fokus på, at vi lykkes bedst sammen.



Vi tilbyder et fast job på 37 timer om ugen og indgår i forretningens vagtplan. Derudover får du gode ansættelsesvilkår samt mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling i en virksomhed, hvor medarbejderne gør en forskel.



Ansøgning



Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Send derfor din ansøgning snarest muligt.



Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte lagerchef Ian Kjærsgaard Lotzfeldt på telefon 93396585 eller mail: ian.lotzfeldt@davidsen.dk.


















Davidsen er en landsdækkende handelsvirksomhed inden for trælast og byggeri med hovedsæde i Kolding. Vi har siden 1944 været en solid og pålidelig partner for dem, der bygger Danmark - både for professionelle og private kunder. Med 49 forretninger, og 1.800 medarbejdere, er vi altid tæt på kunderne, uanset hvor de bygger. I 2024 blev vi en del af det finske børsnoterede handelsselskab Kesko. Familien Davidsen, som grundlagde virksomheden, er stadig en del af ejerkredsen.

description:
CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Biotech-Unternehmen, das sich seinem Versprechen verpflichtet hat, Leben zu retten. In Bern entwickeln und vertreiben wir mit über 1’800 Mitarbeitenden lebensrettende Therapien für Menschen mit schweren und seltenen Krankheiten weltweit.

Für den Bereich Filling Line / Lyophilisation innerhalb des Departements Produktion suchen wir eine/n

Pharmafachmitarbeiter/in Vorbereitungsgruppe Filling Line VI

In Bern wird eine neue aseptische Abfüll- und Lyophilisationsanlage aufgebaut. Sie sind dem Gruppenleiter dieser neuen Linie unterstellt und sind somit ein Teil eines Projektteams welches mithilft die Linie aufzubauen und von der Projektphase in die Routine zu überführen. In Ihrer Aufgabe werden Sie den Gruppenleiter der neuen Anlage in der Projektphase und im anschliessenden Routinebetrieb unterstützen.

Ihre Aufgaben beinhalten im Wesentlichen:

  • Unterstützung des Gruppenleiters während dem Projekt und der anschliessenden Routineproduktion
  • Unterstützung im Bereich Equipmentvorbereitung (Waschen, Verpacken und Sterilisieren) und Stopfenvorbereitung für die aseptische Abfüllung und Lyophilisation
  • GMP-konformes Reinigen und Autoklavieren der benötigten Formatteile.
  • GMP-konformes Aufbereiten und Bereitstellen der Stopfen.
  • Reinigen und desinfizieren der hygienischen Räumlichkeiten.
  • Bereitstellung der gesamten Verbrauchsmateralien.

Qualifikationen & Berufserfahrung

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Lebensmittel-, Pharma-, oder technischen Bereich
  • Hohe Sozialkompetenz und Teamgeist
  • Flexibilität, vernetztes, out-of-the-box Denken und hohe Motivationsfähigkeit
  • Selbstständige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und grosses Qualitätsverständnis
  • Gute PC-Kenntnisse (MS-Office, SAP)
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift
  • Sie schätzen die Vorteile der Schichtarbeit (inkl. Wochenende)

Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung. Ihre Bewerbung sollte ein Motivationsschreiben, einen Lebenslauf/CV sowie Arbeitszeugnisse und Kopien von Diplomen in der Originalsprache und/oder relevante Transkripte beinhalten. Bitte fügen Sie Ihre Dateien, inklusive CV, zu einem Dokument zusammen.

                Vi søger en kunderådgiver - Lokal Erhverv, som vil skabe værdi for lokale virksomheder i Holbæk    

                              
                

                    
                    
                

                
                

                        
Da en af vores kollegaer har fået nyt job internt i SJF Bank, søger vi lige nu en kunderådgiver til vores Lokal Erhvervskunder. Som rådgiver for mindre erhvervskunder får du en central rolle i vores team i områdecenter Holbæk. Her har vi samlet indsatsen omkring mindre virksomhedsejere og ejerledere og tilbyder målrettet rådgivning, der dækker både den private og erhvervsmæssige del af kundernes engagement. Du bliver en del af et team på 4 rådgivere, som arbejder med Lokal Erhverv for hele området Nord/Vest.

I Holbæk bliver du samtidig en del af et større fællesskab med 27 kollegaer, som rådgiver vores privatkunder, private banking kunder og lokale erhvervskunder. Vi har en uformel tone og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vi er kundeorienterede og arbejder for at sikre de bedste kundeoplevelser gennem grundig kundedialog.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at:

Tage aktivt ansvar for at udvikle din egen kundeportefølje med eksisterende og nye kunder gennem opsøgende kontakt og stærke relationer

Rådgive nye og eksisterende mindre erhvervskunder om både deres virksomheds- og privatøkonomi og hjælpe dem godt videre i deres økonomiske beslutninger

Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og specialister for at levere helhedsorienteret rådgivning

Sikre, at alle kunder får en professionel og personlig oplevelse.

Hvad tæller for dig?

Vi byder dig velkommen til et stærkt fællesskab, hvor engagerede og dygtige kollegaer samarbejder tæt på og anerkender hinandens succeser. En kultur med høj medarbejdertilfredshed og stærke relationer, baseret på gensidig respekt og faglighed. Vi giver plads til det, der tæller for dig - og dine idéer, din faglighed og dine ambitioner.

Vi tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi både står stærkt sammen og giver hinanden plads til individuel udvikling. Samtidig er vi rummelige og møder dig som det menneske, du er, og på det sted, du er i dit liv. Sammen med dine kollegaer bliver du løbende uddannet i vores værdier og kultur. Og du får attraktive vilkår som god pensionsordning, fri telefon, gruppelivs-, sundheds- og tandforsikring samt en sund og varieret frokostordning.

Hvad tæller for os?

Vi søger dig, der:

Har en bankfaglig eller anden finansiel baggrund med erfaring i rådgivning af mindre virksomhedsejere.

Brænder for at gøre en forskel for kunderne og skabe tryghed i deres økonomi

Trives i et miljø med høj energi og tæt samarbejde, hvor vi løfter i flok og fejrer vores fælles succeser

Motiveres af at være med til at bygge noget op - i en afdeling og organisation i udvikling og vækst.

 Er du interesseret?

Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning, men vi vil meget gerne se dit CV inkl. en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet. Send det allerede i dag og senest d. 9. september - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdedirektør Niels Vittrup Jensen på telefon 51 51 77 25, eller Talent Acquisition Specialist Eva Nestler på telefon 20 23 69 54.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet det rette match.

Nyt navn, samme værdier

Den 20. maj 2025 skiftede vi navn fra Sparekassen Sjælland-Fyn til SJF Bank. Læs mere om navneskiftet her

Det er summen af os, der flytter noget

 SJF Bank har rundt regnet 160.000 privat- og erhvervskunder. Med hovedsæde i Holbæk og afdelinger fordelt på Sjælland, Fyn og Lolland-Falster stræber vi efter at være den bedste bank for dem, som bor, arbejder og driver virksomhed i vores lokalsamfund. Vi er der for vores kunder, når de har brug for at låne til drømmehuset eller firmabilen. Og vi er der for deres lokalområder, når foreningen har brug for penge til et godt initiativ. Vi er der også for vores cirka 550 engagerede medarbejdere, der hver dag gør deres bedste for at sikre, at vores kunder får tilbudt den rådgivning og de produkter, de har brug for.

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner, og netop derfor betyder fællesskab og samarbejde alt. I SJF Bank kender vi hinanden, løfter i flok og deler både ansvar og succeser. Hos os er det ikke én person, én idé eller én løsning, der skaber resultaterne - det er summen af os.

description:

             Job description 
            
 
  Job description  
 Location 
 
 Kalundborg, Denmark 
 
 Job category 
 
 Project Management & Agile 
 
    Apply now       
 
 
 
 Are you ready to lead complex utility projects that play a vital role in large-scale pharmaceutical production? Join us as a Senior Project Manager in Recovery III and take ownership of critical utility deliveries. This is your opportunity to shape execution, drive collaboration, and create impact in a highly dynamic project environment. 

   

 Your new role 

   

 As a Senior Project Manager for Utilities in Recovery III, you will be responsible for delivering utility systems and ensuring alignment with project timelines, cost, and scope. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive progress and secure successful delivery across interconnected work packages. 

   

 Your key responsibilities will include: 

   
 
 Leading project management activities for utilities, including planning, scheduling, and CQV delivery 

 Managing interdependencies across work packages and ensuring alignment on milestones and resources 

 Driving progress by tracking timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure on-time execution 

 Engaging with suppliers and engineering partners to monitor performance and maintain project direction 

 Establishing transparent processes and structures reflecting the project’s design and status 

 Drive the handover process, from project closure to operations start 
 
   

 You will also act as a key driver of collaboration, ensuring clear communication and resolving challenges to maintain momentum in a complex project setup.  

   

 Your new department 

   

 You will join the LP Support - Utilities team, working within the Recovery III project. The team plays a critical role in ensuring robust and reliable utility systems that support production and operational excellence. 

   

 You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across engineering, maintenance, and project organisations, as well as external partners. The environment is cross-functional and fast-paced, requiring strong stakeholder engagement and the ability to navigate complexity with confidence.  

   

   

 Your skills and qualifications 

   

 We are looking for a driven and collaborative project leader who thrives in complex environments and is motivated by delivering results. 

   

 To succeed in this role, you should have: 

   
 
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline 

 Experience within pharmaceutical production or a similar regulated industry 

 Strong project management capabilities and experience leading through others 

 Excellent communication skills in Danish and/or English, with the ability to influence stakeholders 

 A proactive mindset with strong relationship-building skills and a “can-do" attitude 
 
   

 You are comfortable working with ambitious goals, driving continuous improvements, and building strong collaboration across teams and stakeholders.  

   

   

 Working at Novo Nordisk 

   

 Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job - you're becoming part of a story that spans generations. 

   

   

 What we offer 

   

 Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position. 
 The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.   

   

 Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. 

 Learn more about our Reward Philosophy  here  

   

 There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind. 

   

   

 Contact 

   

 For further information about the position, please contact Pedro Correria at pdhc@novonordisk.com. 

   

   

 Deadline 

   

 26 August 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Trading Lifecycle Associate II
description:
Join our team where you'll play a crucial role in ensuring accurate and efficient trade processing across all asset classes. Your advanced analytical skills and trade lifecycle expertise will be vital in solving complex problems, making impactful decisions, and ensuring compliance with industry standards.

As a Trade Lifecycle Associate II within OTC Derivatives Operations, you will play a pivotal role in managing the operations of the pre- and post-trading life cycle across all asset classes. Your expertise in trade lifecycle processes will be crucial in ensuring all trades are processed accurately and efficiently on respective platforms. You will be expected to apply your advanced analytical skills and broad understanding of the professional field to solve problems, make decisions that impact the department, and ensure compliance with technical standards and policies. Your role will involve coordinating with various departments, managing cash movements in and out of client accounts, and preparing funding for managed demand deposit accounts. You will also be responsible for identifying process inefficiencies and implementing improvements, leveraging automation technologies, and managing projects effectively. Your ability to influence and manage internal stakeholders, coupled with your strong presentation skills and market product knowledge, will be key to your success in this role.
Job Responsibilities:
  • Oversee the preparation and management of funding for managed demand deposit accounts (DDA’s), ensuring proper allocation of wires to client/funding accounts within the appropriate threshold.
  • Conduct comprehensive reconciliation of ledgers using various systems and tools, identifying and addressing any discrepancies promptly.
  • Knowledge of OTC Derivatives products like Rates, Equity, Credit and Commodities is preferred.
  • Collaborate with other lines of business to facilitate proper funding, ensuring seamless coordination and communication.
  • Validate internal entries for processing and confirming instructions, applying a keen attention to detail and a thorough understanding of trade lifecycle processes.
  • Lead and manage projects in partnership with various Operations Departments, leveraging your project management skills to meet goals and deliver results.
  • Contribute to end-to-end process and operating model reviews, identifying areas for improvement and implementing effective solutions.
  • Ensure proper controls are in place to mitigate financial risks, proactively identifying and addressing any gaps.
  • Support strategic projects in partnership with Product, Tech, and Change partners, facilitating seamless change adoption with a key focus on strategic stack adoption.
  • Know the front to back Operations process (including the key elements such as confirmations, settlements, regulatory reporting) and facilitate issue resolution across teams.

Required Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in managing trade lifecycle processes, with a focus on cash movements and funding for managed demand deposit accounts.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in using automation technologies to optimize trade lifecycle operations and implement process improvements.
  • Advanced knowledge of market product definitions, operating procedures, and industry regulations, with the ability to apply this knowledge in day-to-day operations.
  • Proven ability to manage projects effectively, with experience in leading cross-functional teams and delivering results within set timelines.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation, with experience in using various systems and tools for ledger reconciliation and discrepancy resolution.

title: Alsidig og selvstændig tekniker til nathold i Fasterholt
description:
Vil du have et job med ansvar, teknik og frihed under ansvar? DOT A/S i Fasterholt søger en tekniker til fast nathold, som har lyst til at udvikle sig i et stærkt teknisk miljø. Du bliver en del af vores tekniske team, som holder fabrikkens maskiner og procesanlæg i gang, sikkert, stabilt og effektivt.

Dine primære opgaver

• Fejlfinding og afhjælpning af driftsstop på produktionsanlæg

• Forebyggende vedligehold, smøring, kontrol og driftstjek

• Reparation og udskiftning af mekaniske og elektriske komponenter

• Løbende overvågning af anlæggenes driftstilstand

• Samarbejde med produktionen om høj oppetid og driftssikkerhed

Som tekniker på nathold får du en selvstændig rolle med stor indflydelse på den daglige drift.

Dine kvalifikationer

Du har erfaring med ét eller flere af følgende områder:

• Vedligehold af produktions- og procesanlæg

• Fejlsøgning på mekaniske og/eller elektriske systemer

• Pneumatik, hydraulik, automatik eller styringer

Du kan for eksempel være uddannet industrimekaniker, smed, automatiktekniker eller elektriker, eller have en anden relevant teknisk baggrund.

Det vigtigste er, at du har solid teknisk forståelse, godt håndelag og går til opgaverne med energi og ansvar.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du også har:

• Truckcertifikat

• Erfaring med svejseopgaver eller lettere smedearbejde

Vi forventer, at du er

• Stabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

• Struktureret, men også kreativ, når der skal findes løsninger

• Fleksibel i forhold til opgaver og arbejdstid

• Klar til at arbejde på fast nathold

• I stand til at møde stabilt på nathold i Fasterholt

Vi tilbyder

• En alsidig hverdag med faglige udfordringer

• Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt teknisk team

• Grundig oplæring og mulighed for faglig udvikling

• En arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og ordentlighed er i fokus

Ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Lars Jensen på tlf. 61639150.

Send din ansøgning og CV snarest muligt til job@dot.dk, mærket "Tekniker - Fasterholt". Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Om DOT A/S

DOT A/S er Nordens førende specialist i overfladebehandling og korrosionsbeskyttelse af metal. Med moderne produktion på flere lokationer i Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Irland leverer DOT kvalitetsløsninger inden for blandt andet varmforzinkning, maling og metallisering. DOT A/S har hovedkontor i Fasterholt og beskæftiger medarbejdere på tværs af flere nordiske og europæiske lokationer.

Er du A-menneske, og ser du en fordel i at arbejde om morgenen frem for sene aftentimer? Og vil du være med til at give vores kunder en indkøbsoplevelse udover det sædvanlige? Så er du måske vores nye butiksassistent!

På #teamlidl bliver du en del af et seriøst godt sammenhold, og vi har et fælles mål om at blive danskernes førstevalg, når det kommer til dagligvareindkøb. Som Europas største dagligvarekæde har vi høje ambitioner til fælles - i verden og i hverdagen - med grænseløse muligheder og holdånd i en klasse for sig. Derfor investerer vi i dig som medarbejder. Og derfor er der ingen grænser for, hvor langt du kan nå.

Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du ansvarsfulde opgaver og mulighed for at gøre en positiv forskel for vores kunder. Når du starter, klæder vi dig på gennem et grundigt oplæringsforløb i vores koncepter, ligesom du får adgang til skræddersyede kurser, der udvikler dig både personligt og fagligt. Og det gælder for alle i Lidl - uanset om du arbejder fuldtid eller deltid.




Om jobbet


Det allervigtigste i dit job bliver at sørge for, at vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige. Du kan både tale med Hr. Jensen på hans daglige besøg i butikken, og give den travle småbørnsfamilie et smil med på vejen. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

Primært møde ind til morgenvagter med mødetid kl. 06.00 - det kan både være i hverdagene og hver anden weekend - og vær forberedt på, at der også kan være aftenvagter 

Fylde varer op på hylderne

Give vores kunder fremragende service under hele deres indkøbsoplevelse

Betjene kunderne ved kassen 

Sørge for, at butikken altid er flot og skinnende ren




Om dig


Når du starter i Lidl, får du et grundigt oplæringsforløb, og vi slipper dig ikke løs i butikken, før du har styr på vores processer. Derfor er det ikke afgørende for os, at du har erfaring fra butik. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du:

Er A-menneske og kan lide at arbejde om morgenen

Tager initiativ og er hjælpsom

Holder af faste rammer og har fokus på detaljen

Trives i en travl hverdag 

Er mødestabil og pligtopfyldende




Vi tilbyder


Som butiksassistent i Lidl får du:

Verdensklasse sammenhold

En konkurrencedygtig løn på 151,52 kr. i timen som faglært og 142,17 kr. i timen som ufaglært

Et udbetalt tillæg i henhold til overenskomsten, når du arbejder på skæve tidspunkter - fx aftener, weekender og helligdage

Løn og vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst fra HK

En grundig oplæring i vores arbejdsgange og koncepter

Garanteret udvikling og uddannelse

Gode karrieremuligheder, hvis du har ambitioner om mere

Mulighed for sundhedsordning

Vi rekrutterer løbende, så send dit motiverede CV hurtigst muligt. Da butikken er åben alle ugens dage, vil der forekomme dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.
Vores rekrutteringsproces består af en telefonsamtale og en fysisk samtale i butikken.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på jobilidloest@lidl.dk eller tlf. 7635 0635, mandag - torsdag 8.00 - 15.00/ fredag 08.00 - 14.00.
