title: Bliv teamleder for aftenholdet hos Smurfit Westrock i Herfølge - Smurfit Westrock
description:
Bliv teamleder for aftenholdet hos Smurfit Westrock i Herfølge 
  


 
    
 

        
 
            
 Er du en engageret leder, der trives med at skabe et positivt samarbejdsmiljø og sikre en stabil drift? Motiveres du af at tage ansvar, udvikle medarbejdere og skabe en kultur præget af sammenhold og fælles succes? Så er det måske dig, der skal være vores nye teamleder for aftenholdet hos Smurfit Westrock i Herfølge. 

 Som teamleder får du ansvaret for at sikre en stabil og effektiv drift på aftenholdet. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores produktionslederteam og bidrager til at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor vores kerneværdier som respekt, loyalitet, integritet og sikkerhed er fundamentet i det daglige arbejde. 

 Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være: 
 
   Skabe en positiv og motiverende kultur, hvor medarbejderne trives og arbejder som et stærkt team. 

   Sikre et stabilt produktionsflow og en tryg drift på aftenholdet. 

   Overholde og fremme sikkerheds- og kvalitetsstandarder. 

   Administrative opgaver som fx opfølgning på nøgletal og timeforbrug. 

   Samarbejde med produktionslederteamet for at sikre sammenhæng på tværs af skift. 
 
 Er du den rette person? Vi søger en stabil og engageret leder, der kan skabe et godt og trygt arbejdsmiljø. Du er en holdspiller, der værdsætter samarbejde og har fokus på at udvikle og motivere dit team gennem tillid, kommunikation og en positiv tilgang til udfordringer. 

 Vi forestiller os, at du: 
 
   Har mod på at lære om lederskab og tage næste skridt i din karriere og udvikle dig som leder. 

   Er en naturlig motivator, der skaber engagement og sammenhold. 

   Kan kommunikere på en tydelig, direkte og respektfuld måde. 

   Vægter samarbejde og trivsel højt. 

   Arbejder med udgangspunkt i vores kerneværdier: respekt, loyalitet, integritet og sikkerhed. 
 
 Vi tilbyder: 
 
   Et selvstændigt og alsidigt job i en international og vækstorienteret virksomhed. 

   Et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på sikkerhed og trivsel. 

   Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling. 

   Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer. 
 
 Om Smurfit Westrock: Smurfit Westrock er en global leder inden for bæredygtig papir-og emballageproduktion med aktiviteter i 40 lande og over 100.000 medarbejdere, der arbejder på mere end 500 konverteringsanlæg og 62 papirmøller. Vi stræber efter at skabe et sikkert og åbent arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle medarbejdere trives og udvikles. 

 Smurfit Westrock ønsker at fremme ligestilling og mangfoldighed. Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen - uanset etnisk baggrund, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, religion eller alder. 

 Klar til at tage næste skridt? Send os din ansøgning allerede i dag - vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Vi tror på at udvikle talenter internt og tilbyder rigelige muligheder for intern vækst og forfremmelse. Med INTALENT, vores interne jobportal, er det nemt at søge blandt vores ledige stillinger.

Personalekøbsrabat+

Som en del af vores team får du 25 % medarbejderrabat i alle vores butikker og brands i landet. Det er blot én af måderne, vi viser vores påskønnelse af dit arbejde.

Fleksibilitet i arbejdet+

Alle medarbejdere har mulighed for at ansøge om fleksible arbejdsforhold.



Fødselsdagsfri+

Vi tror på, at din fødselsdag er helt speciel. Derfor giver vi dig muligheden for at være fri den dag, for at nyde den fuldt ud!

2.
Når vi har fundet en passende mulighed for dig, modtager du en e-mail med et link til vores VideoAsk-platform. Dette vil give dig mulighed for at give yderligere oplysninger om dig selv.

Hvis din profil matcher en af vores aktuelle ledige stillinger, kontakter vi dig for at arrangere en samtale. Bare tag dit lyseste smil med og vær dig selv. Vi glæder os til at møde dig!


4.

Would you like to use your COBOL experience for more than maintaining existing systems? In Cash Management, you will have the opportunity to work with solutions that are critical to Danish banks today while helping shape how they are modernised for the future. As part of a newly established team, you will have a say in both our technical direction and the way we collaborate.

Join a team with modernisation on the agenda


You will become part of Cash Management, where we develop and maintain solutions that support key processes for Bankdata’s banks and their customers. You will play an important role in ensuring stable and robust solutions today while also exploring how existing functionality can gradually be modernised from COBOL towards Java-based solutions.



The team consists of three Software Developers, a Business Consultant, a Product Owner and your manager. We have deep business knowledge within Cash Management, while still being a relatively new team. This gives you the opportunity to help shape how we collaborate, our team culture and our technical direction.



We work in an agile way and adjust our ways of working when we see opportunities to improve. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with your colleagues, with knowledge sharing and sparring across business and technology being a natural part of everyday life.




Your role: Development, maintenance and modernisation


As a Software Developer, you will work across the entire development process - from analysis and design to implementation, testing and quality assurance. You will take responsibility for existing solutions while also having the opportunity to influence our future technical development.





Your responsibilities will include:



developing, maintaining and enhancing our business-critical COBOL solutions



investigating and analyzing complex dependencies, integrations and operational requirements



ensuring high quality and stability through testing, code reviews, documentation and continuous technical improvements



identifying opportunities and technical dependencies related to the modernisation and migration from COBOL towards Java



collaborating and sharing knowledge with the team while contributing to our long-term technical direction.



During your first 6-12 months, you will:



Build a solid understanding of the Cash Management domain and the business processes supported by our solutions. You will become familiar with our existing COBOL solutions, integrations and key process flows and gradually take responsibility for tasks across the entire development process.



At the same time, you will play an active role in identifying technical dependencies and opportunities for modernisation. Our goal is for you to build close working relationships with the rest of the team and contribute your skills, curiosity and perspectives on how we develop our solutions going forward.


Your profile - COBOL experience with an eye on the future


We imagine that you enjoy working with complex technical challenges and are motivated by both understanding existing solutions in depth and exploring how they can evolve.




Most importantly, you:




have hands-on experience with COBOL and developing complex or business-critical systems



have experience with troubleshooting, testing and quality assurance and take responsibility for quality throughout the process - from analysis to the finished solution



have an understanding of integrations, databases, APIs, batch processes or similar technical environments



have an interest in Java and the modernisation of legacy systems - experience with Java is an advantage, but not a requirement



take a pragmatic and collaborative approach and are motivated by sharing your knowledge, learning from others and challenging existing solutions.






You may have a relevant educational background in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, but relevant practical experience can easily compensate for a formal educational background.



The role can be shaped according to your experience and level of expertise. What matters most is your COBOL experience, technical curiosity and motivation to be part of a modernisation journey.


What do we offer?



The opportunity to make an impact: You will join a relatively new team where you can help shape both how we collaborate and our technical direction.





An exciting technical journey: You will work with business-critical COBOL solutions while also being part of the journey to modernise them towards Java.





Professional development: You can build deep knowledge of Cash Management and gradually take on greater technical responsibility, with opportunities to develop towards roles such as Senior Developer, Lead Developer or Technical Specialist.



Want to help bridge the gap between today’s systems and tomorrow’s solutions?

title: Senior Technician, Information Modelling
description:
• You will be working and supporting a range of infrastructure schemes to independently develop engineering BIM models and drawings under the relevant standards.

  • You will be expected to play a proactive part in the BIM design process and be active on several projects at any given time.

  • You will be contributing to all types of projects.

  • You will be using Revit, ACC, Civil 3D, AutoCAD and other engineering BIM software for the production and development of models and drawings.

  • You will read and adhere to all relevant policies and procedures for Health and Safety including the H&S Policy, H&S Manual, and Local Procedures Manual

  • You will take responsibility for your own personal development with the support of the line manager and follow an agreed development plan.

  • You will assist in the development of others in the team.

Key Competencies / Skills

  • Ability to utilise Revit, ACC, Civil 3D, AutoCAD in adherence to defined CAD & BIM standards to develop 3D modelling, layouts, labelling, dimensioning, sheet layout, design details and other appropriate design concepts.

  • Ability to read and interpret 2D and 3D CAD drawings and models to assist with investigations of engineering problems.

  • Proven ability to work up drawings (plans, sections & details) from Engineers basic sketches to full working drawings.

  • Ability to liaise with the design teams both in GCC and UK as necessary to coordinate design and drawing production.

  • Capable of multi-tasking and managing multiple projects with the ability to accurately predict the time required to fulfil the individual scopes of work required.

  • Undertake reviews of work produced by others to ensure high quality of CAD output.

  • UK / International project experience and working knowledge of UK/International design standards.

  • You should be able to demonstrate some experience and working knowledge of relevant technical design guidance and standards, such as BIM workflow, ISO 19650 etc.,

  • Perform clash detection.

  • You should be able to understand, implement and communicate BIM and CAD standards for use on Civil engineering projects and possessing an appropriate overall level of knowledge of the UK / International infrastructure design sector.

  • Experience in supervising and coordinating the CAD/BIM output of others within a multidisciplinary project environment.

  • Commitment to work as part of a design team focused on project delivery.

  • Good understanding and knowledge of Multi-Discipline Projects

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

Qualifications

  • At least one key area such as Diploma/Engineering in Civil Engineering with 6-10 years relevant work experience in Autodesk BIM Software's.

  • Excellent working knowledge of Revit, ACC, Civil 3D, AutoCAD.

  • Good working knowledge of the relevant Civil & Structural Engineering discipline.

BGV:

  • Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

  • Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in Canada.

This is an opportunity to shape intuitive, high-impact experiences across a sophisticated portfolio of B2B payment products. You will own end-to-end design initiatives spanning both new product experiences and improvements to established payment gateway workflows. The role combines strategic product thinking, user research, interaction design, visual craft, and systems thinking. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, merchants, partners, and other stakeholders to turn complex technical requirements into clear and accessible experiences. You will also help advance design systems and introduce AI-assisted workflows that accelerate prototyping, research, and exploration. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, enjoys solving complex problems, and can balance user needs, business outcomes, accessibility, and technical feasibility.

Accountabilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design initiatives, from journey mapping and user flows through wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, balancing customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.
  • Design both greenfield experiences and improvements to existing payment gateway products, helping create intuitive workflows for complex B2B use cases.
  • Plan and conduct user research, usability testing, and external validation with partners and merchants to uncover insights and continuously improve product experiences.
  • Translate research findings and user needs into actionable design solutions and communicate design rationale clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve scalable design systems that promote consistency, efficiency, and a cohesive experience across products.
  • Benchmark product experiences against competitors and industry standards to identify opportunities for differentiation and improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring designs are both user-centered and technically feasible.
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Figma AI, v0, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar technologies to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, ideation, and design exploration.
  • Simplify complex payment, API, financial, and transaction concepts into clear and accessible user experiences.
  • Apply accessibility principles, including WCAG standards, to product experiences and regulated payment workflows.
  • Contribute to customer-facing materials, conference initiatives, and other design projects that support product engagement and adoption.
  • Help advance product design practices by bringing a strategic perspective, a strong point of view, and a focus on measurable user and business impact.

    • Requirements

    • 4+ years of professional experience designing B2B digital products or complex software systems, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating design process, breadth, and measurable impact.
    • Experience designing financial products, APIs, transaction systems, payment gateways, fintech platforms, or comparable B2B SaaS products is strongly preferred.
    • Strong product design capabilities across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, prototyping, and end-to-end user journeys.
    • Proficiency in Figma and experience creating and maintaining scalable design systems.
    • Experience conducting user research and usability testing and translating findings into effective product decisions.
    • Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and their application to digital and regulated workflows.
    • Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools such as v0, Cursor, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Figma AI, or similar technologies to improve design, research, or prototyping workflows.
    • Ability to simplify complex technical and payment concepts into intuitive experiences for diverse audiences.
    • Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with the ability to present design decisions confidently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, research, business, and external partners.
    • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and independently identifying opportunities to improve products and processes.
    • Understanding of technical constraints, API-driven workflows, and the needs of developer, merchant, and partner audiences is an advantage.
    • Experience designing onboarding, transaction monitoring, merchant, partner, or payment experiences is a plus.
    • Familiarity with service design techniques such as journey mapping and service blueprints is desirable.
    • Experience bringing multiple products or platforms together through a cohesive design system is an additional advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary, with the U.S. range listed at $130,000–$150,000 USD, depending on experience and location.
      • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
      • Remote-first work culture with flexibility for eligible employees.
      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
      • 13 paid holidays.
      • Company volunteer days.
      • Opportunity to work on complex fintech and payment products with meaningful B2B customer impact.
      • Collaborative environment with close partnerships across product, engineering, research, and business teams.
      • Opportunities to use emerging AI technologies as part of the core design and research workflow.
      • Inclusive workplace with initiatives supporting diversity, equity, belonging, and employee communities.

title: Zoho Admin
description:
SEVEN operates its entire business on Zoho, using around 30 applications across memberships, class and service bookings, billing for multiple legal entities, HR, payroll, support, and reporting. We are seeking a Zoho Administrator, rather than a Zoho CRM developer, to take ownership of the configuration, automation, integrations, and data integrity across our full Zoho ecosystem. The role also requires working knowledge of React and Node.js, as several external systems integrate with Zoho, and the successful candidate should be flexible and willing to support projects beyond the Zoho environment as business needs evolve.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full administration of the Zoho One tenant — users, roles, profiles, permissions sharing rules, field-level security and app provisioning
  • Configure, customize and maintain CRM modules, layouts, custom views, workflows,blueprints, dashboards and automations
  • Develop and troubleshoot Deluge functions — standalone, workflow, scheduled andbutton-triggered
  • Build backend logic, workflows and scheduled tasks across Zoho apps
  • Manage API and webhook integrations with external systems
  • Build and maintain Zoho Creator applications
  • Ensure correct integration between Zoho products
  • Maintain data accuracy, run audits and resolve system performance issues
  • Document every configuration change — what changed, why, and how to revert it
  • Collaborate with internal teams, provide support and technical recommendations
  • Support and extend applications built in React and Node.js that integrate with the Zohoestate
  • Take on additional projects outside the Zoho scope of work where the business requires it


Applications in scope

  • Core: Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator
  • Finance: Zoho Books — multiple organizations, multi-currency, tax configuration
  • Operations: Zoho Flow, Zoho Desk, Zoho Inventory
  • People: Zoho People, Zoho Payroll, Zoho Recruit
  • Reporting: Zoho Analytics — workspaces, data sources, scheduled syncs
  • Platform: Zoho One admin console


Requirements

Essential:

  • Valid Zoho certification — candidates must hold a current Zoho certification and provide the certificate for verification at application stage. Uncertified applicants will not be considered.
  • Proven experience administering Zoho One as a whole tenant, not Zoho CRM alone, with confidence across the main Zoho applications listed above
  • Strong Deluge scripting, including API calls from Deluge, error handling and scheduled functions
  • Zoho CRM REST API and COQL, including bulk read/write operations and their batch limits
  • Zoho Books configuration across multiple organizations
  • Zoho Analytics — workspaces, data sources, and keeping syncs healthy after schema change
  • Zoho Flow — building and debugging multi-step flows
  • Zoho Creator application development
  • Working knowledge of React and Node.js
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Able to work independently, respond same-day during core hours, and deliver without close supervision


Desirable:

  • Additional Zoho certifications across multiple applications
  • Zoho People, Payroll, Recruit, Campaigns, Sign
  • Experience in a fitness, hospitality, clinic or membership business
  • Stripe, POS or payment reconciliation experience
  • Git and basic deployment workflow familiarity


Delivery expectation:
  • Delivery-focused role. Multiple completed tickets per day for routine configuration work,
  • and larger builds scoped and delivered against agreed dates. Work is tracked in Asana
  • and reviewed weekly.

Benefits

Competitive Salary: Based on experience and role responsibilities
Club Access: Full access to SEVEN Wellness Club facilities and classes
F&B Discount: 50% off all in-house food and beverage items at The Dose Kitchen
Career Growth: Opportunities to grow across SEVEN’s expanding group of brands
Supportive Culture: A team-oriented environment that values initiative, professionalism, and well-being

Kom og bring din viden om arbejdsmiljøet indenfor anlægsarbejde i spil, når du sammen med den øvrige organisation og eksterne entreprenører, rådgivere og bygherre, ser skaden før den sker. Udarbejder forebyggende handlinger, som forbedrer arbejdsmiljøet både før, under og efter et byggeri. For at blive en succes i jobbet er det afgørende, at du har et godt menneske kendskab, kan samarbejde på flere niveauer i organisationen. Du skal have passion for anlægsarbejde og have erfaring fra anlægsprojekter. Du skal have en uddannelse som ingeniør eller lignende.

Hvis det lyder som dig, så kan dette være en rolle for dig. Bliv en del af Construction Management som vores nye arbejdsmiljøkoordinator og hjælp os med at skabe en bæredygtig fremtid.

Din nye rolle

Som vores nye Arbejdsmiljøkoordinator bliver du en del af Byggeledelsesteamet som primært beskæftiger sig med arbejdsmiljø, byggeledelse, planlægning og tilsyn. Vi har kontor i Ørestad, Odense, Vejle og Aarhus. Vi er primært ingeniører, konstruktører og teknikere med forskellige fagligheder indenfor anlægsarbejde. Afdelingen arbejder meget sammen med andre afdelinger i Rambøll og har stor interaktion med Entreprenører, Rådgivere og Bygherre. Vi arbejder typisk på store innovative tværfaglige projekter som motorveje, jernbaner, ledningsanlæg og havnebyggeri i hele landet. Vi har en uformel omgangstone, arbejder selvstændigt og har en stor grad af selvledelse.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil være:



AMK-P Herunder:

At have en koordinerende rolle i projektorganisationen og understøtte, at arbejdsmiljøaktiviteter planlægges, gennemføres og kvalitetssikres

At føre en dialog med de projekterende således, at nyeste forskningsbaserede viden bliver anvendt, når der vælges produkter, processer og metoder til at fremme et godt arbejdsmiljø

At sikre tilbageværende risici bliver beskrevet og behandlet i et samarbejde med byggelederne

Udarbejde grundlaget for en plan for sikkerhed og sundhed

Udarbejde en journal for vedligeholdelsesopgaver i det færdige byggeri, hvor sikkerhed og sundhed har en særlig betydning

AMK-B Herunder:

At planlægge og gennemføre opstartsmøder med alle bygherrens entreprenører og underentreprenører i samarbejde med byggelederen

At planlægge og lede arbejdsmiljømøder samt opfølgning på beslutninger

At planlægge og gennemføre mønsterrunderinger på byggepladsernes fællesområder

At sikre dokumentering og analysering af nærved hændelser med det formål at bidrage med løsninger, der skaber et endnu bedre arbejdsmiljø

At være en stærk og naturlig kommunikator i forhold til håndværkere, arbejdsmiljøgrupperne og byggeledelsen

At ajourføre plan for sikkerhed og sundhed

At føre en logbog med forhold, der skal indarbejdes i journalen til brug i det færdige byggeri

Om dig

Uddannet ingeniør eller lignende

Passion for anlægsbranchen og erfaring fra anlægsbyggepladser

En uddannelse som arbejdsmiljøkoordinator

God og selvsikker i din kommunikation og du håndterer interessenter bedre end de fleste.

Du har et godt overblik over projekterne og ved at djævlen ligger i detaljerne

Konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret

Motiveret af at arbejde selvstændig

"Safty first" er en del af dit dna og indtænkes i alt hvad du foretager dig

Hvad vi kan tilbyde dig

Investering i din udvikling

Ledere du kan regne med, vejledt af vores ledelsesprincipper

Bliv værdsat for den unikke person du er

Stor inspiration fra kolleger, kunder og projekter

Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø med mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra når det passer ind i projekterne

Pensionsordning via PFA inklusiv betalt sundhedsforsikring

Tekniske ekskursioner og sociale arrangementer

24 ugers betalt barsel for både far, mor og LGBTQ+ familier

Projekter, som ikke blot er fagligt stimulerende, men hvor du også er med til at gøre en reel forskel

Er du klar til at blive en del af Rambøll?

Send os din ansøgning, inklusiv et opdateret CV. Vi arbejder for at fremme diversitet, og derfor opfordrer vi ansøgere fra alle grupper til at ansøge.

Vi erkender, at nogle kandidater kun ansøger, når de opfylder alle krav. Men passion og potentiale vejer ofte tungere end et perfekt CV, og Rambølls læringskultur kan hjælpe dig med at vokse i rollen. Så hvis denne rolle lyder som noget for dig, men du ikke opfylder alle kravene, så opfordrer vi dig til at ansøge alligevel. Måske passer du perfekt til denne eller i en anden rolle i vores afdeling.

Ansøgningsfrist: 13.09.2026 - Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Tak for at du overvejede denne mulighed hos Rambøll! Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Arbejd med bæredygtig forandring hos Rambøll i Danmark

Rambøll er en global arkitektur-, ingeniør- og management consulting-rådgivningsvirksomhed. Vi er en fondsejet organisation med mennesker i fokus, grundlagt i Danmark. Vi tror på, at formålet med bæredygtig forandring er at skabe en verden, hvor både natur og mennesker trives. Det er vores udgangspunkt - og det er det som vejleder os i vores arbejde. Vores historie er forankret i en klar vision om, hvordan en ansvarlig virksomhed skal agere, og åbenhed og nysgerrighed er en vigtig del af vores kultur. Rambøll i Danmark består i dag af mere en 4000 medarbejdere fordelt på 12 kontorer. Rambølls eksperter leverer innovative løsninger på tværs af Byggeri, Transport, Energi, Vand, Management Consulting, Miljø & Sundhed og Arkitektur & Landskab.

Ligestilling, Mangfoldighed og Inklusion

Ligestilling, mangfoldighed og inklusion er grundsten i vores kultur. Hos Ramboll tror vi på, at mangfoldighed er en styrke, og at forskellige erfaringer og perspektiver er afgørende for at skabe innovative løsninger og bæredygtige samfund. Vi arbejder aktivt for at skabe et inkluderende og støttende arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle trives og kan realisere deres potentiale. Vi ved også, hvor vigtigt det er at opnå den rette balance i forhold til hvor, hvornår og hvor meget du arbejder. Derfor tilbyder vi hos Ramboll en høj grad af fleksibilitet til at tilpasse dit arbejde til din individuelle situation. Vi opfordrer alle kandidater uagtet baggrund til at ansøge. Vi hører gerne fra dig, hvis der er nogle tilpasninger, vi kan foretage i rekrutteringsprocessen for at gøre den mere behagelig for dig. Du kan kontakte os på job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com med sådanne forespørgsler.

title: Computational Mechanics Expert - PhD
description:
About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Computational Structural & Mechanical Engineering Expert
Type:Contract
Compensation:$70–$85/hour
Location:Remote
Commitment:15–20 hours/week

Role Responsibilities

  • Design challenging computational problems to test AI capabilities in solving scientific and engineering tasks.
  • Develop problems requiring skilled use of open-source, domain-specific computational tools like FEniCSx/DOLFINx, OpenFOAM, deal.II, and others.
  • Evaluate AI models by testing them against state-of-the-art benchmarks and refine problems to achieve the desired difficulty.
  • Collaborate with AI research teams to improve problem designs and ensure they test strategic reasoning and problem-solving.
  • Work independently and asynchronously to meet deadlines and refine problem designs based on feedback.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Graduate-level training in a relevant STEM field (MS, PhD, or equivalent research experience).
  • Proven proficiency with at least one of the listed scientific software libraries through research publications, open-source contributions, or professional work.
  • Strong Python skills for writing problem setups, oracle functions, and solution validators.
  • Ability to work independently and refine problem designs based on feedback.
  • Comfortable working in a Linux/terminal environment with remote compute sandboxes.

Preferred

  • Experience across multiple listed domains or tools.
  • Familiarity with benchmark or evaluation design.
  • Background in scientific teaching or exam/problem-set design.
  • Experience with computational reproducibility and containerized environments.

Application Process (Takes 20–30 mins to complete)

MindKey Recruiting


    


    



        
    

	
Sundhedshjælper eller med lignende uddannelse til Ippiarsuk
Aktivitetscenteret Ippiarsuk er beliggende i naturskønne omgivelser med en storslået natur og med gode busforbindelser. 

Huset består af 3 plejeafdeling, samt aktivitetscenter med 26 brugere, med cafeteria, vaskeri, administrations kontor. Og i Centeret er der mulighed for træning, aktiviteter og socialt samvær.

Vi har fokus på rehabilitering, træning før pleje, genoptræning. 

Har du lyst til sammen med kollegaer at være med til at præge udviklingen og samarbejdet i Ippiarsuk?




Vores forventninger til dig er:

 Uddannet sundhedshjælper eller lignende uddannelse

 Lyst og interesse samt erfaring for ældreområdet

 Ansvarsbevidst

 Kan deltage i alle aktiviteter selvstændig 

 Gode tværfaglige samarbejdsevner

 Fleksibilitet og godt humør

 Være med til at skabe et godt miljø for brugerne og et godt kollegialt samarbejdet

 Er dobbelt sproget på grønlandsk og dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav




Vi tilbyder:

 Introduktion

 Tillid

 Ansvar

 En travl, men god hverdag sammen med brugere udefra samt beboere og kollegaer.

 Dejlige nye omgivelser

 Fantastisk natur

 Nær Bus 2 ved " Butik Nathalie "




Straffeattest:

Denne stilling er omfattet af lov om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. I henhold til loven kan ansættelsen først begynde, når kommunen har modtaget en straffeattest. Vi skal derfor gøre opmærksom på, at tiltrædelsestidspunktet først kan aftales, når kommunen har modtaget straffeattesten fra Politiet.




Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre, i henhold til den på tiltrædelsestidspunktet gældende aftale/overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre og pågældende forhandlingsberettigede organisation.




Ansættelsen vil ske med 3 måneders prøvetid.




Bolig: 

Der kan ikke anvises personalebolig til stillingen. 




Yderligere oplysninger fås hos:

Såfremt stillingen har din interesse, er du velkommen til at tage kontakt for uddybende oplysninger om stillingen og tilhørende arbejdsopgaver til: 

Leder i Aktivitetscenter Bente Hegelund, tlf. +299 547529 eller e-mail: ks62behe@sermersooq.gl 




Ansøgning:

Ansøgning mærket med Job nr. 759-26 , vedlagt uddannelsesbevis og dokumentation for tidligere beskæftigelse m.v. skal være uploadede inden fristens udløb.




Sådan søger du:

Ansøgninger skal sendes elektronisk, via link nederst på denne side, hvor du kan vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV.




Bemærk:

Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger i papir eller mails, send venligst din ansøgning elektronisk ved stillingsopslaget.

Regnskabsfører til Langelandske menighedsråd

Vi søger en servicemindet, engageret og fleksibel medarbejder til Fælles Regnskabskontor, der skal lave regnskab for 7 menighedsråd på Langeland og Strynø.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En fuldtidsstilling 37 timer/uge
  • Et alsidigt job i et fagligt spændende miljø med indflydelse på egen arbejdsdag
  • Samarbejde med menighedsrådene på Langeland og Strynø
  • Kontor i Sognehuset, Torvet 1A, Rudkøbing
  • Kollega på ca. ½ tid
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde

Jobprofil - du skal:

  • Deltage i bogføring, regnskabsføring, budgetlægning, lønindberetning, kontrol mv.
  • Vejlede menighedsrådene

Din profil - du er

  • Kontor-/regnskabsuddannet
  • Bekendt med lønindberetning
  • Ansvarsfuld, selvstændig og initiativrig
  • Medvirkende til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Interesseret i relevant efteruddannelse
  • Fleksibel ift. arbejdstid
  • Glad for travle perioder

Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026

Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 2 jf. overenskomst for kordegne.

Yderligere oplysninger kan indhentes hos Regnskabsfører Kaj Christoffersen tlf. 5133 1035.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til Bestyrelsesmedlem i Fælles Regnskabskontor Mette Knudsen, mail: 7712MEK@km.dk og skal være os i hænde senest 1. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt medio september 2026.

  Position description  
	Job title
 
 Personlig Træner PureGym Bryggen 
 
	Become a part of the team behind the largest Fitness community in Denmark
 
 
	
  

 Er du uddannet personlig træner og brænder for at give dine klienter de bedste resultater? Kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af landets største personlig træner-team samt få adgang til Danmarks største fitness medlemsbase? 

 Så er du måske vores nye personlig træner i PureGym. 

 Som personlig træner i PureGym hjælper du vores medlemmer med at opnå deres mål gennem træningsforløb, der er karakteriseret ved konstant sparring, coaching og motivation.   

 En personlig træner hos PureGym karakteriseres ved at være energisk og udadvendt og trives blandt andre mennesker. Du brænder for personlig træning og er proaktiv i din tilgang til at skabe en klientbase blandt centerets medlemmer. 

 Vi forventer, at du leverer en høj kvalitet til vores medlemmer, skaber dit eget personlige brand for at tiltrække og fastholde klienter samt laver ulønnet lead-generende arbejde som fx foredrag, SoMe konkurrencer og andre proaktive tiltag.  

   

   

  

 
 
	Your qualifications
 
 
	
  

 Derudover forventer vi 

 • At du er uddannet personlig træner eller har gennemført til og med 2. år på en prof.bach. i fysioterapi eller bachelor i idræt.   

 • At du har ambitioner om at have min. 10 timers personlig træning/ugen. 

 • At du er åben overfor at påtage dig andre roller i centeret som eksempelvis holdinstruktør/Gym Staff indtil du har oparbejdet dig et klientbase. 

 • At du kan fremvise en straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelse 

 Hvis du går videre i processen, vil du blive inviteret til en jobsamtale for at blive taget i betragtning til stillingen som personlig træner. 

   

 Vi tilbyder 

 Som personlig træner hos PureGym vil du primært samarbejde med centerets Gym Manager som vil coache, vejlede og udvikle vores personlige trænere mod succes. Du vil blive aflønnet på timebasis baseret på antal sessioner afholdt med medlemmer, og alt lead-generende arbejde udover sessionerne er ulønnet. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at supplere dine personlig træner timer med instruktør og Gym Staff timer i centeret, hvilket er en glimrende måde at lære alle vores medlemmer at kende på. 

 Udover dette, vil du som PT i PureGym blive en del af landets største personlige træner-team og vil få adgang til Danmarks største fitness medlemsbase. 

   

 Ansøgning
 
 Send din motiverede ansøgning, CV samt eksamensbeviser snarest muligt. Da vi modtager rigtig mange ansøgere, kan du forvente en svartid på op til 3 uger.   

 Vær opmærksom på, at kommunikation fra os nogle gange lander i spamfilteret. Du vil altid modtage en bekræftelsesmail, når du har sendt din ansøgning. Hvis ikke du modtager denne, så tjek din spammail og sørg for at fjerne os som spam, så fremtidig kommunikation lander i din almindelige indbakke.

 Permanent

title: Ai engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an analytical, numbers driven Senior AI/ML Engineer to serve as a core technical pillar across our rapidly expanding AI ecosystem. You are not just managing prompts; you are a creative strategist who knows how to architect sophisticated, production grade AI systems from the ground up.

What You Will Do Master AI Acquisition and Integration: Design and manage high performing AI systems that drive real time market intelligence and user engagement. Own the Full Funnel Architecture: Build and manage the entire technical journey, from initial data ingestion to final product conversion. Scale High Performance Systems: Support and optimise our current portfolio while maintaining extreme low latency standards required for real time market tools. Lead On-Demand Project Development: Act as the primary technical resource for new AI initiatives as they arise, taking them from concept to deployment in a high velocity environment. Execute Life Cycle Journeys: Ensure that the transition from raw social signals to finished market insights is seamless, managing all tools and software required for high fidelity tracking. Performance Reporting and ROI: Be 100% accountable for the commercial outcomes of your code, ensuring we generate value and avoid cash burning through inefficient compute or API usage. The Tech Stack Languages and Frameworks: Python (Fast API, asyncio, Pydantic), Pandas, Num Py, scikit-learn. AI/ML: Llama, Transformers (Hugging Face), LLMs (Open AI/Claude APIs), Fine Tuning, RAG, Machine Learning, Deep Learning. Data and Infrastructure: Postgre SQL, Timescale DB, Redis, Vector DB, Apache Kafka/Rabbit MQ. Cloud and Dev Ops: AWS/GCP, AWS Lambda, Docker, GPU Deployment and Optimisation. Automation and API: Selenium, Twitter API v2, Crypto Exchange APIs (Binance, Coin Gecko). Your Skills And Experience Seasoned Engineering Background: Proven track record of scaling technical products with deep hands‑on development experience. Analytical and Numbers Driven: Live in analytics, basing every architectural decision on hard data to identify leaks before they impact the bottom line. Technical Funnel Builder: Comfortable using low level tools, landing page builders, and CRM software to build the technical infrastructure of our AI products. Creative Strategist: Identify generic solutions quickly and iterate on high performance logic that resonates with target audience psychology. Crypto Market Literacy: Understanding of crypto markets and trading dynamics, with some blockchain knowledge for tokenomics related projects. Direct Communication: Speak and write clearly in UK English, with a bias to action in a lean, high output team where you own the results.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. #J-18808-Ljbffr

 Velkommen til slagterafdelingen hos MENY Gl. Skagensvej 



 I Meny`s Køkken går vi op i mad. For os er fersk kød mere end blot et håndværk. Det er vores passion. Vi er det lokale kulinariske fyrtårn, som kunderne besøger, når de skal have professionelle udskæringer fra faglærte slagtere. Det er også ved slagterdisken, at de henter inspiration til hverdagens retter, får nye opskrifter eller hører om de nyeste madtrends.

 I MENY kalder vi vores medarbejdere for MADarbejdere, og du er først og fremmest passioneret omkring mad og gode råvarer. Du behøver ikke være det naturtalent, som kan det hele fra dag 1. Måske arbejder du allerede som slagtersvend i dag, eller er ny udlært, som er på udkig efter dit næste job. Det vigtigste er, at du kommer med nysgerrighed og lysten til at lære. 



 Du langer kvalitet og gode råd over disken 



 Som slagtersvend er du musklerne bag vores succes, for du er både bag skæredisken, hvor du udskærer og tilbereder kød, og bag køledisken, hvor du inspirerer og servicerer vores kunder. 



 Det bliver bl.a. din opgave at:

 Vi er arbejdspladsen, du glæder dig til at møde ind til

Det er en kultur, du selv er med til at forme og påvirke, for vi giver vores MADarbejdere rum til at være kreative, udfordre os og dele gode ideer.

 Når det så er sagt, så rummer vi alle mennesker - så længe du er glad for mad og klar på at give den nære service, som får kunderne til at komme igen

 .

         Job Title: 
         

     Student worker System Test Engineer
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
 
 
  The Impact You'll Make 
 

 
   


  Are you a student passionate about technology and eager to see how quality is built into real products? In this flexible student worker role where you can gain invaluable hands-on experience, fitting your work around your studies.  


 
  You will play a vital role in ensuring our smart home technology is secure and reliable. Your work will directly support our efforts to meet the upcoming Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) by helping us design and automate tests for our smart IoT devices.  


 
  This is a unique opportunity to learn from industry experts, explore how AI is revolutionizing quality assurance, and see your contributions make a difference. This role also offers the potential to develop into a future internship, providing a clear path for growth.  
 
 

 
  What You’ll Be Doing 
 

 
   

 

  Help design and build our automated testing frameworks, integrating smart home devices using Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) setups  


  Support our testing strategy by identifying edge cases and learning a risk-based approach to prioritize what gets automated  


  Assist with integrating automated firmware tests into our CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality and rapid feedback  


  Translate requirements and risk assessments into traceable test cases  


  Learn to be a system detective, performing log analysis and investigate security-related findings and support mitigation efforts across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile applications  


  Explore and apply AI tools to help create smarter test automation and learn how data can drive quality improvements  

 

   
 
 

 
  What We're Looking For 
 

 
      

 

  Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field  


  A strong interest in software quality and test automation, with some project or coursework experience using Python and LabVIEW/TestStand test systems  


  Familiarity with the concepts of CI/CD and a desire to learn how it applies to firmware testing  


  Understanding of threat modeling and risk assessment principles and wireless communication protocols such as Zigbee, Matter, BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN, or similar  


  An analytical mindset with a passion for problem-solving and root cause analysis  


  Curiosity about leveraging AI to enhance test automation and data-driven quality improvements  

 

   


  If you are a motivated student ready to gain practical experience and grow your skills, we encourage you to apply and help us build the future of smart, reliable technology.  
 
 

 
  What You'll Get from Us 
 

 
   


   


  We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.  


  You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us  


  We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.  


  You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about -we think they’re great.  
 
 

 
  Ready to Make a Difference? 
 

 
   If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.
  
 For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882
   


   

 

     


  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Procesų inžinerijos skyriaus vadovas (-ė)
description:
Mūsų gamybos padaliniai Vilniuje ir Molėtuose ne tik gamina ir surenka „Teltonika“ įrenginius, bet ir teikia išorės klientams produktų kūrimo bei kontraktinės gamybos paslaugas – nuo prototipų iki didelės apimties serijinės gamybos. Pasitelkiame pažangią automatizaciją ir robotiką, kad bet kuri sudėtinga idėja virstų pilnai parengtu produktu.

Šiose pareigose Jūs:

• Būsite atsakingas už procesų inžinerijos skyriaus darbų organizavimą ir kontrolę.
• Būsite atsakingas už procesų inžinerijos skyriaus strategijos formavimą ir jos įgyvendinimą pagal įmonės tikslus.
• Užtikrinsite gamybos procesų standartizavimą, dokumentaciją ir gerųjų praktikų taikymą visoje gamyboje.
• Planuosite ir valdysite skyriaus resursus (personalą, kompetencijas, prioritetus).
• Užtikrinsite elektronikos prietaisų gamybos procesų diegimą ir validavimą NPI bei inžinerinių pakeitimų metu.
• Būsite atsakingas už nuolatinį skyriaus KPI (OEE, IRR, FPY ir kt.) stebėjimą, analizę, atitiktį tikslams ir tobulinimą.
• Užtikrinsite kokybės, našumo ir kaštų tikslų pasiekimą bei atitiktį standartams.
• Užtikrinsite sklandų tarpkomandinį bendradarbiavimą su gamybos, kokybės, technikos ir produktų inžinerijos skyriais.

Ko tikimės iš Jūsų:

• Nemažiau 2 metų vadovavimo patirtis procesų inžinerijos srityje kompleksinėje, reguliuojamoje gamybinėje aplinkoje.
• SPC, MSA, Cp/Cpk išmanymas ir gebėjimas taikyti duomenimis grįstus sprendimus.
• Praktinė Lean / Six Sigma patirtis procesų tobulinime.
• Gebėjimas valdyti prioritetus ir pasiekti rezultatus NPI, mažų serijų ir masinės gamybos aplinkoje.
• Stiprūs lyderystės ir komunikacijos įgūdžiai, darbas su tarpfunkcinėmis komandomis.
• Gebėjimas skaityti techninę dokumentaciją (brėžinius, schemas, BOM).
• Geri Excel įgūdžiai, patirtis su MES / duomenų sistemomis.
• Anglų kalba – B2 ar aukštesnis lygis.
• Patirtis diegiant procesinius ar technologinius pokyčius gamybinėje aplinkoje.
• Gamybos procesų validavimo patirtis (IQ, OQ, PQ) - privalumas.
• Reguliuojamų standartų patirtis (IATF, ISO 13485) - privalumas.

Ką siūlome:

• Siūlome galimybę prisidėti prie įdomių daiktų interneto (IoT) projektų įgyvendinimo.
• Rūpinamės emocine ir fizine savijauta, suteikdami papildomą sveikatos draudimą, į kurį įeina ir psichologo konsultacijos.
• Švenčiame pasiekimus ir linksminamės kartu per komandos formavimo renginius, vasaros festivalius ir kitas mums svarbias progas.
• Dalyvaujantiems rekomendacijų programoje siūlome solidžias premijas.
• Apdovanojame už ilgametį darbą kartu.
• Džiuginame laisva diena ir dovanomis gimtadienio proga bei staigmenomis per įvairias šventes.

Atlyginimas:

Vertiname kiekvieno darbuotojo pastangas ir patirtį, todėl siūlome konkurencingą atlyginimą, atitinkantį Jūsų kompetencijas.
Šios pozicijos atlyginimas – nuo 24 Eur/val. iki 30 Eur/val. (~ 4032–5040 Eur prieš mokesčius), priklausomai nuo patirties ir kompetencijų.

* Darbo sutartyje nustatomas ir apibrėžiamas fiksuotas (tarifinis) valandinis atlyginimo dydis prieš mokesčius.

title: Medicare Compliance & QA Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medicare Compliance & QA Associate based in the United States.

This role supports critical Medicare compliance operations within a fast-growing healthcare technology environment.
You will manage compliance cases from intake through investigation, resolution, documentation, and closure.
The position combines quality assurance, case management, agent support, and operational reporting.
You’ll work closely with agents, carriers, and cross-functional teams to ensure regulatory and internal standards are consistently met.
The role offers an opportunity to identify recurring compliance risks and help improve processes, coaching, and workflows.
You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team using technology to make Medicare easier to navigate for advisors and beneficiaries.
This is a strong opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who wants meaningful responsibility in a rapidly evolving healthcare environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Manage the full lifecycle of CTM and Non-CTM Medicare compliance cases, including intake, investigation, communication, resolution, documentation, and formal closure.
  • Triage compliance-related emails and inquiries, ensuring they are accurately categorized and routed to the appropriate case type and queue.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready case records, including notes, evidence, follow-up actions, and required documentation.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for agents, agencies, carriers, and internal stakeholders throughout the compliance case process.
  • Monitor case progress, follow up on outstanding actions, and escalate issues when necessary to prevent delays and reduce compliance risk.
  • Conduct case audits to verify documentation quality, completeness, and adherence to established case-handling standards.
  • Provide targeted coaching to agents on compliance requirements, documentation practices, corrective actions, and carrier expectations.
  • Identify recurring compliance issues and escalate trends to leadership to support broader coaching and training initiatives.
  • Assist agents and agencies with carrier compliance audits and provide guidance for navigating carrier portals and self-service resources.
  • Track coaching participation and completion metrics, identifying gaps that require additional follow-up.
  • Prepare compliance reporting covering case volumes, status, turnaround times, and other relevant performance indicators.
  • Partner with Compliance, Sales, Platform, Contracting, Finance, and other teams on process improvements, special projects, and new workflows.
  • Maintain flexibility as Medicare regulations and operational requirements evolve, adapting processes and support practices accordingly.

    • Requirements:

    • Experience working with tools such as Intercom, Excel, Airtable, CRM platforms, or case management systems; experience with these tools is valuable, with training available where needed.
    • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records, notes, evidence, and case information.
    • Basic analytical skills with the ability to review data, support quality assurance activities, identify discrepancies, and assist with case audits.
    • Ability to learn new technologies, systems, and compliance processes quickly.
    • Knowledge of Medicare or other health insurance products is advantageous, particularly experience working with Medicare compliance requirements.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain policies, requirements, and corrective actions clearly.
    • A solution-oriented approach and genuine interest in helping agents navigate compliance challenges effectively.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities simultaneously.
    • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across Compliance, Sales, Platform, and other internal teams.
    • Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced environment where regulations, priorities, and processes may change.
    • High ethical standards, integrity, discretion, and respect for confidential information.
    • Experience coaching colleagues, supporting team development, or providing guidance on policies and procedures is a plus.
    • Ability to work remotely from an approved location within the United States and maintain employment eligibility in the U.S.

      • Benefits:

      • Base salary: $60,000–$70,000 USD annually.
      • Equity compensation opportunities.
      • Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, and vision.
      • 401(k) plan.
      • Flexible work location with coworking options available.
      • Paid time off and 11 paid holidays.
      • Monthly remote-work stipend to help cover home-office expenses.
      • Paid parental leave, including up to 14 weeks for birthing parents and 8 weeks for non-birth parents.
      • Two-week paid sabbatical after five years of employment.
      • Wellbeing benefits and perks through programs supporting mental health, primary care, lifestyle, and financial wellness.
      • Opportunity to work remotely within approved U.S. locations as part of a fast-growing, mission-driven healthcare technology environment.
      • Opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute to process improvements with meaningful impact on Medicare advisors and beneficiaries.

I GLS kommer du ind i en af Europas mest kendte virksomheder inden for pakkedistribution. Vi har succes og solid vækst, og vi oplever generelt en rivende udvikling i hele forretningen.



Vi søger lige nu kollegaer til vores natsorteringshold.



Arbejdstid

ca. 30 timer ugentligt, som ligger mandag til fredag i tidsrummet 22:00 - 05:30.

Opgaver på natholdet

•    Scanning af pakker

Erfaring med læsning og sorteringsarbejde

Du har gerne erfaring fra et lignende job, men det er ikke et krav. Du har en god fysik, da der forekommer flere løft i den daglige arbejdstid. Vi har hjælpemidler til de helt tunge løft.



Du taler og læser dansk eller engelsk på et godt niveau. Har du flair for IT samt erfaring eller interesse i at arbejde med scannere og lagersystemer, så er det også et plus.



Teamorienteret og omstillingsparat

Vi lægger vægt på, at du er en teamplayer, som ønsker at yde og bidrage til, at vi får løftet vores daglige opgaver og udfordringer i flok. Samtidig er du omstillingsparat, fleksibel, mødestabil og har en god ordenssans.



Vi tilbyder

En virksomhedskultur, der prioriterer et åbent arbejdsmiljø med plads til alle. Du vil være med til at definere en fælles ansvarsfølelse i en virksomhed med høje ambitioner. Du får samtidig glæde af vores aktive personaleforening, der indbyder til hyggelige stunder med kollegerne på tværs af landet - og som også favner både dig og din familie. 



Skal du med på holdet?

Send os dit CV og besvar ansøgningsspørgsmålene inden d. 9. september 2026.

Vi indkalder løbende egnede kandidater til samtale, så send os dit CV allerede i dag.



Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Lars Linnebjerg, Supervisor Night Shift.

Da Lars arbejder om natten, beder vi dig kun at ringe i tidsrummet 22:00 til 05:00 på 25240142. Du er også velkommen til at sende en mail på lars.linnebjerg@gls-denmark.com



Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Vi tænker i muligheder: Hos GLS baner innovative løsninger vejen for en gnidningsfri kundeoplevelse. Vi søger altid nye måder at være på forkant i det konkurrenceprægede og globale marked for pakkedistribution.



Forbinder globalt, påvirker lokalt: Når du bliver en del af GLS, tilslutter du dig en virksomhed, der forbinder verden. Men vi nøjes ikke med at skabe globale forbindelser - vi tager også ansvar lokalt og engagerer os i de samfund, hvor vi er til stede.

title: Tamil Voice Artist (Freelance) | AI Voice Recording Project
description:
About the Opportunity

Arctic Engines AI is building a high-quality voice dataset for an AI voice technology project and is hiring experienced Tamil voice artists for a paid, in-studio recording engagement.

Requirement: 10

Language: Tamil

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Attend a scheduled in-studio recording session (billed at ~2 hours of processed audio; plan for a longer studio slot to allow for test recordings and retakes)
  • Record a variety of scripted content — everyday conversational scripts, industry/professional-context scripts, and customer-support-style scripts involving numbers, codes, and dates
  • Deliver takes across specified emotional tones (cheerful, low, flat, excited) as directed
  • Take live direction from the recording engineer on pacing, pronunciation, mic technique, and retakes
  • Maintain consistent voice quality, energy, and studio discipline through the full session

Who We're Looking For

  • 1–2+ years of professional experience in voice-over, dubbing, radio jockeying, audiobook narration, or comparable voice work
  • A demo reel, voice sample, or portfolio that demonstrates range, clarity, and control
  • Native or near-native Tamil fluency with clear, broadly neutral pronunciation
  • Proven ability to sustain vocal quality and focus across a 2+ hour recording session
  • Comfortable taking direction and shifting delivery across multiple emotional registers on cue
  • Prior studio/professional recording experience — comfortable with mic distance, positioning, and repeated retakes without fatigue affecting quality
  • Reliable and punctual, able to commit to a scheduled in-studio slot in Bengaluru
  • Willing to sign a confidentiality/NDA agreement, as this project involves proprietary AI training data

Nice to Have

  • Experience recording alphanumeric or technical scripts (IVR, e-learning, customer support VO)
  • Comfort with multiple dialects or accent ranges within Tamil
  • Own basic recording setup (useful if a remote audition sample is requested before the studio session)

Engagement & Compensation

  • Freelance, per-project engagement — one studio recording session
  • Fixed one-time payment of up to 8,000, processed ~30 days after recording approval₹
  • No ongoing commitment beyond the single session unless mutually agreed

How to Apply

  • Submit your resume along with a demo reel, voice sample, or links to previous voice work.

Job Description:

The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is seeking a Program Manager to support transformer programs for strategic utility customers across North America. In this highly visible role, you will collaborate across manufacturing sites, global functions, and customer-facing teams to help deliver critical power infrastructure solutions. You will connect customer priorities with internal execution, promote clear communication, and help ensure commitments are met with quality, reliability, and consistency. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to grid reliability, resilience, and modernization while building your career with a global technology leader.

Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, aligning teams, and helping complex programs move forward. You will build trusted relationships with strategic customers and internal stakeholders while supporting work that is essential to a more sustainable, reliable, and efficient energy future.

How you'll make an impact

  • Support programs for strategic utility customers across a global manufacturing network.

  • Develop strong working relationships with customers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.

  • Help manage program schedules, budgets, resources, and deliverables in support of customer commitments and business objectives.

  • Coordinate with manufacturing, engineering, commercial, supply chain, and external partners to support aligned and timely program delivery.

  • Provide clear status updates, track progress, and maintain visibility for internal teams and customers.

  • Identify risks, opportunities, and potential roadblocks, and work with teams to develop practical mitigation plans.

  • Support issue resolution and help maintain effective coordination from order entry through manufacturing, delivery, and closeout.

  • Apply contract, claim, and change management practices to support customer commitments and business goals.

Your background

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience will also be considered.

  • Minimum 5 years of project management or program management experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading teams and fostering a collaborative, high-performing environment.

  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-changing environment.

  • Experience with project management and business tools such as SAP, Microsoft Project, and Excel.

  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada without the need for employer sponsorship.

More about us

  • Join a global technology leader advancing sustainable energy solutions and innovative transformer technologies.

  • Grow your career through continuous learning, international collaboration, and leadership development opportunities.

  • Be part of an inclusive, values-driven culture that prioritizes safety, integrity, innovation, and long-term success.

Background Screening and Security Checks
As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.

The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

title: Family Peer Worker
description:
• Be part of the reformed Mental Health and Wellbeing system in Victoria

  • Ongoing, Part-Time (30.4hr pw) opportunity based in Traralgon VIC

  • SCHADS Level 3B ($40.49 ph) + Super + Salary packaging

Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with a lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify as LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Program

A key recommendation from the Royal Commission emphasised the crucial role of families and carers in not only caring for their loved ones, but also in the overall functioning and sustainability of the mental health system.

The Mental Health and Wellbeing Connect Centres (MHWBC Centres) will form a vital component of the integrated services provided in the reformed Mental Health and Wellbeing system in Victoria.

Services will be provided primarily by a team of individuals with personal experience as carers, and will offer support to families, carers, kin, and supporters of individuals facing mental health challenges, psychological distress, mental illness, or substance use concerns.

About the role

This is an opportunity for you to join a purpose and values driven team and play a vital role in ensuring that consumers, carers and their families receive valuable and supportive care.

As our new Family Peer Worker, you will be able to draw on your real-life experience to partner with families, friends and carers, get to know their experiences and, as appropriate, offer 1:1 support around key areas of challenge. As part of this, you will support our participants through the development of tailored action plans to incorporate their own aspirations, addresses their unique support needs and contributes to their overall health and wellbeing.

You will also facilitate network meetings and delivering group intervention training and courses to strengthen carers’ ability to sustain their caring role. This is a role that will provide you with a high level of flexibility in terms of your scheduled working hours and can also convert to being a full-time role if that is your preference.

To be successful in this role

  • Personal lived experience of caring for someone with mental health challenges or psychosocial distress and recovery

  • Certificate IV/Diploma in Mental Health, AOD or tertiary qualification in social science or 1+ year relevant work experience in mental health sector or intentional Peer Support Training

  • Demonstrated knowledge of family and caring roles and the impact on carers’ health and wellbeing to determine support requirements

  • Demonstrated skill in establishing empowering and supportive partnerships with individuals, families and carers

You will also need:

  • Current valid Driver’s License and the ability to undertake travel for the role

  • Current Working with Children Check and NDIS Workers Screening Check

  • Right to Work within Australia

  • Satisfactory National Police Records Check

  • NDIS Worker Orientation Module Certificate

What we offer

  • A purpose driven culture where people can thrive, everyone is respected, and differences are valued

  • An equitable, diverse, and socially inclusive work environment

  • Salary packaging up to $15,899 enables you to spend a portion of your salary before it is taxed to pay for things like rent, mortgage repayments, car leasing

  • Meal and Entertainment allowance via salary packaging up to $2,650 per annum

  • Paid parental leave after 12 months of ongoing employment

  • Access for you and your family to our Employee Assistance Program

For a confidential discussion about the role contact Brendan Beschle at bbeschle@wellways.org

Once you APPLY click here for a copy of the position description

We encourage early applications as interviews will begin prior to advertising closing date.

Wellways is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. Successful applicants must undergo a comprehensive screening process prior to their commencement.

If you’d like to know more about our reconciliation commitment, click here Reconciliation | Wellways

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential.   Position description  
	Job title
 
 Mindful Yoga & Pilates Instruktør - Gasværksvej 
 
	Become a part of the team behind the largest Fitness community in Denmark
 
 
	
  

 Vil du være rollemodel og inspirationskilde for vores medlemmer? Vi er på udkig efter dig, der er imødekommende, smilende og passioneret omkring instruktørrollen. Får du energi af at undervise andre og kan skabe en fed oplevelse for vores medlemmer? Lige nu søger vi en instruktør til vores center på Gasværksvej 16. 
 1 ud af 4 medlemmer hos os går på hold. Som holdinstruktør i PureGym er du således en vigtig del af vores vision, nemlig at give vores medlemmer en positiv oplevelse, samt inspirere og motivere dem til at leve et aktivt liv med sunde vaner.    

   

 Om stillingen og dig 
 Yoga og Pilates er hold der gennem smidighed, balance og kropsbevidsthed har fokus på den indre og den ydre balance. Du guider medlemmerne til at komme dybere ind i stillingerne for at styrke deres kernemuskulator samt øge bevægeligheden i alle led. Gennem en træning med fokus på vejrtrækning i et behageligt flow med få pauser, vil du hjælpe medlemmerne med udholdenhed og øge deres forbrænding. 
 Som Yoga og Pilates instruktør forventes det at du har indgående kendskab til   

 
 Yoga: Vinyasa, Hatha og Yin Yoga, da vi i PureGym underviser enten i Yang Yoga eller Yin Yoga. Vinyasa og Hatha Yoga er en del af vores Yang Yoga timer. Som Yoga instruktør kan du undervise i holdtyperne, Yin Yoga, Yang Yoga, Yin Yoga (Heat Wave) og Yang Yoga (Heat wave).  
  
 Pilates: Pilates og kan formidle din time med fokus på vejrtrækning, øget kropsbevidsthed og styrke.  
 Som Pilates instruktør kan du undervise i holdtyperne, Pilates og Pilates (Heat Wave).   

   

 Da vi på Gasværksvej har Heat Wave, ser vi gerne at du som instruktør kan undervise i både Yoga og Pilates i vores Heat Wave holdsal. 

   

 Hvis du blot ønsker at undervise i enten Yoga eller Pilates, send os gerne en ansøgning alligevel o så ser vi på det. 

  

 
 
	Your qualifications
 
 
	
  
 
 Du skal have gennemført en relevant uddannelse for at varetage rollen som instruktør.   

 Du formår at planlægge din undervisning og mestrer at sammensætte et motiverende program.  

 Du brænder for at undervise, motivere og videreformidle sunde vaner.  

 Du er en ægte performer, der nyder at stå i front og skabe et rum fyldt med energiske vibrationer, så du formår at tage vores medlemmer gennem en spændende og underholdende time - Hver gang!  
 
 Som instruktør i PureGym vil du have mulighed for personlig udvikling og efteruddannelse til gode personalepriser. Derudover står du selv for planlægning og gennemførelse af dine timer, og er dermed perfekt for dig, der trives med "frihed under ansvar".  

   

 Ansøgning og ansøgningsfrist 
 Har du lyst til at gå forrest og samtidig være med til at skabe sunde vaner for den danske befolkning? Så send os din ansøgning nu - og husk også at uploade et bevis på, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for denne type holdundervisning, da dette er et krav. Det vil desuden være en klar fordel, hvis du laver en kort præsentationsvideo, hvori du viser hvilken inspirerende performer, du er. 
 Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag eller snarest muligt.  
 Har du nogle spørgsmål er du velkommen til at komme forbi centret og møde os og høre mere.   

   

 Bliv en del af PureGym - Bliv en del af noget større 
 Som medarbejder i PureGym bliver du en del af Danmarks største fitnesskæde med over 130 centre fordelt i hele landet. PureGym DK er en del af en af Europas største fitnesskæder, med hovedkontor i London, UK, med centre i Danmark, England, Schweiz, UAE og New York, US.  
 Vores mission er at inspirere til et sundere liv med ’Fitness for alle’ som omdrejningspunkt. Vi ser os selv som mere end bare en fitnesskæde. Vi hjælper vores medlemmer med at passe på deres fysiske og mentale sundhed i de bedste rammer med professionel support fra vores passionerede medarbejdere. 
   
 Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning!  
   
 Er vi endt i spam? 
 Du vil altid modtage en bekræftelsesmail, når du har sendt din ansøgning. Hvis ikke du modtager denne, så tjek dit spamfilter og sørg for at fjerne os derfra, så fremtidig kommunikation lander i din almindelige indbakke.

title: Bank Relations & Institutional Funding (VP/SVP)
description:
Moladin is seeking an execution-driven SVP/VP of Bank Relations & Institutional Funding to lead and scale our capital strategy, banking partnerships, and debt facility pipeline across our automotive fintech and multi-finance platform.

This role combines strategic debt capital sourcing with direct operational involvement in bank relationship management, facility structuring, treasury optimization, and regulatory alignment. The position serves as the primary executive liaison for 3rd-party commercial banks, institutional lenders, multi-finance partners, and external auditors to ensure seamless capital allocation and liquidity for Moladin's lending operations.

Responsibilities
  • Act as the primary executive lead in establishing, negotiating, and maintaining strong strategic relationships with 3rd-party commercial banks, multi-finance partners, and institutional debt lenders in Indonesia.
  • Directly manage the end-to-end negotiation, structuring, drawdown, and covenant monitoring for debt facilities, joint-financing (pembiayaan bersama) arrangements, and warehouse lending lines.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all banking-related, statutory, interim, and specialized external audits, coordinating directly with Big 4 or major accounting firms to ensure audit readiness and swift resolution of findings.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in directly negotiating, managing, and maintaining credit facilities, debt structures, or joint-financing partnerships with 3rd-party commercial banks and institutional lenders in Indonesia.
  • Experience in Financial Governance and OJK regulatory frameworks is a plus.
