title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description:
At Reltio®, an SAP Company, we believe data should fuel business success. Reltio’s AI-powered data unification and management capabilities—encompassing entity resolution, multi-domain master data management (MDM), and data products—transform siloed data from disparate sources into unified, trusted, and interoperable data. Reltio Data Cloud™ delivers interoperable data where and when it's needed, empowering data and analytics leaders with unparalleled business responsiveness. Leading enterprise brands—across multiple industries around the globe—rely on our award-winning data unification and cloud-native MDM capabilities to improve efficiency, manage risk and drive growth.

At Reltio, our values guide everything we do. With an unyielding commitment to prioritizing our “Customer First”, we strive to ensure their success. We embrace our differences and are “Better Together” as One Reltio. We are always looking to “Simplify and Share” our knowledge when we collaborate to remove obstacles for each other. We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and outcomes and strive for excellence. We “Own It”. Every day, we innovate and evolve, so that today is “Always Better Than Yesterday”. If you share and embody these values, we invite you to join our team at Reltio and contribute to our mission of excellence.

Reltio has earned numerous awards and top rankings for our technology, our culture and our people. Reltio was founded on a distributed workforce and offers flexible work arrangements to help our people manage their personal and professional lives. If you’re ready to work on unrivaled technology where your desire to be part of a collaborative team is met with a laser-focused mission to enable digital transformation with connected data, let’s talk!

Job Summary:

Staff Forward Deployed Engineers at Reltio are elite builders who operate with the autonomy of a technical founder and the rigor of a staff engineer. You will work in small teams, own high-stakes projects end-to-end, and embed directly with strategic customers, from initial discovery to production rollout, to transform Reltio's platform from a system of record into a system of intelligence. You'll write production code, design and ship agentic workflows, and bring field insights back to shape Reltio's product roadmap. If you thrive on undefined problems, move fast, and want your work to directly drive enterprise outcomes, this role was built for you.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

End-to-End Customer Delivery & Ownership

  • Own the full delivery cycle: discovery, technical scoping, agent design, implementation, rollout support, and enablement of customer and customer engineering team for long-term support.
  • Collaborate with customers and business stakeholders to translate real-world problems into concrete technical solutions.
  • Define success metrics tied to adoption, performance, and business outcomes, and measure against them.

Agent Architecture, Build, & Production

  • Design and implement robust agentic workflows using Reltio’s Agent Flow platform that integrate with core systems and event sources.
  • Orchestrate multi-stage behaviors (e.g., context-aware workflows, human-in-the-loop interactions).
  • Build production-grade components with comprehensive observability, graceful error handling, fallback strategies, cost governance, and security controls suitable for regulated industries.

Evaluation, Observability & Quality

  • Leverage automated evaluation frameworks and monitoring dashboards to measure agent accuracy, reliability, throughput, false positives/negatives, and business KPIs.
  • Implement observability, tracing, and logging to analyze decisions and tool invocations for debugging and governance.
  • Develop regression tests, evaluation datasets, and safety guardrails that reduce risk and improve system maturity.

Reusable Assets & Knowledge Sharing

  • Encode successful patterns into templates, connectors, reference implementations, and architecture blueprints for internal reuse.
  • Publish reusable “agent skills,” integrations (CRM, ERP, external data sources), and accelerators that reduce delivery time across customers.
  • Contribute to internal tooling, playbooks, and best-practice documentation and framework.

Strategic Field Feedback

  • Synthesize customer learnings, emerging field signals, and competitive intelligence into structured, prioritized feedback that directly shapes Reltio’s product roadmap and platform strategy.
  • Advocate for roadmap priorities that improve agent usability, integration breadth, and operational scalability.
  • Partner with Product to define and POC feature requirements, acceptance criteria, and success outcomes for agentic solutions and other products in the Agent Flow Suite.

Trusted Advisor & Domain Expertise

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to enterprise technical and business leaders on data strategy, automation opportunities, and governance.
  • Apply deep mastery of data semantics, entity resolution logic, workflow optimization, and decision-centric system design.
  • Demonstrates thorough knowledge of MDM design patterns.
  • Demonstrates command of the Reltio platform and its overall capabilities.
  • Navigate complex enterprise constraints (security, compliance, access governance, multi-cloud architecture) while enabling pragmatic, scalable solutions.

Other Forward Deployed Engineering duties and Agent Flow adoption initiatives as assigned.

Skills You Must Have:

  • 6+ years building and shipping production technology in customer-facing roles (solutions engineering, consulting, applied engineering).
  • Strong programming and system design skills in Python and/or TypeScript/Java, with experience building APIs, microservices & integrations.
  • Demonstrated experience deploying and operationalizing LLM- or agentic systems (prompting, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails).
  • Experience with telemetry/observability tooling, logging, and production monitoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including agent guardrails, bias evaluation, and enterprise data governance (GDPR, HIPAA).
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containerization, and distributed services.
  • Deep understanding of data management, enterprise integrations, workflow orchestration, business rules, and real-time processing.
  • Experience with SaaS platforms, CRM/ERP integrations (Salesforce, Veeva, NetSuite, SAP), and data signals triggering automated actions.
  • Excellent communication and co-creation skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive consensus, influence cross-functional teams, and deliver measurable outcomes under ambiguity and change.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-change enterprise engagements with senior customer leadership.
  • Ability to travel to customer sites periodically (estimated 20-30%), with flexibility based on engagement needs.

Skills That Are Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in enterprise AI adoption, agent/AI workflow productization, or implementation of generative AI solutions.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience with business development support, governance frameworks, or industry compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).

Reltio is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Reltio is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities.

title: Staff Engineer - Recommendations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer - Recommendations based in India.

This role focuses on building the data and machine learning foundations that power personalized discovery and social experiences at scale.
You will help evolve recommendation systems that connect users with relevant content, communities, groups, and events.
Working across data engineering, backend development, and personalization, you will design systems capable of processing large volumes of platform-generated data.
You will collaborate closely with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to turn behavioral signals into meaningful user experiences.
The role offers significant technical scope across cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, APIs, distributed systems, and ML-enabled applications.
You will also help advance personalization from simple heuristics toward increasingly sophisticated, data-driven recommendations.
This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a highly interactive consumer platform within a distributed, collaborative engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines, backend services, and APIs supporting recommendations, content discovery, groups, events, and other data-driven experiences.
  • Build data models and schemas that support both analytical workloads and real-time personalization and recommendation systems.
  • Partner with data scientists, product managers, and engineering teams to ensure relevant user and platform data is accurately captured, processed, and made available for product experiences.
  • Develop and maintain large-scale data processing workflows using technologies such as Spark and Kafka.
  • Help evolve recommendation capabilities from basic heuristics toward more sophisticated, data-backed personalization models.
  • Contribute to backend architecture and implementation, including REST and WebSocket APIs, caching systems, queueing infrastructure, and cloud orchestration.
  • Process and transform high-volume platform data into reliable datasets and signals that can support machine learning and personalization use cases.
  • Optimize data storage, processing, and database performance for both analytical workloads and high-throughput real-time applications.
  • Collaborate across a full-stack engineering environment to deliver reliable, scalable features from data layer through user-facing experiences.
  • Contribute to technical strategy and the evolution of engineering and product capabilities as recommendation and personalization needs grow.
  • Monitor production systems and participate in incident response, including occasionally supporting urgent troubleshooting during outages.
  • Promote strong engineering practices around scalability, reliability, maintainability, observability, and data quality.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on data engineering, backend systems, or scalable SaaS and online platforms.
    • Proven experience designing, building, and optimizing production-grade ETL/ELT data pipelines.
    • Strong SQL skills, including database optimization for analytical workloads and high-throughput real-time access.
    • Hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or Beam.
    • Experience working with cloud platforms at scale, particularly AWS or Google Cloud.
    • Programming experience across technologies such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, MongoDB, and Redis, with the ability to work effectively across multiple languages and systems.
    • Experience with Elasticsearch, data warehousing, and machine learning systems.
    • Strong understanding of scalable backend architecture, distributed data processing, APIs, caching, queues, and cloud infrastructure.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong communication skills and an agile, collaborative mindset suited to a distributed engineering environment.
    • Bonus experience with content discovery, recommendation engines, personalization, social graphs, online communities, or user-generated content.
    • Experience building consumer products, e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, or social products is highly valued.
    • Interest or experience in virtual reality, online communities, or creator-driven platforms is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • 100% remote work with flexible working hours and designated core collaboration hours.
      • Health benefits.
      • 401(k) plan for eligible U.S. employees.
      • Stock options.
      • Generous paid holiday schedule.
      • Unlimited and flexible vacation time.
      • Paid parental leave.
      • Opportunity to work on large-scale recommendation, data, and personalization systems.
      • Collaborative and distributed environment where engineers can contribute to projects and influence technical direction.

title: Assistant to the Head of Gaza Sub Office
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP is the leading United Nations organization fighting to end the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change. Working with our broad network of experts and partners in 170 countries, we help nations to build integrated, lasting solutions for people and planet.

UNDP’s Programme of Assistance to the Palestinian People (PAPP) derives its mandate from United Nations General Assembly Resolution 33/147 of 20 December 1978. Called upon by United Nations Member States in that year, UNDP was requested “to improve the economic and social conditions of the Palestinian people by identifying their social and economic needs and by establishing concrete projects to that end”.

UNDP’s Palestinian Programmatic Framework (PPF) 2023-2027 sets out a vision of “a world in which all Palestinians can enjoy a dignified life and fulfil their own vision of a unified, peaceful and free society”. The PPF is centered around the concept of “Transformative Resilience” and its three elements: a cohesive Palestinian identity, self-reliance, and ownership and leadership.

Over the next three years, UNDP/PAPP will build on its experiences and achievements to make critical contributions to the priorities defined by the Palestinian national development plans and the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF), through interventions in three programmatic priority areas: i) democratic governance and quality services; ii) inclusive economic opportunities; iii) sustainable natural resources management.

Against the backdrop of the ongoing war and humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip, UNDP/PAPP has developed an integrated emergency response and early recovery program to address the urgent and life-saving needs of the Palestinian people. Since October 2023, UNDP/PAPP has been working closely with UN agencies to ensure the continuity of critical services and humanitarian operations. A key enabling element of this response is the efficient management of Administrative and Facilities Assistant within the UNDP Building, which is essential to sustaining the operational functionality of UNDP and the other UN agencies sharing the Facilities.

Under the direct supervision of the Head of the Gaza Sub-Office, and in close coordination with the Head of Programme, the Executive Assistant provides high-quality executive, administrative and coordination support to ensure the effective functioning of the Office of the Head of the Gaza Sub-Office and the Programme function.

The incumbent facilitates the timely flow of information, coordinates meetings, missions and official engagements, maintains confidential records and correspondence, and monitors follow-up on decisions, deadlines and management action points. The incumbent exercises discretion, sound judgement and the highest level of confidentiality in performing the assigned functions.

Duties and Responsibilities

1)Executive and administrative support
  • Manage the calendar, appointments and official engagements of the Head of the Gaza Sub-Office and
    coordinate scheduling requirements with the Head of Programme.
  • Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and background materials, and ensure that relevant documentation is available in advance.
  • Draft routine correspondence, meeting records, minutes and administrative notes, and support the
    preparation and formatting of briefing materials.
  • Coordinate official missions, representation activities and meeting schedules, including logistical and
    administrative arrangements.
  • Provide informal interpretation and translation, as required.
  • Apply established protocol requirements for official meetings, visits and high-level engagements.

2)Coordination, information flow and management follow-up

  • Facilitate the timely flow of information between the Head of Office, the Programme and Operations teams,
    UNDP/PAPP senior management and relevant external counterparts.
  • Monitor weekly decisions, deadlines, commitments and action points issued by the Head of Office and the
    Head of Programme.
  • Maintain weekly HOGSO action trackers and follow up with responsible colleagues and units on the timely
    completion of agreed actions.
  • Compile inputs and prepare periodic status updates, briefing notes and management summaries for review
    by the Head of Office.
  • Support in identifying administrative or communication bottlenecks and propose practical measures to
    improve coordination and workflow efficiency.

3)Meetings, events and official visits

  • Coordinate senior management meetings, official visits, workshops and events organized by the Gaza Sub-
    Office.
  • Support the HOGSO and Head of Programme in Liaising with Programme, Operations, Security, Protocol,
    Communications and other relevant teams on logistical, administrative and protocol arrangements.
  • Coordinate invitations, participant lists, meeting documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Monitor event preparations and provide regular progress updates to the manager responsible or task team.

4)Records, correspondence and contact management

  • Maintain secure and organized electronic and physical filing systems, ensuring the safekeeping of confidential information.
  • Review, register and route incoming correspondence and ensure appropriate and timely follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate and updated contact lists and databases of government, UN, donor, civil society and other relevant counterparts.
  • Support the effective use of digital office-management, scheduling, document-management and collaboration tools.

Institutional Arrangement Assistant

Under the Guidance of the Special Representative of the Administrator and the direct supervision of the Head of the Gaza Sub-Office with secondary reporting to the Head of Program, the Assistant to the Head of Sub Office provides administrative, coordination, and operational support to ensure the efficient functioning of the head of Gaza office. The incumbent facilitates effective communication and information flow, coordinates reporting requirements, and monitor the timely follow-up of key actions and management decisions.

Core Competencies

Achieve Results:
LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

Think Innovatively:
LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

Learn Continuously:
LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

Adapt with Agility:
LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

Act with Determination:
LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident

Engage and Partner:

title: Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate based in Switzerland.

This is an opportunity to lead engaging, high-impact virtual learning experiences for diverse audiences developing skills in machine learning and AI data workflows. You will deliver live technical instruction in German while collaborating professionally in English with program and operations teams. The role combines technical expertise, instructional leadership, and the ability to make complex AI concepts practical and accessible. You will help learners understand how data labeling influences machine learning systems, generative AI, multimodal models, and applied AI workflows. Sessions may range from smaller groups to audiences of thousands of learners in a highly interactive online environment. You will also contribute to curriculum refinement and continuous course improvement. This is a part-time contract position with a remote setup and scheduled sessions aligned with the EST/CEST time zones.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and facilitate live virtual classes for diverse learner groups, potentially ranging from 100 to more than 8,000 participants, while maintaining strong engagement and an effective learning environment.
  • Deliver technical instruction in German on machine learning data workflows, generative AI, foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG, multimodal AI, responsible AI, and related concepts.
  • Explain how data collection, annotation, labeling decisions, model training, evaluation, and deployment are connected, helping learners understand the downstream impact of their work.
  • Manage virtual classroom dynamics, including Q&A, chat activity, pacing, learner engagement, and timely delivery of planned content.
  • Adapt instructional approaches, explanations, and lesson pacing to accommodate learners with different backgrounds and levels of technical understanding.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each lecture and ensure that technical content is delivered accurately, clearly, and in an accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with program and operations teams in English to support smooth delivery, communicate updates, escalate issues, and maintain alignment on schedules and learner needs.
  • Contribute to curriculum design and continuous improvement, including suggesting edits, refining lessons, and supporting the development of hands-on learning activities.
  • Provide constructive feedback before and after sessions to strengthen course quality and learner outcomes.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful, responsive, and empathetic presence when interacting with learners, colleagues, contractors, and guest speakers.

    • Requirements:

    • Fluency in German sufficient to deliver all instruction and learner support professionally, combined with strong English proficiency for written communication, meetings, alignment, and issue escalation.
    • Strong practical understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data collection, model training, evaluation, and deployment, with the ability to explain how labeling decisions affect model behavior and downstream outputs.
    • Solid knowledge of generative AI and foundation models, including concepts such as pre-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and human feedback for model alignment.
    • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot prompting, and the ability to teach learners how to interpret requirements, identify task constraints, and evaluate output quality.
    • Working knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and production AI workflows, including the ability to explain how to assess outputs for relevance, faithfulness, and groundedness.
    • Understanding of multimodal and cross-modal AI, including how models process and generate text, images, audio, and video, and how these capabilities influence annotation and evaluation tasks.
    • Knowledge of responsible AI, privacy, confidentiality, security, bias awareness, and transparency principles relevant to data labeling and AI workflows.
    • Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality live virtual instruction, ideally to large and diverse audiences.
    • Experience supporting technical curriculum development, lesson refinement, skills labs, or similar instructional content.
    • Strong communication, presentation, empathy, adaptability, and classroom-management skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts easy to understand.
    • A positive and collaborative mindset, with strong attention to preparation, professionalism, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
    • Preferred: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) certification or equivalent expertise, particularly experience aligning training content with certification domains and supporting exam readiness.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work: Work remotely from Romania or another location compatible with the required time zone.
      • Part-time contract: Flexible engagement structured around scheduled instructional sessions and program needs.
      • Virtual-first environment: Deliver impactful learning experiences entirely online using modern virtual classroom tools.
      • High-impact teaching: Reach diverse learner populations and contribute to workforce development in AI and data.
      • Professional collaboration: Work alongside program, operations, and instructional teams in an international environment.
      • Curriculum involvement: Contribute ideas and expertise to the development and continuous improvement of technical training content.
      • Potential schedule flexibility: Program dates and lecture times may be adjusted depending on program requirements and instructor availability.
      • Inclusive environment: Participate in a learning culture focused on respect, accessibility, diversity, and equal opportunity.

title: Unit Coordinator
company: San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living
description:
Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long-term skilled nursing, short-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.

Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.

WHY WORK WITH US

  • Mission-driven nonprofit organization
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
  • Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day
  • Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)
  • Supportive, team-oriented environment
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Collaborative leadership focused on enhancing the employee experience

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Unit Coordinator, you will work closely with the Unit Manager, Social Services, and the interdisciplinary team to support the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the unit. You will play a key role in coordinating communication, managing scheduling and documentation, and ensuring smooth workflows across the care team. This role is essential in supporting resident care by maintaining organized systems, assisting with admissions and appointments, and serving as a central point of contact for staff, residents, and families.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinates staff scheduling for the unit and prepares bi-weekly payroll accurately, in a timely manner
  • Functions as a receptionist for the unit taking messages and returning calls for Unit Manager, Social Worker, and Nursing staff; frequently checks and promptly responds to all emails
  • Transcribes Physicians’ orders; manages pharmacy refills; ensures all nursing forms are current and available
  • Responsible for filing, copying, and scanning/faxing documents; distributes mail and orders supplies for the unit
  • Creates and maintains various resident files such as disaster, personal effects, mortuary designation, annual universal lifeline forms, as well as summarizing monthly behavior monitoring log
  • Coordinates and completes all non- employee sitter files; partners with Human Resources to ensure background checks are completed, and works with families to complete required duties check off the list
  • Greets, welcomes, and interfaces with all visitors, families, residents, patients, and staff
  • Works closely with families and unit staff to coordinate internal/external resident appointments; prepares for and assists with new admissions; answers call lights and, participates in all quality improvement activities
  • Responsible for contacting families and communicating the following; appointments, bed hold notifications, information requests, and miscellaneous information on behalf of the Unit Manager, Social Worker, and IDT
  • Monitors residents checking in to and out of the unit
  • Completes online or routine catalog shopping for resident needs as directed by Social Worker and Unit Manager
  • Perform other duties as assigned

JOB DETAILS

    • Pay Rate: $27.00 per hour
    • Hours: Full-Time 40 hours per week
    • Shift Schedule: AM | 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM
    • Days Off: Saturday and Sunday
    • Working Days: Monday through Friday

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • One year of experience in along term health care setting working directly with residents, families, and staff preferred
  • Experience in coordination of services in a health care setting, preferred
  • Cultural sensitivity of Jewish traditions and Russian Émigré issues
  • Strong English communication skills (written, verbal, and comprehension)
  • Strong interpersonal skills, proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential situations
  • Strong analytical, organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work cooperatively as a member of a team
  • Demonstrated strong computer skills including MS Office, Excel, Word, and electronic health records

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift, push, pull or carry a minimum of ten to fifteen (10 to 15) pounds.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time
  • Must be able to assist in the evacuation of residents during emergency
  • Ability to bend, stoop, stretch, twist, sit, and reach
  • Fine motor skills
  • Good visual acuity
  • Perform tasks listed above with or without the aid of mechanical devices

OUR INVESTMENT IN YOU

Full Benefits (Medical, Dental, & Vision), 403(b) Retirement Plan, Paid Time Off (PTO), Tuition Reimbursement, Commuter Benefits, Weekday Shuttle Services to and from Glen Park Station.

San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living is committed to employing a diverse and inclusive workforce, and provide Equal Employment Opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Private Sector Development and Investment Specialist (International Position)
description:
Background

The Government of Pakistan (GoP) has established a dedicated Governance Reforms Unit (GRU) in the Prime Minister’s Office to enhance integrated strategy, policy, and delivery support to the Government of Pakistan and senior leadership. The GRU is modelled on the best international practices, where such units have proven effective in providing evidence-based insights, rapid analytics, and focused implementation tracking at the highest levels of government.

The GRU will function as a rapid-response analytic task force for the Government of Pakistan, providing decision-ready inputs on priority economic sectors and policy questions. It will carry out rigorous analysis to stress-test proposals submitted by line ministries, regulators, provincial governments, state-owned enterprises, and development partners, and will support sectoral oversight across Pakistan's key economic priorities, including tourism, climate change, energy, agriculture, commerce, finance, and other areas identified by the Government of Pakistan.

Technical experts and Analytics Specialists embedded within the GRU will work under the direction of the Head-GRU to analyse critical issues across economic sectors, develop evidence-based assessments, collect inputs from relevant government agencies, and prepare comparative analyses in situations involving conflicting stakeholder positions. They will assist in the examination of policy and implementation options, including the assessment of respective advantages and disadvantages, with clear articulation of economic implications, implementation risks, and other relevant considerations.

Activity Context

Pakistan's economic transformation and industrial competitiveness depend upon the availability of a skilled workforce that can respond to the evolving needs of industry. While significant investments have been made in technical and vocational education and training (TVET), challenges remain in aligning skills development with labour market demand, emerging industries, technological change, and future workforce requirements.

To support sustained industrial growth, Pakistan requires a skills development system that is demand-driven, flexible, and continuously adapts to changing economic conditions. This requires stronger partnerships between government, industry, employers, and training providers, together with institutional arrangements that enable regular assessment of labour market needs, curriculum updates, quality assurance, and workforce planning.

The Government of Pakistan, through the Governance Reforms Unit (GRU), seeks international expertise to identify practical reforms that will strengthen Pakistan's technical and vocational training system and establish an institutional ecosystem capable of supporting long-term industrial development and economic competitiveness.

The assignment will focus on:

  • Aligning technical and vocational training with the current and future needs of Pakistan's industrial economy.

  • Identifying approaches for developing a market-responsive skills development system that continuously adapts to changing labour market demands.

  • Recommending institutional arrangements that strengthen collaboration between government, industry, employers, and training providers to deliver sustainable workforce development.

The consultant will draw upon international experience and good practices to provide practical, evidence-based recommendations that can support policy reform and implementation in Pakistan.

Job Summary

The Technical and Vocational Skills Development & Industry Competitiveness Specialist will provide strategic advisory support to the Governance Reforms Unit (GRU) on developing a market-responsive technical and vocational education and training (TVET) system that supports Pakistan's industrialisation agenda, enhances workforce competitiveness, and responds to evolving labour market demands. The consultant will provide international good practice and practical recommendations on strengthening institutional arrangements, industry engagement, governance, and skills development systems to improve alignment between training provision and the needs of the economy.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Technical and Vocational Skills Development & Industry Competitiveness Specialist will:

  1. Review Pakistan's TVET System

    • Assess the alignment of technical and vocational training with current and future industrial and labour market needs and assess the delivery arrangements currently in place including the regulatory mechanisms.

  2. Recommend Market-Responsive Reforms

    • Identify international best practices and recommend reforms to strengthen demand-driven, industry-led skills development.

  3. Strengthen the Skills Ecosystem

    • Recommend institutional arrangements to enhance collaboration among government, industry, training providers, and employers.

  4. Promote Industry Engagement

    • Identify approaches to strengthen employer participation in curriculum development, apprenticeships, workplace learning, and skills certification with specificity to match the context.

  5. Develop Strategic Recommendations

    • Prepare a concise plan of action outlining priority reforms, implementation actions, and institutional responsibilities to support a responsive and sustainable skills development system with outputs and outcomes over time.

Deliverables

The consultant shall deliver the following:

  1. Inception Note (2–3 pages)

  • Brief workplan, methodology, and key issues to be examined.

2. Plan of Action for a Market-Responsive TVET System
The Plan of Action shall include:

  • Priority policy and institutional reforms required to align technical and vocational training with the needs of an industrial economy.

  • Recommended actions to establish a market-responsive and continuously adapting skills development system.

  • Proposed institutional ecosystem, including the roles and coordination mechanisms of government, industry, employers, and training providers.

  • Prioritised implementation actions with indicative timelines, results, outputs and outcomes.

  • Estimated resource requirements and indicative implementation costs for key reform actions.

  • Identification of potential financing options, including public, private sector, and development partner support.

3. Reform Roadmap

  • A concise implementation roadmap identifying priority actions, responsible institutions, indicative timelines, key milestones, and expected outcomes.

4. Presentation

  • Preparation and delivery of a PowerPoint presentation summarising the key findings, Plan of Action, and recommendations for the Governance Reforms Unit (GRU) and NAVTEC and relevant government stakeholders.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Advanced degree in Economics, Economic Development, Public Policy, Business, Finance, Investment, International Development, or related discipline.

  • Minimum 18 years of international experience in private sector development, economic growth, investment promotion, market systems development, competitiveness, industrial development, or related fields.

  • Demonstrated experience advising governments and development partners on private sector reforms, investment promotion, and economic development.

  • Extensive experience working on programmes funded by FCDO, DFID, World Bank, EU, IFC, UNDP, ADB, or other international development partners.

  • Proven expertise in investment climate reforms, market systems development (M4P), value chain development, MSME growth, industrial policy, Special Economic Zones, and public-private partnerships.

  • Strong analytical, strategic advisory, stakeholder engagement, and report writing skills.

  • Experience working in South Asia, Africa, and emerging economies will be an advantage. This closely reflects Neil Spooner's experience leading PSD, investment, market systems, and industrial development programmes across multiple regions for DFID/FCDO, the EU, World Bank, UNDP, and other partners.

Reporting

The consultant will report to:

Head, Governance Reforms Unit (GRU), Government of Pakistan, with technical coordination through the REMIT Programme.

Duration and Level of Effort

  • Duration: 2 months

  • Level of Effort: 6 days

Submission for Applications

By Sunday, 23rd August 2026.

title: Solutions Architect Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect Lead based in Canada.

The Solutions Architect Lead will own complex client onboarding and integration initiatives for fraud, risk, and compliance technology.
This is a hands-on leadership role combining technical solution design, implementation management, and customer partnership.
You will lead an integration team while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into scalable solutions.
The role spans APIs, SDKs, documentation, implementation planning, technical troubleshooting, and project delivery.
You will manage timelines, risks, quality, and deliverables while ensuring customers achieve successful deployments.
The position also provides an opportunity to influence product development by bringing customer insights and technical feedback to internal teams.
Success requires strong technical depth, exceptional communication, and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving B2B SaaS environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and develop a high-performing integration team focused on successful client onboarding and scalable technical solutions.
  • Manage end-to-end client onboarding, providing technical guidance and support throughout implementation.
  • Analyze customer requirements from both technical and functional perspectives and design practical solutions aligned with platform capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain API specifications, SDK documentation, integration guides, technical resources, and support documentation.
  • Build a deep understanding of customers’ business challenges, technical environments, requirements, and success criteria.
  • Manage implementation projects from planning through deployment, ensuring quality, timelines, risk mitigation, and delivery milestones remain on track.
  • Coordinate with internal and external technical teams to resolve integration challenges and drive projects through completion.
  • Work directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders to explain complex concepts and establish clear implementation paths.
  • Use APIs, JSON payloads, SQL, scripting, and other technical tools to investigate issues and support integration requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and technical tooling.
  • Serve as a key customer advocate by providing product feedback and identifying recurring technical or functional needs for internal stakeholders.
  • Help establish scalable integration practices that improve onboarding efficiency and customer outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • 7+ years of hands-on experience in implementation management, integrations engineering, technical account management, solution architecture, systems analysis, or a comparable technical customer-facing role.
    • Experience working across multiple internal and external technical teams and managing complex implementation initiatives.
    • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within payments, fraud, risk, compliance, financial technology, or a closely related domain.
    • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, web technologies, and technical solution design.
    • Experience working with API specifications such as OpenAPI and analyzing JSON payloads.
    • Working knowledge of SQL querying and the ability to investigate technical issues using data.
    • Experience writing scripts or building internal tools using technologies such as Bash, Python, SQL, Ruby, Golang, or Postman.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and business concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Strong project management, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
    • Demonstrated ability to drive deliverables to completion while managing dependencies, risks, and changing priorities.
    • Strong customer orientation and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
    • Leadership experience and the ability to coach, develop, and motivate integration professionals.
    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly autonomous environment with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and a practical approach to designing scalable, customer-focused solutions.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation combining cash compensation and equity.
      • Estimated Canadian base salary of CA$185,000–CA$250,000, with additional equity and bonus opportunities.
      • Remote-first work culture with the flexibility to work from anywhere.
      • Flexible paid time off and a year-end break.
      • Health, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents in Canada.
      • RRSP matching of up to 4%.
      • MacBook Pro provided for work.
      • One-time home-office setup stipend for items such as a desk, chair, and monitor.
      • Monthly meal stipend.
      • Monthly social meet-up stipend.
      • Annual health and wellness stipend.
      • Annual learning and professional development stipend.
      • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team of experienced professionals.
      • Exposure to innovative fraud, risk, compliance, and financial technology solutions.
      • Opportunity to influence product development and build scalable integration practices.

Arctic Engines AI is building a high-quality voice dataset for an AI voice technology project and is hiring experienced Telugu voice artists for a paid, in-studio recording engagement.

Requirement: 10

Language: Telugu

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • 1–2+ years of professional experience in voice-over, dubbing, radio jockeying, audiobook narration, or comparable voice work

Engagement & Compensation

How to Apply

title: Solsikken/Tusindfryd i Egtved søger en pædagog
description:
Solsikken/Tusindfryd i Egtved søger en relations kompetent, motiveret og faglig stolt pædagog på 37 timer fra 1. oktober 2026.

Om jobbet
Vi søger en relations kompetent og faglig stolt pædagog, der kan indgå i et nærværende og trygt fællesskab med vores børn. Vi har fokus på, at alle børn er en del af fællesskabet og trives. Du skal være god til relations arbejde og skal kunne låne ud af dit nervesystem. Vi har brug for en pædagog, der tør sætte sig selv i spil sammen med børnene. Vores pædagogiske arbejde er kerneopgaven, hvori vi ikke er bange for at sætte ambitionerne højt. I dit pædagogiske arbejde skal du have øje for lege-læringsmiljøerne, så de løbende tilpasses børnegruppen og udviklingsmulighederne heri, så vores børn opnår flere erfaringer. Vi vil noget med vores pædagogiske arbejde og gerne sammen med dig.

Om os
Solsikken/Tusindfryd er en integreret institution på to matrikler. Solsikken rummer 3 vuggestuegrupper og 1-2 børnehavegrupper. I Tusindfryd er de store børnehavebørn

Den ledige stilling er i Solsikken i børnehaven.

Solsikken/Tusindfryd er en del af lokalsamfundet i Egtved med et tæt samarbejde med skole og Dagpleje. Vi har to matrikler med tilhørerende gode legepladser, hvor der er plads til leg og bevægelse.

Vi har alle deltaget i Vejle Kommunes udviklingsforløb med Tea Thyrre Sørensen, som fokuserer på neuropsykologiske perspektiver.

Vores daglige pædagogiske praksis tager afsæt i Den neuropsykologiske tilgang samt Vejle kommunes 8 kompetencemål fra ”Den gode overgang”. Vi arbejder ud fra et årshjul med planlagte forløb. Vi har stor fokus på legende læring og udvikler løbende på vores læringsmiljøer. Så har du lyst til at hjælpe med at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer for vores børn, og er du god til at tænke i nye muligheder, er dette job måske noget for dig.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en rolig hverdag i børnehøjde, hvor alle børn oplever at være en betydningsfuld del af et fællesskab. Vi øver sammen med børnene, så de oplever at få flere erfaringer, bliver selvhjulpne og er en aktiv del af hverdagens rutiner i børnehaven.

Vi tilbyder dig
Mulighed for:
  • at være en del af et team med faglig sparring.
  • for at deltage i opfølgningskursus for nye medarbejdere med Tea Thyrre Sørensen.
  • en personalegruppe, der ser muligheder i forandringer og udfordringer.
  • en personalegruppe, hvor humor, sjov og glæde sætter præg på hverdagen.
  • en ledelse, der motiverer og har fokus på faglig stolthed.
  • et fælles hus med en rød tråd fra vuggestue til storgruppe.

Se evt. vores film på vores hjemmeside
Link: Stillingsopslag - video - Solsikken - Tusindfryd

Ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er på 37 timer med start den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt herefter.
Når man bliver ansat i Solsikken/Tusindfryd, bliver man ansat til hele huset. Som ansat skal man kunne arbejde inden for institutionens åbningstid.

Oplysning om startløn
Ansættelse sker efter overenskomst for pædagoger ved daginstitutioner, skolefritidsordninger, klubber mv, §§4-9. Den forventede startløn på fuldtid og ekskl. pension er 32.343 kr. / ligger i intervallet 32.343 til 39.702 kr. afhængig af anciennitet. Det bemærkes, at endelig indplacering, herunder overenskomstgrundlag og lønniveau, fastsættes på baggrund af din uddannelse og kvalifikationer og den konkrete tilbudte stilling.

Ansøgningsfrist
27. august 2026

Har du lyst til at vide mere?
Mere information kan fås ved henvendelse til Lene Gade på tlf. 20 57 02 52. Der tilbydes gerne en rundvisning i huset.

Attester
Vi indhenter børneattest og offentlig straffeattest med samtykke.

Send din ansøgning
Vi foretrækker, at du søger stillingen online ved at bruge knappen ”Send ansøgning”. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV samt andre relevante bilag.
Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering.

Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe Uønsket post.

Vejle Kommune opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, etnisk baggrund, handicap m.v.

Overvejer du at flytte til Vejle? Så kan du få hjælp til bosætning. Se mere på www.vejle.dk/tilflytter.

title: Senior Lecturer (Education)
description:
• 2x Full time, fixed term until 2028

  • Play a pivotal role in designing a new flagship postgraduate program that prepares future Finance professionals for an AI-enabled world.

  • Base Salary Level B/C $132,533 - $187,198 p.a. + 17% superannuation

​

About the opportunity

The School of Finance within the University of Sydney Business School is home to a vibrant community of internationally engaged scholars committed to excellence in research, teaching, and industry impact. The School maintains strong relationships with leading practitioners, regulators, and organisations, while fostering innovative research across the full spectrum of finance. Joining the Discipline offers the opportunity to contribute to a collaborative academic environment that values intellectual curiosity, research excellence, high-quality education, and meaningful engagement with industry and the broader community.

These are exciting opportunities to play a key role in shaping a new future focused postgraduate program at the University of Sydney Business School. Working within the School of Finance, you will contribute specialist expertise to the design and enhancement of curriculum, digital learning experiences, and teaching resources for this innovative postgraduate program. Collaborating with academic colleagues, industry practitioners and key stakeholders, you will help shape a contemporary and industry relevant student learning experience at the intersection of finance and emerging technologies, while supporting the design and development of project-based curriculum initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop and enhance curriculum for the new digital postgraduate program

  • design engaging learning experiences and teaching resources

  • contribute specialist expertise to course and unit development activities

  • collaborate with academic colleagues to ensure high-quality teaching and learning outcomes

  • support project-based curriculum development and implementation initiatives.

About you

We are seeking a Lecturer/Senior Lecturer in Finance who has:

  • a PhD in Finance, Financial Economics, or a closely related discipline, with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, or computational methods applied to finance

  • demonstrated expertise in applying artificial intelligence and machine-learning methods to finance, financial markets, financial institutions, investment, risk management, financial analytics, or related areas

  • strong technical capability in relevant programming languages and analytical tools, such as Python, R, machine-learning frameworks, large language models, natural language processing, or related computational technologies

  • demonstrated knowledge of current and emerging developments in finance, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and their application within financial services and business

  • experience in curriculum design, development, and teaching within a tertiary education environment, preferably in finance, financial technology, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data analytics, or a related field

  • demonstrated ability to design and deliver rigorous, engaging, and industry-relevant learning experiences

  • a demonstrated commitment to excellence and innovation in teaching and learning, including the development of student-centred educational experiences that integrate financial theory, technical skills, and real-world applications

  • experience collaborating effectively with academic colleagues, industry partners, professional staff, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality educational outcomes

  • strong project management and organisational skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timelines

  • excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial and technical concepts to diverse audiences

  • demonstrated ability to contribute positively to an inclusive, collegial, collaborative, and high-performing academic community.

Senior Lecturer (Level C) who, in addition to the above, has demonstrated capacity to:

  • provide leadership in teaching, curriculum development, and educational innovation

  • lead curriculum design, renewal, and quality enhancement initiatives that improve student learning and graduate outcomes

  • contribute to academic administration, governance, and strategic initiatives at discipline, School, Faculty, or University level

  • mentor and support colleagues and students to achieve academic, professional, and career success

  • establish and maintain productive relationships with industry, academic, and professional partners that enhance teaching, learning, and student outcomes.


Work Rights

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Pre-employment checks

Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

      Hvem er du?
 
 
      Er du stolt af at arbejde, mens byen sover, og køre gaffeltruck gennem natten?? Så vil du passe godt ind hos os som truckfører til IKEAs varemodtagelse. Når IKEA hver dag slår dørene op, er vi afhængige af, at vores lager er blevet fyldt op, så vi kan stå klar til vores kunder. I denne stilling er det et krav, at du har truckcertifikat og erfaring med at køre rækketruck. 
 
 Derudover forventer vi, at du:
 •	Er i god fysisk form og kan håndtere tunge løft
 •	Trives med at arbejde aften og nat
 •	Er struktureret, har evnen til at have overblik og fokus på orden
 •	Kan tale engelsk og har lyst til kommunikere med mange kollegaer samt at arbejde i et team
 •	Dansk truckcertifikat er en fordel men ikke et krav.
 
 
      Dine ansvarsområder
 
 
      Som truckfører spiller du en vigtig rolle for IKEAs salgstal og kunder, da du er med til at sørge for, at kunderne aldrig går forgæves, når de skal købe møbler og tilbehør til hjemmet. Hverdagen er altid travl, da vi hver dag arbejder med en skarp deadline kl. 10, når varehuset åbner. 
 
 Dine opgaver bliver at:
 •	Samarbejde med kollegaer og sikre at varehusets hylder bliver fyldt
 •	Håndtere vareoptælling og opdatere vores IT systemer herefter
 •	Arbejde proaktivt for at vedligeholde sikkerhed og tryghed for kunder og kollegaer i dit arbejdsområde
 •	Rydde op og vedligeholde afdelingen og maskiner.
 
 
      Vores team i IKEA
 
 
      Hos os bliver du en del af et internationalt team af både fuldtids- og deltidsmedarbejdere, som alle arbejder mod det samme fælles mål. Vores logistikoperation om natten og de tidligere morgentimer sikrer en effektiv vareopfyldning i varehuset og yder god service over for kunderne, selvom vi ikke har direkte kundekontakt. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med andre afdelinger, og du får derfor erfaring i at samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker. Vi arbejder i et højt tempo, men har en rigtig godt sammenhold, hvor vi bakker hinanden op og løfter i flok. Der er derfor plads til at være lige præcis den, du er. Vi sørger for den rette oplæring, så du kan føle dig tryg og kompetent i jobbet. Hos IKEA har du uendelige muligheder for at udvikle dig.

Software Tester

Job Qualifications

We are seeking a Software Tester to support the KBR IT Software Development team. The qualified candidate will be a key contributor in development and testing of a web-based systems in support if multiple Business Units throughout KBR globally. The successful candidate should possess experience of testing web-based applications, as well as a demonstrated ability to create detailed test specifications and test plans. Candidate will develop functional tests cases and scenarios by working with the business stakeholders, developers and project manager.

Provides application software development services or technical support, typically for a defined project. Develops program logic for new applications, modify, and analyze existing application logic. Codes, tests, debugs, documents, implements, and maintains software applications. Under general supervision, and occasional direct supervision, performs assignments requiring experience and knowledge of standard concepts within their field. Displays core job competencies by analyzing possible solutions using standard procedures while developing advanced skills. Skills required for this job are typically acquired through the completion of an undergraduate degree and 5+ years of experience, or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree.

  • Create and maintain a set of test scripts to test functionality and performance of product components developed in-house
  • Define and report meaningful test metrics to support decision making by the project manager and product acceptance criteria.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, IT

  • Experience testing Web Interfaces and Data-Load Interfaces and Reports
  • Communication and technical writing skills necessary to produce formal test specifications and test plans

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Vil du som erhvervsmægler flytte markedsandele på Vestegnen med udgangspunkt fra vores Erhvervscenter i Taastrup?




























De sidste tre år har Erhvervscenteret i Taastrup været inde i en særlig positiv udvikling. Vi søger derfor en erfaren mægler til teamet - en mægler med en udtalt ambition om at øge vores markedsposition lokalt.  



Rammerne for fortsat succes er absolut til stede. Erhvervslivet stortrives i området, som er præget af mange virksomheder inden for industri, logistik og lager. Det er derfor med rette, at kommunen er at regne for Vestegnens erhvervscentrum.



Du bliver en del af et stærkt og velfungerende team, som består af vores erhvervschef Lotte Bach og en tilknyttet salgskoordinator. Teamet understøtter dig i relation til den faglige sparring på kunder og sager og letter de administrative opgaver, så du kan koncentrere dig mest muligt om det opsøgende salgsarbejde.



Din sult efter at skabe resultater og din lokalforankring er altafgørende

Helt grundlæggende besidder du sulten, modet og lysten til at blive en aktiv del af vores fælles succes. Din primære opgave er udføre indsatser der gør, at vi får ejendomme til salg eller udlejning (kommissionere) og at vi sælger, udlejer og vurderer erhvervsejendomme på Vestegnen.  Vi ser for os, at din hidtidige erhvervsmæssige baggrund og person er kendetegnet ved:



	
Erfaring fra et tilsvarende job i mæglerbranchen enten som erhvervsmægler eller anden relevant erhvervsmæssig B2B salgsbaggrund fra bank, realkreditinstitut eller salgs- og rådgivningsvirksomhed.

	
Et unikt B2B-netværk på Vestegnen samt lysten og evnerne til at opbygge langsigtede relationer til virksomheder og ejendomsinvestorer.

	
Dokumenterede salgsresultater, der med tydelighed viser, at du formår at skabe enestående resultater i et stærkt konkurrencepræget marked.

	
En stærk vindermentalitet, som betyder, at du går den berømte ekstra mil for at vinde og afslutte en sag.

	
Et stærkt værdigrundlag, der bygger på en høj grad af flid, ordentlighed samt et godt købmandskab.




Vi honorerer din erfaring og indsats

Foruden en attraktiv garanteret minimumsgage tilbyder vi en firmabetalt pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring. Du bliver en del af et højt fagligt miljø, hvor der løbende er sparring med dedikerede og dygtige kolleger i hele landet i vores 19 erhvervscentre. For den rigtige person er der gode karrieremæssige udviklingsmuligheder og der vil også være mulighed for at blive partner.



Fondsejet virksomhed

EDC Poul Erik Bech er for størstedelens vedkommende ejet af en almennyttig fond. Via overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter Poul Erik Bech Fonden primært foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Vores ønske er at være en aktiv bidragsyder til det lokalsamfund, som vi er en del af. Læs mere om fonden på www.poulerikbechfonden.dk



Din ansøgning

Din ansøgning og CV bedes sendt til os via linket 'Søg stillingen', som du finder her på siden. Din ansøgning vil naturligvis blive behandlet fortroligt. 



Har du spørgsmål, eller vil du høre mere om jobbet er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of HR Jens Hein, mobil 3048 0320 eller jnh@edc.dk eller Erhvervschef Lotte Bach, mobil 2122 8931.

Taastrup, Danmark

Jens Hein

5858 7788




30480320














 




























 




























 










































               

            







    













Om EDC Poul Erik Bech


Firmaet blev etableret i 1978, og er siden vokset til at blive Danmarks største og eneste landsdækkende ejendomsmæglervirksomhed. I dag består vi af flere end 77 boligbutikker og 19 erhvervscentre.


Vores mere end 600 dygtige medarbejdere gør hver dag en forskel - og yder en ekstra indsats for, at vores kunder får en god og ordentlig handel. 


EDC Poul Erik Bech er uafhængig af banker og realkreditinstitutter og er den eneste fondsejede mæglervirksomhed. Størstedelen af virksomheden er ejet af den almennyttige fond Poul Erik Bech Fonden. Gennem overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter fonden frivillige foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Hvis du vil læse mere om virksomheden, og hvordan vi er som arbejdsplads, så besøg os på vores karriereside, LinkedIn eller Facebook.

    Performance & Growth Specialist
    Bliv itm8 Marketings første dedikerede Performance & Growth-ressource, og hjælp os med at finde svarene på: hvad skal vi gøre mere af, mindre af - eller helt stoppe med?

      

      
    
  
    
    Ansøg om dette job

  









  



    
      

      
  

    
Din rolle

Vi leder efter en datadrevet marketingprofil, der kan hjælpe os med at forstå, hvad der virker, hvad der ikke virker, og hvor vi kan skabe større effekt af vores marketingindsats.

Vi arbejder med kampagner, content, websites, mails, sociale medier, marketing automation og leadgenerering i B2B-kontekst. Vi har masser af aktiviteter. Vi har masser af data. Men vi mangler én, der tager ejerskab for at forbinde de to.

Derfor søger vi nu en Performance & Growth Specialist, der kan analysere vores performance på tværs af digitale kanaler, kunderejser og indhold, og som samtidig har lyst til at omsætte indsigterne til konkrete forbedringer.

Med andre ord: Du skal ikke bare fortælle os, hvad der er sket. Du skal hjælpe os med at finde ud af, hvad vi skal gøre nu.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:


Analysere performance på mails, landing pages, kampagner, content og kunderejser



Identificere hvad der virker, hvad der bør optimeres, og hvad vi bør gøre mindre af eller stoppe med



Arbejde med tracking, dashboards og data fra blandt andet GA4, HubSpot, Semrush og andre relevante værktøjer



Kortlægge kunderejser, finde frafaldspunkter og komme med forslag til bedre konvertering



Analysere markedet og spotte muligheder, hvor vi kan være mere proaktive i vores marketingindsats


Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for vores HubSpot-ansvarlige, Nicklas Madsen. Han har ansvaret for platformen. Du får indsigten i dataene og ansvaret for at hjælpe os med at forstå og bruge dem aktivt i vores prioriteringer.



Vi søger en team8, der:


Har 2-4 års erfaring med digital marketing, performance, marketing analytics, growth eller lignende



Er stærk analytisk og nysgerrig på, hvorfor noget performer bedre end andet



Kan omsætte data og indsigter til klare anbefalinger og konkrete handlinger



Har lyst til både at analysere og eksekvere på de optimeringsopgaver, analyserne peger på



Trives med at arbejde på tværs af content, marketing automation, web og kampagner



Tør udfordre mavefornemmelser og hjælpe teamet med at prioritere ud fra data



Har erfaring med eller interesse for værktøjer som GA4, HubSpot, Semrush, Search Console, dashboards og tracking


Du behøver ikke være specialist i det hele fra dag ét. Det vigtigste er, at du har en stærk digital forståelse, en naturlig analytisk nysgerrighed og lyst til at tage ejerskab for en ny rolle, som skal være med til at løfte vores marketingindsats.



Det du får

Du får mulighed for at blive den første dedikerede Performance & Growth-ressource i itm8 Marketing. Det betyder, at du ikke overtager en fastlåst rolle. Du er med til at forme den.

Du får en central plads i Content & Activation-teamet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe content, kampagner og digitale aktiviteter, der skal flytte både markedet og forretningen. Du bliver den, der hjælper os med at se mønstrene på tværs og gøre vores indsatser skarpere.

Konkret får du:


En nyoprettet rolle med stor mulighed for at påvirke retningen



Et tæt samarbejde med specialister inden for content, HubSpot, SoMe, kampagner og brand



Mulighed for at arbejde med data på tværs af vores marketingindsatser



En rolle, hvor dine analyser bliver brugt til reelle beslutninger



Plads til både at være nørdet, nysgerrig og praktisk eksekverende


Kort sagt: Du får ansvar for at hjælpe os med at blive bedre til at vælge til, vælge fra og skrue op for det, der virker.



Skal du med på holdet?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Team Lead, Steffen Højfeldt Frandsen, på tlf. 28357571 eller på e-mail sthfr@itm8.com. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter desuden straffeattest forud for ansættelse. 



Om itm8

Vi er itm8 - vores kunders IT-mate.

Bag os står 1.600+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Vi har specialister inden for alt fra IT-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.

Det, der binder os sammen, er ikke kun teknologi. Det er PURPLE POWER - vores måde at arbejde på. Her hjælper vi hinanden først, fejrer det der virker, og skærer igennem bullshit. Vi tror på ambition frem for status quo - og på at forskellighed gør os stærkere.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være perfekt. Det handler om at tage ansvar, skabe værdi og udvikle sig - hver dag.

Lyder det som dig? Så søg - og bliv vores næste team'm8.

							Din ret til ferie, feriefridage og anden frihed					
	
	

		
Ferieloven er gældende for dig som elev på vores erhvervsuddannelse og giver dig ret til betalt ferie under uddannelsen. 


Du optjener løbende feriedage fra tidspunktet for din ansættelses begyndelse. Du optjener 2,08 betalt feriedag for hver måned, du er ansat (FL §5)


Feriedagene optjenes i perioden 1.septmeber - 31. august det følgende år, også kaldet optjeningsåret.


Du skal holde din ferie indenfor en bestemt periode, som kaldes ferieafholdelsesperioden. Perioden går fra den 1. september til den 31. december året efter, dvs. 16 måneder i alt.


Som elev kan du ikke afholde ferie mens du er på skole.


Men uanset hvor mange feriedage, du har optjent, så kan du have ret til et vis antal feriedage fra starten, fordi du får tildelt nogle feriedage afhængig af, hvornår du bliver ansat i ferieafholdelsesperioden. Hvis du er nyligt ansat elev kan du med fordel læse om særreglerne vedrørende ferietildeling her 


Obs! Dit ferieregnskab skal fremgå på din lønseddel jf. overenskomsten §5 stk 4


Ferietillæg


Elever har ret til et ferietillæg, som svarer til 1 % af lønnen. Ferietillægget udbetales to gange om året med lønnen for maj og august.


Læs ferieloven her 



Veterinærsygeplejerskernes Fagforening fik forhandlet retten til optjening og afholdelse af feriefridage for elever ind i overenskomsten gældende fra 1 .april 2025. 


Som elev har du ret til 2 ½ arbejdsgiverbetalte feriefridage som du optjener og kan afholde løbende med 2½/12 dage pr. måneds ansættelse.


Ud over dine 5 ugers ferie, har du altså ret til at yderligere 2½ betalte fridag. Det er vores opfattelse, at de fleste dyreklinikker tildeler dagene i timer, således at medarbejderen kan “bide" noget af en arbejdsdag af til ex. skole/hjem-samtale og dets lige. Snak med din oplæringsvirksomhed om hvordan I gør det hos jer - orienter dig eventuelt i virksomhedens personalehåndbog.


Hvad end du optjener feriefridage i dage eller timer, skal saldoen af friheden fremgå på din lønseddel så du kan holde dig ajour. Læs hvilke emner der i øvrigt skal fremgå af din lønseddel jf. overenskomsten i dennes §5 stk. 4


Hvis du vil læse mere om feriefridage og øvrige aftaler om frihed vi har forhandlet til dig, kan du læse på siden her, som er et uddrag fra gældende elevoverenskomst

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Overview

We are hiring a Software Engineer II to build new AI platform capabilities for Windows Server across on-premises and hybrid customer deployments. You will be at the forefront of AI inference in a novel environment, and your work will infuse cutting edge AI concepts into existing Server platforms and workflows.

AI technologies evolved in the cloud, and you will translate those cloud-connected ideas to air-gapped, on-premises and hybrid environments. You will work at the intersection of AI models, agents, identity, and management surfaces on our most hardened OS platform. Experience or demonstrated interest in operating system fundamentals is a plus; experience with existing AI inference toolchains is valued.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Design and implement how we track usage, policy and efficiency for artificial intelligence capabilities.
  • Build observability pipelines through telemetry insights, diagnostics, and health signals needed to measure how this on-prem infrastructure is performing.
  • Define and develop the management layer for AI inference toolchains from model lifecycles and catalogs to language and protocol gateways.
  • Design and implement validation plans to assess the quality of this infrastructure and evaluate the end to end workflows and life cycle experiences of such a solution.
  • Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure this toolchain meets or exceeds platform release requirements.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, and 5+ years of software engineering experience. Strong development experience in C#/.NET or C++ and experience building Windows Server-based services and components. Experience designing and developing distributed or multi-tier service architectures, including areas such as reverse proxies, policy enforcement, telemetry, usage tracking, logging, and observability systems.

  • Experience with AI/LLM inference platforms and model-serving technologies (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, OpenVINO, Triton, or similar), model lifecycle management, and API gateway architectures supporting AI workloads.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. AND 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with coding in one or more languages such as C, C++ including designing automated tests and validation for the software you ship.
  • Experience or demonstrated interest in operating system fundamentals is a plus; experience with existing AI inference toolchains is valued.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Server administration and management features.
  • Familiarity with Server deployment and usage strategies in air-gapped or on-premises environments.
  • Understanding of AI model catalogs, model serving platforms, inference protocols, and AI orchestration layers.
  • Familiarity with modern observability, diagnostics, distributed tracing, logging, and telemetry solutions.

#W+DJOBS


This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Taler dansk

title: Odia Voice Artist (Freelance) | AI Voice Recording Project
description:
About the Opportunity

Arctic Engines AI is building a high-quality voice dataset for an AI voice technology project and is hiring experienced Odia voice artists for a paid, in-studio recording engagement.

Requirement: 10

Language: Odia

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Attend a scheduled in-studio recording session (billed at ~2 hours of processed audio; plan for a longer studio slot to allow for test recordings and retakes)
  • Record a variety of scripted content — everyday conversational scripts, industry/professional-context scripts, and customer-support-style scripts involving numbers, codes, and dates
  • Deliver takes across specified emotional tones (cheerful, low, flat, excited) as directed
  • Take live direction from the recording engineer on pacing, pronunciation, mic technique, and retakes
  • Maintain consistent voice quality, energy, and studio discipline through the full session

Who We're Looking For

  • 1–2+ years of professional experience in voice-over, dubbing, radio jockeying, audiobook narration, or comparable voice work
  • A demo reel, voice sample, or portfolio that demonstrates range, clarity, and control
  • Native or near-native Odia fluency with clear, broadly neutral pronunciation
  • Proven ability to sustain vocal quality and focus across a 2+ hour recording session
  • Comfortable taking direction and shifting delivery across multiple emotional registers on cue
  • Prior studio/professional recording experience — comfortable with mic distance, positioning, and repeated retakes without fatigue affecting quality
  • Reliable and punctual, able to commit to a scheduled in-studio slot in Bengaluru
  • Willing to sign a confidentiality/NDA agreement, as this project involves proprietary AI training data

Nice to Have

  • Experience recording alphanumeric or technical scripts (IVR, e-learning, customer support VO)
  • Comfort with multiple dialects or accent ranges within Odia
  • Own basic recording setup (useful if a remote audition sample is requested before the studio session)

Engagement & Compensation

  • Freelance, per-project engagement — one studio recording session
  • Fixed one-time payment of up to 8,000, processed ~30 days after recording approval₹
  • No ongoing commitment beyond the single session unless mutually agreed

How to Apply

  • Submit your resume along with a demo reel, voice sample, or links to previous voice work.
