title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Hiring Manager: Kok Yong Theo
Recruiter: Aislinn Roche

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Senior Quality Assurance Manager, you will lead the Quality Management System for Australia and New Zealand and serve as the ANZ Quality Management Representative. You will provide strategic and operational leadership across quality assurance activities, lead a team of quality professionals, and partner with business leaders both locally and regionally to drive compliance, continuous improvement, patient safety and customer outcomes.

This role is based in Mascot, Sydney and will report to the Quality Assurance Director, APAC.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and continuously improve the ANZ Quality Management System in line with ISO 13485, ISO 9001, local requirements and company policies.
  • Oversee audit readiness, management review, quality objectives, metrics, reporting and quality improvement projects.
  • Provide quality oversight across operations, supply chain, distribution, suppliers, post-market activities, document control, training and risk management.
  • Ensure nonconformances, CAPAs, deviations, complaints, field actions and changes are managed effectively.
  • Use quality data and risk-based thinking to identify issues, strengthen processes and support sound business decisions.
  • Partner with leaders and employees to translate quality requirements into clear, practical guidance.
  • Build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, distributors and relevant authorities, working with Regulatory Affairs and other accountable teams where required.
  • Represent ANZ Quality Assurance in local, regional and global forums, escalating significant risks and recommending practical solutions.
  • Maintain compliance with the Quality Policy and applicable quality processes, ensure the team has the resources needed to support the QMS, and promote a work environment that supports relevant Environment, Health and Safety and Energy policies.
  • As part of the APAC QA Leadership team, engage in quality related affairs, issues and projects within the APAC region through various forums.

People Leadership and Business Partnership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Quality team, setting clear priorities, goals and development plans.
  • Oversee team resourcing, recruitment, budget, succession and performance management.
  • Create an inclusive and accountable environment where people feel empowered to raise concerns and improve how work is done.
  • Position Quality Assurance as a trusted business partner, balancing commercial priorities with independent quality judgement.
  • Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that enhance compliance, reduce risk and deliver measurable value.

KEY COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR SUCCESS

People Development

  • Attracts, develops, manages and retains talent through providing employees with continuous feedback, mentoring, coaching, training and actively seeking development opportunities to compliment existing skill sets
  • Holds self and others accountable for making continuous progress against development objectives
  • Upholds our values of High Performance and Caring by developing talent to meet commercial goals while respecting individual differences

Relationship Building

  • Builds and maintains effective external as well as internal networks that add value in achieving work related goals.
  • Skilled in building rapport with a wide variety of individuals with diverse backgrounds and ways of thinking

Collaboration & Communication

  • Models and promotes collaboration and works effectively with others to achieve goals. Involves others, where appropriate, in decision making.
  • Creates an environment which promotes honest and open communication and information sharing amongst the team and organisation.
  • Listens actively and encourages expression of ideas and opinions.

Global Perspective

  • Keeps abreast of important trends both locally and globally that impact the business or organization. Understands the position of the organization within the APAC context, adopts and helps others to adopt a regional/global approach.
  • Identifies the unique business and cultural challenges and/or constraints involved when conducting business globally.

Influence & Adaptability

  • Influences and motivates others. Wins support and acceptance for proposed changes and ideas through consideration of key stakeholder needs.
  • Responds resourcefully, flexibly, and positively when faced with new challenges, transitions, and demands. Willingly and effectively deals with the stress and complexities of various situations.
  • Moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change and uncertainty.

Execution

  • Drives results by assigning clear authority and accountability, integrating and aligning efforts across units and functions, and monitoring progress against objectives. Conveys a strong sense of urgency around continuous improvement, achieving high quality results, and accelerating business performance.
  • Addresses problems directly and drives changes necessary to achieve business objectives.

YOUR EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, Quality
  • Demonstrated experience in quality management within a regulated healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or similar environment.
  • Proven people leadership experience, including leading and developing high-performing teams.
  • Experience leading Quality Management Systems, compliance activities, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead Auditor qualification and/or extensive experience working within ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 environments, including the leadership of CAPA processes, root cause investigations and corrective action programs.
  • Experience across quality systems, supplier quality, quality operations, and post-market quality activities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and influence diverse stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel within Australia, New Zealand, and internationally as required.

WHY CHOOSE US?

  • Great Place To Work Certified in 2024 & 2025
  • Best Workplaces for Women in 2024 & 2025
  • Inclusive Employee Resource Groups
  • 2 Wellbeing Days per year
  • Discounted health insurance
  • Ability to purchase additional Annual Leave
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program

title: Lead Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Contract
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Contract based in United States.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on architecting and delivering complex, full-stack software solutions for demanding client environments.
You will guide multiple engagements from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing support.
The role combines deep engineering expertise with client-facing leadership, requiring you to communicate technical decisions and business tradeoffs with confidence.
You’ll work across frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, data, DevOps, and connected systems while setting a high bar for engineering quality.
The initial engagement centers on Java and Dropwizard, but the broader environment spans React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, Azure, and modern infrastructure tooling.
You’ll also mentor engineers, strengthen delivery practices, support technical scoping, and help clients build systems that are scalable and maintainable.
This opportunity is designed for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems, leading through complexity, and remaining deeply involved in production code.

Accountabilities

  • Serve as the key technical architect across multiple client engagements, ensuring technology strategies align with customer objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead architecture and technical design across frontend, backend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, event-driven systems, data platforms, and user-facing applications.
  • Own technical delivery from discovery and planning through development, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Write and review production-quality code while establishing strong standards for maintainability, scalability, security, testing, and performance.
  • Become productive quickly in existing Java and Dropwizard codebases and contribute directly to the initial client engagement.
  • Collaborate across software engineering, hardware, data science, design, product, and client teams to deliver end-to-end connected and intelligent solutions.
  • Establish and improve engineering practices around automated testing, CI/CD, source control, code reviews, deployment, monitoring, logging, and observability.
  • Design and support cloud-native systems across AWS and Azure, including infrastructure, security, performance, reliability, and operational tooling.
  • Identify architectural, technical, and delivery risks early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and implement practical mitigation strategies.
  • Partner with product managers and technical leads to translate client requirements into actionable technical plans and deliverables.
  • Support pre-sales activities as a solutions engineering partner by contributing to technical scoping, estimation, solution design, and Statements of Work.
  • Mentor and guide engineers through development, code reviews, production troubleshooting, and on-call responsibilities.
  • Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and the continued development of engineering talent.
  • Represent the technical organization in client meetings and industry engagements as a trusted subject-matter expert.
  • Lead concurrent client programs toward successful, on-time delivery while maintaining strong client satisfaction and engineering standards.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
    • 10+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on full-stack engineering experience.
    • 3+ years of experience in a technical leadership role overseeing cross-functional engineering teams or complex software initiatives.
    • Strong backend development expertise using Java or another modern object-oriented language, with production Java experience preferred.
    • Ability to become productive quickly in Java and Dropwizard for the initial engagement, even if your primary background is in another backend ecosystem.
    • Strong frontend development experience with React, TypeScript, Vite, and/or Expo.
    • Proven experience delivering full-stack systems from concept through production and supporting public-facing applications at scale.
    • Deep knowledge of backend frameworks such as Dropwizard, Spring Boot, Django, FastAPI, or comparable production technologies.
    • Experience designing and supporting event-driven architectures, APIs, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
    • Strong experience with AWS and Azure, including services such as Lambda, ECS, Fargate, RDS, CloudFront, CloudWatch, SNS, and SQS.
    • Experience with relational and non-relational databases and data modeling.
    • Highly proficient in CI/CD automation and Infrastructure as Code using tools such as GitHub Actions, Terraform, or Pulumi.
    • Strong understanding of security, logging, monitoring, observability, performance, and reliability in cloud-native environments.
    • Experience with Docker, automated testing, Git, pull requests, and modern source code management platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
    • Demonstrated ability to work effectively within unfamiliar codebases, technologies, frameworks, and client environments.
    • Strong client-facing communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to diverse audiences.
    • Professional services or consulting experience is strongly preferred.
    • Strong ownership, adaptability, and problem-solving skills, with a focus on client outcomes and long-term technical value.
    • Must reside in the United States and be a U.S. citizen.
    • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
    • Must be able to pass a background check.
    • A valid, publicly accessible personal LinkedIn profile with a photo is required for this client-facing role.

      • Benefits

      • Contract compensation of $100 USD per hour, commensurate with experience.
      • Fully remote work within the United States.
      • Flexible work environment designed for distributed teams.
      • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact software and technology programs across connected products, cloud platforms, AI-driven systems, and data-intensive applications.
      • Significant technical ownership and opportunities to influence architecture, engineering standards, and delivery practices.
      • Exposure to a modern polyglot technology environment spanning Java, React, TypeScript, Python, AWS, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Pulumi, and CI/CD.
      • Opportunities to mentor engineers, contribute to technical leadership, and support client-facing solution development.
      • Meaningful work with demanding technical challenges and opportunities for continuous professional growth.
      • Contract engagement structured as a 1099 role, with the scope potentially approximating a full-time workload depending on the contractor’s pace and approach.
      • Client travel may be required up to approximately 10% of the time, and some engagements may include participation in a 24/7 support rotation.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • You will use your skills to develop real-time embedded software for our next generation controller products.

  • Work in small, self-motivated teams collaborating with global Scrum teams.

  • Be involved in all phases of software development from product definition to production release.

  • Use Agile software development practices to build and test our products using Continuous Integration.

  • Break down problems and estimate time for development tasks.

  • Work with multi-functional teams (i.e Software, Hardware, System Test and Product Management) to accomplish your assignments.

  • Develop deep domain expertise while working on various assignments in control system platforms.

  • Demonstrate the ability to help team members through pair programming and code reviews.

  • Drive premier quality in the development and support of products.


Who You Are:
  • You can take quick and decisive actions in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. Showing a tremendous amount of initiative in tough situations; is outstanding at spotting and seizing opportunities. Have a clear sense of ownership in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks. Open to work collaboratively with others across the organization to achieve shared objectives. Like to encourage the expression of diverse ideas and opinions.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 4–6 years of experience in Embedded Software/Firmware Development on Intel x86 and ARM-based processors/controllers.

  • Strong proficiency in C and C++ programming, with extensive experience in developing high-performance, reliable, and safety-critical embedded software.

  • Experience in real-time embedded software design and development using multi-threaded and multi-process architectures under VxWorks or other commercial RTOS environments.

  • Expertise in debugging and performance analysis of complex real-time systems using Wind River Workbench, GDB, JTAG debuggers, trace tools, memory analyzers, and RTOS debugging utilities.

  • Good understanding and implementation experience of industrial communication protocols commonly used in PLC systems, like Modbus TCP/RTU, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, DNP3.

  • Experience integrating and validating industrial communication protocol stacks into embedded firmware and control applications.

  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, and cybersecurity considerations for industrial control systems.

  • Experience in embedded board bring-up, hardware-software integration, and troubleshooting using Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Protocol Analyzers, JTAG/Boundary Scan Tools

  • Ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, processor datasheets, memory maps and peripheral specifications.

  • Experience with software development lifecycle practices including:

    • Agile/Scrum methodologies

    • Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)

    • Version Control Systems (Git, SVN)

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills with the ability to solve complex system-level issues.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams involving hardware, firmware, systems, and product engineering.

  • Self-driven and highly organized professional with demonstrated capability to identify technical challenges, propose innovative solutions, and successfully drive implementation through completion.


Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
  • Experience with Programmable Logic Controllers
  • Having firmware development experience with Xilinx's Ultrascale SOC is an added advantage
  • Experience in scripting languages like Python

Our Culture & Commitment to You:
  • At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  • We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, an Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. title: Postdoctoral Research Associate / Fellow (Cognitive Science of Language)
description:
• Full time, 2 years fixed term, located on the Camperdown Campus at the School of Psychology

  • Conduct and publish high‑quality, cutting‑edge research in the science of language

  • Base Salary, Academic level A/B $117,936 - $142,475 p.a + 17% superannuation

About the opportunity

The School of Psychology at the University of Sydney is seeking a Postdoctoral Research Associate / Fellow (Cognitive Science of Language) to conduct research in language acquisition, focusing on either computational models of language learning (including modelling language bootstrapping from thought) or experimental and corpus‑based studies of Formosan and/or Australian language acquisition.

Key responsibilities include:

  • collaborating with Associate Professor Hartshorne and members of the research group

  • acting as lead researcher and primary point of contact for the project

  • designing, collecting, and analysing data using appropriate computational, experimental, or corpus‑based methods

  • preparing manuscripts and contributing to high‑quality research outputs

  • providing intellectual leadership and mentoring junior researcher.

About you

The University values courage and creativity; openness and engagement; inclusion and diversity; and respect and integrity. As such, we see the importance of recruiting talent aligned to these values and are looking for a Postdoctoral Research Associate / Research Fellow who has:

  • a PhD in psychology, linguistics, or a closely related discipline

  • for the computational modelling stream: prior publications in computational modelling

  • for research on Formosan languages: excellent spoken and written Mandarin

  • for research on Formosan and/or Australian languages: prior publications on the relevant language(s).

Candidates should indicate which level they wish to apply for; however, the selection panel reserves the right to make offers based on its appraisal of the candidate’s skills, experience, and knowledge.

Pre-employment checks and declarations

Your employment is conditional upon the successful completion of all pre-employment or background checks required for the role in terms satisfactory to the University. Also, to meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Eliminate Gender-Based Violence you will be asked to declare if you have been investigated for, or found to engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence in the course of previous employment or in a legal process. Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

EEO statement

At the University of Sydney, our shared values are trust, accountability and excellence and we strive to be a place where everyone can thrive. We are committed to creating a University community that thrives through diversity and reflects the wider community that we serve. We deliver on this through our commitment to diversity and inclusion, evidenced by our people and culture programs, as well as key strategies to increase participation and support the careers of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People, women, people living with a disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and those who identify as LGBTQIA+. We welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds.

We are proud to be recognised as an Australian Workplace Equality Index (AWEI) Platinum Employer. Find out more about our work on diversity and inclusion.

How to apply

Applications via the Apply button at the top of the page. The application should include:

Cover Letter (Max 2 pages) that:

  • Indicates the level for which you are applying

  • Explicitly addresses each of the above selection criteria

  • Lists any career disruptions that should be taken into consideration in relation to your achievements relative to opportunity.

CV (Max 4 pages) that includes:

  • Relevant education/employment

  • Relevant publications and grants received, including list of all authors/investigators in authorship order

  • Relevant teaching/supervision experience

title: Legal Administrative Specialist
description:
Title: Legal Administrative Specialist
Location: Washington, DC | Hybrid with regular onsite support required
Schedule: Full-time, Monday-Friday, during GSA core business hours
Pay: $39.23-$44.32/hour

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. We are hiring a Legal Administrative Specialist to join our team and provide l to the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Office of General Counsel (OGC).

In this role, you will support GSA attorneys and legal staff with front office operations, scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, case and records management, legal filings, review tracking, data entry, and other litigation-support activities.

This position is a strong fit for an experienced federal litigation-support professional who is accurate, organized, discreet with sensitive information, and comfortable managing multiple deadlines in a legal office environment.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. Apply today!

RESPONSIBILITIES
Front Office & Administrative Support
  • Greet visitors, control office access, and follow Government visitor-management and security procedures
  • Answer and route telephone inquiries, receive messages, and direct callers or visitors to appropriate OGC personnel
  • Provide routine or procedural office information only as authorized and follow Government-provided routing procedures
  • Maintain a professional front office environment and protect sensitive information from unauthorized disclosure
  • Receive, review, time stamp, sort, route, and distribute incoming mail, correspondence, and faxes
  • Prepare, collect, and dispatch outgoing mail and coordinate approved local courier services when needed
  • Support general clerical and administrative activities assigned within the scope of the OGC requirement
  • Provide responsive customer service to attorneys, staff, visitors, and other authorized stakeholders
Scheduling, Travel & Timekeeping Support
  • Maintain attorney calendars and schedule appointments, meetings, conferences, and conference calls
  • Maintain suspense lists, reminders, meeting details, room reservations, and schedule changes
  • Prepare meeting rooms and conference materials and reschedule appointments when necessary
  • Arrange official travel and lodging for OGC staff, make cost comparisons, and secure required pre-travel approvals
  • Input travel vouchers in ConcurGov or another Government-designated travel system, as directed
  • Serve as timekeeper, when assigned, and enter time and leave information in HR Links or another designated system
Legal Documents & Correspondence
  • Prepare routine correspondence, non-technical legal documents, reports, and other materials with limited supervision
  • Use Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Adobe Acrobat or Foxit, and other Government-designated software
  • Produce, edit, format, store, retrieve, and print documents from drafts, edited copy, or electronic files
  • Prepare final-form correspondence with accurate grammar, spelling, punctuation, pagination, and formatting
  • Review briefs, memoranda, pleadings, exhibits, attachments, and other documents for proper format and completeness
  • Prepare complex documents containing tables, charts, special symbols, authorities, and other structured material
Files, Records & Case Support
  • Establish and maintain physical and electronic case files, legal subject files, correspondence, and related records
  • Cross-reference files, add new materials, revise file organization, and maintain records under applicable office file plans
  • Search for and retrieve files, track case disposition, and identify records for purge or other directed disposition
  • Safeguard legal files and records from loss, unauthorized access, or disclosure
  • Dispose of sensitive materials in accordance with Government procedures
  • Support accurate and timely case, workload, litigation, and records tracking
Legal Filings & Review Tracking
  • Prepare and assemble documents, transmittals, envelopes, and related materials for filing, submission, mailing, or service
  • Format filings in accordance with applicable court, board, commission, agency, or other procedural requirements
  • Support timely filing or submission to federal courts, boards of contract appeals, GAO, DOJ, and other entities as directed
  • Maintain documentation showing that pleadings or other materials were filed, served, lodged, or otherwise submitted
  • Circulate sensitive correspondence, legislative items, executive orders, and other matters requiring legal review
  • Track legal review items in Government-designated applications and communicate status to authorized requesters
Legal Research, Data Entry & Reporting
  • Search, assemble, and summarize information from authorized legal and Government sources, as directed
  • Use LexisNexis, Westlaw, GSA databases, OGC databases, shared drives, and other approved resources when applicable
  • Maintain and organize legal publications, reference materials, subscriptions, manuals, and related resources
  • Enter and update budget, timesheet, leave, travel, training, workload, litigation-case, and other organizational data
  • Prepare recurring statistical, workload, and managerial reports using tracked information
  • Maintain accurate records and protect reference materials, documents, and files from unauthorized disclosure
Document Reproduction, Office & Optional FOIA Support
  • Coordinate copying, printing, scanning, reproduction, and assembly of legal documents, litigation materials, and reports

title: OBGYN Physician
description:
Job Description:

When you join us, you’ll become a part of a nationally recognized health system dedicated to our mission of “helping people live the healthiest lives possible.”

About this role:

As an OB/GYN physician with Intermountain Southridge OB/GYN, you will work with a team of healthcare professionals committed to providing quality care and excellent patient experience.

You will join a collegial established practice with five OB/GYN generalists, three OB/GYN Hospitalists, six CNMs, one WHNP, and experienced support staff. Our service includes providing surgical backup for the midwives in our work family, support for our WHNP, and coverage for Southridge patients while in house, as well as classic OB/GYN Hospitalist role supporting private docs and all emergencies.


We are passionate about building bridges with our community providers and support our hospital teams to provide excellent care to the women in our area and be the model gold standard.

  • You'll work a mix of clinic, surgical, and restricted OB Hospitalist shifts, with manageable unrestricted call.

  • Clinic time will be split between our newly built Copper Hills Clinic in West Jordan, Utah and Southridge Clinic, on campus of Riverton Hospital, conveniently located across the hall from our Labor & Delivery Unit.

  • Deliveries and surgeries will all take place at Riverton Hospital. Riverton Hospital is a level IV Trauma Center, home to a level II NICU, Da Vinci Robotics, and an award winning Labor & Delivery Unit.

  • MFM & Neonatology consult available 24/7.

How we'll support you:

  • $30,000 starting bonus

  • Up to $20,000 in relocation assistance

  • $75,000 in student loan assistance

  • For those completing residency, a monthly stipend of $1,500 while still in training.

  • You will be paid a guaranteed base annual salary, with additional productivity & quality incentives available.

We care about your well-being which is why we provide our caregivers a generous benefits package. In addition, we offer paid time off, license reimbursement, malpractice insurance coverage, and an annual CME allowance to support your continuous growth and development. Learn more about our comprehensive benefits package.

What you’ll bring:

  • Board Certification or Board Eligibility in OB/GYN

  • Unrestricted Utah MD or DO license, or the ability to obtain an unrestricted license

  • Completion of U.S. ACGME Residency

  • BLS Provider Certification

  • Ability to complete Intermountain Health's credentialing process

  • Team mentality is a must, desire and skills for gynecologic surgery is expected, and strong work ethic and communication skills are imperative.

About Us
Intermountain Health is a model health system by providing extraordinary care and superior service at an affordable cost. We are an integrated not-for-profit system of 33 hospitals, 400 clinics, and a medical group with more than 5,000 employed physicians and advanced practice providers across six states in the mountain west.

Our value statements are core to our culture. They reflect the behavior and attitudes that are important to us, are an agreement for how we treat each other, help us make decisions on how to act, and are a promise of what people can expect from us. Learn more about our Mission, Vision, and Values at: About Intermountain.

Intermountain Health was recently recognized by the American Medical Association’s Joy in Medicine award for our commitment to physician wellbeing. We also received the Lorna Breen Wellbeing First Champion award.

What does it mean to be a part of Intermountain Health?

It means joining the Power of We, building an environment where providers and caregivers can deliver the best in healthcare. Realizing each caregiver, learner, and volunteer is vital to providing care to our patients, because WE can only achieve the extraordinary together. Committed to the best in medical education, research and most advanced technology, the results are better clinical patient outcomes.

Life in Salt Lake Valley
The Salt Lake Valley is the heart of the state of Utah, which is one of the fastest growing states in the country. Salt Lake Valley is located at the base of the Wasatch Mountains and is within an hour’s drive of nine world-renowned ski resorts and within a day’s drive of five national parks. Along with these recreational attractions, there are many cultural and sporting events. There are performances by the Utah Symphony, Ballet West and Pioneer Theater Company, as well as a renovated theater that offers Broadway plays. The Sundance Film Festival and the Park City Art Festival are nationally recognized events held in nearby communities. The NBA’s Jazz, NHL Utah Hockey Club, ECHL Utah Grizzlies hockey, the AAA Salt Lake Bees, the Utah Warriors Rugby team, NWLS Royals, and the MLS Real Salt Lake, all represent our state.

Location:

Southridge Clinic at Riverton, West Jordan Clinic

Work City:

Riverton

Work State:

Utah

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

$7.25 - $999.99

We care about your well-being – mind, body, and spirit – which is why we provide our caregivers a generous benefits package that covers a wide range of programs to foster a sustainable culture of wellness that encompasses living healthy, happy, secure, connected, and engaged.


Learn more about our comprehensive benefits package here.


By applying for a position with Intermountain, I acknowledge that I will comply with all applicable Intermountain policies and expectations. If applying for a remote or hybrid role, this includes remote work expectations related to confidentiality, information security, work schedules, conflicts of interest, and use of company equipment. I further acknowledge that outside employment or activities may not interfere with job responsibilities or create a conflict of interest with Intermountain. Actual or reasonably perceived conflicts may be grounds for disqualification from consideration or, if hired, corrective action up to and including termination of employment.


Intermountain Health is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Spécialiste, Soutien Aux Partenaires, BMO Ligne d’action (Bilingue, français et anglais)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Spécialiste, Soutien Aux Partenaires, BMO Ligne d’action (Bilingue, français et anglais) based in Canada.

This role provides high-quality sales and service support to clients and internal partners across investment and wealth management products.
You will identify client needs, provide tailored guidance, and uncover opportunities to strengthen relationships and improve the overall client experience.
Working in a fast-paced, regulated financial environment, you will manage a range of transactions, inquiries, and service requests with accuracy and professionalism.
You will also collaborate with internal teams and escalate complex situations when additional expertise is required.
The position offers an opportunity to deepen your knowledge of investment products, market trends, compliance requirements, and client service practices.
Strong communication, analytical, and organizational skills will be essential to achieving both service and sales objectives.
This is an excellent opportunity for a bilingual professional seeking to build a career in investment services within a collaborative and development-focused environment.

Accountabilities

  • Provide professional, responsive service to current and prospective clients by addressing questions, resolving requests, and identifying opportunities to improve their investment experience.
  • Proactively contact clients when appropriate to identify investment needs and recommend relevant products, services, programs, or promotions.
  • Ask thoughtful follow-up questions to understand individual client circumstances and provide appropriate guidance aligned with their needs and objectives.
  • Complete required client transactions and accurately document interactions and requests, ensuring all information is processed in accordance with established procedures.
  • Meet sales objectives by identifying and promoting relevant investment products and services while maintaining a strong focus on client needs.
  • Monitor investment markets, industry developments, product trends, consumer needs, and regulatory changes, incorporating relevant knowledge into client conversations.
  • Collaborate with internal business groups and refer clients to the appropriate teams when their needs extend beyond the scope of the role.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved client matters to senior leaders or appropriate internal partners and manage escalations from other employees when required.
  • Analyze client and operational issues, determine appropriate next steps, and complete complex or varied activities within established guidelines and limits.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of client and organizational information while identifying and reporting suspicious activity that may be associated with money laundering or terrorist financing.
  • Follow applicable regulatory, compliance, consumer protection, privacy, and anti-money-laundering requirements.
  • Contribute to broader team responsibilities and take on additional tasks as business needs evolve.

    • Requirements

    • 2–3 years of relevant professional experience, ideally combined with a post-secondary diploma or degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • High school diploma or equivalent work experience.
    • Knowledge of investment products, services, industry competition, market trends, and evolving product offerings.
    • Familiarity with investment and brokerage products and services is strongly valued.
    • Successful completion of the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) or Investment Funds in Canada (IFIC) course, or an equivalent securities representative licensing credential.
    • Functional understanding of risk management, regulatory requirements, compliance principles, and applicable financial services regulations.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both French and English, with the ability to support clients and colleagues within and outside Quebec.
    • Good organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client requests and administrative responsibilities accurately and efficiently.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to assess issues and determine appropriate solutions or escalation paths.
    • Effective collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with internal partners.
    • Strong client-service orientation and the ability to communicate investment-related information clearly and professionally.
    • Attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to work effectively within established procedures and regulatory boundaries.

      • Benefits

      • Annual salary range of $38,500–$71,000 CAD, depending on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications.
      • Potential eligibility for commissions, performance-based compensation, discretionary bonuses, and other rewards depending on the position's compensation structure.
      • Health and wellness insurance coverage.
      • Life and accident insurance.
      • Retirement savings programs.
      • Tuition reimbursement and opportunities to support continued professional development.
      • Access to training, coaching, leadership support, and networking opportunities designed to help employees expand their skills and career opportunities.
      • Inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace environment.
      • Opportunities to build expertise in investment services, wealth management, client relationships, and financial markets.
      • Full-time employment with opportunities for professional growth and development.

title: Senior Director – Finance Process Innovation & Enablement: Capabilities, Insights & AI Enablement
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

At Verizon, we are building a world-class Finance organization. We have begun a comprehensive program to streamline processes, enhance systems, realign the organization, and add opportunities for personal skill-building and professional growth. We’re finding new ways to add value and provide strategic support. This is the kind of work we do. We want to build leading Finance practices within Verizon, setting the stage to become the place any Finance professional wants to work. You can become a catalyst for change.

The Sr. Director of Finance Process Innovation Enablement (FPIE) – Capabilities, Insights & AI Enablement is an elite, hands-on working leader who is a Finance Subject Matter Expert capable of establishing scalable frameworks for project management and business analysis from the ground up while personally executing and leading teams through complex technical initiatives to drive speed to insight following robust SOX compliance and SDLC. In this role, you will lead a high-performing team who provide foundational technology enablement across all FPIE pillars and finance functions—partnering seamlessly with business leadership, Process Improvement, Data Governance, and Process & Organizational Changes.

Beyond supporting internal FPIE pillars, you will provide deep technical leadership to maintain flawless and timely Month-End Close (MEC) operations, enforce strict SOX ITGC compliance and audit readiness, drive practical Finance AI Enablement & Governance, and support organizations across Finance (Accounting, Corporate FP&A, Treasury, Tax, FinOps) in resolving technical challenges.

  • Provide Deep Month-End Close (MEC) & SAP Stability: Provide deep technical and functional oversight for Month-End Close (MEC) operations, vSAP/1ERP transitions, database view promotions (Oracle, SQL, Snowflake), and system break-fixes, ensuring system enhancements never disrupt critical financial reporting cycles.

  • Enforce Compliance & SOX ITGC Governance: Lead the implementation of SOX ITGC controls, privacy guardrails, and reconciliation automation in partnership with E&Y and Enterprise Risk Management to guarantee audit-ready financial data across cloud and enterprise platforms.

  • Strategic Translation: Act as the primary interface between Finance, IT, and business units, translating complex manual finance problems into detailed Functional Requirements Documents (FRD) and Logical Models.

  • Drive Practical AI Enablement & Governance: Lead the end-to-end delivery of practical, high-value AI solutions to automate manual workflows across Finance. Establish and manage the Finance AI Governance framework alongside teams including Corporate CISO, Legal, and Data Governance.

  • Deliver Cross-FPIE Technology Enablement: Provide foundational data and tool enablement to empower other FPIE pillars (Process Improvement, Data Governance, Process & Organizational Changes).

  • Execute Critical Architecture Migrations: Personally direct and de-risk the high-priority technical migration of Qlik Sense applications and Talend data integration pipelines from on-premises servers securely to Qlik Sense Cloud and Talend Cloud.Direct the engineering of native Qlik Cloud P&L reporting models to systematically eliminate manual Excel compilations and retire third-party plugin dependencies (e.g., Vizlib).

  • Oversee GCP Medallion Architecture & System Replication: Oversee the implementation and maintenance of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) for eHana data. Manage technical integrations including Talend Cloud enablement and eHANA to GCP replication.

  • Support Partner Technical Roadblocks: Serve as a senior technical escalation lead that Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and FinOps teams can rely on when data integrations, legacy view promotions, or database views require architectural guidance.

  • SDLC Management: Advance and document a "right-sized" Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodology tailored for finance reporting solutions.

  • Vendor Oversight: Manage complex vendor relationships, contracts (SOWs, DDQs, IRQs), eCAS approvals, and budget allocations (CapEx and OpEx).

  • Executive Reporting: Deliver high-level reporting on project status, value-focused KPIs, and technical risks such as network latency and security architecture.

What we’re looking for...

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or ten or more years of work experience.

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in project delivery and business analysis with at least 7-10 years in leadership roles.

  • Deep knowledge of financial principles, Month-End Close (MEC) processes, and SOX compliance.

  • Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex requirements into actionable executive presentations.

  • Demonstrated ability to establish AI enablement strategies and AI governance frameworks across corporate finance or enterprise business units.

  • Knowledge of Qlik Cloud Architecture, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Medallion architecture, and Talend Cloud data pipelines.

  • Willingness to travel.

Even better if you have:

  • Master’s degree or MBA in Finance, Computer Science, or Information Systems.

  • Technical or professional certifications in GCP / Cloud Architecture, Qlik Cloud, Talend, or CPA / CISA.

  • Experience with AI/LLM integrations (e.g., Gemini API, Qlik Answers, etc.).

  • Ability to drive results up and across a matrixed organization, managing both internal teams and external vendor engagements.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $183,500.00 - $352,000.00.

title: Senior Data Engineer
location: Bangalore, India; Gurgaon, India; Pune, India
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Some of the things we’d like you to do:

  • Deploy data collectors in Adverity to gather data from media, agency system, and other sources
  • Development and maintain data quality checks and procedures, helping stakeholders overcome data issues before they impact the quality of the reporting solution
  • Support the translation of user requirements and business needs into technical specifications
  • Be a proficient user of Google Cloud Platform and associated technologies, ensuring your work incorporates industry best practice
  • Monitor automated jobs, troubleshooting data issues as-and-when they arise
  • Support other members of the team responsible for “last mile” transformation and visualization of data within Google Data Studio reports and dashboards
  • Serve as a technical and professional leader for junior staff
  • Provide hands-on support to users of reporting solutions, helping the wider team triage and respond to user queries in a timely manner
  • Attending internal stakeholder meetings, presenting your solutions, and providing updates on your work.
  • Support the development strong working relationships with third-party data providers that we rely on for access to necessary data.

A bit about yourself:

Required

  • Bachelor degree in Science or Engineering
  • 3+ years’ experience (professional or academic) in data engineering, preferably handling advertising media or marketing data
  • Professional experience with Python, ETL Development, SQL and DBT
  • Analytically minded, enabling you to understand and overcome technically complex challenges, and to tell compelling stories with data
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to manage multiple tasks in an autonomous way
  • Strong spoken and written communication skills, ensuring your thoughts and needs are heard and understood
  • An ability to demonstrate a passion for the digital marketing ecosystem, and an understanding of the role that data plays within it
  • Delivers best results when working in a team environment, and an ability to partner effectively with people of varying degrees of technical capability

Desirable

  • Previous experience working with data and technology
  • Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Tiktok etc.
  • An understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of ad servers and other third-party tech vendors)
  • Experience using or building reports with business intelligence software, ideally Microsoft PowerBI
  • Work experience within a marketing organization, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) Lead based in United States.

The Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) Lead will provide hands-on technical leadership for an established enterprise analytics implementation.
This role combines solution architecture, platform configuration, analytics strategy, and direct delivery across the Adobe ecosystem.
You will own key CJA decisions while translating complex business requirements into scalable measurement and reporting solutions.
The position requires deep expertise in Adobe CJA and Adobe Experience Platform, including data architecture, identity, ingestion, and analytics enablement.
You will work closely with technical and business stakeholders while maintaining direct accountability for configuration, troubleshooting, and execution.
This is an autonomous role suited to an experienced practitioner who can identify gaps, make sound decisions, and move complex initiatives forward.
You will have the opportunity to shape customer journey analytics capabilities and deliver measurable value in a high-impact enterprise environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and actively contribute to an ongoing Adobe Customer Journey Analytics implementation, providing technical direction, solution design, configuration, troubleshooting, and hands-on execution.
  • Design and configure CJA solutions across Analysis Workspace, Data Views, metrics, dimensions, segments, calculated metrics, attribution models, and reporting capabilities.
  • Guide data enablement through Adobe Experience Platform, including XDM schemas, datasets, Identity Service, Real-Time Customer Profile, ingestion patterns, and CJA connection configuration.
  • Assess existing implementations, identify technical gaps and risks, recommend practical solutions, and independently execute improvements.
  • Translate business questions and stakeholder requirements into scalable analytics use cases, measurement frameworks, reporting architectures, and actionable insights.
  • Assess and map data sources, including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Journey Optimizer, CRM platforms, and other enterprise systems, to support customer journey analytics use cases.
  • Establish analytics and reporting best practices that improve consistency, usability, governance, and adoption across stakeholder teams.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders while maintaining ownership of hands-on delivery and serving as a trusted CJA subject-matter expert.
  • Provide architecture recommendations and ensure analytics solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with business objectives.

    • Requirements

    • Deep, hands-on expertise with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, including Analysis Workspace, Data Views, metrics, dimensions, segmentation, calculated metrics, attribution, and reporting.
    • Strong knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform, including XDM, datasets, Identity Service, Real-Time Customer Profile, data ingestion, and CJA data enablement.
    • Demonstrated experience designing CJA implementations and analytics solutions, defining business use cases, mapping data sources, and developing measurement frameworks.
    • Experience connecting AEP data to CJA through batch and streaming ingestion, with exposure to Adobe Analytics, Adobe Journey Optimizer, CRM, and other enterprise data sources.
    • Strong understanding of analytics architecture and the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
    • Excellent consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and analytical concepts clearly.
    • Proven ability to work autonomously, make sound architecture decisions, manage priorities, and lead initiatives with limited day-to-day oversight.
    • Experience combining technical leadership with hands-on platform configuration and delivery in complex enterprise environments.
    • Ability to identify implementation risks, troubleshoot issues, and develop pragmatic solutions that support long-term scalability and adoption.
    • For US-based employment, unrestricted authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship is required.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive annual base salary of $150,000–$200,000, depending on experience, qualifications, location, and other job-related factors.
      • Remote work opportunity within the United States.
      • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
      • Life insurance and disability coverage.
      • Paid time off.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • Opportunity to work on complex Adobe Experience Cloud and customer analytics initiatives for enterprise clients.
      • Collaborative, high-impact environment with opportunities for technical ownership, professional development, and continued growth.

title: Principal Solution Consultant, PPPM
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Solution Consultant, PPPM based in Canada.

This senior consulting role is responsible for shaping complex, outcome-driven engagements across project, program, and portfolio management. You will lead executive discovery, business transformation framing, outcome architecture, governance design, and advisory quality for sophisticated client environments. The role connects business strategy, operating models, technology, governance, adoption, and measurable value without owning detailed technical architecture or commercial strategy. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, Sales, Account teams, Engagement Directors, Solution Architects, and delivery leaders. A major focus will be on strengthening consulting methodology, stage-gate discipline, reusable assets, and customer outcomes. You will also coach other consultants and help elevate the overall quality and maturity of the practice.

Accountabilities

  • Lead complex solution consulting engagements by clarifying business objectives, transformation constraints, value targets, operating-model impacts, risks, success measures, and delivery approaches.
  • Conduct executive-level discovery and translate ambiguous business challenges into structured consulting narratives, decision paths, phased roadmaps, and measurable outcome models.
  • Define outcome architectures covering value hypotheses, KPIs, baselines, target outcomes, benefits tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Design governance frameworks with appropriate stage gates, decision forums, escalation paths, decision ownership, and executive communication cadences.
  • Shape current-state and future-state operating models that connect people, processes, technology, governance, adoption, and value realization.
  • Advise senior stakeholders on organizational structures, portfolio management, investment priorities, capacity, strategic alignment, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Translate organizational strategies into scalable work management solutions supported by Atlassian products, while remaining focused on business value rather than software implementation alone.
  • Apply and continuously improve solution consulting methodologies across diagnosis, design, validation, activation, and scaling phases.
  • Review engagement artifacts for clarity, completeness, evidence, value alignment, customer relevance, and readiness for executive or delivery-team use.
  • Support complex sales pursuits through discovery approaches, advisory workshops, solution framing, scope assumptions, value cases, proposals, and statements of work.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Account teams as a consulting and scoping advisor without owning pricing, negotiation, commercial strategy, or close plans.
  • Partner with Engagement Directors, Principal Solution Architects, Technical Architects, and delivery leaders when specialized business or technical input is required.
  • Develop and maintain value cases, operating models, roadmaps, governance models, KPI frameworks, benefits trackers, decision logs, executive presentations, playbooks, templates, and discovery guides.
  • Coach Senior Solution Consultants and Solution Consultants through advisory reviews, workshop preparation, structured feedback, and artifact improvement.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, enablement, communities of practice, capability planning, and consulting quality initiatives.
  • Promote responsible use of approved AI tools to improve consulting efficiency, consistency, quality, and value realization.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience in solution consulting, management consulting, business transformation, enterprise PMO, Project Portfolio Management (PPM), or a closely related advisory discipline.
    • Demonstrated ownership of large or complex consulting engagements involving multiple stakeholders, workstreams, business domains, or delivery phases.
    • Strong experience designing enterprise work management solutions using Atlassian products such as Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence; experience with Jira Align, Atlassian Focus, or Atlassian Strategy Collection is highly desirable.
    • Extensive experience leading executive-level discovery, advisory workshops, governance forums, and decision-oriented client conversations.
    • Strong capabilities in problem framing, value modeling, KPI development, roadmapping, operating-model design, adoption planning, and benefits tracking.
    • Solid understanding of project, program, and portfolio management principles, including governance, work hierarchies, dependencies, roadmaps, and executive reporting.
    • Strong knowledge of stage-gate governance, iterative delivery, consulting methodologies, and outcome-based advisory practices.
    • Familiarity with enterprise delivery, ITSM, Agile, Work Management, service management, and the broader Atlassian ecosystem.
    • Demonstrated ability to coach consultants, evaluate advisory artifacts, and establish repeatable methods and quality standards.
    • Experience working in regulated, complex, or enterprise environments such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, public sector, or multinational organizations is preferred.
    • Knowledge of ITIL, SAFe, Lean-Agile, DevOps, Enterprise Service Management, change management, or operating-model frameworks is advantageous.
    • Relevant certifications such as Atlassian ACP, SAFe SPC or Lean Portfolio Management, PMP, PMI-PfMP, PMI-PgMP, or equivalent consulting credentials are desirable.
    • Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly, credibly, and in a decision-oriented manner.
    • Excellent structured problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguity into coherent plans, artifacts, and decision paths.
    • Strong systems-thinking capabilities across people, processes, technology, governance, risk, and operating models.
    • Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation with an annual performance-based bonus.
      • Comprehensive benefits package.
      • Generous paid time off (PTO).
      • Flexible work policy.
      • Fully distributed, multicultural, and international working environment.
      • Opportunities to work with leading global organizations on complex transformation initiatives.
      • Exposure to AI-enabled delivery practices and emerging approaches to digital collaboration.
      • Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development opportunities.
      • Opportunities to influence consulting methodologies, quality standards, and innovation initiatives.
      • Multiple career progression paths, including Engagement Director, Practice Lead, Team Leadership, and senior Solutions Consulting leadership roles.
      • Collaborative, inclusive, and people-first culture where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas and perspectives.

title: Director, Billing
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Billing based in United States.

The Director, Billing will lead strategic initiatives designed to improve billing performance, accelerate cash collections, and reduce revenue cycle inefficiencies across a complex multi-client healthcare environment.
This is a high-impact leadership role focused on identifying root causes, developing scalable solutions, and transforming billing operations.
You’ll work closely with Revenue Cycle, Revenue Integrity, Denials Management, Front-End Operations, and client-facing teams to drive measurable improvements.
The role combines hands-on analytics with enterprise-level strategy, giving you the opportunity to influence operational priorities and long-term transformation.
You’ll also lead and develop a growing team while establishing workflows, frameworks, and best practices that can scale across markets.
Success requires strong analytical thinking, executive communication, curiosity, and the confidence to challenge established processes.
This is an opportunity to shape the future of healthcare billing while making a measurable impact on financial performance, client outcomes, and operational excellence.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead analysis of denials, rejections, claim edits, and other billing performance indicators to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and implement innovative billing optimization strategies that improve operational efficiency, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen financial performance.
  • Drive enterprise-wide initiatives focused on reducing unbilled days, improving claim quality, and accelerating cash collections.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle Operations, Revenue Integrity, Denials Management, Front-End Operations, and client-facing teams to identify issues and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Present analytical findings, recommendations, business cases, and process improvement strategies to senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Build scalable workflows, operating frameworks, and best practices that support consistent billing performance across multiple clients and markets.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a growing billing optimization team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, engagement, and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner in defining the future state of billing operations and identifying opportunities for enterprise transformation.
  • Balance strategic leadership with hands-on analytical problem-solving in a fast-paced, continuously evolving healthcare environment.
  • Evaluate opportunities to incorporate automation, AI-enabled tools, and emerging technologies into billing workflows and operational processes.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of implemented initiatives and use performance data to refine strategies and sustain improvements.

    • Requirements:

    • Progressive leadership experience within healthcare revenue cycle operations, with a strong understanding of billing and related revenue cycle functions.
    • Demonstrated expertise in root-cause analysis and the ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable, measurable solutions.
    • Experience working across multiple revenue cycle functions and successfully leading process improvement or operational optimization initiatives.
    • Advanced critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify meaningful trends.
    • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
    • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using data to support operational decision-making.
    • Proven ability to lead teams, develop talent, establish accountability, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
    • Ability to influence change across complex organizational structures and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and client-facing stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to challenge traditional approaches in pursuit of better outcomes.
    • Experience working in a dynamic, multi-client healthcare environment with competing priorities is strongly valued.
    • Familiarity with Epic, Cerner, or other major healthcare information systems is preferred.
    • Knowledge of clearinghouse operations and claim management processes is advantageous.
    • Experience within a payer, health system, consulting organization, or healthcare technology environment is a plus.
    • Exposure to automation and AI-enabled technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, bots, or workflow automation platforms is preferred.
    • Experience leading enterprise transformation or operational excellence initiatives is an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Compensation: Base salary range of $88,200–$132,300 USD, with final compensation determined by factors such as geographic location, skills, experience, education, licensure, and internal equity.
      • Remote flexibility: Remote opportunity available nationwide within the United States.
      • Comprehensive benefits: Healthcare, paid time off, retirement, and well-being programs supporting employees and their families.
      • Professional development: Investment in career growth, including opportunities to earn a professional certification relevant to your field.
      • Tuition support: Access to tuition reimbursement programs.
      • Recognition and incentives: Quarterly and annual incentive programs recognizing strong performance and contributions.
      • Leadership opportunity: High visibility and the chance to lead transformative initiatives across a broad healthcare client base.
      • Team development: Opportunity to build and grow a high-performing team while shaping billing operations at an enterprise level.
      • Innovation-focused environment: Exposure to emerging technology, automation, AI-enabled tools, and continuous improvement initiatives.
      • Purpose-driven work: Opportunity to improve healthcare financial operations while contributing to stronger client performance and patient outcomes.
      • Collaborative culture: A people-focused environment emphasizing collaboration, growth, innovation, leadership, and work-life flexibility.

title: [Loonshot Games] Client Programmer- Project Camp (5년 이상)
description:
우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

저희는 누적매출 5,000억 이상 달성한 모바일 게임을 운영해 온 숙련된 팀입니다. 지금은 크래프톤의 룬샷게임즈에서 새로운 게임을 만들기 위해 소중한 동료를 찾고 있습니다.

  • 아름다운 판타지 세계와 매력적인 캐릭터 서사를 중심으로 한 모바일 RPG
  • 도트 기반 캐릭터와 입체적인 배경 연출을 결합한 개성 있는 2.5D 비주얼의 게임
  • 동료를 만나고 공간을 성장시키며, 자신만의 모험을 확장해 나가는 수집·성장형 게임
  • 쉬운 진입성과 전략적 전투, 감성적인 내러티브를 함께 갖춘 게임

※ 본 포지션의 채용이 진행되는 Loonshot Games는 2/23자로 크래프톤의 자회사로 분사 완료되었습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • Unity 기반 모바일 RPG 클라이언트 개발
  • 프로젝트 초기 단계부터 핵심 게임 루프, 주요 콘텐츠 구현 및 비주얼 프로토타이핑 개발
  • 도트 캐릭터와 입체적인 배경을 결합한 2.5D 비주얼 기술 R&D 및 개발

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • Unity 기반 모바일 게임 클라이언트 개발 경험이 3년 이상 있는 분
  • 초기 개발 단계에서 불확실한 요구사항을 구체화하고 구현해 본 경험이 있으며, 초반 개발 환경 구축이 가능한 분
  • 게임의 재미와 방향성에 대해 적극적으로 의견을 제안할 수 있는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 모바일 플랫폼에서 개발부터 출시 및 라이브 서비스까지의 경험이 있는 분
  • 신규 프로젝트에 참여하여 초기 아이디어를 구체화하고, 프로토타입 또는 Vertical Slice 빌드 제작 경험이 있는 분
  • 2.5D 게임 개발 경험이 있는 분
  • AI 기반 개발 도구를 활용해 빠른 프로토타이핑 및 비주얼 구현이 가능한 분
  • 새로운 개발 방식, AI 도구, 외부 서비스 활용에 도전적이고 열린 태도를 가진 분

룬샷게임즈의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > *과제 전형 > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 합격 또는 불합격 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일 또는 유선으로 개별 안내 드립니다.

필요 서류를 확인해주세요!

  • 입사지원서 (자유 양식), 자기소개서, 경력기술서, 포트폴리오 (필수)
  • 신입일 경우 자기소개서를, 경력일 경우 경력기술서를 중심으로 기술해 주시기 바랍니다.
  • 포트폴리오 (필수) 첨부 시, 하단 안내 사항을 확인해 주시기 바랍니다.

근무지

  • 역삼 센터필드 East 타워
  • 본 공고를 통해 입사하는 구성원은 성수 사옥 이전 계획에 따른 근무지 변경 예정 사실을 인지하고 입사하는 것을 확인 및 동의한 것으로 봅니다.
