                                    Why join?
                                
                            

                                

                                    
                                    
Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

                                

                                

                                    
                                    
Continuous development opportunities for all employees

                                

                                

                                    
                                    
Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

                                

                                

                                    
                                    
A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

                                



                    


                

                    

                        
                    


                    
Join us in this role where you have ownership of trading strategies across Continental European and UK power markets, generating value through fundamental and quantitative insights while contributing to the transition to a renewable energy future.

As a Senior Trader, you'll operate within a defined risk mandate, identify and capture opportunities across the power curve, and help shape the future direction of our discretionary and systematic trading strategies. You'll work at the intersection of market intelligence, analytics, and technology, combining deep market understanding with innovative trading approaches to deliver strong commercial results.

Welcome to Market Trading

You'll become part of Continental & UK Trading, where we generate value through trading across European power, carbon, and gas markets. The team combines experienced traders, analysts, quants, and developers, creating an environment where market insights, data-driven decision making, and innovation come together.

In this role, you'll focus on Continental European and UK power curve products, leveraging your understanding of market fundamentals, cross-commodity relationships, and risk dynamics to identify and execute profitable trading opportunities.

As a team, we're ambitious, collaborative, and highly performance-oriented. We challenge each other's thinking, share knowledge openly, and continuously adapt to changing market conditions. This creates an exciting environment for experienced traders looking to make an impact while continuing to develop professionally.

You’ll play an important role in: 

delivering strong trading performance across Continental and UK power markets within an allocated risk mandate

developing and executing trading strategies across forward and futures markets, with a particular focus on curve products

identifying market opportunities through analysis of power fundamentals, weather, cross-border flows, fuel markets, carbon pricing, and broader macroeconomic developments

helping shape and enhance systematic trading capabilities by collaborating closely with quantitative analysts and algorithmic developers

actively managing risk and ensuring disciplined position management under changing market conditions

translating market developments into actionable trading decisions and commercial outcomes.

To succeed in the role, you: 

have significant experience trading European power markets, especially Continental European and/or UK markets

have a proven track record of delivering results within a delegated trading mandate and managing risk effectively

possess a strong understanding of power market fundamentals and the key drivers influencing curve valuations

can develop clear market views and translate them into profitable trading strategies

combine strong analytical and numerical capabilities with sound commercial judgement

are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where decisions must be made under uncertainty

thrive in close collaboration with traders, analysts, quants, and developers

communicate openly, challenge constructively, and contribute positively to a high-performing team culture.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us
Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.


                    
Position salary range: 
For this position, the expected base pay range is kr53,360.00- kr80,040.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

title: External Engagement Strategy Lead
description:
• Full time, Fixed Term opportunity to July 2027

  • Lead strategic partnerships and external engagement at one of Australia's leading law schools

  • Base salary (HE010) $162,528 + 17% Superannuation

About the opportunity

In this influential leadership role, you'll shape the future of external engagement at Sydney Law School, build high-value partnerships, and work closely with senior University leaders to advance strategic priorities and strengthen the School's global profile.

This unique fixed-term opportunity supports the School's external engagement and partnership priorities during a period of long service leave (September 2026 to July 2027). You'll lead key engagement initiatives, strengthen strategic partnerships, and provide leadership to the External Engagement and Partnerships team.

Sydney Law School is one of Australia's most respected law schools, combining outstanding teaching, influential research, and strong industry connections to prepare students for successful and meaningful legal careers. The School offers a dynamic and intellectually rigorous environment that inspires critical thinking, innovation, and leadership.

What you'll love about this role

This is a unique opportunity to join the Sydney Law School Leadership Group and make a visible impact across a leading academic institution. You'll work with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders, drive strategic initiatives, and play a key role in advancing the School's engagement, partnership and reputation goals.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • lead the development and execution of the Law School's strategic external engagement priorities

  • build and maintain influential relationships with industry, government, alumni, international partners and other key stakeholders

  • identify and advance partnership opportunities that enhance the School's reputation, reach and impact

  • provide strategic advice and support to the Dean and senior leadership on external engagement and partnership initiatives

  • lead and coordinate the interim External Engagement and Partnerships team, ensuring delivery of key priorities and operational effectiveness

  • contribute to strategic planning and decision-making as a member of the Sydney Law School Leadership Group

About you

  • relevant tertiary qualifications in business, communications, public policy, international relations, marketing, law, education, or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications and/or equivalent experience will be highly regarded

  • extensive experience in external engagement, partnerships, stakeholder engagement, business development, or a related field within a large and complex organisation

  • experience building and maintaining influential relationships with senior stakeholders across industry, government, academia and the broader community

  • demonstrated success delivering strategic initiatives that enhance organisational reputation and achieve measurable outcomes

  • exceptional communication, influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to provide trusted advice to senior leaders

  • strong leadership, judgement and collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate complexity and deliver results in a dynamic environment. Experience in higher education, or a similarly complex environment, will be highly regarded


Work Rights

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Pre-employment checks

Your employment is conditional upon the completion of all role required pre-employment or background checks in terms satisfactory to the University. Similarly, your ongoing employment is conditional upon the satisfactory maintenance of all relevant clearances and background check requirements. If you do not meet these conditions, the University may take any necessary step, including the termination of your employment.

EEO statement

At the University of Sydney, our shared values include diversity and inclusion and we strive to be a place where everyone can thrive. We are committed to creating a University community that reflects the wider community that we serve. We deliver on this commitment through our people and culture programs, as well as key strategies to increase participation and support the careers of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People, women, people living with a disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and those who identify as LGBTIQ. We welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds.

How to apply

Applications should include a current CV and responses (maximum 500 words each) to the following questions:

  • Describe a strategic partnership, stakeholder engagement, or external engagement initiative that you have led. What was your approach, what challenges did you encounter, and what outcomes did you achieve?
  • What interests you about this opportunity, and how has your experience prepared you to lead external engagement and partnership priorities in a complex organisation such as the University of Sydney Law School?

title: Staff Software Engineer - Data Integration
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer - Data Integration based in the United States.

This is a high-impact engineering role focused on the connectors and parsers that power a data intelligence platform for regulated enterprises.
You will work at the intersection of data engineering, systems integration, metadata, and modern AI-assisted development.
Your work will transform complex legacy data sources into trusted lineage and dependency models that help customers understand migration risks.
You will build integrations across legacy ETL platforms, databases, cloud systems, proprietary formats, and undocumented technologies.
As part of a small, early-stage product team, you will have significant ownership over architecture, implementation, testing, and technical direction.
The environment is fast-moving and AI-first, with an expectation that you use modern AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining rigorous engineering standards.
This is an opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, establish reusable engineering patterns, and directly shape a critical product capability.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and maintain robust connectors for legacy ETL platforms, databases, modern cloud data systems, and other enterprise technologies.
  • Develop parsers capable of processing XML, SQL, repository exports, scripts, and vendor-specific or proprietary formats.
  • Transform extracted metadata into accurate lineage, dependency, and transformation models that customers can trust.
  • Create automated tests, validation frameworks, and known-good datasets to continuously verify connector accuracy and reliability.
  • Partner with senior technical leadership to improve the connector framework, establish reusable architectural patterns, and document best practices.
  • Reverse engineer unfamiliar or poorly documented systems to understand their structures, dependencies, and transformation logic.
  • Integrate AI into everyday engineering workflows, using it to accelerate reverse engineering, coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and problem solving while retaining ownership of technical decisions and final output quality.
  • Contribute to a fast-moving product environment where shipping quickly, validating thoroughly, and iterating based on real-world findings are essential.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven experience in data engineering, metadata management, systems integration, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • Hands-on experience with ETL platforms, SQL parsing, data lineage, transformation logic, or comparable data integration technologies.
    • Strong ability to reverse engineer unfamiliar systems, including technologies with limited or incomplete documentation.
    • Professional experience with TypeScript and a strong understanding of automated software testing practices.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools as an integrated part of the software engineering lifecycle, rather than only as an occasional productivity aid.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and a practical engineering mindset, with a willingness to investigate issues deeply and fix problems rather than work around them.
    • Ability to operate effectively in an early-stage environment with evolving requirements, limited precedent, and significant individual ownership.
    • A bias toward action, rapid delivery, thorough validation, and continuous improvement.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with architects and other technical stakeholders.
    • Experience with Informatica PowerCenter, DataStage, Talend, SSIS, or similar enterprise platforms is a plus.
    • Familiarity with graph models, OpenMetadata, OpenLineage, compilers, parsers, SQL transformation frameworks, or related technologies is advantageous.
    • Experience delivering software in regulated, security-sensitive, or highly controlled environments is also a plus.
    • Candidates must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer without current or future visa sponsorship and must reside in an eligible U.S. state or Washington, DC.

      • Benefits:

      • Estimated annual compensation range of $180,000–$225,000 USD, with final compensation determined by factors including experience, skills, education, location, and internal equity.
      • Potential eligibility for discretionary bonuses, commissions, or other incentive programs.
      • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • Paid time off and additional employee benefits.
      • Opportunity to work within a small, growing team with substantial ownership and influence over product and engineering decisions.
      • Collaborative environment focused on solving meaningful business and technology challenges.
      • Exposure to modern AI-assisted engineering practices and complex enterprise data technologies.
      • Equal opportunity workplace committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

title: Home-Based Art Director
description:

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Number of Openings: 1

The DCX Client Services – Home-Based Art Director

We are looking for an experienced Art Director to oversee the quality, efficiency, workflow, and creative output of its Art Department. This role will lead production art processes, train and guide artists and team members, manage art priorities, and ensure artwork meets client branding and production requirements.

The ideal candidate has strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills, production graphics experience, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to lead and develop an art team. Experience in the promotional products industry is highly valuable, particularly experience working with production graphics, although direct industry experience is not required.

  • Attention to Detail
  • Prioritization & Time Management
  • Communication & Collaboration
  • Creativity & Problem Solving

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Oversee the overall quality, efficiency, and workflow of the Art Department.
  • Establish and maintain standards for art quality, branding, and production efficiency.
  • Analyze and improve art processes, systems, and standard operating procedures.
  • Train new artists and team members on production standards and best practices.
  • Supervise artists by providing feedback, direction, and guidance.
  • Prioritize art requests and coordinate the team to meet deadlines and turnaround expectations.
  • Review artwork for format, color, quality, sizing, legibility, and decoration requirements.
  • Create art proofs using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Prepare production-ready artwork according to vendor specifications.
  • Manage art requests through dashboards, trackers, and email.
  • Create custom designs and layouts based on client or sales team requirements.
  • Support virtual proof requests and coordinate licensing submissions.
  • Maintain client art assets and uphold branding guidelines.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with third-party artists.
  • Monitor licensing approval status and communicate updates to sales representatives.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Education

Experience

  • Professional experience in graphic design, production graphics, art direction, or a related field.
  • Experience overseeing, training, or guiding artists is highly relevant.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Adobe Illustrator skills.
  • Strong Adobe Photoshop skills.
  • Art preflight and production-ready artwork preparation.
  • Understanding of vector and raster artwork.
  • Color, sizing, resolution, and print-production requirements.
  • Branding and brand guideline management.
  • Creative layout and design.
  • Art workflow and request prioritization.
  • Strong computer skills.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

  • Promotional products / branded merchandise production graphics is highly desirable.
  • Experience with art proofs, decoration methods, production specifications, and licensing workflows is valuable.

title: Administrativ medarbejder til DSV'S toldteam Joboplysninger | DSV
description:
Administrativ medarbejder til DSV'S toldteam
      

        
  Horsens
      

     
 



         

     

    
    
 
        
  
 Hvis du er en nuværende DSV medarbejder og er interesseret i en stilling i et andet land, så kontakt venligst din HR Partner for, at gennemgå processen og kravene for at ansøge. 

 
         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
                 
 Job Req Number:  124350 
 Time Type: Full Time 

   


   


 Er du grundig, struktureret og motiveret af at få detaljerne til at gå op? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et vigtigt område indenfor international handel og logistik? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DSV's toldteam i Horsens. 


   


   


 Start here. Go anywhere. 


   


 Som en del af DSV's toldkompetencecenter bliver du en del af et erfarent og hjælpsomt team, der understøtter både kunder og kolleger på tværs af organisationen. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med told fra starten. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, lærenem og motiveret for at opbygge specialistviden inden for et område, hvor kvalitet og præcision er afgørende. 


   


 DSV har en af Danmarks største toldafdelinger og håndterer opgaver inden for import, eksport, transit, toldoplag og rådgivning. Som toldkompetencecenter understøtter vi både eksterne kunder og forretningsområder på tværs af organisationen. Vi søger nu en engageret medarbejder med fokus på håndtering af vores toldoplag. 


   


   


 Bliv en del af et stærkt toldteam 


   


   


 Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og kvalitet er i centrum. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores viden og løfter i fællesskab opgaverne, også når tempoet er højt. Hos DSV prioriterer vi et godt arbejdsmiljø, fordi vi ved, at de bedste resultater skabes, når mennesker trives og arbejder godt sammen. 


   


   


 Om jobbet 


   


   


 Du bliver en vigtig del af vores toldteam, hvor vi sikrer korrekt og rettidig toldbehandling af varer til og fra toldoplag. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring, så du får de bedste forudsætninger for at lykkes i rollen. 


   


 Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være: 


   

 

 Behandling af toldangivelser 


 Kontrol af oplysninger og dokumentation 


 Opfølgning på toldsager 


 Dialog med kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere 

 

   


   


 Hvem er du? 


   


 Vi forestiller os, at du: 


   

 

 Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer 


 Trives med administrative opgaver, hvor præcision er afgørende 


 Bevarer overblikket og arbejder effektivt, også når der er travlt 


 Er analytisk og hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye regler, systemer og arbejdsgange 


 Tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til samarbejdet i teamet 


 Har erfaring fra en administrativ stilling eller en relevant uddannelse, fx handelsøkonom, logistikøkonom eller en kontoruddannelse med erfaring 

 

   


   


   


 Derfor vil du trives hos os 


   


 Stillingen passer til dig, der finder motivation i at arbejde med regler, processer og detaljer, og som sætter en ære i at levere et korrekt stykke arbejde første gang. Du er lærenem, kvalitetsbevidst og motiveres af at blive dygtigere inden for dit fagområde. 


   


 Erfaring med told er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er din indstilling, lyst til at lære og evnen til at arbejde grundigt med opgaver, hvor detaljen gør forskellen. Til gengæld tilbyder vi en spændende rolle i et kompetent og hjælpsomt team, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle stærke faglige kompetencer inden for et vigtigt område af international transport og logistik. 


   


   


 Er du interesseret? 


   


 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Katrine Schmidt på telefon 25 41 62 14. 


   


 Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket. 


   


 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 


   


   


   

 DSV - Global transport and logistics 


 At arbejde hos DSV betyder at spille i en helt anden liga. 


 Som en global leder inden for transport og logistik har vi været på en ekstraordinær vækstrejse. Lad os vokse sammen, mens vi fortsætter med at innovere, digitalisere og bygge videre på vores præstationer. 


 Med tæt på 150.000 kolleger i over 90 lande arbejder vi hver dag på at tilbyde solide tjenester og imødekomme vores kunders behov og hjælpe dem med at nå deres mål. Vi ved, at den bedste måde at opnå dette på er ved at tiltrække nye talenter, friske perspektiver og ambitiøse individer som dig. 


 Hos DSV ligger præstation i vores DNA. Vi arbejder ikke bare - vi sigter mod at forme fremtidens logistik. Denne ambition fremmer et dynamisk miljø bygget på samarbejde med teamspillere i verdensklasse, ansvarlighed og handling. Vi værdsætter inklusion, omfavner forskellige kulturer og respekterer hvert enkelt individs værdighed og rettigheder. Hvis du vil gøre en forskel, få kundernes tillid og udvikle din karriere i en fremsynet virksomhed - er dette stedet at være. 


 Start here. Go anywhere

Through careful analysis and strategic involvement, the ideal fraud analyst will identify trends in fraud to prevent fraudulent transactions and the resulting chargebacks. This position is responsible for reviewing both long- and short-term data trends to provide in-depth fraud analyses and develop solutions in order to resolve those issues. This position handles highly detailed and advanced fraud issues and sales analysis for client accounts.

 Så har vi en spændende mulighed til dig. 

 Hos BR skaber vi oplevelser, og du er en vigtig del af et team præget af samarbejde og fleksibilitet, hvor kunden og den gode vejledning og service er i centrum. Du bliver del af et hold af medarbejdere med en fælles begejstring for legetøj og ikke mindst for legebørn. At skabe den gode kundeoplevelse hos BR er meget mere end at sørge for fyldte hylder og en god bundlinje. Det er at evne at skabe den rette stemning, og det er at give kunderne en oplevelse, der får dem til at komme igen og igen.

 Du er serviceminded, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket, når situationen kræver det. 

 Du har fokus på kunderne og en fantastisk service, og du bidrager til det gode sammenhold i teamet. 

 Du kan lide, at der er travlt og drives af den energi, en fyldt butik giver.

 Er det dig?

title: Senior-Data Engineer
location: Bangalore, India; Gurgaon, India; Pune, India
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Role Summary and Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer, based out of Gurgaon/Bangalore who will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines utilizing Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and advanced serverless technologies—ensuring cross-platform scalability, security, and reliability.
  • Implement highly efficient, complex SQL solutions—including advanced query optimization, partitioning, and indexing—to power sophisticated analytics models and enable real-time data processing.
  • Lead the development and integration of robust automation frameworks using Python, and API orchestration, introducing innovative solutions to streamline the entire data lifecycle and maximize operational efficiency.
  • Exercise full ownership of production pipeline reliability; proactively identify and resolve critical issues through deep root-cause analysis, and institute resilient, long-term stability measures for continuous uptime.
  • Establish, refine, and enforce rigorous coding and architectural standards through comprehensive code reviews and technical audits, setting quality benchmarks for the offshore engineering team.
  • Champion best-in-class documentation, data lineage, and automated CI/CD deployment practices, ensuring transparency, auditability, and governance across all data assets.
  • Demonstrate expert-level support for analytics and media teams, translating business challenges into scalable, high-performance technical solutions, leveraging deep Azure and SQL expertise.

Senior-Level Expectations:

  • Act as the organization’s subject matter expert (SME) in end-to-end pipeline architecture, orchestration frameworks, schema evolution, and advanced Azure Data Factory strategies.
  • Lead modernization initiatives across the organization, championing the adoption of technologies such as Databricks, DBT and advanced DevOps practices to future-proof the data platform and enable rapid innovation.
  • Ensure strict adherence to SLAs and regulatory compliance through advanced monitoring, proactive risk mitigation, and continuous improvement of operational processes.

Skills and Experience:

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:

  • 3-4 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with expert-level mastery of Azure Data Factory, SQL, and cloud data platforms (Azure and/or GCP).
  • Proven expertise in designing, optimizing, and managing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, including deep skills in SQL performance tuning, ADF orchestration, and CI/CD automation.
  • Advanced knowledge of production operations, troubleshooting, and high-availability data processing at scale.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Vice President, Product Owner - GTB Channels.GTB - Channel Management-Shared.Corporate & Investment Banking Group
description:
Job Purpose
GTB Channels Product Owner (PO) role will have overall accountability and ownership to build, develop, commercialize, improve adoption and performance of Mashreq’s corporate digital channels, such as NEO CORP (online corporate channel), Mobile App, Host-to-Host (H2H) and SWIFTnet, and third-party platforms—integrated with Cash and Trade product engines. PO will own the channel enhancement backlog, and work closely with clients and key stakeholders like Product, CXC, Technology, Operations, Compliance and Islamic team to articulate requirements, write use cases, user stories, BRDs, create roadmaps, maintain the backlog, ensure timely delivery and roll out of functionalities across markets.

The Channels PO role is pivotal in ensuring accelerated delivery of critical enhancements, rapid execution of our plans by working closely with clients as well as internal stakeholders. Being onshore is critical because this role requires direct engagement with key stakeholders, fast decision-making, and real-time coordination across Product, CXCG, Sales, Operations, Technology, and Client teams. Onshore presence enables faster resolution of complex issues, addressing feedback, adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements, and alignment with market-specific nuances.

The incumbent will work in close collaboration with GTB Product (Cash and Trade), Customer Experience and CIBG Technology and Operations. Key part of the job will be to gather requirements, writing use cases, user stories, Business Requirement Documents (BRD), development roadmaps, maintain the backlog, roll out functionalities and support key client mandates through digital channels. The role requires strong understanding of Transaction Banking Products, Core Banking, Payment infrastructure, client connectivity requirements and new age digital solutions for Payments, Collections and Trade Finance. This role bridges business strategy and technology execution, ensuring that channel capabilities align with client needs, regulatory expectations, and the bank’s overall digital transformation agenda.


Key Result Areas
• Own the channel product backlog – Work with the product management, customer experience, Technology, compliance, Sharia team to ensure channel products are prioritized and abide by the specifications and expectation as set by Product Management, regulators, and clients working environments.
• Drive Channel Performance – drive the overall performance of channels, offering GTB products by developing, enhancing and launching new capabilities and driving initiatives for existing products to grow client adoption.
• Understand the market dynamics – constant monitoring the market evolution for regulatory changes, trends, drivers, client needs and competitor offerings through market analysis, feedback from Sales, direct client interaction, contribute in winning key deals and feedback from voice of the client surveys
• Execute Channel Strategy – know the market landscape and drivers, core product proposition, target market and client segments, build channel connectivity and capability , and track the usage w.r.t. client adoption, functional utilization, digital penetration, volumes/revenues flow through channels, capability assessment and continuous improvement in channel offerings.
• Drive Digital Innovation – establish processes and checkpoints to identify opportunities to develop new products and enhance existing products based on market/sales feedback, client needs and/or regulatory changes. Prioritise the development pipeline based on a sound commercial assessment of each opportunity and review the quality of investment plans before the team seeks formal approvals. Constantly review the Minimum Value Proposition (MVP) for the product set against each target segment as well as defining the future roadmap for an Enhanced Value Proposition (EVP) to stay ahead of the market and position Mashreq as the leading innovator in the region.
• Commercialise Digital Propositions – lead and execute a commercialisation plan for each channel capability such as Corporate API Solutions, develop marketing/sales materials, product training for Sales and Coverage and client education events. Track and monitor execution of these plans through regular reviews and identify any issues where help is required to remove roadblocks.
• Customer Experience –ensure highest channel product quality and client usability, ensure all enhancement value is captured and agreed by proudest management
• Expertise - Domain knowledge in Corporate Digital channels, User Interface and User Experience (UI/UX) along with Transaction Banking products such as Cash Management, Payments, Trade and Supply Chain is expected to the expert level with clear examples of digital transformation, implementations in a developed market covering all aspects, products, operational processes and clients experience, act as a point of reference in business domain
• Support Product Management – monitor participation of team members in the working level product development teams. Ensure the scope of each product build/enhancement is clearly defined in relevant Business Requirements Documents and touch base with the Product Heads regularly to check that Product Managers are providing effective inputs and supporting key deliverables such as the development of test cases, standard operating procedures, and product implementation guides
• Stakeholder Management - Engage directly with senior stakeholders in Operations, Service, Technology, Risk, Legal and Compliance to ensure they are supporting key improvement initiatives.


Knowledge, Skills and Experience
• 15 – 20 years of digital channel design experience in wholesale/corporate banking platforms such as online banking platform, Mobile App, APIs, H2H etc
• Strong understanding of Transaction Banking Product, processes and Channels catered to cash management products ideally in global or large regional bank
• Track record in developing and successfully commercialising new digital capabilities
• Experience in agile product development approaches
• Strong people management skills
• Strong analytical and data rationale mindset
• Strong communication ability and executive impact

The opportunity

You will be a part of the future Energy Transformation as a Cybersecurity project manager at Hitachi Energy. You will be responsible for overseeing and driving the successful execution of various cybersecurity activities within our delivery projects You will ensure that activities are performed on time, within budget and meet the high-security standards expected from a global technology leader.


“We are proud to deliver HVDC system solutions that are supporting the energy transition all over the world. How you’ll make an impact

title: Service Delivery Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary

Service Delivery Specialist is responsible for driving service delivery, execution, dispatching, master planning, field parts inventory and service tools management processes to ensure customer satisfaction, problem resolution and operation excellence across LCT. Focus areas and task details will be defined for team members by priorities.

Job Description

[HR Talk]

GE헬스케어 서비스사업부에서 고객 서비스 운영의 핵심 컨트롤 타워 역할을 담당하는 대리급 후보자를 채용합니다. 필드 엔지니어 배치, 예방점검(PM), 장비 설치 및 업그레이드 운영을 총괄하며 고객 이슈를 신속하게 해결할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 또한 데이터 분석과 지속적인 프로세스 개선을 통해 고객 만족도 향상, 운영 효율성 증대 및 서비스 품질 혁신을 주도하는 포지션입니다. 유사업무를 해보신 3년차 이상의 대리급을 우대하며 영어소통이 가능한 후보자를 선호합니다.

  • Ensuring ongoing customer satisfaction by efficient planning of field operations and timely resolution of customer issues
  • Driving operational excellence on the service delivery processes under responsibility
  • Dispatching field team members to the corrective service requests with most efficient and smart planning option, considering engineering proficiency and geographical circumstances.
  • Master planning and follow up of Preventive Maintenance (PM), Field Modification Instruction (FMI), Installation, Option & Upgrades (O&U), helium refill operations
  • Monitoring and closely following down systems and hot issues until resolution and customer satisfaction
  • Establishing a smart service inventory in line with Global Parts Team’s strategy and ensuring availability of parts in local warehouses
  • Managing installation and field tool inventory; purchase, loan, calibration & repair processes
  • Performing data analysis and business case development for key projects
  • Developing productivity initiatives/projects to reduce costs, improve efficiency, eliminate manual work and increase speed of service
  • Achieving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and ensuring daily compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s)

Technical Knowledge & Hard Skills (Requirements)

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Basic business acumen and understanding of key financial drivers
  • Knowledge of Lean & Continuous Improvement principles
  • Experience in statistical and/or data management tools
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Fluency in English

Behavior & Soft Skills (Requirements)

  • Sense of priority & urgency
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills
  • Process mindset
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced changing environment
  • Excellent planning, prioritization and organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and verbal & written communication skills
  • Demonstrated collaboration, negotiation and conflict resolution skills
  • Analytical, problem solving & root-cause analysis skills
  • Embraces all cultural operating behaviors of the company

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

title: Lead Software Engineer - React.js, Redux, Reusable components, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Java
description:
Scope:

  • We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer with strong full stack development experience to architect, design, develop, and deliver scalable SaaS solutions. The role will have a strong focus on React, TypeScript, Node.js and Java technology.

  • The candidate will work closely with engineering teams and architects to build scalable, resilient, secure, event driven, and multi-tenant applications and will be expected to remain hands on while providing technical leadership and mentorship

Our current technical environment:

  • Software: TypeScript, JavaScript, React.js, Redux, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, Gradle, Java, REST APIs, Snowflake

  • Application Architecture: Cloud-native, scalable and resilient microservices architecture, Event driven architecture etc.

  • Cloud Architecture: Azure

  • Frameworks/Others: Kafka, Snowflake, Postgres, Mongo DB, Github CI/CD, Elastic Search

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, and delivery of scalable full-stack applications.

  • Develop modern and reusable React/TypeScript UI components, hooks, libraries, and frameworks.

  • Design and develop scalable Node.js REST APIs and backend services.

  • Work with Java/Spring Boot services and contribute to backend architecture and development as required.

  • Drive technical design decisions for microservices, event-driven, cloud-native, and multi-tenant SaaS architectures.

  • Design solutions for scalability, performance, resiliency, availability, and security.

  • Establish and promote engineering best practices around coding, testing, CI/CD, observability, and deployment.

  • Troubleshoot complex production and performance issues and identify sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate with architects, product teams, platform teams, and other engineering teams.

  • Mentor junior and senior engineers and provide technical guidance.

  • Lead POCs and evaluate new technologies/frameworks to solve complex business problems.

  • Contribute hands-on to coding and remain actively involved throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Drive continuous improvements to simplify architecture, improve maintainability, and optimize system performance.

What we are looking for:

  • 8+ years of software development experience, with strong hands-on full-stack development experience.

  • Strong experience with React.js and TypeScript.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and Java particularly building scalable REST APIs and backend services.

  • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, ES6+, object-oriented programming, and core CS fundamentals.

  • Experience with React Hooks, Redux, React Router and reusable component development.

  • Experience building reusable UI components, libraries, frameworks, or developer toolkits.

  • Strong HTML5 and CSS skills, including hands-on experience with styled-components or Emotion.

  • Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Mocha, or similar frameworks.

  • Good experience with REST APIs, API management, OAuth, and secure application integration.

  • Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot, Java is a secondary technology for this role.

  • Experience with microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and multi-tenant SaaS applications.

  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming/messaging technologies.

  • Good understanding of RDBMS and NoSQL databases.

  • Experience with Azure/cloud-native technologies and cloud scalability.

  • Experience with CI/CD, GitOps and Agile development practices.

  • Strong problem-solving, architectural thinking, communication, and mentoring skills.

  • Ability to work hands-on while providing technical leadership across engineering teams.

Our Values


If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

RF Subsystems Engineer - Design the communication systems that connect ambitious satellite missions to Earth




    


        

            
We are seeking an experienced RF Subsystems Engineer to design, develop, and validate RF communication subsystems for ambitious nanosatellite missions.

In this role, you will design and integrate RF front-end components across UHF, S-band, and X-band systems, perform link budget analyses, and validate performance through hardware-in-the-loop and over-the-air testing.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, working on next-generation RF concepts and mission-specific communication architectures while collaborating closely with GomSpace’s RF Hardware team in Aalborg — whose flight-proven NanoCom radios and SDR platform are on orbit today across missions like GOMX-4, GOMX-5, Starling, and Juventas (ESA/Hera). Depending on the mission, you may contribute to conventional communication subsystems, software-defined radio applications, or advanced RF sensing payloads.

Important eligibility requirement: Employment in this position requires eligibility for national and EU security clearance. Certain citizenships or dual citizenships may affect the ability to obtain such clearance under applicable regulations.

Your Role

As RF Subsystems Engineer, you will own the end-to-end RF subsystem architecture for advanced mission proposals, from link budget analysis and front-end design through firmware development, HIL testing, and over-the-air validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

Define RF subsystem architectures and perform trade-offs across frequency bands, performance, and constraints

Perform link budget analysis, RF chain modelling, and system-level performance optimisation

Specify RF subsystem requirements and interfaces in coordination with system and payload teams

Support integration, verification, and validation of RF subsystems, including HIL and over-the-air testing

Contribute to selection and oversight of RF front-end components and suppliers (UHF/VHF/S/X-band)

Identify and assess onboard signal processing and data reduction algorithms for RF payloads.

Assess radar emitter detection, classification, and geolocation techniques using pulse and spectral analysis.

What Success Looks Like

In the initial phase, success means:

Understanding GomSpace’s NanoCom product portfolio and SDR architecture.

Completing a link budget analysis for an active mission proposal and performing your first HIL or over-the-air RF test using GomSpace equipment.

Communicating RF trade-offs and link budget results clearly to non-RF stakeholders.

Contributing directly to winning new mission opportunities through robust RF subsystem designs and credible technical proposals.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end RF subsystem design for mission proposals — from link budget through component selection to test verification — and for establishing reusable RF modelling and simulation tools for the BU.

What You Bring

You are an RF engineer with hands-on experience in satellite communication systems, comfortable moving between simulation, the lab bench, and system-level integration.

You likely bring:

An MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.

5+ years of experience in RF subsystem design, testing, or integration for satellite or aerospace applications.

Hands-on experience with UHF, S-band, or X-band communication systems.

Proficiency in RF simulation and design tools (CST, ADS, HFSS, or similar) and experience with spectrum analysers, VNAs, and RF test equipment.

Familiarity with modulation schemes (GMSK, QPSK, 8PSK, DVB-S2) and communication protocols (CSP, CCSDS).

Experience in RF payload design, digital signal processing (DSP), or sensing systems would be considered a strong advantage.

Experience with RF signal analysis and/or ELINT/SIGINT techniques (e.g. radar pulse detection, classification, and geolocation).

Experience with ECSS standards or space-grade RF qualification is a strong plus.

Who You Are

You are precise, methodical, and energised by the challenge of squeezing maximum performance out of tight RF margins in space. You enjoy the full cycle — from modelling a link budget to measuring real hardware on the bench.

You are known for:

Precision and attention to detail — RF performance in space demands it.

Hands-on problem solving — equally comfortable in simulation tools and at the lab bench.

Collaborative communication — able to bridge RF-specific topics with systems and payload teams.

Curiosity — eager to explore emerging RF technologies and push boundaries in nanosatellite communications.

Execution discipline — delivering results in demanding, schedule-driven environments.

Customer focus - ensuring focus on customer’s success.

True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

Why Join Us

You will help define communication architectures for some of the most challenging nanosatellite missions in Europe, working at the intersection of RF engineering, systems engineering, and mission design. Your work will directly influence customer proposals, mission feasibility, and the technologies that ultimately fly in space.

This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Kelly Antonini, Systems Engineering and Hardware Manager: klan@gomspace.com

The primary workplace will be at our premises at 1 Boulevard du Jazz, L-4370 Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

About GomSpace

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

Vil du være erhvervsmægler på Vestsjælland?




























Og sætter du kundeservice, faglig kompetence samt ikke mindst ordentlighed højt i din hverdag, er du måske vores nye stærke medlem på holdet.



De sidste tre år har Erhvervscenteret på Vestsjælland med base i Slagelse været inde i en bemærkelsesværdig forretningsgunstig stabil periode. Vi søger derfor en erfaren mægler til teamet - en mægler med en udtalt ambition om at øge vores markedsposition lokalt.  



Rammerne for fortsat succes er absolut til stede. Vores portefølje af erhvervsejendomme til salg eller udlejning spænder vidt i området, og vi rådgiver i dag kunder inden for detail, kontor, lager, logistik og investering. Vores produktkatalog omfatter naturligvis salg af erhvervsejendomme, men også rådgivning, sparring og optimering i en bred vifte ifm. investering og realisering samt generationsskifte.



Du bliver en del af et stærkt og velfungerende team med base i Slagelse, som består af en solid partnerkreds godt understøttet af erfarne erhvervsmæglerkræfter samt et velfungerende salgskoordinatorteam. Teamet understøtter dig i relation til den faglige sparring på kunder og sager og letter de administrative opgaver, så du kan koncentrere dig mest muligt om det opsøgende salgsarbejde.



Din sult efter at skabe resultater og din lokalforankring er altafgørende

Helt grundlæggende besidder du sulten, modet og lysten til at blive en aktiv del af vores fælles succes. Din primære opgave er at udføre indsatser der gør, at vi får erhvervsejendomme til salg samt udlejnings- eller vurderingsopgaver ind i forretningen. Efterfølgende er opdraget at sælge og udleje erhvervsejendomme på Vestsjælland. Vi ser gerne, at din hidtidige erhvervsmæssige baggrund og person er kendetegnet ved:



	
Erfaring fra et tilsvarende job i mæglerbranchen enten som erhvervsmægler eller anden relevant erhvervsmæssig B2B salgsbaggrund fra bank, realkreditinstitut eller salgs- og rådgivningsvirksomhed.

	
Et unikt B2B-netværk på Vestsjælland samt lysten og evnerne til at opbygge langsigtede relationer til virksomheder og ejendomsinvestorer.

	
Dokumenterede salgsresultater, der med tydelighed viser, at du formår at skabe enestående resultater i et stærkt konkurrencepræget marked.

	
En stærk vindermentalitet, som betyder, at du går den berømte ekstra mil for at vinde og afslutte en sag.

	
Et stærkt værdigrundlag, der bygger på en høj grad af flid, ordentlighed samt et godt købmandskab.




Vi honorerer din erfaring og indsats

Foruden en attraktiv garanteret minimumsgage tilbyder vi en firmabetalt pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring. Du bliver en del af et højt fagligt miljø, hvor der løbende er sparring med dedikerede og dygtige kolleger i hele landet i vores 19 erhvervscentre. For den rigtige person er der gode karrieremæssige udviklingsmuligheder og der vil også være mulighed for at blive partner.



Fondsejet virksomhed

EDC Poul Erik Bech er for størstedelens vedkommende ejet af en almennyttig fond. Via overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter Poul Erik Bech Fonden primært foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Vores ønske er at være en aktiv bidragsyder til det lokalsamfund, som vi er en del af. Læs mere om fonden på www.poulerikbechfonden.dk



Din ansøgning

Din ansøgning og CV bedes sendt til os via linket 'Søg stillingen', som du finder her på siden. Din ansøgning vil naturligvis blive behandlet fortroligt. 



Har du spørgsmål, eller vil du høre mere om jobbet er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of HR Jens Hein, mobil 3048 0320 eller jnh@edc.dk eller partner Sven Lyse, mobil 5360 5181 eller sly@edc.dk.

Om EDC Poul Erik Bech


Firmaet blev etableret i 1978, og er siden vokset til at blive Danmarks største og eneste landsdækkende ejendomsmæglervirksomhed. I dag består vi af flere end 77 boligbutikker og 19 erhvervscentre.


Vores mere end 600 dygtige medarbejdere gør hver dag en forskel - og yder en ekstra indsats for, at vores kunder får en god og ordentlig handel. 


EDC Poul Erik Bech er uafhængig af banker og realkreditinstitutter og er den eneste fondsejede mæglervirksomhed. Størstedelen af virksomheden er ejet af den almennyttige fond Poul Erik Bech Fonden. Gennem overskuddet fra mæglervirksomheden støtter fonden frivillige foreninger, der gør en forskel for udsatte børn. Hvis du vil læse mere om virksomheden, og hvordan vi er som arbejdsplads, så besøg os på vores karriereside, LinkedIn eller Facebook.

title: Praktijkbegeleider | Venray | 24 uur
description:
Maak verschil voor de zorgprofessional van morgen. Bij Vincent van Gogh geloven we in de kracht van leren, ontwikkelen en samen groeien. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste praktijkbegeleider die leerlingen en stagiaires, van verpleegkundige beroepsopleidingen en agogische beroepsopleidingen, ondersteunt in hun ontwikkeling tot zorgprofessionals. Wil jij bijdragen aan de toekomst van onze organisatie én van de zorg? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou

Wat ga je doen?

Als praktijkbegeleider begeleid je leerlingen en stagiaires binnen verpleegkundige en agogische opleidingen tijdens hun leertraject in de praktijk. Je bent een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt en helpt hen om het beste uit zichzelf te halen.

Daarnaast ondersteun en adviseer je leidinggevenden en werkbegeleiders bij de uitvoering van het opleidingsbeleid. Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit, stimuleert ontwikkeling en draagt actief bij aan een positief en leerzaam opleidingsklimaat.

Over de functie

We zoeken een praktijkbegeleider voor 24 uur per week. De omvang van het dienstverband hangt samen met de groei van het aantal leerlingen en stagiaires dat we de komende jaren willen begeleiden. Het aantal uren stemmen we af op deze ontwikkeling.

Wil je graag meer uren werken? Dan bieden we mogelijkheden om je contract uit te breiden, bijvoorbeeld in de functie van verpleegkundige of agogisch medewerker.

Jij bent een zelfstandige en betrokken professional die energie krijgt van het begeleiden en coachen van anderen. Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding (social work, hbo verpleegkunde). Bij voorkeur zijn we opzoek naar een verpleegkundige.

  • Het diploma Opleider in de Gezondheidszorg, of de bereidheid deze opleiding op korte termijn te volgen.

  • Kennis van wet- en regelgeving rondom beroepspraktijkvorming en de Wet BIG.

  • Ruime ervaring binnen de verpleegkundige en/of agogische praktijk.

  • Het vermogen om te reflecteren en anderen hierin te begeleiden.

  • Sterke sociale vaardigheden voor het coachen, beoordelen en ondersteunen van leerlingen, stagiaires, werkbegeleiders en het adviseren aan leidinggevenden.

  • Didactische vaardigheden waarmee je werkbegeleiders helpt groeien in hun rol.

  • Het talent om leerlingen en stagiaires en werkbegeleiders te motiveren, enthousiasmeren en waar nodig bij te sturen.

  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden.

Daarom kies jij voor Vincent van Gogh

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die groot durft te denken, maar dichtbij mensen blijft. We geloven in vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en samenwerken. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris volgens FWG 50 van de CAO GGZ. Het salaris bedraagt minimaal €3560 en maximaal €4716 o.b.v. 36 uur, afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, kennis en ervaring.

  • Volop mogelijkheden voor opleiding, ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei.

  • Een organisatie waarin professionals de ruimte krijgen om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

  • Een werkomgeving die continu in ontwikkeling is en openstaat voor nieuwe ideeën.

Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

Om goed voor anderen te kunnen zorgen, is het belangrijk dat er ook goed voor jou wordt gezorgd. Daarom bieden we primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en veel flexibiliteit.

Er is bij ons veel te kiezen, zoals werken in deeltijd en flexibel werken. Met FiscFree kun je leuke producten en diensten met 40% fiscaal voordeel aanschaffen. Andere voorbeelden van onze aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn 100% betaald zorgverlof, een collectieve zorgverzekering, ouderschapsverlof en goede regelingen voor pensioen en reiskosten.

Wat maakt Vincent van Gogh gewoon anders?

Als grootste ggz-organisatie in Noord-Limburg hebben we een rijke traditie in het behandelen en begeleiden van mensen met ernstige psychische en psychiatrische klachten. Dit doen we over een breed spectrum, klinisch en ambulant en steeds vaker bij mensen thuis of digitaal. Onze ambitie? Herstel is haalbaar, zeker met de juiste zorg, direct én duurzaam. In de eigen omgeving en samen met de cliënt, met naasten en andere betrokkenen binnen de keten en het netwerk. Hiervoor kent Vincent van Gogh elf zelfstandige eenheden, verspreid over heel Limburg.

Anders innoveren
Trots op onze historie, gaan we de uitdagingen van deze tijd volop aan. We werken aan innovaties die de cliënt echt centraal stellen, met hulp van technologie, ICT en e-health. Daarvoor zoeken we mensen die willen leren en bouwen aan een toonaangevende en innovatieve organisatie voor nieuwe ggz. Want het kan en moet gewoon anders.

Interesse?

Word jij enthousiast van deze functie en herken je jezelf in het profiel? Dan ontvangen we graag jouw cv en een korte motivatie.

Je kunt uiterlijk reageren tot en met 21 september 2026.

De sollicitatie zal plaatsvinden op 24 of 25 september.

Mocht je vragen hebben over de sollicitatieprocedure, dan kun je terecht bij Saqi van Elsen, corporate recruiter, via werken@vigogroep.nl.

title: Security Operations Engineer II
description:
Overview

The Cloud & AI organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Microsoft is one of the largest enterprise service companies in the world.

Security represents one of the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. The Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is accountable for managing and prioritizing cybersecurity risks for Microsoft. This team oversees the company’s overall cyber defense, including the security of Microsoft products and business operations, and collaborates with Engineering teams to advance Secure Future Initiative (SFI) objectives.

Security is a core priority for Microsoft, and strong Identity and Access Management protections are essential to protecting Microsoft at global scale. We are looking for an experienced Individual Contributor to join the IAM Protection team and drive security operations, remediation, and execution across identity platforms. This role combines identity security expertise, data-driven operational analysis, and program execution to identify and reduce security risks, strengthen governance, and improve the overall identity security posture. The role will work closely with Software Engineers and partner teams to translate security requirements into actionable engineering improvements, leveraging automation, telemetry, and tools such as Power BI and Azure DevOps to drive measurable outcomes and enable secure, scalable identity operations.



Responsibilities
  • Drive execution of identity security operations and remediation initiatives, partnering with Software Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and address security risks across identity platforms.
  • Conduct identity security assessments and track remediation across authentication, authorization, application identities, privileged access, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Analyze security posture, operational health, access risks, and remediation trends using telemetry, operational data, and enterprise reporting tools.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and executive-ready reporting that provide actionable visibility into security posture, remediation progress, risks, trends, and program outcomes.
  • Own tracking of security findings, dependencies, risks, exceptions, and remediation commitments from identification through closure, ensuring timely follow-through and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Software Engineers, security teams, and service owners to translate security requirements into actionable engineering work and drive adoption of secure identity practices.
  • Identify recurring security and operational issues and work with engineering teams to develop automation, tooling, and durable platform improvements that reduce manual effort and identity-related risk.
  • Support identity security incidents and operational investigations by coordinating technical analysis, remediation, root-cause analysis, and preventative actions.
  • Establish and improve operational processes, governance mechanisms, and metrics that strengthen identity security posture, compliance readiness, and execution predictability.
  • Independently manage multiple technical security initiatives, communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders, and influence partner teams to deliver committed security outcomes.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related technical field AND 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity, identity and access management, security operations, or a related technical field
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience with identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, application identities, privileged access, or identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience conducting security assessments, identifying risks, and driving remediation across complex technical environments.
  • Experience using data, Power BI, Excel, Azure DevOps, or similar tools to analyze security posture, track remediation, manage execution, and communicate actionable insights.
  • Experience independently driving multiple technical security initiatives and partnering with Software Engineering teams to manage dependencies, resolve risks, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, or other enterprise-scale identity platforms, with a strong understanding of cloud identity and access management.
  • Experience with cloud security, Zero Trust, identity governance, application identities, privileged access, or identity lifecycle security.
  • Experience developing automation, scripts, or operational tooling to improve security monitoring, remediation, reporting, or operational efficiency.
  • Experience analysing identity telemetry, security signals, and operational data, including supporting security incidents, root-cause analysis, and preventative remediation.
  • Experience driving cross-organizational security and governance initiatives involving engineering, security, compliance, application owners, and other technical stakeholders.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.



Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. description:
Farmakonom til Matas Rødovre Centrum - Matas
    

            
            
            
            
            
            
            




    


    


    



    

    

    

    
    

    

    


    

    


    









	

		

		        
				


				
				

					
					
				

			

		


	





                    


















    

        

            
            
        

        


    






    

    









    







	

		

		    


		    Farmakonom til Matas Rødovre Centrum
				


			

Vil du være en del af en af Danmarks mest kendte retailvirksomheder, hvor faglig rådgivning, stærke brands og gode kundeoplevelser er kernen i hverdagen?
I Matas møder vi hver dag kunder, der søger inspiration, tryghed og kompetent vejledning inden for skønhed, sundhed og personlig pleje. Som farmakonom bliver du en vigtig del af den oplevelse - og får mulighed for at bruge din faglighed i en hverdag med både salg, rådgivning og tæt kundekontakt.

Hos Matas bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab med høje ambitioner, dygtige kollegaer og masser af mulighed for at udvikle dig. Vi arbejder hver dag for at gøre det nemt og inspirerende for kunderne at træffe de rigtige valg - og vi leder efter dig, der vil være med til at løfte den opgave i vores butik i Rødovre Centrum.

Du får ansvar for rådgivning inden for hudpleje og sundhed
Som farmakonom i Matas får du en central rolle i vores særligt indrettede område for dermatologisk hudpleje og specialhudpleje. Her rådgiver du kunderne om produkter, rutiner og løsninger, der matcher deres behov - og du kan også tilbyde hudscanninger og konsultationer via matas.dk/booking.

Din vigtigste opgave er at møde kunden med faglighed, nærvær og god service. Samtidig trives du med salg og ser det som en naturlig del af god rådgivning at hjælpe kunden med at finde de rigtige produkter.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

rådgive og inspirere kunder inden for dermatologisk hudpleje, specialhudpleje og sundhed

sælge og rådgive om kosttilskud - gerne i tæt samarbejde med vores helse- og sundhedsrådgiver

tage ansvar for egne områder og bidrage til butikkens salgsmål

være med til at holde butikken præsentabel, indbydende og inspirerende

deltage i events, kundekonsultationer og salgsaktiviteter i butikken

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med udvikling og fællesskab
I Matas får du et job, hvor ikke to dage er helt ens. Du får mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil i mødet med kunderne, samtidig med at du bliver en del af en butik med højt tempo, god energi og et stærkt fællesskab.

Vi sørger for, at du løbende får ny viden gennem kurser og efteruddannelse, så du kan udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Du får indblik i produkter, salgsteknikker og nye trends - og du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi gerne vil lykkes sammen.

Hos Matas kan vi tilbyde dig:

løbende efteruddannelse og kurser inden for produkter, rådgivning og salg

et alsidigt job med stor variation og selvstændighed i hverdagen

et stærkt fællesskab med dygtige og engagerede kollegaer

gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling

en attraktiv arbejdsplads med høje ambitioner og fokus på kundeservice

Du er uddannet farmakonom og motiveres af kundemødet
For at komme i betragtning til stillingen er det et krav, at du er uddannet farmakonom. Vi forestiller os, at du har lyst til at bruge din faglighed i en salgs- og rådgivningsrolle, hvor du hver dag hjælper kunderne med at finde de produkter og løsninger, der passer bedst til deres behov.

Du er nysgerrig på hudpleje og sundhed, og du motiveres af at give kunderne en oplevelse, der gør en forskel. Branchekendskab er en fordel, men ikke et krav - det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tage ansvar og være en aktiv del af teamet.

Vi vil gerne høre fra dig, hvis du:

er uddannet farmakonom

har interesse for hudpleje, dermatologiske produkter og sundhed

er salgsorienteret og trives med kundekontakt

sætter en ære i at give kunderne god service og kompetent rådgivning

kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag med højt tempo

er positiv, selvstændig, fleksibel og en god teamplayer

er nysgerrig på at udvikle din faglighed og dine salgskompetencer

Vil du med på holdet i Matas Rødovre Centrum?
Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Vi inviterer løbende kandidater til samtale og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette. Vi håber, at vi snart kan byde dig velkommen som en del af teamet i Matas.


			

            
                Ansøg
            

			


    


    




		

			Om Matas Group
			

			
			 
Matas Group er nordisk leder inden for skønhed og velvære med en omsætning på +8 mia. kr., +500 butikker, +4.000 medarbejdere, +5 mio. loyalitetsmedlemmer og webshops i Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Finland. Matas Group opererer med to detailbannere på tværs af markederne: Matas i Danmark og KICKS i Sverige, Norge og Finland og tilbyder en bred portefølje af eksterne brands, egne brands og fokus på høj service, personlig- og ekspertrådgivning. Matas Group er noteret på Nasdaq OMX Copenhagen.
