Studentermedhjælper til Geoscience 



Er du studerende, og har du lyst til at bruge din faglighed i praksis?



Som studentermedhjælper i Geoscience bliver du en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at bidrage til konkrete opgaver og få indblik i arbejdet med Danmarks energisystem.



Om teamet og opgaverne



I Geoscience arbejder vi med planlægning og gennemførelse af undersøgelser af terræn, jordbund og havbund i forbindelse med Energinets anlægsprojekter. 

Vi søger en studentermedhjælper, der kan hjælpe med strukturering, registrering og kvalitetssikring af geodata.



Dine opgaver kan bl.a. være:



	
Oprydning, strukturering og kvalitetssikring af større mængder geodata 

	
Registrering og vedligeholdelse af digitale arkiver og databaser.

	
Indlæsning, kontrol og validering af data i GIS-databaser  

	
Udarbejdelse af digitale kort, tematiske visualiseringer samt bidrag til grundvandsscreeninger og vandhåndteringsplaner




Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra start. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, stille spørgsmål og bidrage med din faglighed og nysgerrighed.



Derfor skal du vælge Energinet



Som studentermedhjælper hos os får du mulighed for at koble teori og praksis og få erfaring fra en organisation, der arbejder med komplekse samfundsopgaver.



Du får bl.a.:



	
Relevant erfaring inden for geotekniske og geofysiske undersøgelser, forvaltning af geodata og GIS

	
Indblik i Energinets rolle i den grønne omstilling

	
Mulighed for sparring med erfarne kolleger

	
Opgaver, hvor du kan udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

	
Fleksibilitet i forhold til studie og eksamensperioder




Hvem forestiller vi os, du er?



Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en relevant uddannelse inden for geologi, geofysik eller et beslægtet fagområde. At du som minimum har afsluttet 4. semester på en relevant bacheloruddannelse. Det er også relevant, hvis du er i gang med de sidste semestre af en kandidatuddannelse.



Det kan fx være, at du læser:



	
Geologi / geofysik

	
Geoscience, jord- og miljøvidenskab eller lignende naturvidenskabelig uddannelse




Det er en fordel, hvis du har interesse for GIS, håndtering af geodata, databaser og datakvalitet, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære.



Vi lægger vægt på, at du:



	
Kan arbejde selvstændigt med dine opgaver

	
Er god til at stille spørgsmål og søge sparring

	
Har lyst til at bidrage til teamets opgaver

	
Kan omsætte din faglige viden til praksis




Rammer for jobbet



Stillingen er på 10 timer om ugen. 



Arbejdsstedet er Erritsø ved Fredericia, og du bliver en del af Geoscience i Energinet.

Vi tilrettelægger arbejdstiden med hensyn til dit studie og er opmærksomme på, at der kan være perioder, hvor eksamen og undervisning fylder mere.



Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel sammen med os?



Så glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV senest 15. september. Du er også velkommen til at vedlægge karakterudskrift. Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.



Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Senior Manager, Jan Søe Dybdal på tlf. 4295 6082 eller JASDY@energinet.dk .



Særlige forhold: Da Energinet løser samfundskritiske opgaver, udfører vi baggrundstjek forud for ansættelsen. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at dit baggrundstjek er foreneligt med ansættelse i Energinet. Baggrundstjekket gennemføres desuden én gang årligt.



 



Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle kvalificerede, uanset baggrund, til at søge jobbet. Vi arbejder aktivt og målrettet med mangfoldighed i Energinet og opfordrer dig derfor til at udelade billede, oplysninger om alder, civilstand og lignende, for at minimere ubevidste biases i processen. Du kan læse mere om vores mangfoldighedspolitik her.



Du bliver en del af Energinet Eltransmission A/S, der har til opgave at udvikle, bygge, eje og drive det nødvendige eltransmissionsnet, Herefter stilles det til rådighed for samfundet med den rette kapacitet, i den rette kvalitet, så omkostningseffektivt som muligt og således, at anlægget kan udnyttes optimalt og sikkert. Eltransmission sikrer optimal Asset Management ved at have fokus på anlæggenes samlede levetid - fra vugge til grav.




























Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.


For at lykkes med den opgave, skal vi have dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere. Derfor har vi skabt rammer, hvor udvikling prioriteres, nye idéer bliver taget alvorligt, og der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Vi kalder det Energi til mere, og du kan blive endnu klogere på det her

		    Brandvagt - Sjælland
				


			

Er du opmærksom, ansvarsbevidst og klar til at tage del i et vigtigt arbejde for sikkerheden? Så er jobbet som brandvagt måske noget for dig. Vi søger engagerede brandmænd til at indgå i vores team, hvor du får en central rolle i at forebygge brand og håndtere sikkerhedsopgaver på store, komplekse byggepladser på Sjælland.

SiteHub er en service- og teknologivirksomhed, som har specialiseret sig i effektiv byggepladslogistik. Det gør vi ved at kombinere byggepladslogistik og -drift med avanceret software- og hardwareteknologi, så vi øger sikkerheden og effektiviteten på byggepladsen og leverer de nødvendige data til brug for bygherrens compliance. 

SiteHub har travlt og søger flere nye kollegaer. Vi hjælper byggepladser med kvalificerede medarbejdere, der gerne vil bidrage til en professionel byggepladsdrift, samt påtage sig et dagligt ansvar for de opgaver, som du dagligt bliver stillet over for. Vi søger pt. brandmænd, der kan tage ansvar og være en vigtig del af et team på vores byggepladsprojekter på Sjælland. 

Om jobbet:

Som brandmand bliver du en del af et team, hvor du og dine kollegaer samarbejder om at løfte opgaven. Som brandmand vil dine opgaver blandt andet være:  

Overvåge aktiviteter med åben ild eller gnistdannelse og sikre brandforebyggelse

Identificere og overvåge potentielle brandfare

Deltage i koordineringen af brandvagtsteamet og -opgaverne

Udføre regelmæssige runderinger for at sikre, at alt er i brandsikker stand

Kontrollere, at brandslukningsudstyr er tilgængeligt og klar til brug

Sikre, at nødudgange og evakueringsveje er frie og tydeligt markerede

Være klar til at aktivere brandalarm og sikre hurtig kommunikation i tilfælde af brand

Assistere i sikker evakuering af personale og besøgende, hvis det bliver nødvendigt

Dokumentere sikkerhedsinspektioner og eventuelle hændelser

Om dig:

Vi søger funktionsuddannede brandvagter, som er mødestabile, selvkørende, ansvarsbevidste, opmærksomme og som altid er parat til at hjælpe en kollega ved behov. title: PEEQ søger for Rørby Johansen A/S - Kørselsdisponent til Entreprenørkørsel - Herlufmagle
description:
PEEQ søger for Rørby Johansen A/S - Kørselsdisponent til Entreprenørkørsel - Herlufmagle

Er du klar til et spændende job i en danskejet virksomhed transportvirksomhed, hvor du kan bidrage til en fremragende kundeservice og være med til at sikre en effektiv kørselsdisponering?

Om Rørby Johansen A/S

Vi er en familieejet virksomhed med base i Herlufmagle, som tilbyder et bredt udvalg af transportløsninger. Vores flåde tæller bl.a. 15 store kranbiler – herunder en af Danmarks største med en 600 t/m kran – samt over 35 lastbiler til entreprenørkørsel og maskintransport. Derudover har vi en omfattende beholdning af affaldscontainere og køreplader.

Hos os værdsætter vi høj kvalitet, godt samarbejde og en evne til at løse komplekse opgaver for vores kunder.

Om stillingen

Som kørselsdisponent hos Rørby Johansen bliver du en vigtig del af kundeservice- og logistikdriften. Udover de traditionelle opgaver inden for ordremodtagelse og tilbudsgivning vil du også være med til at sikre en optimal kørselsplanlægning for entreprenørvogne, samt kran og grab.

Erfaring fra en lignende stilling vil være en stor fordel. Da man vil side med egne biler samt indlejede vognmænd og du skal kunne håndtere mange bolde i luften samtidigt.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Modtage og håndtere og oprette ordrer fra vores kunder, både pr. telefon og elektronisk.
  • Kørselsdisponering for at optimere logistikken og sikre rettidige leverancer.
  • Sikre en høj kvalitet i kundeservice.
  • Rådgivning og vejledning af kunder.

Vi tilbyder dig

Hos Rørby Johansen bliver du en del af et stærkt team med fokus på faglighed og samarbejde.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et spændende job i en virksomhed, hvor det nogen gange går rigtigt stærkt.
  • En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og en uformel tone hvor der værnes om trivsel og ordentlighed.
  • God løn efter kvalifikationer, pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og imødekommende kolleger.
  • Arbejdssted på vores kontor i Herlufmagle.

Din profil

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Har solid erfaring med koordinering og kørselsdisponering.
  • Erfaring med kran og grab, er en stor fordel.
  • Har en god forretningsforståelse.
  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og har gode kommunikative evner.
  • Er god til at danne overblik, kan planlægge fremad og kan handle hurtigt, når det er nødvendigt.
  • Er en teamplayer og altid er klar til at hjælpe en kollega, når der er behov.
  • Er mødestabil, robust og selvkørende.

Søg stillingen:

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, indtil den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi opfordrer derfor dig til at søge hurtigst muligt, hvis du er interesseret i stillingen.

BEMÆRK: Vi kan ikke håndtere ansøgninger sendt pr. alm. mail, hvorfor du bedes anvende nedenstående link.

Peeq står for rekrutteringsprocessen til denne stilling. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Cecilie Dyhrberg hos Peeq på telefon +45 60 23 82 98.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

title: Engineer, Electrical Engineering
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Job's mission

Join a team that transforms ideas into real-world solutions. As an Electrical Engineer at ASM, you’ll contribute to the development and integration of advanced technologies that power the semiconductor industry. Your work will ensure our systems are designed, tested, and delivered with precision and purpose.

What you will be working on

  • Apply design engineering principles, product specifications and research data to create designs for systems and products for semiconductor industry.
  • Develop fail safe, cost effective designs for lower level sub-assemblies used in microprocessor controlled semiconductor equipment.
  • Integrate lower level assemblies to obtain a desired system level configuration.
  • Adapt digital and analog I/O requirements to achieve customer specific configurations.
  • Provide technical support for capital orders, expense projects, retrofits and development projects.
  • Evaluate engineering change requests and implement changes as necessary following established procedures and schedules.
  • Participate in design reviews prior to releasing new designs to production.
  • Support testing of hardware for cost reduction and product improvement projects to verify performance objectives. Design and build test equipment, support basic instrumentation with hardware, create test procedures, perform electro-mechanical tests as required and maintain reliability data and records of all evaluations performed.
  • Assess feasibility of product proposals, resolve technical issues, develop new systems, tools, and units while adhering to product design safety criteria.
  • Report generation, schedule creation and maintenance, and inter-team coordination.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum Bachelor or Master’s or PhD in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
  • Knowledge in equipment electrical hardware design or development of units/systems like Reactor or Plasma Source, etc.
  • Proficiency in Auto CAD technique and also in JMP
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment supporting a global customer base.
  • Clear communication skills in English

What sets you apart

  • A person with fundamental knowledge that enables learning about future processes and mechanisms.
  • A person with basic knowledge and aptitude to grow into a system engineer in the future.
  • A person who has the motivation to develop into a system engineer in the future.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager

Country/Region: Uganda

Location: Kasese

Organization: Save the Children International

Join us to lead sustainable change for children:

  • Be part of a GLOBAL and DIVERSE technical community
  • Get EXPOSURE in many different contexts
  • Test and scale up INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS
  • Influence policies that affect MILLIONS OF CHILDREN

OVERVIEW

Are you passionate about being an advocate for children? Do you want to use your expertise to bring about lasting change for children and be a part of an inspiring, dynamic global movement?

THE ROLE:

Reporting to the Regional Program Manager, the person provides technical assistance and oversight for aspects related to the Projects in the Field Location. The job holder provides overall programmatic and operational lead and management including; planning, implementation, capacity enhancement, monitoring/ evaluation and reporting both internally (within SCI) and externally (for/with partners). The person is accountable for overall coordination and oversight delivery of the projects across all the thematic areas of Education, Child Protection, Child Rights Governance and Disaster Risk Management, Youth Resilience in the field location. The job holder may be called upon as and when necessary to support the emergency team in cases of humanitarian crisis.

Sounds interesting? Read more below

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

Coordination and Strategic Management:
• Oversee the coordination and implementation of the projects across the operational area in line with the project designs and donor requirements.
• Create and sustain positive working relationships with the partners and other stakeholders.
• Plan and coordinate district level engagements with partners and key stakeholders.
• Monitor and ensure timely and quality reports are submitted as per the reporting requirements per project.
• Working closely with Technical Thematic Teams to ensure quality program delivery, documentation and reporting of progress.
Operational Planning
• Provide District level lead in planning, development of detailed implementation plans, phased budgets, implementation, monitoring, documentation and reporting.
• Overseeing the implementation and budget performance in line with the program plans and budgets
• Effectively support the projects staff and partners in developing annual plans, in line with project designs and Save the Children International planning guidelines.
• Support staff and partners to ensure that project plans are to the desired standards and on time.
• Prepare realistic and detailed implementation plans and phased budgets in collaboration with the relevant departments.
Finance and Budget Management
• Manage the Program budget in coordination with relevant financial team both in regional office and country office.
• Overseeing the budget performance to ensure that all project implementation in the operational area is on course as per the detailed implementation plans and phased budgets.
• Support project implementation teams with budget monitoring and reporting.
• Ensure that the budget monitoring reports are responded to in time and with accurate information.
• Working closely with the regional teams, to ensure that partners are well guided, supported and their capacity built in sound financial management procedures.
Program and Financial Reporting.
• Responsible and accountable for the preparation of timely and high-quality progress and end of project narrative and financial reports which are in accordance to the donor reporting schedule and formats.
• Review all program financial reports ensuring that donor guidelines have been followed and high standard met, prior to submission to management.
• Organize and facilitate quarterly follow-ups and progress review meetings to address key performance issues from the reports.
• Overall Budget Vs Actual analysis and variance explanations for all projects in the operational area.
• Share monthly Humanitarian situation reports with the RPM.
Internal, external engagements and Advocacy.
• Ensuring that the program experience is represented and given recognition at stakeholder meetings, workshops, donor, networks and any other engagements.
• Develop and maintain regular channels of communication with partners and key stakeholders at district level.
• Support advocacy and influencing engagements across the district, linking it with national level advocacy processes.
Technical Oversight
• In liaison with Technical Advisors and Field teams provide guidance and support to project team, partners and stakeholders.

Staff Performance Management

  • Ensure that all field staff understand and are able to effectively respond and manage emergencies.
  • Ensure the recruitment, training, development and growth of staff is appropriate and support professional development of staff.
  • Manage the performance of all the field location staff under his/her supervision.
  • Builds and maintains effective relationships, with their team and colleagues.
  • Manage the field team; defining expectations, provide leadership and seeking technical support as needed, and evaluate direct reports regularly.

Staff Safety and Security

  • Support and strengthen safety and security measures in the field location and minimize security lapses and occurrences
  • Develop and operationalise the field location Safety and Security Plan
  • Work with field-based office and staff to ensure that the staff and assets of Save the Children International are safe and secure.
  • Ensure that all safety and security minimum operating standards are met.
  • Coordinate the implementation of staff security guidelines and support periodic security assessment and reporting.
  • Provide periodic security up-dates to staff and escalate security incidences to the Regional Program Manager.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

To be a strong supporter and advocate for children in this role you will need to have;

  • Minimum of a Bachelors’ Degree in humanities. Experience in managing integrated programmes across different thematic areas such as education, child protection, child rights governance or disaster risk reduction is a must.
  • At least 5 years of accrued working experience in program implementation with a minimum of 3 years in a management level position in an international NGO and those applying partnership approaches is desirable.
  • Experience in strategic thinking and planning skills, be able to set priorities, prepare manageable plans and to evaluate progress.
  • Experience of working with local partners and District Local Government in Child Rights Governance, , Education, or Child Protection is an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills and strategic planning abilities.
  • Ability to establish and maintain conducive collegial relations and perform effectively as a member of a team.
  • Willingness to travel and work in hard-to-reach areas, occasionally under strenuous conditions.
  • Computer literacy and excellent documentation skills are a must.
  • Availability and willingness to work extra hours during times of humanitarian responses.
  • Highly developed cultural awareness and ability to work well in an international environment with people from diverse backgrounds and cultures
  • Ability to intervene with crisis management or troubleshooting as necessary.
  • Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills including influencing, negotiation and coaching
  • Excellent time management and planning capacity.
  • Availability and willingness to work extra hours during times of humanitarian responses.

Application Information:

Please apply using a cover letter and up-to-date CV as a single document not exceeding 5mbs to .. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations. We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.

Application closes on August 19, 2026, at midnight Uganda time.

Save the Children is an equal opportunity employer and seeks to employ and assign the best qualified talent, persons with disabilities and female candidates are encouraged to apply.

Disclaimer: Save the Children International does not charge any kind of fee at whichever stage of the recruitment process and does not act through recruitment agents.

OUR DIVERSITY BELIEF

Save the Children International is committed to create a truly inclusive, effective and representative organisational culture, encouraging equity and diversity among its employees and eliminating unlawful discrimination. We want our people to be truly representative of all sections of society. Having a diverse profile of employees, different age groups, backgrounds, cultures, disabilities, gender identities and expressions, sexual orientation etc., including a range of different experiences and capabilities helps us understand, represent and serve our beneficiaries better. We are guided by our values in everything we do, and recognise that being a diverse and inclusive employer helps us fulfil our responsibility to make a difference for children around the world.

description:
Lead Development Representative - EMEA, Asia and India 
 

 
        
         
 
    

    
 
          
 Copenhagen, Denmark

         Job Description 
         

        
 
  Lead Development Representative (Lead Generation)  

  Ready to launch or accelerate your sales career?  

   

  Are you ambitious, multilingual, curious, and motivated by connecting with people? Do you want to build a successful career in sales with a global technology leader? If so, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.  

   

  At Milestone Systems, we're looking for a motivated Lead Development Representative (LDR) to join our Global Lead Generation team. Whether you're starting your sales career or looking for your next step in business development, this role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop valuable commercial skills, gain international experience, and make a real impact on business growth.  

   

  As an LDR  , you will be primarily responsible for lead generation and qualification, with a particular focus on leveraging events and our website as lead sources.  You will   engage with potential customers and help to build the pipeline that drives our continued success. You'll work closely with sales and marketing teams across EMEA and APAC while developing the skills needed for a career in sales, business development, account management, or marketing.  

   

  Why join Milestone?  

  At Milestone, we believe our people are our greatest asset. When you join us, you'll become part of a collaborative, supportive, and high-performing culture where learning and development are actively encouraged.  

   

  You'll benefit from:  
 
  Comprehensive onboarding and training programme  

  Continuous coaching and mentoring from experienced sales professionals  

  Exposure to international markets and customers  

  A collaborative team environment where your ideas and contributions matter  

  The opportunity to work for the global leader in video management software  
 
   

  This is more than a lead generation role. It's an opportunity to build a strong foundation for a successful commercial career.  

   

  Join a team with high aspirations  

  You will become part of our Global Lead Generation team, a highly engaged and supportive group responsible for connecting Milestone with future customers.  

  We value teamwork, knowledge-sharing, innovation, and celebrating success together. From your first day, you'll be encouraged to contribute ideas, develop new skills, and take ownership of your career growth.  

   

  What you'll do  

  As a Lead Development Representative, you will be responsible for identifying and qualifying potential customers from inbound lead sources such as events and website enquiries and helping to drive business growth by delivering high-quality opportunities to our regional sales teams.  

   

  Your responsibilities will include:  
 
  Prospecting, researching, and identifying new leads by using a variety of approaches and through various channels, including cold calling, email outreach, social media, and networking.  

  While you won't have face-to-face customer interactions, you will have the opportunity to interact with customers over the phone and MS Teams, building relationships and providing valuable insights.     

  Identifying key decision makers within these prospects and determining the   potential of leads to the business.  Once leads are qualified, LDRs hand them off to the sales team for further engagement and closing.    

  Building rapport and understanding customer needs are essential to the LDR role utilising key customer service skills combined with sales techniques and strategies.  

  Lead Development representative will be required to manage their time effectively to meet targets and deadlines.   

  Engaging proactively with and coordinating with the sales team to develop and grow the sales pipeline.     

  Capturing all relevant information in Salesforce with strong attention to detail   when managing leads, tracking interactions, and maintaining accurate records.   

  Managing the team inbox to   support customer and partner enquiries   and route inquiries to the appropriate team.     

  Consistently achieving activity and qualification targets while delivering an excellent customer experience  
 
   

  What we're looking for  

  We are seeking ambitious, motivated individuals who thrive on connecting with people and are passionate about building a career in sales and marketing. We are especially interested in multilingual candidates who can support our diverse international customer base.  

  You may be a recent graduate looking to start your career, have experience in sales or customer service, or already be working in a business development role and ready to take the next step in your professional journey.  

   

  We'd love to hear from you if you have:  
 
  A strong interest in sales, business development, or customer engagement  

  Excellent communication skills and confidence speaking with customers in multiple languages  

  A curious mindset and willingness to learn  

  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail  

  Fluency in English is essential. Candidates who speak one or more additional EMEA languages alongside their native language will be given priority.  

  Resilience, persistence, and a positive attitude  

  The ability to manage multiple priorities and work towards targets  
 
   

  Additionally, the following would be advantageous:  
 
  Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, recruitment, or lead generation  

  Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce  
 
   

  Formal qualifications are helpful but not essential. We are more interested in your motivation, attitude, and potential to succeed.  

   

  About Milestone     

  When joining Milestone, you will become part of one the world’s leading providers of video management software in and beyond security. Since starting up in Denmark in 1998 our team has grown to include + 1,000 employees based in 25 countries. Today, our solutions are used in 500,000+ installations worldwide - with many more to come.     

  We believe that in addition to our strong and exciting technology, our success is also based on our dedication to putting people first - both the people we work with and the people around us. It’s how we grow our culture, our business, and our community. Because at Milestone, we grow together. Ready to elevate your career with an amazing team? Join Milestone. If you are curious to know more about who we are, we suggest you visit    http://milestonesys.com/career         

  Apply      

  Are you excited about this opportunity then we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously and the position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

title: German-Speaking Architect for International Bridge and Infrastructure Projects|Danske Arkitektvirksomheder | Brancheorganisation
description:
German-Speaking Architect for International Bridge and Infrastructure Projects 

         
        
 
          
 
            Opdateret 11.08.26
           

         

        
                    
   At Dissing+Weitling, we are looking for an experienced architect who is a native German speaker and fluent in spoken and written English to join our bridge and infrastructure projects in Germany.   
  You will become part of our Mobility team and play a key role in developing competition proposals at a high international level. Therefore, it is important that you have experience with German projects or have worked as an architect in Germany. Experience with bridge architecture, railway stations, or other infrastructure projects is an advantage, but not essential. As part of a practice working across both architecture and mobility, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to building projects over time.   We value flexibility and collaboration across disciplines.  
  About You  
  You are a highly skilled architect with a strong ability to sketch and develop concepts, combined with a solid understanding of detailing. You transform creative ideas into well-founded design solutions that balance architectural quality with technical feasibility. You have a keen eye for detail and see collaboration and professional dialogue with colleagues as a natural part of the design process. You are committed, ambitious, and motivated by creating winning competition proposals. The role also involves business development activities, so experience with client acquisition or business development would be an advantage.  

  We expect you to:    
 
    Hold a degree in Architecture.  

    Be a native German speaker and be fluent in spoken and written English.  

    Have experience developing competition concepts and strong design skills.  

    Have at least three years of professional experience in an architectural practice after graduation.  

    Be highly proficient in Rhino and Grasshopper.  

    Combine a structured approach with creativity.  

    Have a strong work ethic and a positive attitude towards your work.  
   About Us  
  We offer a highly professional environment, a strong team culture, and a wide variety of projects. We design all types of bridges—in every kind of landscape and across much of the world—from the award-winning Bicycle Snake (Cykelslangen) in Copenhagen to the recently completed Queen Margrethe II Bridge.  

  In addition, we have a long tradition of designing and delivering headquarters, hotels, residential developments, and industrial architecture, as well as restoring and transforming the built cultural heritage.  

  We are an architectural practice of approximately 40 employees, based at Islands Brygge in Copenhagen. Our open, transformed studio provides an environment that encourages close professional collaboration, where architects from different disciplines and nationalities work together in a culture where emerging talents and experienced architects learn from one another.  

  Our practice has its roots in Arne Jacobsen's architectural studio, and we continue to build on this strong design heritage, which remains the foundation of our architectural approach.  

  This is a full-time position.  

  Please send your application, CV, and portfolio to    job@dw.dk   , quoting "German-Speaking Architect" in the subject line, as soon as possible.  

  We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Kontorelev til Semler Mobility i Køge Joboplysninger | SEMLER
description:
Kontorelev til Semler Mobility i Køge
     
                         
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Job ID: 
         

     4565
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 
         Sted: 
         

     
			
 

					 Køge, DK, 4600
					 
			 


			
     
                 

             

         

     

    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
                 
 Leder du efter en elevplads, hvor du får ansvar fra dag ét, lærer en masse nyt og bliver en del af et stærkt team med god energi?  


   


 Hos Semler Mobility i Køge søger vi en kontorelev med speciale i administration til opstart den 1. november 2026. Har du lyst til at lære, tage initiativ og blive en vigtig del af vores hverdag, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter. Her får du ikke bare en uddannelse. Du får praktisk erfaring, ansvar og mulighed for at blive en del af en af Danmarks største bilkoncerner. 


   


 Din elevtid hos os
 Som kontorelev hos Semler Mobility får du et spændende uddannelsesforløb med masser af læring, ansvar og udvikling. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, og hvor du får mulighed for at prøve kræfter med mange forskellige opgaver. 


   


 Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være: 

 

 Administrative opgaver inden for økonomi, herunder udarbejdelse af kasserapporter og kontering af fakturaer. 


 Administration af nummerplader, bilbeskatning samt koordinering af virksomhedens udlejningsbiler. 


 Kundekontakt via telefon, modtagelse og viderestilling af henvendelser 


 Diverse administrative ad hoc-opgaver 


 Daglig vedligeholdelse af vores kundeventeområder, herunder kaffemaskiner, blade og aviser. 


 Koordinering af aktiviteter i personaleforeningen, herunder arrangementer, jubilæer og løbende administrative opgaver. 

 

   


 Uddannelsen varer to år med base i Køge. I ferieperioder vil du også hjælpe i vores afdeling i Ringsted ved behov. Som en naturlig del af elevforløbet deltager du desuden i den obligatoriske skoleundervisning. 


   


 Hvem er du?
 Du har enten afsluttet EUX eller HHX, eller du har en HTX-, STX- eller HF-uddannelse suppleret med et 5 ugers EUS-forløb. 


   


 Måske har du allerede erfaring fra et fritidsjob, kundeservice eller butik. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, har lyst til at lære og ikke er bange for at tage initiativ. 


   


 Vi forestiller os, at du: 

 

 Trives med kundekontakt og samarbejde. 


 Er struktureret og kan holde styr på flere opgaver samtidig. 


 Er positiv og klar på nye udfordringer. 


 Har erfaring med Microsoft Office-pakken, herunder Word, Excel og Teams. 


 Er god til at formulere dig på dansk, både mundtligt og skriftligt. 


 Har kørekort. 

 

   


 Hvorfor vælge Semler Mobility? 
 Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi vægter både faglig og personlig udvikling højt. Du får dygtige kolleger, som gerne deler deres viden. 


   


 Vi tilbyder blandt andet: 

 

 En elevuddannelse med masser af ansvar og læring. 


 Gode karrieremuligheder efter endt uddannelse. 


 Et socialt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø. 


 Pension, sundhedssikring og attraktive medarbejderfordele. 


 Mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed med mere end 3.200 kolleger. 

 

   


 Hvad kan du forvente af mig som leder?
 Jeg arbejder målrettet og fokuseret mod resultater - med tydelige forventninger og klare prioriteringer. 


   


 Du får frihed under ansvar - med løbende opfølgning og konkret feedback. Jeg har fokus på din udvikling og på, at vi skaber rammerne for at lykkes sammen i et team. 


   


 Ordentlighed vægter jeg højt og sætter pris på, at du tager initiativ, stiller spørgsmål og bidrager aktivt, så vi sammen skaber de bedste løsninger. 


   


 Klar til at søge?
 Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag via "Ansøg nu". Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat. Opstart er den 1. november 2026. 


   


 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Helle N. Nielsen på telefon +45 24 41 87 45. 


   


 Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!  

                 
     
                 

             

         

     

    
 
        
 
            
 
                
 

     
     
                 

             

         

     


    
 
        
 
         

     

                                         

                                        
 
    
    
 
        
   
         

     

    
 
        
  

     

    
    
 
        
   Din vej. Fælles fremtid  


 Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.   



 At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.  



 Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.   



 Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi opererer i.   



 Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.   



 Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.  



 Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Lagermedarbejder til nyt ostelager i Vinderup - Thise Mejeri hos Thise Mejeri
description:
Lagermedarbejder til nyt ostelager i Vinderup - Thise Mejeri hos Thise Mejeri





  



























































































































 Lagermedarbejder til nyt ostelager i Vinderup - Thise Mejeri




Vi søger nye kolleger til lageret i Vinderup, som er en del af Thise Mejeri's nyopstartede ostelager, hvor vi hver dag håndterer og sender økologiske oste ud til hele Danmark - og udlandet. 

Som en del af lageret bliver du en vigtig brik i den sidste del af osteproduktionen, hvor kvalitet, præcision og godt humør er grundstenene i vores arbejde.




 Om jobbet og dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af lagerteamet i Vinderup ostelager og du vil være med til, at starte det op sammen med dygtige kollegaer og teamleder Jan Lundhus. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver at vende oste i kasser og på reoler med brug af moderne udstyr. Du er den der læsser og losser lastbiler som køre til og fra lageret og du formår, at holde styr på lageret, så det står rent og præsentabelt.   
Da vi arbejder med fødevarer, er hygiejne og kvalitet altid i fokus - det går vi aldrig på kompromis med. Vi er alle med til at sikre høj hygiejne og kvalitet i alle led af produktionen. 
Arbejdet foregår primært på daghold i tidsrummet mandag-fredag 6.00-14.00. Ved spidsbelastninger, fx i forbindelse med kampagner, kan der efter aftale forekomme natarbejde eller weekendarbejde.




 Om dig

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar for kvaliteten og strukturen på lageret og trives i en hverdag, hvor du kan arbejde selvstændigt. 

Vi forestiller os, at du:


Har blik for kvalitet og forstår vigtigheden af hygiejne i en fødevareproduktion


Har truckcertifikat, og at du selvstædigt kan læsse og losse lastbiler


Har erfaring med fødevarefremstilling, processtyring eller fra fødevarebranchen, men det er ikke et krav





 Vi tilbyder


Et job i en virksomhed i konstant udvikling



Kolleger, der sætter en ære i deres arbejde og hver dag kæmper for gode resultater


Mulighed for at arbejde med kvalitetsbevidste produkter, der er kendt og værdsat i hele Danmark





 Vil du med på holdet?

Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt på linket herunder 'Ansøg her' - vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Jan Lundhus Jensen på +45 27 79 04 02 eller mail jl@thise.dk.




 Thise - Mejeri med passion

Læs mere om vores værdier her: Vores værdier på Thise


















































































Thise mejeri er beliggende i det skønne Salling med tæt kontakt til naturen og fjorden men samtidig også tæt på byer som Skive, Holstebro og Viborg. På mejeriet forarbejder vi ca. 160 millioner kg. mælk, som vi konverterer til Thise friskmælk, Vesterhavsost, Thise smør, Skyr, yoghurt og mange andre lækre mejeri produkter. Vi er 300 engagerede medarbejdere på mejeriet.

title: Executive
description:
Donation Accounting and Compliance Specialist


Summary

We are seeking a meticulous Donation Accounting and Compliance Specialist to manage the financial integrity of our fundraising operations. This pivotal role focuses on the accurate recording, verification, and reconciliation of donor contributions. The successful candidate will ensure strict adherence to regulatory standards while maintaining comprehensive financial records, facilitating seamless communication between finance and relationship management teams, and supporting the overall transparency of our donation ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Record Keeping: Accurately log all donation transactions by cross-referencing bank statements with supporting documentation to ensure data integrity.
  • Donor Verification: Validate donor Permanent Account Numbers (PAN) via the TRACES portal, ensuring all donor profiles meet current regulatory compliance standards and resolving any data inconsistencies.
  • Receipt Processing: Generate and distribute official donation receipts to contributors, maintaining a precise log of all issued documents and recording these entries within the Tally accounting system.
  • Bank Data Coordination: Provide daily bank statement updates to the Relationship Management team and assist in tracking donation inflows across multiple collection channels.
  • Reconciliation Assistance: Support the reconciliation of funds collected through various fundraising platforms and perform periodic audits to align donor records, bank receipts, and general ledger entries.
  • Documentation Management: Organize and maintain comprehensive donor files, including Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs), correspondence, and financial records, ensuring efficient filing and retrieval processes.
  • Operational Flexibility: Execute additional job-related tasks and instructions as directed by supervisors to support organizational goals.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Overview

With the rapid acceleration of AI and the need to deliver trustworthy, high-performing models, Microsoft's Commercial Business & AI (CEAI) Data Science and AI Engineering Platform team are driving innovation at scale! Our mission is to advance AI capabilities through rigorous evaluations, fine-tuning, and large-scale experimentation to create intelligent, personalized experiences for customers worldwide. The CEAI Data Science and AI Engineering Platform team is seeking passionate full stack developers and AI practitioners to join agile, cross-functional teams working on cutting-edge model evaluation frameworks, optimization pipelines, and experimentation platforms that power Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

We are looking for a Software Engineer II (Full Stack with AI) to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications while leveraging modern AI technologies to build intelligent, enterprise-grade solutions. This role combines good full-stack engineering expertise with practical experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered application development.

The right candidate is passionate about building end-to-end applications, integrating AI capabilities into business workflows, and delivering secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar, ensuring good user experience.
  • Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using technologies such as C#, .NET, Python, Java, or Node.js.
  • Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring performance, scalability, and data integrity.
  • Build and deploy cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure services including App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Service Bus, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Integrate Generative AI capabilities into applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Develop AI-powered features such as chatbots, copilots, intelligent search, document processing, recommendation systems, and workflow automation.
  • Build and integrate AI agents capable of planning, tool calling, memory management, and enterprise workflow automation.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization using Azure Active Directory, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and role-based access control.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions and automate testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver high-quality software.
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code following engineering good practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, performance optimization, debugging, production support, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Apply Responsible AI principles while designing AI-powered applications, ensuring fairness, privacy, security, compliance, and governance.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies in cloud computing, AI, software architecture, and modern development practices.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field
  • OR equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Full Stack Development

    • 4+ years of professional software development experience.
    • Good experience in one or more programming languages:
      • C#
      • .NET
      • Python
      • Java
      • JavaScript/TypeScript
    • Experience building frontend applications using:
      • React
      • Angular
      • Vue.js (optional)
    • Experience developing backend RESTful APIs and microservices.
    • Hands-on experience with Azure data platforms, including Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric.
    • Experience working with SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases.
    • Good understanding of software architecture, design patterns, object-oriented programming, and distributed systems.

Cloud & DevOps

    • Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
    • Hands-on experience with:
      • Azure App Service
      • Azure Functions
      • Azure SQL
      • Azure Storage
      • Azure Service Bus
      • Azure Event Hub
      • Azure Key Vault
      • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
      • Docker
      • Kubernetes
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
    • Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.

AI & Intelligent Applications

    • 1–3+ years of experience working with Generative AI technologies.
    • Experience integrating OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or other LLM platforms into enterprise applications.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Instructor: Machine Learning Data Associate based in Romania.

This is an opportunity to lead engaging, high-impact virtual learning experiences for diverse audiences developing skills in machine learning and AI data workflows. You will deliver live technical instruction in German while collaborating professionally in English with program and operations teams. The role combines technical expertise, instructional leadership, and the ability to make complex AI concepts practical and accessible. You will help learners understand how data labeling influences machine learning systems, generative AI, multimodal models, and applied AI workflows. Sessions may range from smaller groups to audiences of thousands of learners in a highly interactive online environment. You will also contribute to curriculum refinement and continuous course improvement. This is a part-time contract position with a remote setup and scheduled sessions aligned with the EST/CEST time zones.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and facilitate live virtual classes for diverse learner groups, potentially ranging from 100 to more than 8,000 participants, while maintaining strong engagement and an effective learning environment.
  • Deliver technical instruction in German on machine learning data workflows, generative AI, foundation models, prompt engineering, RAG, multimodal AI, responsible AI, and related concepts.
  • Explain how data collection, annotation, labeling decisions, model training, evaluation, and deployment are connected, helping learners understand the downstream impact of their work.
  • Manage virtual classroom dynamics, including Q&A, chat activity, pacing, learner engagement, and timely delivery of planned content.
  • Adapt instructional approaches, explanations, and lesson pacing to accommodate learners with different backgrounds and levels of technical understanding.
  • Prepare thoroughly for each lecture and ensure that technical content is delivered accurately, clearly, and in an accessible manner.
  • Collaborate with program and operations teams in English to support smooth delivery, communicate updates, escalate issues, and maintain alignment on schedules and learner needs.
